jobs.title: AI Implementation Strategist — Enterprise Deployment
jobs.description: **AI Implementation Strategist — Enterprise Deployment** ======================================================== **Level:** Senior Individual Contributor; exact title and level flexible based on experience ### **About the Role** Logical Intelligence is building a new class of AI reasoning systems designed to solve complex problems under real\-world constraints. We’re looking for a highly technical, hands\-on AI Implementation Strategist to bridge our research and engineering teams with strategic enterprise customers. You’ll work directly with customers to understand difficult technical problems, identify where our technology can create value, and take use cases from initial discovery through pilot and production. This is a hands\-on IC role for someone who wants to stay deep in the day\-to\-day work rather than manage a team. ### **What You’ll Do** * **Technical Discovery \& Architecture:** Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their technical environments and translate complex problems into AI use cases, architectures, integrations, and measurable success criteria. * **Pilot\-to\-Production Deployment:** Scope and drive technical pilots and integrations, helping customers move from early experimentation to production. * **Research\-to\-Customer Bridge:** Work closely with Logical Intelligence research and engineering teams to solve deployment challenges and bring customer learnings back into the product. * **Technical Customer Leadership:** Build credibility with technical and business stakeholders and guide customers through ambiguous, high\-value AI initiatives. * **Commercial Expansion:** Combine technical depth with commercial judgment to identify valuable use cases and help successful deployments grow into long\-term enterprise relationships. ### **What We’re Looking For** * Strong technical foundation in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or another quantitative discipline * Hands\-on experience deploying complex software, data, ML, or AI systems with enterprise customers * Strong understanding of modern AI/software architectures and the ability to engage deeply with technical teams * Experience translating ambiguous customer problems into concrete technical requirements and deployment plans * Experience taking pilots or proofs of concept toward production * Comfortable working directly with both engineers and senior customer stakeholders * Strong ownership mentality and comfort operating in an early\-stage environment where the playbook is still being built Experience in **industrial, chemistry, materials, energy, manufacturing, scientific computing, or other technically complex domains** is especially valuable. Management consulting or forward\-deployed experience is a plus, but not required. We expect many strong candidates to have approximately **8\+ years of experience**, but technical depth, hands\-on execution, and demonstrated impact matter more than a specific number of years. logicalintelligence.com

jobs.title: Chief Scientist
jobs.description: **The Opportunity:** Lead deep\-water ecological research from an operational offshore platform. MARÉ provides what academic labs often lack: a dedicated ROV fleet, a 20\-year benthic imagery archive, and a skilled engineering and video processing team ready to turn field operational data into high\-impact peer\-reviewed science. **Position Overview:** Since 2003, Marine Applied Research \& Exploration (MARÉ) has been putting (robotic) eyes on the seafloor below diver depth \- typically in the mid\-depth 30m to 500m range. We are seeking a Chief Scientist to serve as MARÉ’s primary scientific authority, driving our research agenda across mesophotic ecosystems, deep\-sea coral/sponge communities, and seamount ecology along the North American West Coast, the Gulf of Mexico, and beyond. This is an applied research and expedition leadership role designed for an active marine ecologist. Rather than managing bureaucracy or driving advocacy campaigns, you will focus on high\-caliber science: acting as Chief Scientist on multi\-week offshore ROV missions, publishing peer\-reviewed research, collaborating closely with video processing and engineering teams to modernize ocean data extraction, and building scientific partnerships across North American and global deep\-sea networks (including NOAA, state fisheries departments, and academic research institutions). **Key Responsibilities:** * **Expedition Leadership \& Field Science:** Plan, direct, and serve as Chief Scientist on multi\-week offshore ROV expeditions, overseeing cruise track design, dive planning, biological sampling protocols, and real\-time dive scientific reporting. Survey Design \& Rigor: Establish and maintain robust scientific sampling standards and QA/QC protocols for all video\-derived transects, bathymetric characterizations, and oceanographic data collections. Permitting \& Compliance: Lead scientific permitting processes for state, federal, and international offshore operations in collaboration with operations staff. * **Scientific Research \& Collaborative Publishing:** Author and co\-author high\-impact research papers in peer\-reviewed journals, positioning MARE’s long\-term observational datasets within broader oceanographic and ecological literature. Archive Science: Tap into MARE’s extensive 20\-year imagery archive to identify novel research questions, historical baseline comparisons, and ecological trends in mesophotic and seamount communities. * **External Scientific Synthesis and Conference/Network Visibility:** Serve as the primary technical point of contact for external scientific collaborators (e.g., NOAA Deep Sea Coral Research and Technology Program, state agency scientists, university partners), facilitating open data exchange and joint proposal writing. Present research findings at major national and international ocean science conferences and represent MARÉ in deep\-sea working groups. Developing opportunities for collaboration with other mission\-aligned NGOs and topic\-aligned academic institutions. * **Data Modernization \& Technical Collaboration:** Work closely with MARÉ’s internal video processing team and software engineer to refine species identification pipelines, taxonomy keys, and biological database structures (SQL/GIS), working with them to continuously improve the speed and quality of marine data processing workflows with the latest technological advancements. Collaborate with scientific partners to integrate MARÉ data into larger data systems. **Qualifications:** Required Experience: * Ph.D. in Marine Biology, Biological Oceanography, Marine Ecology, or a closely related discipline. Deep\-Water Expertise: Demonstrated research focus and publication record in mesophotic (30m–150m), deep sea coral, seamount, or benthic ecology below diver depth. * Sea Time \& ROV Experience: Proven track record serving as Chief Scientist, Co\-Chief, or Lead PI on multi day/multi\-week offshore research cruises involving ROVs, submersibles, or advanced benthic survey platforms. * Analytical \& Spatial Skills: Strong quantitative background in ecological statistics, spatial analysis (GIS), and handling large observational or imagery\-derived ecological datasets. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and an action\-orientation to turn exploration into rigorous and relevant scientific research into pragmatic conservation and restoration outcomes. * Work Authorization: Candidates must be currently authorized to work in the United States and not require current or future employer sponsorship. Preferred Experience: * ROV piloting and/or navigating experience. * Familiarity with Eastern Pacific (North American West Coast) mid\-depth ecosystems.. * Established scientific network with federal agencies (NOAA Fisheries / Sanctuaries), state marine resource agencies, or deep\-sea research consortia. * Demonstrated success in writing or co\-authoring scientific grant proposals (e.g., NOAA, NSF, state research grants, or research foundations). * Experience with machine learning tools for ocean imagery processing (e.g., automated species classification, 3D habitat reconstruction). **How to Apply:** * Please send to MARÉ Executive Director, Larissa Pommeraud () a cover letter detailing your motivation and availability (time and office presence) with your offshore ROV/expedition leadership experience and research interests, as well as a complete CV with publication list, and contact information for 2\-3 professional references. Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $115,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * How soon could you start? Education: * Doctorate (Required) Experience: * mid\-depth marine ecology field research and analysis: 3 years (Required) Ability to Relocate: * Blue Lake, CA 95525: Relocate before starting work (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description: We're Hiring: Chief Technology Officer (CTO) **Company:** ETDOX **Position:** Chief Technology Officer (CTO) **Location:** Remote / Hybrid / On\-site (To be finalized) **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Experience:** 7–12\+ years preferred **Compensation:** Competitive salary / Equity (Based on experience and engagement) About ETDOX ETDOX is an ambitious, technology\-driven company focused on building innovative AI\-powered solutions that help businesses automate processes, improve operational efficiency, and accelerate digital transformation. We aim to develop intelligent, scalable, and impactful technology solutions that solve real\-world business challenges. We are looking for a visionary yet hands\-on **Chief Technology Officer (CTO)** who can take ownership of our technology strategy, lead product engineering, and help establish ETDOX as a competitive player in the AI and technology ecosystem. Role Overview As the CTO of ETDOX, you will be responsible for defining and executing the company's technology vision, building scalable technical infrastructure, overseeing AI product development, and leading the engineering function. This is a strategic leadership position that also requires strong hands\-on technical capabilities, especially during the company's early growth stages. You will work closely with the founder and leadership team to transform business ideas into robust, secure, commercially viable technology products. Key Responsibilities1\. Technology Strategy \& Leadership * Define and execute ETDOX's overall technology roadmap. * Align technology decisions with business objectives and growth plans. * Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities for innovation. * Establish technical standards, engineering processes, and development best practices. * Provide technical leadership for long\-term product and platform development. 2\. AI \& Product Development * Lead the architecture, design, and development of AI\-powered applications and automation solutions. * Oversee integration of LLMs, generative AI, AI agents, and machine learning capabilities. * Build scalable AI systems using modern frameworks and APIs. * Develop strategies for AI model evaluation, optimization, and deployment. * Ensure product quality, reliability, performance, and security. 3\. Engineering \& Infrastructure * Design and maintain scalable backend systems, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure. * Oversee cloud deployments using AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Implement CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, DevOps, and infrastructure automation. * Establish cybersecurity, data protection, and disaster recovery practices. * Optimize infrastructure costs and system performance. 4\. Team Building \& Management * Recruit, mentor, and lead software engineers, AI developers, and technical specialists. * Build a high\-performance engineering culture focused on ownership and innovation. * Define development workflows, sprint planning, and delivery milestones. * Manage external technology partners and development vendors when required. 5\. Business \& Strategic Collaboration * Collaborate directly with the founder on product strategy and business expansion. * Translate client requirements into scalable technical solutions. * Support technical discussions with enterprise clients, strategic partners, and potential investors. * Evaluate build\-versus\-buy decisions and third\-party integrations. * Contribute to product differentiation and ETDOX's long\-term competitive advantage. Required Qualifications * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 7\+ years of experience in software engineering, including technical leadership responsibilities. * Proven experience architecting and delivering scalable SaaS platforms, AI products, or enterprise software. * Strong proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or other modern development languages. * Practical experience with LLMs, generative AI, RAG architectures, AI agents, and AI API integrations. * Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, microservices, databases, APIs, and distributed systems. * Experience managing engineering teams and taking products from concept to production. * Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving skills, and business understanding. Preferred Qualifications * Previous experience as a CTO, VP of Engineering, Engineering Lead, or Technical Co\-founder. * Experience building technology products in an early\-stage startup. * Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks. * Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS architecture and enterprise integrations. * Understanding of AI governance, data privacy, and compliance. * Experience scaling products for international customers. * Exposure to fundraising, technical due diligence, and investor discussions. What We're Looking For We are seeking someone who is: * **A builder:** Comfortable writing code, architecting systems, and shipping products. * **A strategic thinker:** Able to connect technology decisions with business outcomes. * **An AI enthusiast:** Deeply interested in practical applications of artificial intelligence. * **A leader:** Capable of building and inspiring an exceptional technical team. * **An owner:** Willing to take responsibility for technology from ideation to execution. * **Startup\-minded:** Adaptable, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment. Key Success Metrics During the first 6–12 months, success in this role may include: * Establishing a clear technology and product roadmap. * Building and launching production\-ready AI solutions. * Creating a secure, scalable, and cost\-efficient technical architecture. * Recruiting and developing a capable core engineering team. * Improving product development speed and deployment reliability. * Supporting successful enterprise client implementations. Why Join ETDOX? * Opportunity to shape the technology vision of a growing AI\-focused company. * Direct collaboration with the founder and involvement in major business decisions. * Ownership of technical architecture, product innovation, and engineering strategy. * Opportunity to build AI products with meaningful real\-world applications. * Potential for long\-term leadership growth and equity participation, depending on the agreed compensation structure. How to Apply Interested candidates should share their updated resume, LinkedIn profile, and relevant portfolio or GitHub projects, along with a brief introduction highlighting their experience building and scaling technology products. **Subject:** Application for CTO – ETDOX *Join ETDOX and help build the next generation of intelligent business technology.* Pay: $1,000\.00 \- $10,000\.00 per month Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Professional development assistance * Referral program Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Troveo** Troveo builds the data platform that AI labs and model builders need to train the next generation of models. We have created the world's largest licensed platform of scarce, proprietary data for AI, spanning video, audio, text, and business workflows. Troveo indexes, enriches, and packages this high\-quality data into formats ready for training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, and agentic use cases. Backed by top investors, we’re a small, high\-impact team solving one of the biggest bottlenecks in AI development. **Role Overview** We are seeking a versatile, hands\-on Data Engineer to build and maintain a scalable analytics data warehouse while contributing to data modeling, performing data analysis, and ensuring reliable data delivery to downstream teams and systems. This hybrid role combines core data engineering responsibilities with data modeling, analytics, and operational support. You will own the full analytics data lifecycle, from ingestion and transformation to modeling, quality assurance, and timely delivery, while partnering closely with software engineers and business stakeholders. **Key Responsibilities** Data Pipeline Engineering * Design, build, and maintain ELT/ETL data pipelines (batch and streaming), optimizing for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost. * Design and implement conceptual, logical, and physical data models (including dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas). * Build and maintain transformation layers using modern tools (e.g., dbt) to create clean, well\-documented, analytics\-ready datasets. * Apply data modeling best practices, versioning, testing, and documentation to ensure consistency and reusability. Data Analysis \& Reporting Support * Write optimal SQL queries for data exploration, ad\-hoc analysis, and troubleshooting. * Support the creation of reports, dashboards, and self\-service analytics assets in collaboration with data analysts and business teams. * Translate business questions into data requirements and deliver actionable insights or datasets. Operational Support \& Data Deliveries * Monitor data pipelines and data delivery processes to ensure SLAs for timeliness, freshness, and accuracy are consistently met. * Proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data issues impacting downstream consumers or business operations. * Manage incidents related to data availability and quality; participate in on\-call rotations as needed. * Implement data quality checks, observability, and alerting to maintain high reliability of data deliveries. * Automate operational tasks and continuously improve data delivery processes. Collaboration \& Best Practices * Work cross\-functionally with analysts, data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver solutions. * Document data pipelines, models, lineage, and processes. * Contribute to data governance, security, and best practices across the data platform. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related role (analytics engineering experience is highly relevant). * Strong proficiency in SQL and Python. * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines and working with cloud data platforms/warehouses. (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, etc.). * Experience with data orchestration tools (Apache Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or similar). * Solid understanding of data modeling techniques and dimensional modeling. * Experience performing data analysis and working with BI/visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar). * Proven ability to troubleshoot data issues and support operational reliability/SLAs. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Bonus Points** * Experience with DBT for data transformation and modeling. * Knowledge of data observability/monitoring tools. * Experience with real\-time/streaming data technologies (Kafka, Flink, etc.). * Familiarity with CI/CD practices for data pipelines. * Experience in data quality frameworks and governance. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience). **Compensation** * **Base Salary**: $160,000 – $175,000 (depending on experience and location) * **Equity**: Competitive equity package in a well\-funded AI startup with significant upside **What We Offer** * **Comprehensive Health Benefits**: Medical, dental, and vision coverage (100% employer\-paid for employees) * **Flexible PTO \& Paid Holidays**: Unlimited PTO with encouragement to actually use it * **Remote\-First Policy**: Work from anywhere in the US (with occasional team offsites) * **Learning \& Growth**: Annual learning stipend, access to top conferences, and direct mentorship from experienced founders * **Equity Ownership**: Competitive equity package with clear growth potential as we scale * **Modern Tech Stack \& Tools**: Budget for the best equipment and software * **Strong Culture**: High\-trust, low\-ego environment focused on impact, transparency, and work\-life balance. We believe great work happens when people are supported, challenged, and given ownership. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Troveo is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Ingestion Platform
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Product and Data **Compensation** ---------------- * $155K – $165K • Offers Equity Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading\-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real\-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform. **The Role** ------------ Alt Value is our moat. It is only as good as the data underneath it — and that data lives on dozens of external marketplaces and auction houses that have no interest in making it easy for us to get. That's this job. You own the pipelines that scrape, normalize, and land every transaction and listing that feeds our pricing model. When a comparable sale closes on eBay or at a major auction house, how fast it shows up in Alt Value, and whether it shows up correctly, is your call and your consequence. Pricing decisions, cash advance terms, market analytics, and every dashboard in the company sit downstream of you. **The metric you own: Data Coverage.** Supporting KPIs are pipeline latency, uptime, and source coverage. **What You'll Own:** -------------------- * **The ingestion layer.** Design, optimize, and own the pipelines that scrape, process, and ingest transaction and listing data from major auction houses and marketplaces. Scraper to orchestrator to warehouse, end to end. * **Build for reuse first.** Most of the ingestion stack — auth handling, retries, session and proxy management, monitoring — should generalize across sources. Go deep and custom only where a specific source's structure actually requires it. * **Knowing before we do.** Build the monitoring and alerting that tracks latency, uptime, and coverage across every source. A source going quiet should page you, not surprise a pricer three days later. * **Making it cheaper and steadier.** Modernize storage and processing, cut manual intervention out of the loop, and optimize for cost, performance, and reliability. * **The consumers.** Partner with pricing, ML, product, and analytics to deliver data clean and standardized enough that nobody downstream is writing defensive code around your output. **How You'll Use AI Here:** --------------------------- We don't want to hear that you use Claude every day. Everyone does. We want to know what you've built with it. Concretely, in this role: * Point an agent at a **site that just changed its markup** and have it propose the parser fix, run it against a fixture set, and open the PR * Build a **triage loop over the orchestrator** — cross\-reference a failed DAG against logs and warehouse state, diagnose the cause, and hand you a ranked list instead of a wall of red * Use **LLM extraction for the long tail** of low\-volume sources where a bespoke scraper will never pay for itself * Put an **MCP server over the warehouse** so a coverage question is a sentence, not another one\-off query * Use **Claude Code or Cursor** as the default way you work through a migration or a backfill, not as autocomplete If you've built agents, written skills or MCP servers, wired up connectors, or shipped internal tooling your team actually depends on — lead with that. **What You Bring:** ------------------- * 3\-4 years in data engineering or a closely adjacent seat. * Modern web scraping at scale — Playwright or comparable, plus the ability to impersonate a real browser at the network layer (TLS/request fingerprinting) when a plain HTTP client gets flagged. Selenium alone doesn't cut it anymore. * Strong Python, 3\+ years hands\-on. Solid SQL for analysis and transformation. * A pipeline you owned end to end in the past two years. Not a pipeline you contributed to. One that was yours when it broke. * Judgment on when to generalize and when to go bespoke — you don't rebuild the same infrastructure per source, and you don't force a one\-size\-fits\-all approach onto a source that needs custom handling. * Orchestration in your hands, not your resume. Airflow, Dagster, or a comparable DAG system — you've built on it, been paged for it, and cleaned up after it. * Cloud development experience (AWS, GCP). * LLM\-based extraction and processing at scale (e.g. LLM\-as\-a\-Judge, Agent loops), not just UI\-based Q\&A and simple Skill building. * Startup experience. You understand the pace, and you've worked somewhere the roadmap changed under you. * A pragmatic bias. Value delivered incrementally over the perfect rebuild. **Bonus:** large\-scale dataframe processing (Pandas, Polars, PySpark). You collect, or you have opinions about the collectibles market. **How We'll Interview You:** ---------------------------- We'll be specific so you can prepare. *Before any of it: download the app, put a card up, make a bid, or put a card up for sell. Every round assumes you've used the product, and we expect your point of view to sharpen as you go.* **1\. Recruiter screen \- 30 minutes** Come ready to talk about the metric you own today, why Alt specifically, and how you're actually using AI. We'll answer your questions and align on comp. **2\. Hiring manager with Dae, Head of Data — 30 minutes.** Be ready to go deep on one pipeline you owned end to end: the systems design, what you owned versus the team, where it broke, and what came out the other side. **3\. Coding screen — 45 minutes.** A working session on a data problem close to what this role actually does. **4\. Systems design — 60 minutes.** Design an ingestion system under real constraints. We'll push back on at least one of your choices on purpose — how you take that matters as much as the design. **5\. Cross\-functional — 60 Mins** How you work with the people downstream of your data. **6\. Leore, our founder and CEO — 30 minutes.** Everyone who joins Alt meets Leore. Come with a point of view on what you'd go after first. **7\. Reference check(s) — 15 minutes** with a former manager(s) **Compensation:** $155,000 \- $165,000 per year, plus equity for all full\-time employees. **What we offer:** ================== ***For full\-time Employees*** * We cover 85% of your medical, dental, and vision, and up to 50% for dependents. HSA/FSA available * Generous PTO that people actually take * Parental leave at full salary * $200/month wellness \+ $100/month home office stipend * Free DoorDash Pass membership, because dinner shouldn't be a decision * Remote\-first (for most positions), with WeWork access when you want a room with other humans * 401(k) * Alt Equity to all full\-time employees Compensation Range: $155K \- $165K

Otherwise a strong interest to learn. * Experience with Airflow, data warehouse, Databricks or Sagemaker. **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY This position is with Disney Entertainment \& Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. Disney Entertainment \& Sports LLC is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Mobile Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a Mobile Engineer to join our product engineering team in Kansas City, MO. You will own our mobile application across its full lifecycle: feature development, store releases, crash and performance monitoring, and the fixes that keep ratings intact after each release. The work is shared between building new functionality and maintaining an app that already has real users, roughly 60 percent new development and 40 percent maintenance, monitoring, and platform upkeep. participate in implementation review on both platforms * Manage third\-party SDK integrations \- analytics, payments, maps, or authentication, including upgrade planning and privacy compliance (App Tracking Transparency, data consent) * Contribute to app\-store compliance work: permissions justification, privacy nutrition labels, and review preparation * Monitor release health metrics : crash\-free rate, startup time, and app size, and drive improvements against defined targets **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of professional mobile development experience, with at least two years shipping applications to the App Store and Google Play * Production experience with Flutter or React Native, including at least one release cycle where you owned the app end to end * Working knowledge of native mobile platforms: Swift/SwiftUI for iOS and Kotlin for Android, sufficient for debugging and targeted native work * Strong understanding of mobile\-specific problems: lifecycle management, memory constraints, network variability, and background execution limits * Experience with mobile CI/CD and store distribution workflows (Fastlane, Codemagic, or equivalent) * Practical use of crash and performance monitoring in maintaining a live application * Clear written communication; release notes, incident writeups, and handoff documentation are expected outputs * Ability to work on\-site or hybrid in Kansas City, MO, with occasional after\-hours windows for releases or urgent fixes **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with payments or in\-app purchase flows * Accessibility implementation on mobile (VoiceOver, TalkBack) * Familiarity with native module development or platform\-channel work bridging Flutter/React Native to native code * Exposure to app\-store optimization practices and release\-note discipline that supports them * Experience in regulated domains: fintech, healthcare, or insurance * Backend familiarity (Node.js, Python, or Kotlin/Spring) that eases debugging across the API boundary **Benefits** * Salary: $115,000\-$125,000 per year, based on experience * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Paid time off and company holidays * 401(k) with company match * Device and professional development allowance **How to Apply** Submit your resume with links to applications you have shipped to the App Store or Google Play. Pay: $115,000\.00 \- $125,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee discount * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: *Aerospace is at a turning point — costs are rising, supply chains are strained, and old ways of building can't keep up. At Neon Aero, we're breaking that mold. We move fast, think big, and combine start\-up agility with aerospace expertise to design, build, and scale aircraft in ways the industry has never seen. Our team leverages automation, AI\-driven tools, and a fully connected digital backbone to accelerate innovation and reduce barriers to production.* *Here, you won't just take a job — you'll help reinvent how the world flies. If you're ready to solve complex problems, push technology further, and work alongside some of the brightest minds in aerospace, this is your chance to make a real impact.* We are seeking a Principal Electrical Engineer to provide technical leadership in the architecture, design, and qualification of high\-integrity electronic control systems across Neon's product portfolio. This role is focused on the controller and system\-electronics side of the architecture: command/monitor architecture, flight control computers and LRUs, embedded compute, sensing, communications, fault detection, redundancy, and the electrical interfaces that tie complex products together. It is complementary to our Principal Engineer – High Voltage Power Electronics role, which owns high\-voltage motor\-drive and power\-stage design. This is a deeply hands\-on individual contributor role. You will develop system architectures, block diagrams, schematics, interface definitions, safety concepts, and the analysis behind them. You will work directly with embedded software, motor control, systems, mechanical, power electronics, test, manufacturing, and certification teams to bring high\-reliability electronic systems from concept through qualification and production. This role does not require direct people management, but it requires principal\-level technical leadership, mentoring, and ownership of difficult cross\-functional decisions. **Why This Role Matters** * Own electrical system architecture for high\-integrity controller electronics, FCCs, LRUs, actuator controllers, avionics/compute platforms, sensing systems, and related embedded hardware. * Architect command/monitor, active\-active, simplex, duplex, or other redundant control architectures based on system safety, integrity, availability, and cost requirements. * Define partitioning between command processors, monitoring processors, motor\-control electronics, power electronics, sensors, communications, and vehicle\-level interfaces. * Translate system requirements and safety objectives into practical electronic architectures, hardware requirements, interface definitions, and verification strategies. * Select microcontrollers, processors, FPGAs, memories, communication devices, supervisors, watchdogs, isolation components, and sensor interfaces appropriate for high\-reliability applications. * Design and review embedded digital, analog, and mixed\-signal electronics, including low\-voltage power supplies, power sequencing, reset architecture, discrete I/O, signal conditioning, protection, and health monitoring. * Architect fault detection, fault containment, redundancy management, cross\-monitoring, heartbeat, synchronization, and safe\-state mechanisms. * Define communication architecture and physical layers for interfaces such as CAN / CAN FD, ARINC 825, ARINC 429, Ethernet, RS\-422/485, SPI, and similar embedded or aerospace buses. * Own electrical interface definitions and collaborate with systems and software teams on ICDs, timing assumptions, diagnostic coverage, degraded modes, and hardware/software partitioning. * Establish grounding, shielding, isolation, EMI/EMC, signal\-integrity, and power\-integrity approaches across boards, harnesses, sensors, and enclosures. * Lead schematic development and critical PCB design reviews using Altium or equivalent ECAD tools. * Personally perform or direct worst\-case circuit analysis, tolerance analysis, derating, signal\-integrity analysis, power\-budget analysis, and fault analysis. * Lead board bring\-up, system integration, lab debugging, and root\-cause investigations for issues spanning hardware, firmware, software, sensors, communications, and power electronics. * Define hardware verification strategies and support qualification testing for environmental, EMC, electrical power, and fault conditions. * Support certification\-oriented development including requirements traceability, design assurance, configuration control, verification evidence, and hardware change management. * Drive DFM, DFT, DFA, production test strategy, and manufacturing readiness for controller electronics and LRUs. * Mentor electrical engineers through architecture reviews, schematic reviews, design analysis, bring\-up, and debugging while remaining deeply hands\-on. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered. * 12\+ years of experience developing and shipping complex electronic systems. * Demonstrated ownership of system\-level electrical architecture for embedded control, avionics, industrial control, automotive, robotics, medical, aerospace, or similarly high\-reliability products. * Deep hands\-on experience with embedded digital and mixed\-signal hardware, including microcontroller\-based systems, sensing, communications, and board\-level power architecture. * Strong proficiency with schematic capture and PCB design using Altium or equivalent ECAD tools. * Strong understanding of processor selection, watchdog and reset architecture, communication interfaces, sensor interfacing, low\-voltage power conversion, grounding, isolation, and EMI/EMC. * Experience designing fault\-tolerant or redundant electronic architectures and reasoning about failure detection, fault containment, and safe\-state behavior. * Experience bringing electronic assemblies from concept through prototype, qualification, industrialization, and production. * Proven ability to lead cross\-functional technical decisions involving electrical hardware, embedded software, systems engineering, mechanical design, test, manufacturing, and suppliers. * Strong lab and debugging capability using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, programmable supplies, electronic loads, data acquisition, and related instrumentation. **Preferred Experience** * Command/monitor or other redundant safety\-critical controller architectures. * Flight control computers, actuator controllers, avionics LRUs, embedded compute platforms, sensor interfaces, or vehicle\-control electronics. * DO\-254 hardware development experience and familiarity with DAL\-driven hardware architecture and verification. * Familiarity with DO\-160, ARP4754A/B, ARP4761, MIL\-STD\-461, MIL\-STD\-704, or comparable safety\-critical and environmental standards. * Experience with CAN / CAN FD, ARINC 825, ARINC 429, Ethernet, RS\-422/485, SPI, BiSS, resolver/LVDT interfaces, or similar sensing and communication technologies. * Experience with safety\-oriented or aviation\-pedigree microcontrollers and processors. * FPGA or programmable\-logic experience for monitoring, I/O, timing, or safety functions. * MATLAB, Python, SPICE, or similar tools for analysis, test automation, or data reduction. * Experience in aerospace, automotive, robotics, consumer hardware, industrial controls, medical devices, or other environments where electronics must be both high\-performance and production\-ready. **Why Join Us** * Work alongside elite engineering talent and innovators from across aerospace and tech. * Be part of a team moving faster than the industry standard. * Shape solutions that are lower\-cost, autonomous, and scalable: the future of aviation. * Competitive compensation, including equity participation, growth opportunities, and full health benefits (health, vision, dental, 401(k)) designed to support you in and out of work. *Neon Aero, Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.* *We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, and we welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply.* *All final candidates must successfully complete a background check and drug screening as a condition of employment.* **At this time, Neon Aero and its divisions are not accepting unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters or staffing agencies.**

jobs.title: Product Builder, Vault
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Product and Data **Compensation** ---------------- * $200K – $220K • Offers Equity Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading\-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real\-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform. **The Role** ------------ Functionally the Vault is a high\-end warehouse with sophisticated internal software and a marketplace bolted directly to it. **This is a builder seat, not a product management seat.** You own the Vault from arrival to exit: ingest SLAs, intake and routing, exception handling and QC, outtake, international shipping, customs, insurance, carrier integrations, and the tooling that runs all of it. And you own it the whole way: you stand in the room and watch the bottleneck, you pull the station data yourself, you write the tool that removes it, you ship it, you watch what P90 does, you keep it or you kill it. **What this role is not:** writing PRDs for someone else to implement, running a quarterly roadmap ritual, managing an ops pod, or translating between the warehouse and engineering. If that's the shape of your last five years, this probably isn't the right fit, and we'd rather say so up front than waste your time. You report directly to the CEO. If you want a CEO in the build with you, this is that. If you want distance from the top, it isn't. **The metric you own: Time\-to\-Liquidity (median and P90\).** Supporting KPIs: ingest and outtake SLA adherence, cost per item processed (labor minutes, rework, fully loaded unit cost), throughput per FTE and items per week, error and rework rate, inventory activation rate (vaulted to live to sold), ship\-and\-decide velocity (tools and changes shipped per week), and Vault\-related seller satisfaction. **What You'll Own** ------------------- * **The end\-to\-end lifecycle, in code.** Receiving and ingest, processing and routing, exception handling and QC, outtake and customer handoff. Define measurable SLAs at every stage, instrument them yourself so the numbers exist, enforce them, and hunt bottlenecks systematically instead of working around them. The station\-level data that tells you where P90 went does not exist yet in the shape you'll need. You build that too. * **The Vault tooling, built not requested.** Queue management, prioritization, labeling, SLA tracking, the exception taxonomy and the software that enforces it. Retool got the operation this far and it is now the ceiling. Replace it with durable software, starting with the version you write yourself and put in front of an ops lead this week. You'll be in Python, Postgres, and AWS, with React and TypeScript for the surfaces the vault team actually touches. * **International shipping and logistics.** Customs, insurance, labeling, carrier integrations. Cross\-border is where delay and risk concentrate. Make it fast and boring, wire it into the SLA and liquidity picture, and put document models on the paperwork so outtake stops being a human transcription step. * **Inventory activation and liquidity.** Shrink the distance between "in vault" and "live on marketplace." Find where activation stalls by item tier, seller segment, and station, then build the product that closes it. Partner with Pricing, Auctions, CX, and Risk so vaulted inventory gets listed and monetized quickly. * **Quality, reliability, and trust.** Error rates, rework, and the exception taxonomy are yours. A mis\-handled high\-value item isn't a ticket. It's someone's money and someone's trust, and the control that catches it is software you wrote. * **The bets and the trade\-offs.** A short quarterly plan tied to time\-to\-liquidity, cost per item, and activation rate, and a weekly record of what actually shipped. Work shoulder to shoulder with Ops, Engineering, Pricing, Marketplace, and CX. Support exploration of Vault\-as\-a\-Service without letting it distract from core execution. Communicate the trade\-offs to the CEO plainly. **What Great Looks Like (6 Months)** ------------------------------------ * **You've been shipping to production since week two**, and the team reviews your PRs the way they review each other's. * **Time\-to\-liquidity is materially down**, at the median and at P90, driven by tools you built rather than by headcount. * **SLAs are real** across ingest, processing, and outtake: published, instrumented by you, tracked, met. * **Leadership runs on your dashboard.** A weekly Vault operating view people actually open, wired to live station data. * **30 to 50% fewer manual handoffs**, with exception handling running as a classified queue rather than a c " Not "I can read code." You open the pull request, you take the review, you own the consequence when the queue tool breaks at 6am on an auction week. Full\-stack enough to move through an operational surface without a handoff: the internal UI, the API, the query, the job. * **You've owned an operational system with real SLAs and unit costs** and moved the numbers on it. Throughput, cost per unit, rework, capacity utilization, and how the four trade off against each other. Roughly 5\+ years of building, but we're reading the work, not the years. * **You own a number today** and can name it, its baseline, and where you took it, on the first ask. * **Strong data fluency.** SQL and Python. You pull your own station\-level numbers, and you've built the instrumentation behind them because it usually didn't exist. * **A track record of turning messy, real\-world processes into software.** Not a process document. Software you wrote, that operators use, that survived contact with a bad week. * **Physical curiosity.** You've stood on a floor, watched the work, and changed your mind because of what you saw. This role includes occasional travel to the vault, and the people who are good at it want to go. * **You've built real things with AI**, not just used it. Agents, skills, MCP servers, connectors, internal tooling people depend on. * **Scrappy and high\-ownership.** You communicate with precision, you move without hand\-holding, and you go find the bottleneck rather than waiting for the brief. **Backgrounds that fit:** engineers from fulfillment, logistics, or supply\-chain platforms; full\-stack engineers who moved toward the operational side; forward\-deployed and internal\-tools engineers; technical founders in warehouse or 3PL software; product people who never stopped shipping code. **How We'll Interview You** --------------------------- We'll be specific so you can prepare. *Before any of it: download the app, put a card up, make a bid, or sell. Every round assumes you've used the product, and we expect your point of view to sharpen as you go.* **1\. Recruiter screen, 30 minutes via Google Meet.** The metric you own today, the last thing you shipped yourself, why Alt specifically, and how you're actually using AI. We'll answer your questions and align on comp. **2\. Hiring manager with Leore, our founder and CEO, 30 minutes.** This role reports to Leore, so he runs the hiring manager round himself. Go deep on an operational system you owned: the SLAs, the cost per unit, what broke, and specifically what you built with your own hands. **3\. Team interview, two 45\-minute sessions.** The engineers and ops leads you'll ship alongside. How you work in a shared codebase, and how you work with the people on the floor. **4\. Build walkthrough, 45 to 60 minutes.** Bring one thing you built and shipped, a repo, a PR, a live URL, an internal tool, an agent or skill you wrote, and open it on screen. jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Product and Data **Compensation** ---------------- * $230K – $250K • Offers Equity Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading\-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real\-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform. **The Role** ------------ Every buyer, seller, and lender on Alt is acting on a number our models produced. Alt Value prices the card. The underwriting model sizes the advance. Those two systems are the difference between a marketplace and a handshake, and they are the closest thing we have to a moat. We've proven model\-driven pricing works. This role takes it from working to excellent: more coverage, better accuracy, lower cost to run, faster to refresh. You'll own the full lifecycle — feature generation, training, validation, deployment, serving, and the monitoring that catches drift before a customer does. This is not a research seat. The models exist. What they need is someone who treats production as the deliverable. **The metric you own: Model\-Based Pricing Coverage** — the percentage of cards confidently priced by models rather than by hand. Supporting KPIs: pricing accuracy (% error), pricing freshness (end\-to\-end orchestration time), and underwriting performance (advance disbursement rate against target default rate). Most people who are great at this have owned a model in production where being wrong cost money — pricing, risk, credit, or fraud — not a notebook that got handed to someone else to deploy. **What You'll Own:** -------------------- * **Leaner, sharper pricing.** Cut infrastructure cost meaningfully while improving accuracy, especially on high\-value assets where being wrong is expensive. * **Underwriting from good to great.** Iterate the model to maximize cash advance disbursements without breaching risk thresholds or default targets. * **The full ML lifecycle.** Feature generation and training through deployment and monitoring. No handoff, no throwing it over a wall. * **The production path.** The models' AWS infrastructure and the pricing APIs themselves — capacity planning, autoscaling, latency, and diagnosing the memory and timeout failures that only show up at scale. * **Experiments that settle arguments.** Design and run backtests to find and validate features that actually move predictive power and coverage. * **Domain depth.** Work directly with our Expert Pricers until your model changes reflect real market judgment, not just what the data allows. **What Great Looks Like (6 Months):** ------------------------------------- * **Shipped leaner, more accurate pricing models.** Infrastructure cost is meaningfully down and accuracy is up, especially on high\-value assets. * **Moved underwriting from good to great.** More disbursement, no breach of risk thresholds. * **Earned trust with Expert Pricers.** You're their go\-to partner, and they can tell your changes reflect the market. * **Hardened the production path.** The pricing APIs are faster, more observable, and easier to reason about, with drift monitoring in place before it reaches customers. **How You'll Use AI Here:** --------------------------- We don't want to hear that you use Claude every day. Everyone does. We want to know what you've built with it. Concretely, in this role: * Build an **agent that reads a batch of new comps and flags the ones our model is likely to price badly**, before a pricer has to catch it by hand * Use **foundation models for feature extraction from unstructured card and listing data** — condition language, provenance notes, auction descriptions — and get real lift out of it * Stand up a **backtest harness you can talk to**, so evaluating a feature idea is a conversation rather than a two\-day branch * Put an **MCP server over the model registry and prediction logs** so "why did this card price move" is a question, not a query * Use **Claude Code or Cursor** as the default way you work through a refactor or an infra migration, not as autocomplete If you've built agents, worked with the API directly, written skills or MCP servers, or shipped internal tooling your team depends on — lead with that **What You Bring:** ------------------- * **7\+ years** engineering, with **5\+ years building and shipping production ML/AI models** * **Production\-grade Python and SQL**, including custom feature\-engineering pipelines — not just off\-the\-shelf scikit\-learn. Time\-decay weighting, leakage\-safe k\-fold cross\-validation, cascading fallback and imputation logic * **Gradient\-boosted or ensemble estimators** trained and validated against strict accuracy tolerances, with segment\-specific tuning by category or asset type * **LLMs and foundation models in production**, for both internal tooling and user\-facing product * **MLflow** or a comparable tool for experiment tracking and model registry/versioning * **Production model\-serving on AWS that was yours** — capacity planning, autoscaling, and diagnosing memory and timeout failures at scale * **CI/CD, production workflow orchestration, and IaC** * **A pragmatic bias.** Value delivered incrementally over the perfect rebuild **Bonus:** real\-time or low\-latency serving at scale. Startup experience. You collect, or you have opinions about the collectibles market. **How We'll Interview You:** ---------------------------- We'll be specific so you can prepare. Before any of it: download the app, buy, bid, and sell. Explore our industry. Every round assumes you've used the product, and we expect your point of view to sharpen as you go. **1\. Recruiter screen — 25 minutes.** Come ready to talk about the metric you own today, why Alt specifically, and how you're actually using AI. We'll answer your questions and align on comp. **2\. Hiring manager with Dae, Head of Data — 45 minutes.** Be ready to go deep on a model you took to production and kept there: the systems design, what you owned, where it broke, and what you'd do differently. **3\. System design— 45 minutes.** Design a model\-serving path under real constraints. We'll push back on at least one of your choices on purpose — how you take that matters as much as the design. **4\. Team interview\- 45 minutes.** How you work with the people who depend on your models, including our Expert Pricers. **5\. Dae — 30 minutes**, then **Leore, our founder and CEO — 30 minutes.** Everyone who joins Alt meets Leore. Come with a point of view on where you'd take our pricing intelligence. **Compensation:** $230,000 \- $250,000 per year, plus equity for all full\-time employees. **What we offer:** ================== ***For full\-time Employees*** * We cover 85% of your medical, dental, and vision, and up to 50% for dependents.
