jobs.description: We are hiring a Software Engineer at Level 1, 2, or 3 based on skills, experience, and demonstrated scope of impact. In this role, you will design, build, test, and support software solutions across the application development lifecycle, partnering with cross\-functional teammates to deliver reliable, maintainable, and cost\-effective systems. Position level will be determined based on individuals’ skill, knowledge, and experience. **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- **Level 1** Early\-career engineer who creates and modifies basic programs with guidance. Supports coding, testing, debugging, code reviews, performance monitoring, and documentation, and assists with basic to moderate designs and prototypes. **Level 2** Mid\-level engineer who creates and modifies moderately complex programs. Contributes to more complex code reviews and moderate to complex designs, mentors engineers, and may lead design execution or assist with requirements analysis, technical debt reduction, and application architecture. **Level 3** Senior engineer who develops complex software solutions, provides technical leadership, leads code reviews, contributes to architectural decisions, and mentors engineers. Collaborates across teams to reduce technical debt and uses cloud\-native platforms, automation, and AI technologies to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions, including technical guidance on responsible AI\-enabled development. * Develop cost\-effective solutions and enhancements for existing and new software applications, programs, and processes by analyzing information, investigating problem areas, and implementing solutions. * Support the product lifecycle by monitoring and reviewing system performance, coding, testing, debugging, documenting, participating in code reviews, and implementing software changes according to department standards. * Contribute to DevOps practices by supporting designs and prototypes; helping create and execute test plans and program specifications. * Use test environments and test cases to design, prototype, validate, and correct systems. * Document programs, processes, and procedures to communicate changes and maintain operational efficiency. * At Levels 2 and 3, contribute to improvements in coding standards, tools, and development processes; at Level 3, help evaluate and implement automation, emerging technologies, and AI\-enabled development practices. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Knowledge of software engineering principles, practices, and the full development lifecycle (design, coding, testing, debugging, and support). * Knowledge of software systems, design techniques, development tools, and data processing concepts, with general knowledge at Level 1, working knowledge at Level 2, and advanced knowledge at Level 3\. Relevant technologies include C\#/.NET/.NET Core, LINQ, SQL, and related tools. * Analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to identify root causes and recommend solutions. * Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate within a cross\-functional team. * Demonstrated alignment with organizational core competencies (e.g., change agility, communication, customer focus, innovation, teamwork, critical thinking, and decision making). * Level 3 requires advanced knowledge of C\#, .NET/.NET Core, SQL, LINQ, Blazor, system design, software architecture, application integration patterns, and cloud technologies, along with the ability to lead technical initiatives, manage projects, and influence technical direction. Python, JavaScript, and Angular experience is optional. **Education** ------------- Levels 1 and 2: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, information systems, engineering, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education, professional certifications, training, and relevant work experience. Level 3: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, management information systems, or a related field; a combination of education and/or relevant work experience may be accepted in lieu of a degree. * **Level 1:** 0–2 years of academic, internship, project\-based, or professional experience in software development or a related technical field. Practical experience through coursework, projects, portfolios, or labs may be considered. Foundational proficiency in at least one relevant programming language and familiarity with source control, debugging, testing, and relational data concepts. * **Level 2:** 2\+ years of progressively responsible experience in software development or a related technical role, including developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production software. Proficiency in one or more relevant programming languages and practical experience with source control, automated testing, relational data, APIs, and CI/CD practices. * **Level 3:** 5\+ years of related progressive experience in development and systems analysis, experience with 1–3 coding languages ( osoft DevOps, Git, and GitHub Copilot and/or Microsoft 365 Copilot or equivalent. * **AI architecture knowledge — strongly preferred for Level 3:** Working knowledge of large language models, vector databases, semantic search, prompt engineering, and agent\-to\-agent communication patterns; ability to evaluate AI technologies and recommend architectures, frameworks, implementation patterns, and governance considerations based on business and technical requirements. * **AI implementation experience — strongly preferred for Level 3:** Designing and implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, including knowledge retrieval, vector search, grounding, and prompt orchestration; architecting, developing, and supporting Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrations for secure enterprise access; designing and optimizing agentic workflows using Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or similar tools; and using AI\-assisted development for code generation, testing, documentation, debugging, and solution design. **Benefits** ------------ * Hybrid availability * 401(k) with company match * Health insurance * Paid time off, holidays * Volunteer time off * Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA) * Paternity leave **Growth opportunities** ------------------------ We believe each of us has potential to grow and adapt with our business. We take your career as seriously as you do. Helping you develop your skills and talents leads to opportunities — not only for you, but also for our company. That’s why we provide: * LinkedIn Learning Premium access * CliftonStrengths® assessment and coaching * On\-site and virtual workshops and cohorts featuring world\-class content from FranklinCovey, Crucial Learning, Gallup, and more * Free world\-class insurance acumen courses through AHIP and LOMA * Reimbursement and bonus opportunities for professional designations and certifications, including a tuition reimbursement program * Opportunities to take part in Wellabe's mentorship programs **About Wellabe** ----------------- Since 1929, Wellabe has been finding solutions to help our customers protect their health and financial well\-being. And we’re committed to fostering an internal culture of inclusivity, well\-being, and development so each of our team members can succeed. Learn more about Wellabe’s culture of betterment by visiting wellabe.com/culture (https://www.wellabe.com/culture). Wellabe is full of smart, caring, hard\-working people with a broad range of talents who understand collaboration is key. We bring our best selves every day, to connect with others to solve problems, spark innovation, and bring ideas to life. Meet the team and learn what makes Wellabe a great place to work by visiting wellabe.com/news/employee\-spotlights (https://www.wellabe.com/news/employee\-spotlights). **Our core values:** * Be dedicated: Show unwavering commitment by proactively taking initiative, setting clear goals, and managing time effectively. * Be trustworthy: Take accountability for actions, navigate difficult conversations with integrity, and build strong relationships through consistent, honest behavior. * Be determined: Demonstrate enthusiasm and a relentless drive to overcome obstacles and achieve goals. * Be collaborative: Foster teamwork by being self\-aware, actively listening, and effectively communicating across all levels. * Be open: Embrace diversity and new ideas to create an inclusive environment. * Be generous: Embody generosity and compassion by serving a greater purpose and helping others. * Be better: Commit to continuous improvement and adapt effectively to change. * Be well: Prioritize physical and mental health, manage stress, and demonstrate emotional intelligence. Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager - IT
jobs.description: **About Genetix Biotherapeutics** At Genetix Biotherapeutics every role has meaning, every team member is respected, and every day is a chance to make a difference. When you join Genetix, you're not just landing a new role, you become part of a company that's pursuing curative gene therapies to give patients and their families more days. We are doers, thinkers and collaborators who embrace and live by our values: Our innovation is rooted in the diversity of our teams and results are achieved through cooperation and the integration of multiple viewpoints. This is personal and we approach every challenge with radical care. **T****his role is based in Somerville, MA and follows a hybrid schedule of three days onsite per week.****To support regular in\-office collaboration, only candidates within commuting distance of Somerville will be considered.** **Position Summary** The **Senior Manager, IT** owns the day\-to\-day delivery of the security and infrastructure services that support Genetix's commercial products. You will lead identity, endpoint, backup and recovery, network, and cloud operations during a period of active modernization, including a move of identity services toward Microsoft Entra, a rebuild of backup and DR, and hardening of both corporate and laboratory environments. This is a hands\-on leader who can run projects through change control in a validated, regulated environment, manage vendors, and build a team and operating rhythm that is secure, auditable, and reliable. **RESPONSIBILITIES** **Identity \& Access** * Lead identity modernization across Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and hybrid Active Directory, including SSO migrations for business applications, conditional access, MFA coverage, and authentication policy. * Own privileged access: PIM, admin role reduction, service account de\-privileging and lifecycle (inventory, owner, expiry, rotation), and stale account cleanup. * Run access governance and least\-privilege role design for business applications, with timely provisioning and deprovisioning for employees, contractors, consultants, and managed service providers. * Own the AD security backlog, directory sync health (Entra Connect), and Group Policy migration to Intune. **Infrastructure, Backup \& Cloud** * Operate core infrastructure: AWS (multi\-account, federated access, networking), on\-prem and virtualized servers, firewalls and VPN, and legacy file services. * Build and run backup and recovery, including backup platform deployment, network paths to cloud targets, restore testing, retention, and data archiving. * Lead patching and lifecycle: OS and application patching, server and client end\-of\-life, and scheduled outage coordination. * Manage DNS and domain hygiene, including verification records, decommissioned records, and legacy domain consolidation, to reduce attack surface. * Lead monitoring and observability, including tool replacement and alerting tied to incident response. **Endpoint, Lab \& Security Operations** * Own endpoint and lab security: disk encryption and Secure Boot compliance, endpoint management, DNS\-layer protection, patch policy for lab and corporate systems, and removal of retired tools. * Own intake and triage of security reports, including phishing submissions and external vulnerability disclosures, with defined response and closure. * Support audits and customer or partner security assessments (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, SOX, SOC 2\), including questionnaires, evidence collection, and remediation tracking. **Validated Systems \& Change Control** * Partner with Quality and application owners on infrastructure for validated systems (LIMS/ELN, statistical computing, lab instruments), including server builds, security hot fixes, non\-production testing, regression sign\-off, and change control. * Support commercial and partner\-facing systems and treatment center security and connectivity requirements. **Team, Vendors \& Delivery** * Lead, coach, and develop engineers and analysts; set priorities and manage workload across projects and service requests. * Manage managed service providers and vendors (SLAs, contracts, performance, escalation). * Define SLAs and reporting for security and infrastructure requests, and improve intake, approval, and onboarding workflows with the service desk. * Write runbooks, SOPs, and change records so operations are repeatable and audit\-ready. * Apply AI tools such as Claude in daily work, including integrations with enterprise systems, and champion responsible AI adoption with appropriate access controls. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years in IT infrastructure, security operations, or systems engineering, including 3\+ years leading people or technical teams. * Hands\-on identity experience: Entra ID and hybrid Active Directory required; Okta or another SSO platform strongly preferred. Includes conditional access, MFA, PIM, and service account governance. * Hands\-on experience with endpoint management (Intune), disk encryption, patching, and vulnerability management. * Experience with backup and recovery platforms, cloud networking (AWS preferred), firewalls and VPN, and Microsoft 365\. * Experience managing projects through formal change control and managing vendors. * Experience supporting audits or compliance programs in a regulated environment. * Working knowledge of AI tools such as Claude (or similar) applied to operations. * Strong communication skills, risk\-based decision making, and the ability to prioritize competing demands in a small, fast\-moving team. **Preferred** * Biotech, pharma, or GxP experience, including computer system validation and supporting lab systems and instrumentation. * Experience modernizing hybrid environments (IdP migrations, GPO to Intune, monitoring replacement, legacy domain consolidation). * Security or infrastructure certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, Security\+, AWS Security Specialty, Microsoft identity/security certifications). * Experience in a company that is rebuilding or scaling its IT function. **Genetix is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or any other applicable legally protected characteristics.**

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Full Stack (Agentic Payment)
jobs.description: **About Sapiom** Sapiom is payment infrastructure for AI companies and agents. One integration lets an agent pay on behalf of a person or a business, with permissions, protected card credentials, and spending rules built in. Agents can think now, and increasingly they can act. What they can’t do is spend. The rails underneath assume a person at the keyboard, so teams fall back on closed catalogs, cards and API keys pasted into config, or a human approving every purchase. We’re removing that constraint. A customer connects a card and grants a named agent permission without leaving your product. They set the limits — per purchase, per merchant, approval required or not. The agent buys inside those limits across browser checkout, payment protocols, and APIs. Card details never enter the conversation, and every purchase leaves a record from approval through merchant confirmation. The work spans the whole path a purchase takes: connecting a customer and their agent, vaulting the card, establishing agent identity, enforcing the rules, moving the payment, and making the outcome legible afterward. Card issuing, voice\-initiated payments, payment recovery, and insurance are all part of where this goes. We have assembled a team with deep infrastructure and payments DNA. Our founder ran payments engineering at Shopify for five years and built an autonomous consumer agent company before that. We raised a $35M Series A led by Dragonfly in August, bringing us to $50M total. Accel led our seed; Menlo Ventures and Anthropic are also behind us. **About the role** ------------------ Agents are starting to buy things on their own, and the rails underneath all assume a person at the keyboard. Letting an agent complete a purchase inside limits its owner actually set, and keeping proof of what was agreed, is the company. The first version of that ships before you'd start. Almost everything that turns it into something customers can depend on is still ahead, and the team works those problems in parallel rather than one at a time. You'd own one of them. Payments is unforgiving in a way most product work isn't. A purchase either moves money or it doesn't. A record either holds up six months later when someone disputes a charge, or it's worthless. We'd like someone who finds that interesting. This is a staff role. You'd set the design for a large piece of this, at thirty people, while it's still deciding\-shaped. **What you'd work on** ---------------------- **Limits and authority.** How much latitude an owner hands an agent, and how that gets enforced before money moves rather than explained afterwards. Most of these decisions are still open. **Completing the purchase.** Checkout is where this gets unglamorous. Every merchant behaves differently, totals move, and plenty of steps still expect a human. Making that reliable across a long tail of them is a multi\-quarter problem. **What happens when it goes wrong.** A payment that goes quiet is the hardest case in the domain. The system has to work out what actually happened before it does anything else, and never charge someone twice. **Proof.** A versioned record of what a buyer saw and agreed to, still legible months later when someone disputes it. Unglamorous, and the thing the rest of it rests on. **The surface customers build on.** A public API and the tools an agent calls. Designing a contract a model uses correctly is its own discipline. **You may be a fit if** ----------------------- * You have 8\+ years building production software, several of them in payments, money movement, or financial infrastructure. We're hiring for depth in the domain. * You've owned architecture from first principles — set the design, defended it, and lived with what it cost. * You've worked somewhere being wrong was expensive, and you design for failure up front: idempotency, retries, reconciliation against a number someone else is also computing. * You have real range across the stack. Strong TypeScript, and you build the interface on top of your own system instead of handing that off. * You've run a multi\-month project from a problem statement rather than a spec, and other engineers built on what you shipped. * You use AI tools in your own engineering workflow. Nice to have: card issuing, tokenization, or PCI scope; checkout integrations at depth; browser automation or request interception; something you shipped that an LLM calls as a tool; early\-stage companies where you set the architecture rather than inherited it. **Applying** ------------ A recruiter screen, then a loop of roughly three hours: a hands\-on AI project, a project deep dive, and a conversation with our founder. Everyone on our engineering team carries the title Member of Technical Staff internally.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Ledger
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Product and Data **Compensation** ---------------- * $300K – $500K • Offers Equity Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading\-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real\-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform. **THE NORTH STAR** 99\.99% reliability on gateway and banking integrations, and a ledger where every cent is accounted for and every entry says who created it and when. Supporting KPIs: reconciliation exception queue depth at daily close, gateway and banking integration uptime at 99\.99%, P90 time from auction close to seller funds available, share of ACH returns and reversals handled with no manual correcting entry, and time to bring a new PSP or rail to production. **TH ROLE:** This is a builder's seat, not a manager's seat. You will write the ledger, the rails, and the reconciliation yourself. You will make the build\-versus\-buy call and defend it. You will tell the business no when correctness demands it, and you will be right often enough that they keep asking. The people who are great at this have owned a ledger somewhere it mattered, and they think in idempotency, race conditions, and reconciliation. **WHAT YOU'LL OWN:** * The ledger as system of record. Entries, lines, balances, holds, reversals, and the states between: pending, posted, available, canceled, declined, reversed. Immutability and audit trail as design constraints, not features. Point\-in\-time balances that show a customer where they stood on any past date. Done looks like an auditor pulling a trial balance without asking you for help. * Rails and money movement. ACH origination and returns, RTP and other instant rails, wires, cards, and stablecoin settlement. A credit\-push rail changes what you can auto\-charge and when funds are final, and you own those product consequences, not just the integration. Done looks like the fourth PSP costing a sprint, not a rewrite. * Reconciliation. When the ledger and the processor disagree, you own the answer. Automated matching, an exception queue a human can actually work, and breaks caught before a customer finds them. Every point of automation here is a point on the north star. * Payouts and lending infrastructure. Getting sellers and borrowers their money faster than anyone else in this market: instant payout options, batch payouts at auction close, and the settlement timing that makes them safe. Then the full loan lifecycle, disbursement through repayment, partial payment, delinquency, and collateral release. * Risk posture on high\-value flows. Holds, limits, and settlement windows set with data, and you will know what each one costs in conversion. Step\-up verification triggered by risk signals rather than blanket friction. * The trade\-off calls. Shipping speed against uncompromising correctness, build against buy. You set the planning cadence with Robbe, you work across Finance, Risk, Ops, and Support, and you are the one who explains upward why a number moved. **WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE IN 6 MONTHS:** * The reconciliation automation rate is materially higher than the day you started, and you can show the weekly series. * The exception queue at daily close is worked to zero by a human in under an hour, on a system you built for that. * A new rail or PSP has gone to production on the provider architecture you designed, and it did not require a ledger migration. * Pending, posted, and available are modeled cleanly enough that Support answers "where is my money" off the customer\-facing surface instead of escalating to engineering. * Corrections post as reversing entries. Nobody has edited history, and an auditor can say so. * At least one thing you shipped is running with AI in the loop, and the team depends on it. * Finance trusts the close. **HOW YOU'LL USE AI HERE** * Turn a payment provider or bank partner integration spec into a typed client and a test suite in an afternoon instead of a sprint, including the ACH return codes and reversal paths nobody wants to hand\-write. * Stand up a rail simulator that produces the failures a sandbox won't: a late return, a duplicate callback, a partial reversal, a webhook that arrives twice out of order, a settlement that lands after the window closed. Then run your ledger against it. * Build an agent that triages the reconciliation exception queue overnight, clusters the breaks, and hands you a ranked list with a proposed cause for each instead of a wall of unmatched rows. * Put an MCP server over the ledger so "where did this discrepancy come from" is a question you ask in plain language rather than another  real money on real rails. ACH origination and returns, RTP or FedNow, wires, or equivalent. You know what an R01 is, why NACHA return windows matter, and why a credit\-push rail changes the product flow and not just the API call. * You have handled large transactions, where the failure mode is a five\- or six\-figure problem and somebody notices immediately. * Database mastery. Expert SQL and relational design, and a transaction that holds under load at auction close and during scheduled auto\-pay batches. Python, Postgres, and AWS are our stack. * You're API\-native. Webhooks, idempotency, eventual consistency, and reconciliation are your default vocabulary, not terms you looked up. * You've built real things with AI, not just used it. Agents, skills, MCP servers, connectors, internal tooling people depend on. * Product\-owner thinking. You don't just build a pay button. You understand the flow of funds and how to tell a worried customer what happened to their money. * Restraint. The most common way this seat fails is overengineering. You know when a queue and a lambda are the answer and when they are three new partial\-failure modes. **We read the work, not the years. Most people who clear this bar have five to ten years behind them, and we have no interest in screening out the person who got there faster.** Strong plus: enough React and TypeScript to ship the customer\-facing surface that reads off your ledger. This is not a fullstack seat, but the person who can take a ledger change all the way to the UI will go further here. Backgrounds that fit: payments or ledger infrastructure at a pre\-IPO fintech, core banking or money movement at a marketplace, a founding or early engineer who built the money layer, or an infrastructure engineer who took ownership of financial correctness because nobody else would. Bonus: distributed systems, credit or risk modeling, direct experience with Stripe, Plaid, Airwallex, PayPal, Modern Treasury, or Increase, evaluating or implementing a third\-party ledger service (Modern Treasury, Fragment, Formance, TigerBeetle or similar), stablecoin or on\-chain settlement, KYC/KYB, bank partnership, or SOX and audit\-readiness exposure. You collect, or you have a view on where this market is going. US\-based, remote. **HOW WE'LL INTERVIEW YOU:** *We'll be specific so you can prepare. Before any of it: download the app, put a card up, make a bid, and try selling. Every round assumes you've used the product, and we expect your point of view to sharpen as you go. For this role, look specifically at the cash advance, deposit, and payout surfaces.* * Recruiter screen, 25 minutes, Google Meet. The metric you own today and how you're performing against it, why Alt specifically, and how you're actually using AI. We align on comp here and answer your questions. * Hiring manager, Robbe Simon, 45 minutes, Google Meet. * Technical screen, 60 minutes. * Architecture and system design, 60 minutes. * Culture interview, 30 minutes. How you work with the people who depend on your systems: operations, finance, support, and the customer on the other end of a held transfer. * Leore, our founder and CEO, 30 minutes. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally. **One Team** From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. What You’ll Need * 10\+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or a related discipline, including experience leading senior technical professionals. * Demonstrated experience moving data platforms from batch processing toward real\-time or near\-real\-time architectures. * Deep experience with modern cloud data platforms and lakehouse architecture. * Experience with AWS, Databricks, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog is highly valued. * Strong foundations in data modeling, data warehousing, data governance, and distributed data systems. * Working knowledge of SQL and Python sufficient to review designs and engage credibly with engineers. * Practical experience using AI in your own work, along with sound judgment about where AI creates meaningful value. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to make technical strategy clear to executive leaders and design decisions clear to engineers. * Demonstrated ability to influence product and engineering partners without relying solely on formal authority. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. And It’s Great to Have * Experience in fitness, wellness, SaaS, payments, or another subscription\-based business. * Experience building customer\-facing analytics or reporting products. * Experience with Databricks SQL, Power BI, or comparable analytics platforms. * Experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple time zones. In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may be offered other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, commissions, equity, or other incentive programs, where applicable. Compensation and benefits may vary by location and are subject to applicable legal, business, and market requirements. **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:** * Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset * Time Off – with our open PTO policy, we offer flexibility in how and when you take PTO! * Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. \#oneteam * Parental \& Pawternity Leave – we offer leave for when your family grows by two feet or four paws! * Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement * Medical/Dental/Vision coverage * EAP – we get you help when you need it. Period. * Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16 * And more! – so many benefits we couldn’t even fit them all here! At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement. **ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness.com **About ABC Fitness** ABC Fitness is the \#1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data\-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients. From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. jobs.title: Data Scientist II

statistical modeling, machine learning, and generative AI to rapidly test and improve product capabilities * Evaluate model performance, fairness, bias, and appropriate use **Product Data and Experimentation:** * Design data collection strategies that capture student behavior, performance, and engagement while supporting rapid product development * Analyze pilot and user\-study data and model outputs understandable and actionable for various stakeholders **Cross\-Organizational Collaboration:** * Collaborate across teams to align data, modeling, research, and product requirements * related quantitative discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge and abilities can be acquired * At least 3 years of applied data science experience, including building statistical or machine\-learning models and analyzing product experiments, pilots, or user studies * Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience developing scalable data pipelines and moving data products or models from prototype toward production **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** * A hands\-on, product\-oriented data scientist who can move from analysis and rapid prototyping to production implementation * Strong in statistical modeling, machine learning, experimental design, and model evaluation * Experienced in scalable data pipelines, cloud environments, and integrating complex data sources * Skilled at using behavioral and performance data to develop personalized product experiences * Thoughtful about responsible AI, including fairness, bias mitigation, transparency, privacy, and appropriate use * An effective cross\-functional communicator who translates research and business needs into actionable technical solutions **It’s a plus if you have (preferred requirements):** * Master’s degree in data science or related field * Experience with recommender systems, generative AI, natural language processing, or personalized and adaptive systems * Experience with education, assessment, career, workforce, labor\-market, occupational, or skills data **About ACT** When ACT was founded in 1959, it disrupted the assessment industry with a new approach to helping students better understand their readiness so they could take steps to improve it. By leveraging our expertise and authority in assessment and research, we will again disrupt the industry—helping more people learn, better measure their progress, and improve their navigation through life’s transitions. More than ever before, ACT is fulfilling its mission of helping people achieve education and workplace success. We’re doing it by pushing the boundaries of learning innovation through the work of our people, who we call team members because we’re all in this together. We know transformation does not come without challenge. That’s why ACT invests in a variety of experiences for team members to strengthen their connections, explore ideas, learn from customers, and celebrate success. Learn more about working at ACT at act.org! *ACT is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. ACT participates in E\-verify. ACT's recruitment team appreciates your interest in working with us to transform college and career readiness pathways for all learners and wishes you the best of luck in your career journey.\*\***

jobs.title: Agentic Application Developer
jobs.description: AGRILAND FS is a fast\-growing energy company delivering diesel, gasoline, propane, and other petroleum products to customers nationwide, with a full agronomy business alongside. Our small technical team builds and runs the ELEVATE application suite and the ATLAS data platform, using AI as a core part of our daily workflow rather than an occasional shortcut. We are looking for a developer early in their career who is ready to build modern, AI\-accelerated, cloud\-native applications. This is not a role where you spend years on boilerplate before touching anything real. We do not put team members in isolated boxes. Your center of gravity is our AWS serverless platform, where we build the custom applications in the ELEVATE suite. You will also touch the commercial platforms our business runs on today, Salesforce among them, but this is a cloud developer role, not a platform\-specific one. As you master the fundamentals, your role will have the opportunity to expand into owning the full path to production and, eventually, whole applications. **What You'll Do** **Phase 1: Core Development (Day 1 Focus)** * **AWS Applications:** Build, test, and deploy custom applications on our AWS serverless stack (Lambda, S3 and CloudFront, DynamoDB, API Gateway) as the core of the ELEVATE suite. * **Commercial Platforms:** Contribute to the systems the business runs on today where code is needed, including Lightning Web Components in Salesforce, without making any single vendor's platform your identity. * **AI\-Accelerated Workflow:** Use AI assistants to prototype quickly, generate and critically review code, write test suites, and document components as you go. * **Bug Resolution:** Troubleshoot and resolve bugs in existing components and applications, learning the codebase by fixing it. **Phase 2: Delivery Ownership (Ramping around Month 6\+)** * **Path to Production:** Own the road from working code to production: Git\-based version control, code review, deployment pipelines, and closing out the last 10% that gets nearly finished work over the finish line. * **Requirements Translation:** Partner with stakeholders to translate operational pain points into structured user stories, technical requirements, and working solutions. * Release Discipline: Help formalize and enforce our review\-and\-deploy process as more people across the company gain build access. * Reusable Foundations: Contribute to a growing library of reusable components and patterns across the ELEVATE suite, so the next build is faster than the last. Phase 3: Expanding the Stack (Growing into the Platform) * **Data Engineering:** Go deeper on ATLAS: pipelines, warehousing, and the analytics layer that runs the business. * **Platform Engineering:** Take on infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring, and the deployment machinery itself. * **Agentic Development:** Push past code assistance into agents, automation, and AI\-native ways of working, and bring what you learn back to the team. **Where This Role Grows** We build our own applications, and we view early\-career development as the launching pad for long\-term technical and professional growth. As you advance past your first year, your trajectory can evolve into: * **End\-to\-End Product Ownership:** Owning an application from roadmap through stakeholders, build, deployment, and user adoption, not just tickets. * **Delivery Leadership:** Becoming the team's authority on how software ships: pipelines, environments, and release standards for everything we build. * **Specialized Career Tracks:** Deep\-diving further into serverless application architecture, data platform engineering on ATLAS, or front\-end craft and user experience across the ELEVATE suite. **What We're Looking For** * **Development Foundation:** Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, plus exposure to Python or Apex. Coursework, personal projects, and professional experience all count. * **Cloud\-Native Mindset:** Curiosity about consumption\-based cloud platforms and how serverless applications are designed, built, and paid for. Exposure to any commercial platform (Salesforce or comparable) is helpful but not required; we would rather teach a platform than unteach config\-only habits. * **AI Fluency:** Comfort using AI coding assistants in a real development workflow: prompting effectively, reviewing generated code critically, and iterating rather than accepting output blindly. * **Finisher's Instinct:** Energy for the unglamorous last mile: testing, deployment, documentation, and follow\-through until users are actually using the thing. * **Strong Communication:** Ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders and build trust across the business. * **Range:** A refusal to be boxed into one discipline; you are curious about how the whole system fits together, not just your corner of it. **Why This Role Is Different** Most early\-career development jobs lock you into one vendor's ecosystem for years. This role starts with real code shipped early on a modern serverless stack, then gives you a direct path to own delivery end to end and grow into data, infrastructure, or product ownership. Because we build our own applications, the skills you develop are portable: cloud architecture, AI\-accelerated development, and delivery discipline travel anywhere. Backed by an AI\-first workflow and a small, collaborative team, you will get to know the whole business and build a career without boundaries. **What we offer our team:** * Paid, in\-house training and certification for DOT License and Endorsements for a Class A CDL with tanker and hazmat endorsements * Work with updated and modern equipment * Competitive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, and more * Paid time off, sick pay, and paid holidays * Solid retirement future with a 100% company\-funded Pension Plan at no cost to you, ***plus*** an additional 401k with company match * Recognition and pay incentives for good job performance **Are you a good match to join the AGRILAND FS Team? Apply now!** *AGRILAND FS is an equal opportunity employer*

jobs.description: US \> Arizona \> Phoenix **Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture.** For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential. **Job Mission** The Senior Engineer (II), Systems Engineering is a technical leader responsible for the development, integration, qualification, and deployment of advanced sensor technologies across ASM product platforms. This role focuses on transforming sensor data into actionable insights by driving sensor architecture, data acquisition strategies, signal analysis, and data\-driven decision\-making. Working closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Firmware, Software, Process, and Manufacturing Engineering teams, this individual will define sensor requirements, integrate sensing technologies into complex equipment, and develop analytical methods that improve process understanding, equipment performance, and product outcomes. This position requires strong systems thinking, expertise in sensor technologies and data analytics, and the ability to lead multidisciplinary projects from concept through deployment. **What You Will Be Working On** **Sensor Systems Leadership** * Lead the development and integration of advanced sensor technologies for semiconductor manufacturing equipment. * Define sensor architecture, performance requirements, interfaces, and validation strategies. * Evaluate and select sensing technologies for process monitoring, equipment health monitoring, and advanced control applications. * Drive sensor system design reviews focused on performance, scalability, and robustness. * Identify emerging sensor technologies and assess their applicability to future ASM products. **Sensor Integration \& Data Acquisition** * Lead integration of sensors with hardware, firmware, software, and control systems. * Develop and implement data acquisition architectures for collecting high\-quality sensor data. * Define calibration, synchronization, and validation methodologies for multi\-sensor systems. * Support integration of optical, thermal, pressure, flow, plasma, gas, vibration, acoustic, and environmental sensors. * Establish best practices for sensor characterization, performance evaluation, and deployment. **Data Analytics \& Insight Generation** * Develop data analysis methodologies to extract meaningful insights from sensor and equipment datasets. * Apply statistical analysis, signal processing, and machine learning techniques to identify patterns and correlations. * Analyze process and equipment data to improve product performance, process understanding, and operational efficiency. * Develop dashboards, KPIs, and health\-monitoring metrics for sensor\-enabled systems. * Generate data\-driven recommendations that influence product design and technology roadmaps. **Product Development \& Program Leadership** * Lead sensor technology development projects from concept through qualification and release. * Define verification and validation plans for sensor\-enabled subsystems. * Drive proof\-of\-concept studies and technology demonstrations for next\-generation sensing solutions. * Coordinate technical activities across multiple development programs and stakeholders. * Collaborate with suppliers and technology partners to evaluate and qualify new sensor solutions. **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner with Process, Software, Firmware, Electrical, Mechanical, and Product Engineering teams to deploy sensor solutions. * Work closely with data scientists and software engineers to operationalize sensor data. * Support customer\-facing activities requiring sensor characterization, performance analysis, and technology assessments. * Present technical findings and recommendations to engineering leadership and business stakeholders. **Mentorship \& Technical Leadership** * Mentor engineers in sensor technologies, systems engineering, and data analytics methodologies. * Promote best practices for sensor integration, experimental design, and data analysis. * Lead technical working groups focused on sensor innovation and advanced monitoring capabilities. * Drive continuous improvement in sensor development processes and analytical workflows. **Minimum Qualifications** * BS in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Physics, Optical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline. * 5\+ years of experience in sensor systems, system integration, data acquisition, process diagnostics, or related engineering functions. * Experience integrating sensors into complex hardware systems. * Experience with data analysis, signal processing, and statistical methods. * Proficiency with data analysis tools such as Python, MATLAB, JMP, Minitab, or similar platforms. * Experience designing and executing experiments for sensor characterization and validation. * Strong systems\-level problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills. * Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * MS or PhD in Engineering, Physics, Data Science, or related technical field. * Experience with semiconductor equipment and semiconductor manufacturing processes. * Experience with optical sensors, spectroscopy, machine vision, imaging systems, gas sensing, plasma diagnostics, or environmental monitoring. * Experience with edge computing, Industrial IoT, and connected sensor systems. * Experience with machine learning, predictive analytics, and large\-scale data processing. * Experience developing sensor\-driven control strategies and process monitoring solutions. * Knowledge of database systems, cloud analytics platforms, and data infrastructure. **What Makes You Successful** * Strong understanding of sensor technologies and how to translate measurements into actionable information. * Ability to connect sensor data, process behavior, and equipment performance. * Passion for data\-driven engineering and advanced analytics. * Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary technical projects. * Excellent troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills. * Strong collaboration and stakeholder management abilities. * Demonstrated ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement mindset. **Apply today to be part of what’s next.** We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting\-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect. jobs.title: [CSP] Site Reliability Engineer (14:00–22:00 CET)
jobs.description: Communications Service Providers (CSP) are the biggest, most important clients of AVSystem. We build, test, launch and operate systems for our telco customers and make a living by keeping them relevant, reliable and remarkable. Our products (UMP, CEM, BSAP and DHCP) manage hundreds of millions of devices in 100\+ large deployments worldwide, for operators like T\-Mobile, Play and Vodafone, also through our cloud offering. The SRE team runs them on Kubernetes in GCP and AWS, on bare metal and VMs in operators' data centres, and in air\-gapped on\-prem environments. Every operator brings its own customizations, and years of per\-operator projects left debt in our tooling, processes and infrastructure. You'll spend part of your time untangling and simplifying it, which takes discipline. Running the commands was never the hard part of this job. Deciding which ones to run was, and owning the result: whether a change is safe on an operator's network, what to fix first when two customers call at once, and when a workaround can wait until morning. We are looking for an engineer who takes those decisions and carries them, with whatever tools write the scripts this year. ### **Your hours** This role works a fixed afternoon schedule: **14:00–22:00 CET**, **Monday** **to** **Friday**, so our operators in the US and Latin America have an SRE inside their working day, and planned work that fits these hours goes to you, whichever time zone the operator is in. Those hours are your normal working time, not overtime. You'll spend your first weeks in daytime hours next to the team, then move to the afternoon schedule. Each day starts with a handover from the daytime team and ends with a written note for the morning. **Requirements** ---------------- * A few years running production Linux systems as an **SRE**, **DevOps** engineer or **sysadmin**, with solid **Linux** (Ubuntu, RHEL) and **networking** (TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, routing) fundamentals: from a shell, you can tell what a host is doing and why. * **Python** or Go good enough to write automation your teammates can read, test and maintain. Bash for the small things. * Working knowledge of **Kubernetes**, at least one public cloud (**GCP**, **AWS** or **Azure**), and **Ansible** or Terraform. * Hands\-on monitoring, alerting and logging work with the **Prometheus** **stack** and Loki, which we run, or with Zabbix, Splunk or ELK. * Daily, hands\-on use of coding agents (we run **Claude** **Code**), the judgment to tell when their output is wrong, and the habit of not running in production what you could not explain to a colleague. * Fluent spoken **English** (you will often run calls with our customers' teams on your own, native speakers included) and proficiency in Polish. **A huge plus if you have** --------------------------- * Set up and run MongoDB, Redis or Kafka. * Tuned or debugged JVM applications and distributed systems. * Supported customers in another time zone, or worked shifts. * Readiness to travel to our customers in the US from time to time. **Not for you if** ------------------ * you need your weekday evenings free. * you think customer calls are someone else's job. * your first move on a slow service is a restart, not a graph. * you would rather repeat a manual task than automate it. * you want every runbook written before you touch a system. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own problems end to end: frame them, choose the approach, direct agents and teammates through the implementation, verify the result, and run it in production. * Learn the telco domain on purpose: how an operator runs its access network, what our products do in it, and what a failed rollout costs the operator. * Work with our US and Latin American customers during their day, from calls and troubleshooting with their engineers to resolving production issues, and run any operator's planned work (upgrades, migrations, configuration changes) that fits your hours. * Build and maintain automation that removes toil from the team's week. * Find and fix performance and reliability problems, including in our product code, and lead the blameless postmortems that keep them from coming back. * Improve our observability stack (Prometheus, Loki, Grafana) and the Service Level Indicators the team watches. * Work with development teams on feature design, so they ship features we can operate. * After onboarding, join our additionally paid 24/7 on\-call rotation. **How we hire** --------------- * A call with our recruiter, partly in English, with a few short technical questions. * Three technical conversations with the SRE team, online: Linux troubleshooting on a live VM, a short Python exercise, and system design. * A conversation with the team's manager. We send the meeting link and the format of each stage before every interview. Take a break whenever you need one. **What we offer** ----------------- * Remote work from anywhere **in Poland**, with occasional visits to our Kraków office. * Our goal is to inspire people more than manage them. We want our teams to do what is best for our products. This, in turn, generates a **sense of responsibility** which drives us to do great work. * A dream team is one in which all of your colleagues are extraordinary at what they do and highly effective working together. We model ourselves on a professional sports team, not a family. A family is about unconditional love. A dream team is about pushing yourself to be the best possible teammate. **Dream** **teams** are about **performance**, not seniority or tenure. * Our customers depend on the reliability of our products to generate revenue in their business. The telco industry is ever\-growing and needs us to support that growth. * Open\-source contribution opportunities. * A team of highly skilled and humorous colleagues. * Access to the best tools and equipment available in the market. * A **Claude Code Premium seat** from day one and the model access the work needs. We don't ration tokens; we look at what shipped. * A MacBook Pro / ThinkPad with 2 monitors. * Company events and team building activities. * Multiple career paths and employee development options – we want you to develop into a tech lead in the future, but we’ll support you in getting another dream role in site reliability, management, product development or sales. * Training and conferences. * Onsite gym and chillout space. * Multisport card. * Medical care. * Kitchen full of snacks and treats (including Good Lood ice cream). * Car parking area and bike room. * A relaxed work atmosphere – no dress code, no open space. ##### **Site Reliability Engineer** Product: CSP Level: Regular Contract: B2B/ UoP Location: Remote Salary UoP: 16 600 \- 24 900 PLN gross Salary B2B: 20 000 \- 30 000 PLN net Holiday: 20\+ paid days

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (AI Platform)
jobs.description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. Affirm's engineering team is building a large\-scale, fault\-tolerant, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products, merchants, and vendors. Ensuring that our infrastructure is transparently available to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of writing blameless postmortems as well as writing detailed tech specs and gathering feedback before large changes to systems. The AI Platform team owns Affirm's paved path for building, running, evaluating, and governing AI systems. Our customers are not only Affirm users, but also every engineer and a growing set of production workloads at Affirm. As a team, we are responsible for building and exposing simple, governed interfaces to models, tools, and agents, with identity, cost attribution, reliability, and security built in. Examples of components we own include the LLM Gateway that fronts every approved model (Claude, ChatGPT, and open\-weight models across AWS Bedrock and other providers), the MCP Gateway that mediates and audits tool calls, the Agent Runtime that gives agentic workloads bounded execution, and the evals and observability layer that tells teams whether an AI change is better, cheaper, or safe to ship. We are early: the gateway is in daily use across engineering, the first production agent is live, and the next year takes us from developer productivity to production inference and agents. **What You'll Do** * Plan, execute, and own technical decisions and projects within the AI Platform team, from design through launch and on\-call. * Design and build the gateway, runtime, and evaluation services that take AI workloads at Affirm from pilot to production, securely scaling across millions of users and their transactions. * Make AI spend attributable and governable: build the identity, quota, routing, caching, and failover controls that let teams adopt new models and tools without re\-solving the same platform problems. * Partner with security, infrastructure, and product engineering teams to set the guardrails for agentic workloads and the on\-behalf\-of identity model for tool access. * Create and monitor metrics for your team's systems, and own the operational health of what you ship: monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and on\-call. * Set and improve code review and design standards, and advocate for them beyond your team through writing and tech talks. * Use AI tools and agentic workflows every day as a multiplier for your own code, design review, and operations, and push the team on what a small AI\-native team can deliver. * Educate, mentor, and grow engineers in the team, and drive best practices around design, coding, and testing. **What We Look For** * You have 4\+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin. * You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes. * You have practical experience building with LLMs, agents, or AI frameworks in production: inference APIs, LLM gateways (LiteLLM or similar), MCP, tool calling, evals, or agent runtimes. * You understand AI usage and the infrastructure needed to support and leverage AI workloads across different disciplines. * You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others. * You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely. * Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders. * You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team. * This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field. Pay Grade \- N Equity Grade \- 9 **Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range.** Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job\-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.) USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $195,000 \- 255,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $173,000\-233,000 \#LI\-Remote **Remote\-first with flexibility built in** Affirm is proud to be a remote\-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in\-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office\-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in\-person onboarding experience. **Benefits designed for you** Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: * Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. * Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. * Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. * Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We're committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we're happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Secure Systems and Simulation
jobs.description: **About AirSpace Innovation:** AirSpace Innovation (ASI) is a small, fast\-moving engineering firm working at the intersection of autonomy, air traffic management, and emerging aerospace operations. We help government, commercial, and academic partners develop innovative engineering solutions, from concept development and modeling to software prototyping, simulation, and operational tests. At ASI, you'll have the opportunity to tackle meaningful technical challenges, collaborate with experienced engineers and aviation experts, and help develop technologies that shape the future of aviation. We offer competitive benefits, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for professional growth. **Job Description:** We are looking for a talented, hands\-on Software Engineer to develop and enhance software applications, secure information exchange capabilities, modeling and simulation tools, and engineering prototypes supporting next\-generation aviation systems. Our current and emerging work includes airspace integration of higher airspace operations (HAO) and space launch/reentry operations, air traffic management (ATM) / Communications, Navigation, and Surveillance (CNS) modernization, and simulation of advanced aviation operations. This role combines software development with opportunities to apply cybersecurity, secure communications, data engineering, and emerging technologies. You will work alongside aviation experts and systems engineers to translate operational concepts into software that accurately reflects aviation data, procedures, and requirements. We are particularly interested in candidates who bring familiarity with aviation operations, terminology, or software applications alongside experience developing secure, interoperable software systems. Demonstrable experience in emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML), is also valuable. **What You'll Be Doing**: * Design, develop, maintain, and enhance software applications and engineering prototypes supporting aviation and autonomous systems. * Develop APIs, data models, and software interfaces that enable information exchange across distributed systems and services. * Evaluate and implement secure communication capabilities, including authentication, authorization, digital signatures, encryption, and data integrity verification. * Support the development of digital identity and trust mechanisms for aviation stakeholders, including aircraft, operators, services, and authorized government entities. * Contribute to prototyping and evaluating network\-based aircraft identification, cooperative information services, and secure data\-sharing concepts. * Develop and extend modeling and simulation tools involving aircraft trajectories, operational scenarios, geospatial analysis, and airspace visualization. * Integrate software components and external data sources, and implement data processing, validation, and visualization capabilities. * Apply modern software engineering practices, including modular design, automated testing, debugging, version control, and documentation. * Collaborate with aviation subject matter experts to translate operational requirements into working software and validate domain\-specific assumptions, such as altitude/flight\-level conventions, units, coordinate systems, and timing. * Explore opportunities to apply AI/ML, intelligent automation, and emerging technologies to aviation software applications. **Required Qualifications \& Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of professional software development experience. * Strong proficiency in Python, including experience developing and maintaining software applications. * Experience developing APIs, backend services, data processing applications, or distributed software systems. * Practical understanding of secure software development principles, including authentication, authorization, data protection, and secure communication. * Experience with modeling, simulation, scientific computing, geospatial applications, or other data\-intensive software development. * Familiarity with software architecture, data structures, application integration, and common development tools such as Git and Linux. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a distributed engineering team. * Strong communication skills and the ability to understand and apply domain\-specific terminology, data conventions, and operational requirements in collaboration with aviation experts. * Authorization to work in the United States and ability to meet applicable FAA Public Trust background investigation requirements for assigned work. **Preferred Qualifications \& Experience:** * Prior software or engineering experience in aviation, ATM, UAS, or other aerospace applications, including familiarity with aviation terminology and operational practices. * Supporting U.S. federal agencies or government contractors, particularly the FAA, including requirements\-driven development, technical reviews, documentation, and customer deliverables. * Digital identity, trust frameworks, and cybersecurity technologies, such as PKI, digital signatures, authentication, authorization, and secure information exchange. * NAS data familiarity such as FAA SWIM infrastructure and data * Aviation data models such as FIXM or AIXM * Trajectory\-Based Operations (TBO) or FF\-ICE * Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), workflow orchestration, BI dashboards * Applying AI/ML/LLM to aviation datasets (feature engineering, guardrails) * Publications, open\-source contributions, or patents **You don't need experience in all these areas.** We value strong programming fundamentals, practical engineering experience, curiosity, and the ability to learn and contribute across different technical domains. **Benefits \& Work Environment** ASI offers eligible full\-time employees: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) retirement plan with company matching * Paid time off and paid holidays * Flexible work arrangements * Opportunities for professional development This is a remote position with regular collaboration during U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Occasional travel may be required, generally not expected to exceed 10%. We believe that the best ideas come from a diverse team. jobs.title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Data Center Capacity Delivery - Controls
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. jobs.title: Global Manufacturing Capacity Engineer
jobs.description: Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor\-based products and coaxial and high\-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive. **Position: Global Manufacturing Capacity Engineer** **Location: Nashua, NH (Global Travel)** Amphenol High Speed Products Group is the market leader for high\-speed, high\-bandwidth electrical connectors and cable assemblies for the Telecom/Datacom market, including AI infrastructure, data centers, storage, servers, routers, and switches. Our products enable the electronics revolution and support major Tier 1 OEMs globally. We have design, sales, engineering, and manufacturing locations worldwide and are currently seeking a Global Manufacturing Capacity Engineer to join our Cable Backplane Systems (CBS) Global NPI organization based in Nashua, NH. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Own the CBS global manufacturing capacity planning model and establish one controlled view of demand, secured capacity, constraints, ramp assumptions, and required investments across the manufacturing network. o Translate customer forecasts, program build plans, and allocation assumptions into required production hours, equipment quantities, line capacity, shifts, labor, and site loading by month. o Define and govern standard capacity assumptions including cycle time, OEE, yield, attrition, planned downtime, available manufacturing hours, changeover, maintenance, utilization targets, and ramp curves. o Consolidate site capacity data into a common model that supports consistent comparison across Vietnam, China, Mexico, USA, and future CBS manufacturing locations. o Provide executive\-level visibility of capacity coverage, gaps, timing, mitigation plans, and CapEx requirements before customer demand is impacted. * **Capacity vs. Demand Management \-** Maintain short\-, medium\-, and long\-range capacity models by program, product family, process, site, and equipment family. Show demand hours, secured capacity hours, coverage percentage, and risk status using controlled assumptions. * **Ramp Capacity Planning \-** Model capacity through NPI and production ramp, accounting for phased equipment availability, qualification timing, learning curves, yield maturation, staffing readiness, and expected OEE progression. * **Constraint \& Bottleneck Analysis \-** Identify physical and operational bottlenecks, quantify the magnitude and timing of each gap, and determine whether the constraint is driven by equipment, process, labor, test, material flow, floor space, or readiness. * **Scenario \& Allocation Modeling \-** Evaluate alternative site allocations, production transfers, shift patterns, overtime, equipment redeployment, line conversions, outsourcing, or phased CapEx. Quantify capacity, cost, schedule, and risk tradeoffs for leadership decisions. * **Equipment / CapEx Requirements \-** Convert verified capacity gaps into equipment and line requirements, including quantity, timing, utilization, required operational readiness, and the impact of supplier lead time, installation, debug, and qualification. * **Capacity Governance \-** Lead recurring global capacity reviews with site IE, Planning, Operations, Automation, Finance, and NPI. Maintain assumptions, data ownership, action items, decisions, and mitigation due dates. * **Digital Capacity Platform \-** Develop Power BI dashboards and standardized data structures for capacity, demand, utilization, ramp, and equipment requirements. Support integration with planning, ERP/MRP, MES, equipment, and other approved data sources. * **Data Quality \& Change Control \-** Establish validation rules and revision control for forecast changes, cycle\-time updates, equipment status, site allocations, and other inputs that materially change capacity conclusions. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations Research, Mechanical Engineering, or a related quantitative/technical discipline. * 5\+ years of experience in manufacturing capacity planning, Industrial Engineering, production planning, operations analytics, or factory modeling in a high\-volume environment. * Strong knowledge of cycle time, OEE, yield, available hours, utilization, bottleneck analysis, line loading, equipment requirements, and production\-ramp modeling. * Demonstrated ability to convert forecast and demand into machine, line, labor, and capital requirements and to communicate the assumptions behind the analysis. * Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience with Power BI are strongly preferred. Experience with ERP/MRP, MES, SQL, Snowflake, or manufacturing databases is a plus. * Experience supporting NPI, factory allocation, production transfers, CapEx planning, or global capacity reviews is strongly preferred. * Strong analytical communication skills with the ability to present complex scenarios, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and executive audiences. * Ability to manage multiple changing data inputs while maintaining accuracy, traceability, and version control. * Travel \- Approximately 15\-30% domestic and international travel.
