jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. #### **ABOUT THE TEAM** The LatticeOS Team builds the foundational software\-defined operating system that powers our family of autonomous systems, sensors, and third\-party integrations. Our work spans edge devices, robotic platforms, and cloud infrastructure, creating a unified operating environment for system orchestration, secure data distribution, and real\-time execution. As a core engineering capability, LatticeOS directly enables mission\-critical operations across all domains, powering both internal products and external developer partners integrating through the Lattice SDK. Our solutions are designed for real\-world deployment in the most demanding operational environments, where reliable middleware, high availability, and seamless hardware\-software integration make the difference between mission success and failure. #### #### **ABOUT THE JOB** As a Senior Software Engineer working in the ProtoKV domain you will design and build the core distributed key\-value infrastructure that underpins state sharing across Lattice OS, focusing on performance, reliability, and consistency guarantees at the edge. They'll own the protobuf schema evolution strategy and API surface, ensuring that services across the mesh can safely publish and consume typed state without breaking contracts. A significant portion of the role involves optimizing for the unique constraints of tactical environments — low\-bandwidth links, intermittent connectivity, and strict latency requirements — where traditional distributed systems assumptions don't hold. You'll also collaborate closely with teams across Lattice to understand consumption patterns, debug cross\-service state issues, and evolve ProtoKV's replication and conflict\-resolution mechanisms as the platform scales to new mission sets. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or relevant field, or equivalent experience * 6\+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on distributed systems or data/databases * Deep experience with Python, Go lang, C\+\+, Rust, or similar systems programming languages * Solid distributed\-systems fundamentals. You can reason about replication, consistency, partition behavior, and failure modes, and explain why a given design does or doesn't converge. * Production experience building or operating storage engines, databases, or large\-scale data infrastructure. * Comfort in a systems language. Depth matters more than the specific language you've used. * A bias toward shipping and owning your work. The team is small and what you build is load\-bearing The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: * **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. * **Please always verify communications:** + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address. + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider provides risk\-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public\-record information, and other lawful open\-source or commercial data sources. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Experience implementing high availability, high throughput, scalable systems. * Expertise in identifying and diagnosing application and database related issues, perform root cause analysis, and recommend corrective actions. * Strong ability with dimensional data modeling and OLAP principles. * Experience with PowerShell, Python * Experience using provided tools (AWS, GitLab, Visual Studio). * Experience with agile methodology (Scrum, Kanban, Lean, etc.) preferred. * Familiarity with .NET, C\#, JSON, XML, VisualCron, PowerBI * Familiarity with reporting and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau). * Knowledge of non\-relational databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra) and big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark). **Skills \& Abilities** * Experience in healthcare technology, Medicare Part D, PDE submissions \& returns, pharmacy claims and benefit management * Demonstrated ability to be creative, flexible, and passionate about building quality solutions. * Demonstrated jobs.title: Security Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. Security at that scale runs on data, and you'll be the engineer who owns it and the systems that produce it: component\-level hardware inventory and chain of custody, fed by software that runs at our sites and on hosts, and continuous control monitoring, with the posture calculations that decide what each site is cleared to run. You set the architecture, agree schemas and interfaces with the teams, operators and vendors that own the sources, build the pipelines, stores and tools, and run what you ship. The goal is security that runs itself: custody, access and evidence verified continuously from records, with tools and AI agents doing the reviews. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well. You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's compute and data center operations teams, and directly with data center operators, hardware vendors and logistics providers. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Hardware inventory and chain of custody:** own the component\-level record of what hardware exists, where it is and who has handled it: the data model, the pipelines that join inventory and custody events from many source systems, change history on every record, and the tamper\-evident stores behind it * **Tools, automation and AI agents:** build the tools and agents the team runs on this data: reconciliation, audit evidence exports, custody checks. When a review keeps costing people time, you build the tool or agent that retires it * **Custody workflows and field software:** build the workflows and the site and host software that capture custody events as they happen (a receipt, a move, a data wipe, a decommission) and enforce who is authorized to record them * **Continuous control monitoring and posture:** own the pipelines that turn check outcomes, assessment results and findings into per\-control and per\-site measures over time, against the compliance frameworks we and our partners are assessed against, and the posture calculation that decides what a site is cleared to run * **Data quality:** build coverage checks, reconciliation against sources and alerts on a silent or drifting feed, so a wrong or missing record is caught the same day; own retention and access controls on the records * **Integration and reporting:** agree schemas and interfaces with the engineers who run the security monitoring platform, and build the query surfaces and reports the team, site leads and leadership use directly **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Have designed and run production data systems (relational schemas, change data capture, batch or streaming pipelines and the services around them) and kept them correct: coverage measured, records reconciled against the source, alerts on silence, and a design that expects records to get corrupted or lost * Have integrated with systems you did not control (inventory tools, ticketing systems, vendor APIs) and built data models that outlive any one source * Have shipped software that runs outside a central service (host agents, site\-local services, edge collectors) and kept it correct in the field, or built metrics a team made decisions on and defended them when challenged * Have worked hands\-on with data about physical assets or security controls: a hardware fleet, data center or supply chain inventory, asset custody, or the control and evidence data of a security or compliance program * Read and review other people's code, and build with AI coding agents using Git and code review * Own a domain end to end: set the approach, design and build it with the teams and vendors whose systems it depends on, and run it as something people use every day * Write SQL and at least one general\-purpose programming language well **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with asset management, supply chain or warehouse systems where serialized tracking and custody transfer are the core problem * Experience building continuous control monitoring or metrics for a securit  to know each copy is still reporting * Have built AI agents or automation that replaced recurring manual work The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 \- $405,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Cybersecurity
jobs.description: **Company Description** Apex Clean Energy was founded with a singular focus: to accelerate the shift to clean energy. Through origination, construction, and operation of utility\-scale wind, solar, and storage facilities, distributed energy resources, and green fuel technologies, Apex is expanding the renewable frontier across North America. Our mission\-driven team of nearly 400 professionals uses a data\-focused approach and an unrivaled portfolio of projects to create solutions for the world’s most innovative and forward\-thinking customers. For more information about how Apex is building the energy company of the future, visit apexcleanenergy.com. *Apex strives to excel in every phase of project realization, from origination and financing to construction and asset management. Our mission\-driven team seeks determined, resolute individuals who strive to innovate and go above the call of duty, and who will relentlessly do their part to help accelerate the shift to America’s clean energy future.* **Job Description** The Senior Manager, Cybersecurity owns Apex's cybersecurity program across corporate IT, cloud, and operational technology environments, reporting to the Director of Integrated Technology Solutions (ITS). This is a senior individual\-contributor role with no direct reports and real authority. You'll set security standards, review significant technology changes, direct security work carried out by ITS engineers and operations staff, and lead the response when incidents occur. You can enforce security standards and take immediate protective action against an active threat, while business leaders own decisions to accept material residual risk. This role leads Apex's cybersecurity program at a point where the direction is set, and the foundations are in place. The work now is to mature it: turning strategy into durable standards, sharper risk decisions, and a program that keeps pace as the business and the threat landscape change. You'll have broad scope, direct access to leadership, and a real hand in protecting infrastructure that supports the energy transition. The role is supported by ITS infrastructure, systems engineering, and operations teams, and by a 24/7 managed security partner that provides monitoring and initial response. You'll be the senior escalation point when incidents occur, including after hours. * Hours: Full\-time * Type: Exempt * Department: Integrated Technology Solutions * Travel: 10% * Office Location: Charlottesville, VA **Primary Responsibilities:** **Strategy \& Risk** * Lead and evolve Apex's cybersecurity strategy, roadmap, policies, and standards in partnership with the Director of ITS * Run the cybersecurity risk program, including the risk register, assessments of systems, vendors, and integrations, and security review of significant technology initiatives before implementation * Report security posture, material risk, and program performance to leadership **Security Operations** * Oversee vulnerability management, endpoint protection, SIEM/SOC monitoring, network and firewall governance, and cloud security posture * Own identity and access standards, including IAM, PAM, and account lifecycle * Manage relationships with managed security, SOC, and incident response partners, including performance and escalation * Direct ITS technical staff on security work, while staying hands\-on enough to investigate threats and validate controls yourself **OT \& NERC CIP** * Define cybersecurity requirements for the IT/OT boundary, including remote and vendor access, in partnership with SCADA/OT leadership * Integrate NERC CIP cybersecurity requirements into Apex's overall security framework * Work with SCADA/OT leadership to extend incident response, monitoring, vulnerability management, and vendor risk programs to OT, including protection of critical backups **Incident Response \& Resilience** * Serve as incident commander for cybersecurity events, coordinating with Legal, Communications, leadership, insurers, forensics partners, regulators, and law enforcement * Maintain incident response plans and playbooks, and run regular tabletop exercises, including joint exercises with SCADA/OT * Own IT disaster recovery and cyber recovery planning and testing, and coordinate enterprise business continuity **Enabling the Business** * Set security requirements for AI, SaaS, APIs, automation, data handling, and secrets management so teams can adopt new technology responsibly * Lead security awareness, phishing simulation, and privileged\-user training, and build security capability across ITS **Qualifications** *To succeed as the Senior Manager, Cybersecurity at Apex Clean Energy, you’ll need to excel within the following criteria:* **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of progressively responsible experience in cybersecurity, including leading security programs or major initiatives across teams without direct reporting authority * A track record of maturing an established security progr Hands\-on experience with SIEM, EDR, firewalls, vulnerability management, IAM/PAM, and cloud security tooling, including personally investigating incidents * Experience leading incident response and making time\-sensitive decisions during active events * Ability to separate technical findings from material business risk and explain the difference to senior leadership * Sound judgment balancing security, operations, business priorities, and regulatory obligations **Preferred Qualifications** * CISSP, CISM, GICSP, GIAC, or comparable certification * Working knowledge of NERC CIP as it applies to generation assets * Experience in energy, utilities, or other critical infrastructure, including OT, ICS, or SCADA environments (IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800\-82 familiarity a plus) * Experience managing MSSPs, SOC providers, or incident response firms * Experience assessing security risk in AI, SaaS, and automation adoption At Apex Clean Energy, we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and success. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply, even if you do not meet every qualification listed in the job description. Your unique experiences and skills could be the perfect fit for our team! If you are passionate about renewable energy and want to join us in accelerating the shift to clean energy, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application for our team’s review! **Additional Information** **Work Environment:** Works in both an indoor office environment and an outdoor environment, occasionally at night which may be subject to inclement weather. Extended hours may be required to complete scheduled repairs. **How You’ll Grow** At Apex Clean Energy, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT APPLY** APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI\-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com. **LOCATION:** *APPLY is hybrid/remote\-friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in* ***Latin America****, preferably working in hours that align to* ***PT (Pacific Timezone) or*** ***ET (Eastern Timezone)****. Candidates located in Santiago, Chile are able to work out of our Santiago office as remote/hybrid employees. Candidates located outside of Santiago, Chile will be fully remote employees.* **THE ROLE:** APPLY is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data team. You will build and own data foundations on modern cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake using dbt\-based ELT: from source audits and migration guidelines, through modelling (identity resolution, semantic and consumption layers), to activation pipelines into customer engagement platforms such as Braze. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams, clients and third\-party vendors to define data requirements, translate business needs into technical specifications, and produce clear, actionable recommendations. The successful candidate will have a strong background in data engineering on the modern data stack and excellent communication skills to interact with stakeholders and clients. If you have a passion for technology, thrive in a dynamic environment, and possess strong client\-facing communication skills, we want to hear from you. ### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Work with internal disciplines, vendors, clients and stakeholders to define data requirements and the technology stack for projects. * Audit source systems (CRM and marketing platforms such as Salesforce and Sailthru) and define migration guidelines: what to migrate, in what structure and in what order, for execution by internal or third\-party teams. * Translate business requirements into technical specifications including data streams, integrations, transformations, databases and data warehouses. * Design and build transformation layers in dbt on Snowflake, including identity resolution, semantic layer and consumption/reporting layers. * Build and maintain pipelines that activate data in customer engagement platforms (e.g., Braze). * Run discovery audits of digital products (apps, games, web) and produce data foundation recommendations. * Work in git\-based workflows with code review, dbt tests and existing CI/CD processes for warehouse objects. * Define the data architecture framework, standards and principles, including modelling, metadata, security and reference data; analyze and optimize existing architectures and models for performance and cost. * Create a plan of activities required to populate new solutions with all current and historical data. * Implement data security and access controls to ensure compliance with company policies and regulation. * Document data sources, ELT/ETL processes, data dictionaries and metadata to facilitate data discovery; maintain data lineage and data flow documentation. * Research, evaluate and recommend new technologies, and develop best practices for data management, security and privacy. ### **REQUIREMENTS:** * A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. * At least 5 years of experience in data engineering or related fields. * Expert\-level SQL and strong experience in ELT/ETL and cloud data warehousing, with hands\-on Snowflake experience. * Strong hands\-on experience with dbt (modelling, tests, documentation, macros) and git\-based workflows (branching, code review, CI/CD). * Proven experience in data modelling (dimensional and semantic layers) and analysis techniques. * Experience with customer data modelling and identity resolution across CRM, marketing and product sources. * Experience integrating data with customer engagement platforms (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Sailthru or similar). * Experience planning data migrations between platforms: source audit, mapping, target structure definition and historical backfill. * Working knowledge of Python for data tooling and automation. * Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS or GCP) and its data services. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot data issues and develop effective solutions. * Comfortable producing written guidelines and recommendations for client and third\-party teams. * Understanding of data privacy and security best practices. * Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills. * Fluent English. **Nice to Have** * Snowflake (SnowPro) or dbt certification; cloud certifications welcome. * Spark/PySpark. * Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience with consumer or digital\-product data (apps, games, subscriptions). **LIFE AT APPLY** People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you: **Agentic Delivery:** Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact. **An inclusive and safe environment:** We’re truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe. **AI \& Strategic Upskilling:** Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work. **Generous vacation policy:** Work\-life balance is key to our team’s success, so we offer ample time away from work to promote overall well\-being. **Flexible work arrangements:** We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in\-office, to a blend of both. APPLY is a safe, respectful, and inclusive community where differences are celebrated. We are committed to equal opportunity and fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. Learn more in our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) section. For recruitment accommodations, please email careers@applydigital.com. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Staff Systems Safety Engineer
jobs.description: Apptronik is a human\-centered robotics company developing AI\-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond. We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better. **JOB SUMMARY** Be the technical authority for the safety of our humanoid robots, from concept through customer deployment. You will author the system safety architecture and safety case and provide technical leadership to the engineers who own hazard analysis, safety functions, and customer deployment safety, so that the safety case holds up with customers and assessors. You will draw on deep functional safety and robot safety expertise, technical leadership, and sound risk\-based judgment. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES** * Provide technical leadership to the systems safety engineers, from hazard analysis and safety requirements through site risk assessment and commissioning, be accountable for the technical quality of their work, and support first customer deployments on site * Set technical direction across the safety team, review its work, and mentor engineers through coaching, technical guidance, and input on hiring, and keep the team's day\-to\-day technical priorities aligned to long\-term goals * Author the system\-level safety architecture (including AI) and functional safety concept, driving architecture\-level safety decisions across current and next\-generation platforms, balancing performance, technical risk, and compliance * Serve as technical authority for safety trade\-offs, residual risk recommendations, component and architectural decisions, and conflicts between safety and product goals * Author and maintain the safety case, ensuring evidence from software, hardware, AI, user safety, and deployment is complete, consistent, and traceable, including the SOTIF argument for hazards that arise without a fault * Perform system\-level safety analyses that span the domain roles, such as system fault trees and common\-cause failure analysis, lead in\-depth design reviews of safety\-critical subsystems, and take hands\-on ownership of deliverables where the team has gaps * Define the safety lifecycle, including the AI safety lifecycle under ISO/IEC TS 22440 and the SOTIF process under ISO 21448, and safety engineering methods, and the technical criteria for design reviews, safety gates, and SOTIF residual risk acceptance **SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS** * Proven hands\-on leadership of functional or system safety for complex robotic, machinery, or autonomous products from concept through deployment, including authoring safety architectures and safety cases * Deep expertise in hazard analysis and risk assessment, the hierarchy of controls, safety function definition, and the safety lifecycle under IEC 61508, IEC 62061, ISO 13849, and ISO 12100 * Experience with robot and machinery safety standards, such as ISO 10218, ANSI/A3 R15\.06, ANSI/A3 R15\.08, and ISO 25785\-1, and with the safety of robot deployments at customer sites * Experience providing technical leadership and mentoring to safety engineers across hardware, software, and system topics * Experience building a safety case and working with notified bodies, NRTLs, or third\-party assessors * Familiarity with safety of AI/ML\-enabled systems, such as ISO/IEC TS 22440 and SOTIF (ISO 21448\), and with requirements tools such as JAMA * Strong executive communication, strategic thinking, and the judgment to make and defend risk\-based decisions **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Robotics, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience); Master's preferred * 12\+ years of relevant experience, including 7\+ years in functional or system safety, with substantial responsibility for the safety of complex robotic or electromechanical products and prior technical leadership of a safety team * Certified functional safety expert or professional (e.g., TÜV, exida) preferred **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times * Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen * Hearing and speech to communicate Salary range for CA: $280,000 \- $310,000 * This is a direct hire. Please, no outside Agency solicitations. jobs.title: Solution Engineer, Data & AI
jobs.description: **Company Overview:** Arctiq is a global, intelligence\-driven technology services company delivering professional and managed services across Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Networking \& Connected Experiences, Cybersecurity, Data \& AI, Autonomous Operations \& Intelligence, and Enterprise Service Management. We help organizations operate, secure, and modernize complex environments by unifying infrastructure, networking, data, security, automation, and observability under a single, integrated operating model. Our work focuses on helping customers reduce operational friction, improve resilience, and make better, faster decisions as their environments evolve. Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer\-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries. **Position Overview:** **The Solution Engineer, Data \& AI** is a hands\-on builder who designs, delivers, and operates production\-grade data and AI solutions. You will join a team of engineers who bring real software engineering discipline to data work — version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability are how we work, not afterthoughts. We also expect our engineers to embrace agentic engineering, using tools like Claude Code to dramatically accelerate how software gets built without compromising quality. Depending on business need and your strengths, you will be aligned to one of two paths: **Path 1 — Client Delivery:** Support delivery of fixed\-price, outcome\-based data and AI projects for clients across a wide range of industries and problem domains, on Azure, AWS, and GCP. In a fixed\-price model, engineering quality and delivering within agreed scope directly affect client outcomes and project margin. **Path 2 — Internal Data \& Analytics:** Bring order to our internal data on Azure Databricks — integrating, cleaning, and modelling data from our business systems so the organization has trusted analytics and reporting and helping automate core business processes such as quote\-to\-cash. Both paths share the same technical foundation, and engineers may move between paths over time as priorities and interests evolve. **Responsibilities:** **Data Pipeline Engineering** * Design, build, and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines for batch and streaming workloads * Apply proven lakehouse architecture patterns, with clear data contracts and well\-managed schema evolution * Build data quality checks, testing, and monitoring into every pipeline from day one **Data Modelling \& Analysis** * Design analytical data models that reflect business requirements and perform at scale * Profile, explore, and analyze data to validate assumptions, surface quality issues, and share meaningful insights with stakeholders * Apply sound data governance practices so data assets are secure, traceable, and discoverable **AI \& Machine Learning Engineering** * Build, train, and evaluate machine learning and generative AI solutions — from classical ML to LLM\-based and agentic applications * Establish rigorous evaluation approaches tied to clear, business\-aligned success criteria * Take models from experimentation to production, ensuring they are reliable, observable, and maintainable **MLOps \& DevOps** * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for code, data, and models * Manage cloud and platform resources through infrastructure as code * Implement full model lifecycle management — versioning, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining * Champion engineering best practices across the team: code reviews, branching strategies, automated testing, and documentation **Agentic Engineering** * Use agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) as a core part of your daily workflow to accelerate design, development, testing, documentation, and refactoring * Provide AI agents with effective context through clear specifications, project instructions, and reusable workflows * Apply rigorous review, testing, and validation to AI\-generated code — you own the quality of what ships, regardless of who or what wrote it * Share effective agentic workflows with the team and help codify them into repeatable practices and accelerators **Path 1 — Client Delivery** * Deliver engineering workstreams on fixed\-price client engagements, from technical discovery through outcome acceptance * Work across client environments on Azure, AWS, and GCP, adapting patterns to each client’s cloud, security model, and constraints * Partner with Architects and your Engineering Manager to deliver solutions within agreed scope, timeline, and commercial constraints * Participate in client workshops, demos, and technical working sessions, building credibility with client technical teams * Identify scope creep, technical risks, and blockers early — and raise them promptly and constructively * Leave clients better off: document solutions clearly, transfer knowledge, and help build client\-side capability * Contribute to reusable accelerators, templates, and patterns that make future engagements more predictable **Path 2 — Internal Data \& Analytics** * Integrate data from our core business systems (e.g., CRM, PSA, finance/ERP, HR) into our Azure Databricks environment * Clean, reconcile, and standardize messy internal data — resolving duplicates, aligning definitions across systems, and establishing a single source of truth for key entities such as customers, projects, contracts, and revenue * Coordinate with internal teams to identify, prioritize, and resolve data quality issues at the source, and put processes in place to prevent them from recurring * Build trusted, well\-documented data models that power internal analytics, KPIs, and executive and operational reporting * Partner with Finance, Sales, Operations, and leadership to understand reporting needs and translate them into reliable data products * Help design and automate quote\-to\-cash workflows, connecting data and handoffs from opportunity through quote, contract, delivery, invoicing, and collections **Qualifications:** * 4\+ years in software and platform engineering, including meaningful time on a collaborative software development team * Hands\-on experience building production data and ML solutions in the cloud * Strong, demonstrable experience with the Databricks platform in production environments * Practical experience using agentic coding tools to accelerate software development — with examples of how it has changed the way you work **Technical Skills** **Software Engineering \& DevOps** * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL * Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git workflows, code review, unit and integration testing, modular design * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tooling and infrastructure as code * Comfortable with containerization, environment management, and automated deployment **Cloud Platforms** * Working knowledge of all three major clouds — Azure, AWS, and GCP — with deep hands\-on experience in at least one * Understanding of how data platforms are deployed and integrated on each cloud, including storage, identity, networking, and security * Familiarity with each cloud’s native data and AI services and when to use them alongside Databricks **Databricks** * Deep, hands\-on experience across the Databricks platform, including data engineering, governance, and ML/AI capabilities * Experience deploying and managing Databricks solutions using software engineering and DevOps best practices **Data Engineering \& Modelling** * Proven ability to design and build scalable batch and streaming pipelines * Strong data modelling skills across dimensional and modern lakehouse patterns * Experience with data quality frameworks, testing, and observability **AI / ML \& MLOps** * Practical experience building, evaluating, and deploying ML models to production * Experience with generative AI patterns such as retrieval\-augmented generation, agents, and LLM evaluation * Strong MLOps practices across so agents produce high\-quality results * Sound judgment on where AI\-assisted development adds leverage and where it introduces risk, with a disciplined approach to reviewing and testing its output jobs.title: Full-Stack Robotics & AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Astera** ---------------- Astera Institute is a private foundation supporting ambitious work in science and technology through grants, investments, and in\-house research. Its research programs combine the pace and autonomy of a startup with the freedom to pursue difficult scientific questions. Learn more about Astera’s mission at astera.org/vision. **About the Robotics Lab** -------------------------- We are building a frontier robotics lab at Astera Institute. We believe neuroscience and AI will converge in embodied intelligence: animals and robots face shared challenges of perceiving their surroundings, navigating, manipulating objects, and using memory and reasoning to accomplish tasks in the physical world. Robotics provides a powerful testbed for investigating how biological neural circuits solve these challenges and for developing AI systems that turn perception, learning, and cognition into effective action. Our strategy starts with making robots useful, while developing a mechanistic understanding of how neural circuits can generate intelligent behavior. We aim to continually expand the repertoire of behaviors a robot can perform reliably in real environments, while improving its ability to learn new skills, adapt to changing conditions, and recover from failure. These practical capabilities provide both measurable outcomes and a foundation for investigating deeper principles of intelligence. **Position Summary** -------------------- We are looking for an engineer who can take a learning\-based robotics system from model development to reliable operation on a physical robot. You will work across perception, policy learning, inference, and robot integration, connecting what a model predicts to what a robot actually does. This is a hands\-on engineering role in our Robotics Lab in Emeryville, California. You will work closely with researchers and hardware engineers to develop manipulation capabilities, investigate failures on real robots, and improve the software and models together. **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- * **Develop models for robotic manipulation.** Fine\-tune and evaluate vision and action models for robotic manipulation, using pretrained models and robot data. * **Connect perception to action.** Build the software that connects cameras and other sensors to model inference and robot commands, including calibration, coordinate transforms, action representations, and control interfaces. * **Optimize models for deployment.** Deploy models on robot hardware and optimize inference latency, memory use, and throughput through profiling, distillation, compilation, and precision changes. * **Build responsive policy execution.** Implement responsive policy execution, including asynchronous inference and action chunking where appropriate. * **Diagnose failures across the stack.** Debug failures across the full system—from observations and model outputs to middleware and physical motion—and build logging, replay, and evaluation tools to understand them. * **Build reusable robot software.** Package robot capabilities with clear interfaces, reproducible configurations, and tests so other team members can use and extend them. **Desired Qualifications** -------------------------- * **Machine learning engineering.** Strong Python skills and practical experience training or fine\-tuning models in PyTorch or a comparable framework. * **Physical robot integration.** Experience integrating learning or perception systems with physical robots, including coordinate frames, sensor calibration, and action or control interfaces. * **Systems debugging and optimization.** Ability to profile software, identify runtime bottlenecks, and debug problems that span models, robotics software, and hardware. * **Practical engineering experience.** A record of building working systems and evaluating them on real tasks, with a clear understanding of your own technical contributions. * **Technical collaboration.** Comfort working closely with researchers and engineers, making practical tradeoffs, and iterating from experimental results. * **Robot learning experience.** Robot learning frameworks such as LeRobot or openpi, imitation learning, or vision\-language\-action models. jobs.title: Marketing AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avenue Z, Inc.** Avenue Z is a digital marketing and PR agency engineered to move fast. Brands partner with us to drive revenue and reputation through high\-impact public relations, performance media, AI search optimization (AEO), and our creator network. Trusted by leaders in emerging tech, finance and consumer brands, ***we drive influence*** across all channels \- from AI Search to The Wall Street Journal, Shopify to TikTok, Meta to Google. **The role** ------------ You are a growth marketer who builds. You have bought media on Meta, Google, or TikTok with your own hands, you know what a good ROAS looks like before the dashboard loads, and when something is manual, repetitive, or slow, your instinct is to open an editor and wire it to the platform API rather than schedule a working session. The Marketing AI Engineer builds and ships the AI agents, automations, and reporting systems that run paid media, creator and affiliate campaigns, CRO, and client reporting at Avenue Z. The work is concrete: agents that launch and QA ads across Meta, TikTok, and Snap; systems that reallocate budget toward top\-performing creators; reporting that ties creator content, ad spend, and attributed revenue into one picture; alerts that catch an expiring TikTok Shop affiliate code or a Meta partnership permission before spend stalls. You are also the technical lead for our AI builders. You set the standard for how agents are designed, reviewed, and shipped across service lines, you review their work, and you are the person leadership turns to when a build needs a decision. You will embed with the paid media, creator, and ecommerce teams to find where throughput or margin is lost, build the system that fixes it, drive adoption, and move to the next one. This is a builder and a leader role. You ship working systems yourself, and you raise the bar for everyone else who ships them. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Build against the marketing platforms our revenue runs on** * Integrate with the Meta Marketing API, TikTok Business and TikTok Shop APIs, Google Ads API, Snap, Shopify, and affiliate and creator platform APIs: OAuth and token refresh, rate limits, webhooks, and partnership\-access flows. * Build agents and automations for ad launching and QA, budget pacing and reallocation, creative tagging and performance intelligence, anomaly detection, and cross\-platform commission tracking. * Build the reporting layer that shows a brand what actually drove revenue, cross\-referenced against Shopify as the source of truth. **Embed with the teams and ship against real problems** * Sit with paid media, creator and affiliate, CRO, and ecommerce teams. Audit how they work today, map the workflow from input to output, and find the steps that should run automatically. * Turn a messy manual process into a working system inside weeks, not quarters. Define where a human approves and where the system acts on its own, especially where money or brand safety is on the line. * Drive adoption. A system that ships and sits unused does not count. Train the team, gather feedback, and iterate. **Build Innovative AI Driven Marketing SolutionsAI** * Provide technical leadership on product roadmap. Be an expert in building and shipping production ready solutions. * Set the standard for how Avenue Z designs, reviews, documents, and ships agents and automations across service lines, and enforce it through code review and design review. * Review and mentor the engineers and builders already working on AI automation across PR, SEO and AEO, organic social, and ecommerce. Unblock them, raise their quality bar, and own the outcome of their work. * Run the intake and prioritization of automation requests so the team builds what moves revenue, time saved, or client retention, in that order. * Report progress, blockers, and measured impact to the CTO and present to leadership. **Invent new capability** * Build things that create new advantages for the business, not just faster versions of old tasks: autonomous media buying, creative\-to\-landing\-page pipelines, creator performance ranking, and whatever you see next that we have not. **What you won't do** --------------------- * Be a passive project coordinator or a pure strategist with no build capability. * Spend months planning without shipping. * Wait for perfect requirements before building. * Build for novelty instead of business value. * Replace human judgment where brand, strategy, or client context still matters. * Treat marketing as someone else's domain. You have to understand the ad account as well as the people running it. **Who you are** --------------- **Required** * A background in growth marketing. You have personally run paid media on at least one of Instagram and Facebook, Google, or TikTok, and you understand campaign structure, pixels and events, attribution windows, creative testing, and what the numbers mean. * Hands\-on experience working with the Meta Marketing API and the  ity. * Commercially aware: knows the difference between an impressive demo and a system that makes or saves money. * High agency. Does not wait to be assigned the problem. * Good judgment on what should be automated and what should stay human. * Can switch between a conversation with a media buyer and a code review without changing register. **Show us your work** --------------------- We will ask every candidate for a list of projects or code repositories that demonstrate the ability to do this job. Public GitHub repos, private repos you can grant read access to, a Loom walkthrough of a system in production, or a written case study with architecture and results all work. We are looking for: * At least one build against a marketing platform API (Meta, TikTok, Google, Shopify, or similar) that ran in production. * At least one AI agent or automation that replaced real manual work, with the before and after. * Evidence of your coding practice: how you structure a project, handle secrets, test, and document. * If you have led a team, an example of a standard you set and how you enforced it. Candidates who cannot share any work product will not advance. **Your first 90 days** ---------------------- **Days 1 to 15: Learn the work** * Meet the paid media, creator, CRO, and ecommerce leads and the AI builders across service lines. * Get read access to the ad accounts, the platform apps, and the existing agent codebases. Audit what is live, what is half\-built, and what is broken. * Map the highest\-friction, highest\-frequency workflows and prioritize three to five to build or fix first. * Agree success metrics and reporting cadence with the CTO. **Days 16 to 45: Build fast** * Ship your first agent or automation into live use on a named client account. * Review the open work of the existing builders and set the code review and design review standard. * Document logic, approvals, edge cases, and operating rules for everything you ship. **Days 46 to 75: Expand and standardize** * Extend what works to more accounts and teams. Build reusable patterns, templates, and shared tooling. * Introduce a clear framework for human review and escalation, especially for anything that touches spend or client\-facing output. * Take over intake and prioritization of automation requests. **Days 76 to 90: Prove impact** * Present before and after results, adoption, and measured time or money saved to the CTO and CEO. * Recommend the next wave of builds. * Have a team that ships to your standard without you in every review. **Success metrics** ------------------- * Three to five high\-value systems live on real client accounts in the first 90 days. * Measurable reduction in manual work on targeted processes, with the baseline captured before the build. * Strong internal adoption by the teams using the systems. * Reliable performance with clear exception handling. Nothing touches a live ad account or a client without a logged action and a named approver. * The AI builders across service lines shipping to a single documented standard. * A clear roadmap for the next phase of agent development tied to revenue, retention, or cost. **Daily reality** ----------------- * Review a manual process in paid media or creator ops and redesign it into a system. * Build or refine an agent based on yesterday's feedback from a media buyer. * Review another builder's pull request and send it back with what to change. * Wire a new platform endpoint, handle the token refresh, and ship it. * Monitor what is running, fix what failed overnight, and improve reliability. * Ship again. **Reporting** ------------- * Daily: async update to the CTO on builds, blockers, and wins. * Weekly: working session with the CTO on priorities, decisions, and impact. * Monthly: summary of automation impact, adoption, and next opportunities to the CEO. **Benefits** ------------ * Medical, vision, and dental plans * 401(k) plan with 4% employer match * Unlimited PTO * Professional development stipend

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description: **The big picture:** Axios is a respected media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award\-winning news content in an audience\-first format known as Smart Brevity™. We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer with strong cloud infrastructure and AI security experience to lead our defensive posture, drive threat modeling and vulnerability management, and embed security controls \- including AI\-driven defense and monitoring \- across our platform and automation pipelines. **Why it matters:** As a Senior Security Engineer at Axios, you will architect and implement proactive security strategies to protect our audience, platform, and data assets against evolving threat vectors, including AI\-driven attacks. In this role, you will define our security roadmap, leverage internal and third\-party AI defense tools, and ensure our cloud systems remain resilient, secure by default, and capable of automated threat detection and response. **Responsibilities:** * Lead the architectural design and implementation of security controls across cloud infrastructure, platform services, and AI integrations. * Drive vulnerability management, threat modeling, incident response, and proactive security assessments across AWS, Kubernetes, and AI application environments. * Shape, maintain, and execute the company's long\-term security roadmap in close alignment with engineering and executive leadership. * Embed automated security testing, SAST/DAST, and AI\-driven compliance checks directly into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure\-as\-code workflows. * Oversee identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, encryption protocols, and zero\-trust architecture standards. * Evaluate, deploy, and maintain internal AI security tools and modern third\-party defensive solutions to detect, mitigate, and respond to AI\-driven threats and sophisticated attack vectors in real time. * Promote a strong security culture across engineering by conducting threat modeling workshops and coaching teams on secure coding and infrastructure practices. * Partner with product, infrastructure, data, and QE teams to ensure security is integrated seamlessly into every stage of the development lifecycle. **Skills:** * Deep expertise in cloud and application security, including threat modeling, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, IAM, secrets management, AI security, and compliance frameworks. * Strong working knowledge of AWS infrastructure and security controls (IAM, KMS, EKS, RDS, S3\). * Experience hardening Kubernetes clusters, runtime security, container scanning, and network policy enforcement. * Proficiency in integrating SAST/DAST and security automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions). * Solid scripting or programming skills in Python, Go, or Bash for security tooling and automated remediation. * Hands\-on experience with SIEM, security logging, automated threat intelligence, and AI\-powered monitoring frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or modern SOC tooling). * Demonstrated leadership in driving security initiatives, defining policy, and guiding engineering teams on security risk. * Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively balance security requirements and business agility. **What success looks like:** * **Security \& Compliance:** Focused on proactive security initiatives, including automated vulnerability scans, implementation of controls, remediation, and contributions to the long\-term security roadmap. * **Cloud Security Architecture:** Hardened, reviewed, and optimized AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure security to meet strict compliance, resilience, and least\-privilege access standards. * **DevSecOps \& Automation:** Integrated automated security scans, secret detection, and vulnerability gates seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines without disrupting developer velocity. * **Security Tooling Adoption:** Evaluated, piloted, and deployed advanced security and defensive AI tools that measurably enhanced threat detection speed and reduced exposure risk. * **Threat Detection \& Response:** Established robust security monitoring, SIEM alerting, and incident response playbooks to maintain real\-time visibility and rapid response capabilities across all production platforms. * **Cross\-Functional Security Leadership:** Partnered with engineering, product, and QE teams to instill a security\-first culture, conduct threat modeling workshops, and guide technical teams on risk mitigation. * **AI Defense \& Security:** Evaluated and deployed internal AI security tools and 3rd\-party defensive solutions to proactively safeguard infrastructure, applications, and corporate assets against AI\-driven threats and emerging attack vectors. *Starting salary for this role is in the range of $150,000 \- $180,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account the cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote\-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.* Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows. **What Axios brings to the table besides salary:** * 401(k) with employer match * Robust PPO and High Deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network * Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high deductible health plan option * Dental and vision coverage * Primary caregiver 12\-week paid leave * Birth\-givers will have an additional 6\-8 weeks depending on type of delivery, for a total of 18\-20 weeks continuous leave * Generous vacation policy, plus holidays * One mental health day per quarter * Annual learning and development stipend * $100 monthly work\-from\-home stipend * Tele\-mental health services through Headspace * OneMedical membership, including tele\-health services * Personal health advocacy resources through HealthAdvocate * Inclusive fertility, hormonal health and family forming benefits through Carrot Fertility * Access to the Axios Employee Support Fund, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies * Increased work flexibility for parents and caretakers * Virtual company\-sponsored social events * A strong and positive work environment * A commitment to an open, inclusive, and diverse work culture **Equal Opportunity Employer Statement** Axios is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Axios makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

jobs.title: Sr Engineer, Embedded Firmware
jobs.description: **Sr Engineer: Embedded Firmware** ================================== In this role, you will drive firmware design from inception to customer deployment, ensuring seamless hardware validation and integration. This is a unique opportunity to leverage your expertise in embedded systems, multi\-chip package environments, and high\-speed SerDes to shape the future of optical interconnect. **Essential Functions:** * Design, develop, and optimize embedded firmware for controlling high\-speed SerDes interfaces and electronic/photonic subsystems. * Collaborate closely with analog/mixed\-signal, digital, and photonic block designers to develop and implement sophisticated control algorithms for our photonic circuits and establish the micro\-architecture and embedded requirements for our multi\-chip package systems. * Write unit tests and integration tests for firmware modules; participate in firmware code reviews; maintain high\-quality firmware through CI/CD practices. * Develop and execute firmware test code to support initial silicon power\-on and bringup activities; debug hardware\-firmware interactions at first silicon. * Partner effectively with hardware, validation, systems, and software teams throughout the product development lifecycle. * Maintain clear technical documentation including APIs, firmware architecture documents, module specifications, and build/release notes **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's in Electrical/Computer Engineering or a related field with 3\+ years of relevant industry experience. * Proven expertise in bare\-metal embedded firmware development, with strong programming skills in C. * Experience with various microcontrollers and firmware debugging tools. * Proficiency with modern version control workflows (e.g., Git), modern firmware development tools, and CI/CD tools. * Hands\-on, proactive approach with the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic startup environment. * Silicon bring\-up experience. * Experience in scripting with high level language like Python. * Experience with Make\-based build flows. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Ability to own architecture and development of firmware modules from scratch. * Experience in embedded firmware development for high\-speed electronics and photonics applications. * Silicon bring\-up experience for high\-speed SerDes and photonics applications. **Principal Engineer: Silicon Validation** ========================================== In this role, you will lead the silicon validation of our optical chiplets. You will define and drive the validation strategy from initial silicon power\-on through block and chip level signoff. This is a rare opportunity to apply deep expertise in high\-speed SerDes, photonic systems, and post\-silicon validation to shape the future of optical interconnect for next\-generation AI infrastructure. **Essential Functions:** * **Lead Validation Strategy**: Define and implement comprehensive validation methodologies for our electronic\-photonic SoCs, covering initial bringup, functional validation, electrical characterization, and system\-level testing. Develop detailed test plans, success criteria, and select appropriate test equipment and methodologies. * **Drive Silicon Bring\-up**: Lead first silicon power\-on and bringup for new tape\-outs, collaborating with firmware and design teams to establish operating conditions and validate core functionality from day one. * **Own Block and System Validation**: Execute rigorous post\-silicon validation of SerDes interfaces, optical control loops, and mixed\-signal blocks using industry\-standard lab equipment (BERT, DCA, oscilloscopes, OSA, VNA). * **Apply Standards and Best Practices**: Draw on industry standards (IEEE, OIF, JEDEC, Ethernet/Optical MSA specs) and semiconductor validation best practices to establish rigorous validation targets, coverage objectives, and signoff criteria. * **Root Cause and Debug**: Investigate and drive to closure all silicon failure modes, from signal integrity issues to mixed\-signal anomalies, using systematic debug methodologies and close collaboration with design and firmware teams. * **Mentor and Lead**: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to senior and junior validation engineers; guide the team's technical execution. * **Deliver High Quality Documentation**: Create and maintain comprehensive validation reports, signoff packages, and product performance documentation. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field with 10\+ years of relevant industry experience, or Master's degree with 7\+ years of experience. * Demonstrated leadership in post\-silicon validation for complex SoCs or multi\-chip packages, including first silicon bringup and full signoff. * Hands\-on expertise with high\-speed SerDes validation and characterization (NRZ and PAM\-4\) using equipment such as BERTs, oscilloscopes/DCAs, and network analyzers. * Strong proficiency in Python for lab automation, data analysis, and test infrastructure development. * Experience developing and owning validation test plans end\-to\-end. * Deep understanding of communication protocols and standards (Ethernet, PCIe, etc.). * Excellent communication skills and ability to drive cross\-functional technical alignment. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Familiarity with optical transceiver standards and co\-packaged optics integration challenges. * Knowledge of high\-speed standards: Ethernet (200G/400G/800G), PCIe Gen5/6, OIF CEI. * Experience driving NPI and transition from lab validation to manufacturing test. **Sr Engineer: Silicon Validation** =================================== In this role, you will own the silicon bringup and validation of our optical chiplets. You will execute post\-silicon bringup and characterization across SerDes, photonic, and mixed\-signal blocks, building the test infrastructure and automation that ensures our products meet and exceed specification before customer deployment. **Essential Functions:** * Perform initial power\-on and bringup of new silicon tape\-outs, including boot sequence validation, clock/power domain verification, and initial functionality tests. * Perform functional and electrical characterization of high\-speed SerDes interfaces, photonic control blocks, and mixed signal blocks. Define and execute test plans at both block and chip level. * Use lab test equipment (BERT, oscilloscope/DCA, OSA, signal generators) to characterize signal integrity, eye diagrams, BER, jitter, and optical performance metrics. * Develop and maintain Python\-based test scripts and automation frameworks for regression and characterization testing. * Systematically investigate silicon anomalies and failures; collaborate with design and firmware engineers to develop and verify fixes. * Write clear test plans, validation reports, and signoff documentation; communicate findings to cross\-functional teams. * Partner with firmware, analog/mixed\-signal, digital, and systems engineering teams across the full product development cycle. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field with 3\+ years of relevant industry experience. * Hands\-on experience with post\-silicon bringup and validation of high\-speed SoC or mixed\-signal devices. * Working knowledge of SerDes PHY operation and characterization, including NRZ and/or PAM\-4 signaling. * Proficiency with lab equipment used for high\-speed characterization: BERT, oscilloscopes, signal analyzers. * Proficiency in Python for test scripting and data analysis. * Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to work independently in a lab environment. * Proficiency with version control (Git) and software development environments. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with photonic device or electro\-optic system characterization and validation. * Familiarity with optical measurement equipment (OSA, optical power meters, lasers). * Experience with high\-speed serial standards: Ethernet (100G\+), PCIe, OIF CEI. * Experience with board\-level debug and hardware bring\-up using JTAG or I2C/SPI interfaces.

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Now **We are the people who give possibilities purpose** ---------------------------------------------------- BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities. **Job Description** =================== **About the Role** We are seeking a highly experienced Staff Machine Learning Engineer to help advance next\-generation medical technologies for continuous physiological monitoring, disease detection, and predictive clinical decision support. In this role, you will develop clinically meaningful algorithms using multi\-modal healthcare data, including physiological sensor signals, medical device data, electronic health records, imaging data, and other real\-world clinical datasets. You will work in a highly cross\-functional environment with algorithm engineers, data scientists, clinicians, systems engineers, software teams, regulatory specialists, and product leaders to translate complex clinical and physiological problems into validated, deployable algorithmic solutions. This is a senior technical role suited for an engineer with deep expertise in classical machine learning, modern AI/deep learning, physiological signal interpretation, and real\-world deployment across both cloud\-based platforms and edge medical devices. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the design, development, validation and deployment of AI/ML algorithms for continuous physiological monitoring, novel vital sign and physiological parameter development, disease detection and risk stratification and early warning systems. * Develop algorithms using multi\-modal data sources, including physiological waveforms and time\-series data such as PPG, blood pressure, capnography and other monitoring signals, bedside and wearable sensor data, electronic health records and structured clinical data, etc. * Apply advanced analytical approaches, including: * Classical machine learning models * Statistical modeling and probabilistic inference * Time\-series modeling * Signal processing and feature engineering * Deep learning architectures * Multimodal AI models * Transformer\-based models and foundation\-model approaches where appropriate * Translate clinical and physiological understanding into robust algorithm design, including feature selection, model architecture, performance targets, and clinically interpretable outputs. * Build end\-to\-end algorithm development pipelines for data ingestion, signal quality assessment, annotation, feature extraction, model training, validation, robustness testing, and post\-market performance monitoring where applicable. * Partner with clinical, medical affairs, regulatory, quality, and product teams to ensure algorithms are developed with appropriate clinical context, usability, safety, and regulatory considerations. * Develop and optimize algorithms for cloud environments and for edge or embedded medical devices, accounting for latency, memory, compute, power, cybersecurity, and reliability constraints. * Support verification, validation, documentation, risk analysis, and design controls for regulated medical technology products. * Contribute to intellectual property generation, technical strategy, research roadmaps, and external scientific engagement. **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of industry experience in AI/ML, algorithm development, biomedical signal processing, healthcare analytics, medical devices, or related technical areas. * Master’s or PhD degree preferred in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Computational Biology, or a related engineering or quantitative field. * Deep expertise in machine learning and AI model development, including both classical and modern approaches. * Strong hands\-on experience with physiological time\-series data, biomedical signals, medical device data, or clinical datasets. * Understanding of human physiology, especially as it relates to patient monitoring. * Demonstrated experience developing algorithms from early feasibility through productization or deployment. * Experience working with multi\-modal healthcare data, such as sensor signals, EHR data, imaging data, lab data, and clinical outcomes. * Strong programming skills in Python and experience with ML/AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn, or equivalent tools. * Experience with cloud\-based algorithm development and deployment using platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. * Experience optimizing models for deployment on constrained environments, including embedded systems, edge devices, or near\-real\-time medical technology platforms. * Strong understanding of model evaluation, use we believe it fosters creativity, innovation, and effective problem\-solving, which are essential in the fast\-paced healthcare industry. For most roles, we require a minimum of 4 days of in\-office presence per week to maintain our culture of excellence and ensure smooth operations, while also recognizing the importance of flexibility and work\-life balance. Remote or field\-based positions will have different workplace arrangements which will be indicated in the job posting. For certain roles at BD, employment is contingent upon the Company’s receipt of sufficient proof that you are fully vaccinated against COVID\-19\. In some locations, testing for COVID\-19 may be available and/or required. Consistent with BD’s Workplace Accommodations Policy, requests for accommodation will be considered pursuant to applicable law. **Why Join Us?** ================ To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do.
