with development teams to remediate security defects and provide recommendations on secure coding practices and fixes. * Implement and maintain security controls within CI/CD pipelines, including policy\-as\-code and automated testing capabilities to support secure software delivery. * Execute Secure SDLC improvements aligned to OWASP SAMM, BSIMM, and NIST SSDF, contributing to maturity penetration testing and responsible disclosure activity — scoping input, findings validation, retesting, and root cause analysis to prevent recurrence. * Automate security testing tasks and evidence generation and review, and evaluation of third\-party and SaaS applications. * Support incident response for application\-layer events, including exploit reproduction, root cause analysis, and recommended control improvements. * Write and maintain application security documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures. * Produce metrics and reporting that provide visibility into scanning coverage, Secure SDLC adoption, and the security posture of the application portfolio. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or equivalent practical experience. * 4–6 years of hands\-on security or software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused specifically on application or product security. * Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, and OWASP ASVS, with the ability to explain both exploitability and the correct fix to developers. * Hands\-on experience operating enterprise SAST, DAST, and SCA tooling, including onboarding applications and tuning rulesets. * Experience participating in threat modeling using STRIDE or a comparable methodology and translating findings into actionable security requirements. * Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines. * Experience securing cloud\-native applications in AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including containerized workloads (Docker required, Kubernetes preferred). * Hands\-on experience with scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell). * Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance requirements with limited day\-to\-day oversight. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineering teams. **Nice to Have** * Experience in retail, e\-commerce, or other high\-volume PCI in\-scope environments. * Experience with API security platforms and discovery tooling. * Experience working within an embedded, co\-sourced, or managed application security delivery model alongside external partners. * Experience contributing to a security champions program. * Experience supporting bug bounty or responsible disclosure programs. * Offensive security or exploit development background, including CTF or hands\-on web application exploitation experience. * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code such as Terraform or CloudFormation. * Familiarity with software supply chain security practices such as SBOM, SLSA, and artifact signing. * Familiarity with securing AI\-assisted development workflows and LLM\-integrated applications, including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. **Preferred Certifications** * CompTIA Security\+ * GIAC GWAPT, GWEB, or (ISC)² CSSLP * AWS or Azure Security certifications * OSCP or OSWE * CCSP This is a hybrid role. jobs.description: **When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.** The Executive Director, AI Engineering and EHR Systems provides strategic and operational leadership for the design, development, deployment, and support of enterprise artificial intelligence solutions across Beth Israel Lahey Health (BILH). This role is responsible for AI platforms, machine learning solutions, data pipelines, and critical healthcare technology environments, including Epic EHR backend systems and integration platforms. Working closely with clinical, operational, digital health, software engineering, data and analytics, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams, the Executive Director defines the technical vision, architecture, and engineering practices required to operationalize AI at scale across the enterprise. The role is also accountable for building and leading high\-performing teams, ensuring the responsible, secure, and compliant implementation of AI solutions, and driving the successful delivery and adoption of AI initiatives from concept through enterprise\-wide deployment. **Job Description:** **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities including but not limited to:** * Lead the design, development, frameworks, APIs, and reusable services to accelerate solution delivery and adoption. * Define and implement AI engineering standards, best practices, and architectural guidelines to ensure jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: Deliver, monitor, maintain and configure network equipment, services and solutions needed to support client networking systems and environments. general network health analysis * Analyze and monitor the performance of the network using monitoring tools (SolarWinds NPM, NCM, IPAM, Net Flow, Ping Plotter, MIB, OID) * Respond to network outages and work with vendors to ensure smooth operation and troubleshooting * Troubleshooting issue resolution of LAN/WAN environment both prime shifts and after hours on\-call support * Incident, Problem, Configuration and Change management * Project work such as design, ordering equipment, configuring new equipment, lease replacements * Providing customer support , testing network connections, equipment installation and turn\-up * Responsible for handling second level troubleshooting issues, upgrading operating systems, and planning layout for configuration systems. * Schedule and perform maintenance and system upgrades of network infrastructure. * Responsible for assisting Network Engineering in areas of design and configuration of switches, routers, and load balancers. * Provide comprehensive diagnostic, root cause and troubleshooting support, accurate problem resolution and make findings available for future troubleshooting and analysis. * Determine the need to deploy field service resources required to deliver client service requests via incident management and dispatch processes through the service desk. * Escalate irresolvable issues requiring manufacturing or carrier services (Tier 4\) support assistance within prescribed service levels and procedures to complete problem resolution. * Monitor service desk tickets volume, identify trends in problem activity, document findings and make available for future client troubleshooting issues and ensure timely closure of all assigned tickets. * Utilize service delivery management and related technology systems and tools for efficient execution of service desk activities. * Utilize escalation and exception paths, processes and systems to report current performance and make recommendations for improvement of performance * Continuously expand, research and leverage knowledge of technology, market and industry trends and benchmarking to identify, recommend and implement best practices, methodologies and relevant analytics. * Continuously develop and enhance knowledge, skills and abilities through various learning channels to expand technical and non\-technical capabilities. Ensure further expansion of skill\-set in the products \& services that BBOX supports. * Meet all financial performance objectives for area of responsibility and take corrective action as needed. * Implement and make recommendations to improve methodologies, core competencies and processes for the service desk to ensure stable and quality product \& service delivery consistent with company objectives and client expectations. * Maintain and enhance a strong client service\-oriented environment focused on problem prediction, detection and resolution. Proactively identify and remove barriers to meeting client expectations. Provide timely documentation of issues, action plan and outcome. Achieve all client satisfaction objectives and internal and external SLAs. * Actively and consistently recommend and support all efforts to improve, simplify, automate and enhance day to day service delivery operations and the client experience. * Foster and contribute toward collaborative working relationships within NACS operations and across all levels and departments of the organization to execute service desk functions and company priorities. * Achieve performance targets established by leadership for applicable Key Performance Indicators * Perform other duties as assigned by management. Technology Services or Managed Service Provider industry experience required. * Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE), Microsoft System Engineer (MCSE), or related certifications preferred. * Excellent Layer 2 \& 3 networking skills including strong knowledge and proficiency in industry\-standard networking technologies and infrastructures including cabling, LAN, WAN, and various telecommunication access methods, DNS based Global Server Load Balancing (GSLB) theory as well as legacy networking technologies and system interdependencies. Cloud \& Virtualization technologies preferred. * Production environment experience consisting of directly managing routers, switches, global and local load balancing, SSL acceleration, HTTP compression/caching, and DNS in a high\-availability infrastructure. * End\-to\-end process thinker, with proven experience in business processes and workflow design. * Service awareness of all organization’s key product and service offerings for which support is being provided. * Ability to listen to and understand client requirements and individual preferences with successful track record of ability to develop creative and innovative solutions. * Excellent problem solving skills with demonstrated success in root cause analysis. * Demonstrated experience of continuously expanding and leveraging knowledge of technology, market and industry trends with success in identifying, recommending and implementing best practices and methodologies. * Ability to work effectively across all functional groups to optimize product \& service offerings, fostering a seamless internal and external client experience and track record of timely and accurate issue resolution. * Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Outlook, SharePoint, ERP, service delivery management tools such as ServiceNow and related cloud based technology systems.

jobs.description: Location: New York, New York Additional Locations: Atlanta GA See More Team: Corporate Strategy Job Requisition \#: R266856 Date posted: Oct. 26, 2026 **Job description** ------------------- **About this role** **Forward Deployed Business Analyst – BlackRock Transformation Office (BTO)** The BlackRock Transformation Office (BTO) is a global group of change professionals that delivers strategic transformation to help make BlackRock greater than the sum of its parts. We drive 1BLK outcomes by continuously connecting and being students of the firm’s people, processes and technology. We are a versatile team with varied experiences and backgrounds, motivated by the challenge of finding solutions that benefit BlackRock and our clients. In BTO, we focus on developing our people, strengthening leadership and delivery skills, and broadening firm and industry knowledge. Projects and roles consider both successful delivery and individual development objectives and career aspirations. **Your role and impact** The Forward Deployed Business Analyst will work in cross\-functional teams to reimagine, innovate and scale solutions that drive growth and operating models within the firm. This is not a traditional business analysis role centered on gathering requirements and handing them to technology. The role combines business analysis, product discovery, business architecture and hands\-on prototyping to turn ambiguous problems into tangible solutions that business users and engineers can test and refine together. Successful candidates will combine the structured thinking of a business analyst, the prioritization instincts of a product owner, the enterprise perspective of a business architect and the bias to action of a hands\-on builder. **Your responsibilities** In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: * Take ownership of complex, ambiguous business problems and rapidly translate them into testable solution hypotheses with measurable outcomes. * Build structured business context covering terminology, entities, relationships, decision logic, data dependencies, controls and exceptions for use by subject matter experts, AI tools and engineering teams. * Decompose business processes into explicit logic, controls and exception paths for implementation by technology teams. * Create functional prototypes using AI\-enabled development capabilities to discover requirements, challenge assumptions and validate future\-state processes, data, policies and controls. * Shape the target operating model, including ownership of data, governance, controls, roles and exception management. * Partner continuously with business experts, product managers, engineers, architects, data specialists and control partners from discovery through implementation. * **Develop measurable project objectives, drive consensus, and communicate plans, progress and outcomes effectively to stakeholders and management across levels.** **Your experience** * 3–5 years of relevant work experience in transformation, product delivery, business architecture, technology\-enabled change or a comparable discipline. * Experience in business architecture and operating\-model design, connecting solutions to business capabilities, roles, governance, policy ownership, controls and exception handling. * Proficiency in prototype\-led problem solving and rapidly converting ambiguous business problems into functional prototypes that stakeholders can see, test and challenge. * Expertise using AI\-enabled development environments to accelerate analysis, prototyping, requirements definition and testing, including critically evaluating generated outputs, maintaining traceability and understanding where human judgment remains essential. * Experience with iterative delivery and hands\-on ownership through cycles of analysis, experimentation and solution shaping. * Experience in financial services or a similar industry. BlackRock operates a pay\-for\  a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. **Our hybrid work model** BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. **Guidance on AI use for candidates** At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. jobs.title: Senior Data Management Professional - Automation Engineer - Economics News
jobs.description: Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news, and analytics through innovative technology quickly and accurately. We apply problem solving skills to identify workflow efficiencies and implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products, and processes. **Our Team:** The Economics Data team supports high\-impact, time\-sensitive headline data publishing across Bloomberg News and Bloomberg Terminal. The world’s most important market\-moving economic indicators we provide relies on automated acquisition, extraction, validation, monitoring, and publishing processes that must operate with speed, accuracy, transparency, and resilience. The team manages automated headline generation and economic data release workflows across a broad range of sources, including government agencies, central banks, national statistics offices, vendor feeds, news APIs, web sources, email\-based sources, and social media channels. These workflows support critical Bloomberg products and wires, including economic indicators, automated news headlines, and downstream data delivery. **The Role:** We are looking for a Senior Data Management Professional – Economics News Automation to manage, coordinate, and improve high\-impact automated headline and economic data workflows. This role is focused on driving and coordinating automation\-first data operations across acquisition, extraction, validation, monitoring, publishing, and remediation. You will help modernize and scale existing automation processes, reduce operational risk, improve data quality and timeliness, and strengthen end\-to\-end visibility across critical news and economic data workflows. skills, including root\-cause analysis, data profiling s, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, manage high\-impact incidents, and champion scalable, automation\-first solutions. **We’d Love to jobs.title: Sr. Network Engineer
jobs.description: Responsibilities: Network Architecture \& Design Leadership: Define architecture standards and lead the design and deployment of scalable, resilient Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), SD\-WAN, and wireless systems across multiple global sites. Infrastructure Ownership: Own the configuration, lifecycle, and advanced troubleshooting of routers, firewalls, network switches, and wireless controllers, setting configuration baselines and best practices for the team. Performance \& Reliability: Define monitoring strategy and KPIs, analyze network health to proactively prevent latency, packet loss, and outages, and lead root\-cause analysis for major incidents. Infrastructure Upgrades \& Lifecycle: Plan and govern hardware replacements, patch management, and system upgrades, including change management and risk assessment for business\-critical environments. Disaster Recovery \& Resilience: Design and validate failover mechanisms, backup strategies, and business continuity plans, ensuring recovery objectives (RTO/RPO) are met. Cloud \& Hybrid Networking: Architect and manage virtual and hybrid cloud networking environments across AWS, Azure, or other cloud providers, including connectivity, routing, and security integration. Automation \& Standardization: Drive network automation and Infrastructure\-as\-Code initiatives to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and accelerate delivery. Technical Leadership \& Mentoring: Provide technical guidance and mentoring to network engineers, review designs, and represent the network domain in cross\-functional and architecture forums. accountability for capacity, quality, delivery, and technical standards. * Proven track record of hiring and retaining top technical talent and leading distributed, multi\-location teams. * Strong We're trusted by half of the Fortune 500 and government agencies all around the world, and looking for people as passionate about the problems we're solving as we are. ### **Location** This is a **fully remote** position within the United States. ### **Role Summary** As a **Senior Site Reliability Enginee**r (SRE) on the Infrastructure and Ops platform team, you will help design, build, and deploy the tools used to empower our development teams and production applications. We’re looking for talented engineers to help grow our operational maturity, as well as equally enjoy mastering cloud\-native technologies to build and support our microservice architecture growth and reliability. As a Developer Efficiency and Experience focused SRE, you will be responsible for helping improve the efficiency of engineering and our development teams by supporting the SDLC and workflows of our developers, ranging from writing supporting application code, automation, and most importantly, empowering developers to have the confidence to create, deploy, and manage their services end\-to\-end inside the platform. ### **What you'll do** * Build and maintain tooling to support our applications in Kubernetes and in the Google Cloud Platform. * Work with development teams to help them build, ship, and deploy services and applications with ease and confidence, and promote service resilience and reliability. * Help ensure smooth operations of our production environments, and work with developers to help debug complex issues as they arise. This includes creating and facilitating the capturing and monitoring of the 4 golden signals in our applications. * Help to create a self\-service platform by working with the rest of the SRE and infrastructure team to accelerate and promote developer velocity, including service catalogs, repository tooling and documentation. We believe in the self\-service model and treat the development team as our internal customers, including listening to feedback, seeking out improvements, and quickly iterating to continually provide value. * Participate in a shared on\-call rotation schedule. We believe in service end\-to\-end ownership, and as such, both development teams and SRE participate in on\-call. Our SRE team is responsible for maintaining and being on call for our infrastructure environments and ensuring primary site uptime. ### **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in an SRE role or similar. * Experience deploying, managing, and debugging applications in a Kubernetes environment. We leverage Helm and Crossplane heavily to deploy our applications. * Experience building, securing, and managing container images. * Experience working with Cloud\-based environments, and interacting with Cloud services such as CloudSQL databases, Pub/Sub, Memorystore, and others. * Familiarity with Infrastructure\-as\-code Tools, such as Terraform, Crossplane, or similar. * Experience with tools and solutions used to monitor the 4 golden signals (latency, traffic, errors, and load), including Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry. * Familiarity with a monorepo, trunk\-based development model with monolithic build tooling and CI/CD, with a strong desire to achieve Continuous Deployment. Familiarity with CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, or similar. * Ability to communicate and support developers with empathy to support their day\-to\-day roles, seeking ways to automate and promote self\-service as necessary to continually enable developers to move with higher velocity and confidence through the entire SDLC. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building and supporting a gRPC microservice architecture. Familiarity with Kubernetes Service Mesh, such as Istio or similar, to support our microservice architecture observability, multi\-cluster routing, and network efficiency is highly desirable. * Ability to interface with application code to help assist in introducing best practices, golden path standardization, shared libraries, etc. The majority of our applications are written in Go. Python and Scala are present to a lesser degree. * Familiarity with Application Security tooling, such as dependency scanning, static analysis, and other linting tooling to help shift security left in the SDLC and CI process, and bridge engineering practices with our Security Operations team. * Familiarity and comfort with Linux\-based environments. ### **Qualities** * Have a passion for clean, concise architecture and enjoy working in a GitOps\-based environment. * Comfortable with projects that have a large degree of uncertainty and risk * Desire to collaborate with and advise product management and leadership to balance long\-term maintainability of software against rapid development, as well as clearly communicate BCDR implications. * Understands and practices the principles of continuous delivery to ensure quick, safe, and sustainable development in the face of changing priorities and uncertainty ### **What will make you stand out** * Basic understanding of infrastructure operations, including load\-balancers, ingresses, routing, DNS, and VPC design. We operate several data center environments across the globe in addition to our cloud infrastructure. * Not being afraid to dig into code to better understand how our applications work to better facilitate testing, integration, and development environments, to help instrument metrics, or to improve service reliability. * Deep understanding of how to optimize and support web\-based applications and help protect public\-facing assets with tooling such as anti\-DDoS and Web Application Firewall technologies. *For high cost of living areas (Seattle, San Francisco Bay Area, or New York City), our target salary range for this role is between $166,000 USD and $203,000 USD \+ bonus eligibility and equity.* *For all other US locations, the expected salary range for this position is $145,000 USD \- $190,000 USD, plus bonus eligibility and equity.* *In addition to our great compensation package, our benefits are effective on day one and include, but are not limited to: 401k match, health, vision, dental, and more! Please see our* *careers page* *for more details.* This is a fully remote position within the United States. **Note to external recruiters/agencies:** We are not currently engaging with third\-party agencies for this role and will not accept unsolicited outreach. We kindly ask that you do not submit resumes or candidate profiles to our team. #### **Identity Verification** As part of our hiring process, all candidates who receive an offer of employment will be asked to complete an identity verification through CLEAR. **California Privacy Rights Notice** Pursuant to the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), we are providing you with notice that we collect personal information from job applicants for business purposes, including evaluating your candidacy for employment, conducting interviews, and, if applicable, completing the hiring process. The categories of information we may collect include identifiers (such as name and contact information), professional or employment\-related information (such as work history, education, and references), and other information you provide in your application. We do not sell or share your personal information. For more information on how we use and protect your personal information, and your rights under the CCPA, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer
jobs.description: Description: *CENTEGIX® is the leader in rapid incident response safety solutions, protecting more than 18 million people across 18,000\+ locations in all 50 states. The CENTEGIX Safety Platform®, including CrisisAlert™ wearable panic buttons, Safety Blueprint® critical incident mapping, Visitor Management, and Reunification, gives organizations the tools to plan for and respond to any emergency, from the everyday to the extreme. CENTEGIX serves K\-12 and higher education, healthcare, government, commercial, and public safety organizations nationwide.* **Purpose** We are looking for a Senior Hardware Test Engineer to join our team in Annapolis, MD at our testing center to help CENTEGIX continue to deliver on the quality customers expect from the CrisisAlert system. This position focuses on hands\-on lab duties, test design, setup, and occasional 3D\-printer / CNC fabrication. **Position Responsibilities** * Design, deploy, and maintain hardware and firmware for Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) test jigs. * Apply industry\-standard testing protocols for low\-power embedded systems. * Execute comprehensive test plans for firmware deployments, including system, regression, and low\-power evaluations. * Use lab equipment—oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and function generators—for signal\-level diagnosis and debugging. * Partner with hardware, firmware, and cloud teams to root\-cause issues and confirm fixes. * Develop and maintain automated test workflows triggered by Continuous Integration (CI). * Maintain traceability between requirements and tests. * Produce detailed test reports, results, and procedures in compliance with ISO 9001 and ISO 13485\. * Drive ongoing improvements in test coverage, product quality, and process effectiveness. * Give clear, constructive feedback to advance the maturity of the testing process. Requirements: * 6 years of professional test engineering experience in embedded systems. * This is a hybrid role based in our testing lab in Annapolis, MD. Requires 5 days/week onsite during the initial training and onboarding period, transitioning to 3 to 4 days/week onsite once fully ramped up. * Hands\-on experience validating low\-power embedded systems using industry\-standard methodologies. * Experience with firmware verification, communication protocols, and diagnostic and measurement hardware. * Test automation in Python or a similar scripting language. * Skilled with lab equipment for hardware\-level diagnostics. * Familiarity with AWS IoT and AWS CloudWatch. * Competency designing 2–4 layer PCBs in Altium or equivalent. * End\-to\-end ownership of test plans: development, execution, and formal reporting. * Proficient with Git; able to build firmware directly from source. * Working knowledge of HIL environments, CI/CD, and regression testing. * Solid foundation in basic Electrical Engineering principles. * Hands\-on skills including soldering and assembly of electro\-mechanical test fixtures. * Competent in sourcing components and ordering PCBs for rapid prototyping. **Desired Qualifications** * Experience with AWS Lambda, RF testing, or environmental stress testing. * Experience operating 3D printers and light\-duty CNC machinery for prototype development, including fabrication of components from wood, plastic, and aluminum. * Familiarity with quality management systems (ISO 9001 / ISO 13485\). * Understanding of Agile workflows and CI/CD pipelines for firmware. * Ability to analyze complex system interactions across hardware, firmware, and wireless layers.. **What’s in it for you?** * Participation in company wide discretionary bonus * Fifteen days of PTO plus twelve company holidays * Three days of paid Sick Leave and one floating holiday * Monthly device(s) reimbursement * Up to $2500/year reimbursement for eligible education expenses * We offer a range of Healthcare plans to meet your needs (medical, dental, vision) * 401(k) Plan with 4% employer contribution to help you plan for the future * Employee Referral Bonus * Charitable Program Match **Compensation** The annual base salary range for this position is $130,000\-150,000\. Final base salary within this range will reflect experience, skills, and geographic location. **Recruitment Process \& Fraud Prevention** CENTEGIX job opportunities may be advertised on our careers page as well as trusted job boards such as Indeed and LinkedIn. All applications are processed through our official applicant tracking system. If you are contacted regarding an opportunity with CENTEGIX, verify that communications come from an email address ending in @centegix.com. CENTEGIX recruiters may also connect with candidates through LinkedIn. We encourage candidates to review recruiter profiles and confirm they are listed as current CENTEGIX employees. As part of our hiring process: * Applications will be reviewed and managed through our official recruiting process * Interviews will be conducted by CENTEGIX employees * CENTEGIX will never ask candidates for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, banking information, or financial account details during the recruiting process * Official offer letters will only be extended following a completed interview process **Equal Employment Opportunity** CENTEGIX is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at CENTEGIX are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate

jobs.title: Civil Engineer

Manages contracts and consultants involved with each project as requested by the Chief City Engineer. * The position will perform stormwater management and soil erosion reviews for private and public construction projects. * This individual confers with consultants and contractors to outline a work plan and to coordinate record keeping, scheduling, preparation of pay estimates, surveying and final inspection of all projects before acceptance. Coordinates warranty inspections when required. **What We're Looking For:*** A bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a comparable field of study is required. * Five (5\) years of experience in civil engineering and/or training in construction, public works and/or public infrastructure are required or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Candidates must possess a valid State of Michigan Driver’s License. * Be a registered State of Michigan Professional Engineer. * Candidates must possess a thorough knowledge of the principles, practices, materials and equipment of civil engineering as applied to the design and construction of municipal infrastructures. **Why Join Us?*** The salary range is $80,914 \- $117, 439 and is commensurate with experience * Excellent benefits package. * Potential for advancement. * Half\-day Fridays! Monday – Thursday 7:30 AM – 5:30 PM and Friday 8 AM\-noon. **Here is How to Apply:** * Apply online at www.portagemi.gov/200/Employment or in person at Portage City Hall/Human Resources. 7900 S. Westnedge Avenue. * Questions? Contact Human Resources at (269\)329\-4533 or text (269\)998\-1385\. **Equal Employment Opportunity** It is the policy of the city to afford equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, marital status, height, weight, disability, sexual orientation or gender identity; Positive action shall be taken to ensure the fulfillment of this policy.

jobs.title: Solution Consultant
jobs.description: The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees. We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of. Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number. We’re trusted by 250\+ brands managing $30B\+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best\-in\-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum. If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you. **The Role** ------------ We’re looking for multiple levels of Solution Consultants to lead customer implementations from kick\-off to go\-live as a trusted delivery expert who combines functional and technical expertise to help customers realize the full value of Confido. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Solution Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into AI deployments that go live and generate real value. Engagements are focused and time\-bound — typically 16 weeks or less — and spans multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment, it ensures customers realize lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Deliver Implementations** * Own the full implementation lifecycle — from kickoff through go\-live — for new enterprise customers * Manage detailed project plans, timelines, and workstreams across multiple concurrent deployments * Configure and customize the Confido platform to match each customer's workflows, data structures, and operational requirements * Drive customer\-side stakeholder alignment, ensuring the right people are engaged at the right moments **Customer Enablement** * Deliver training programs, documentation, and onboarding materials that get users up to speed fast * Run live onboarding sessions and workshops tailored to different user personas — from day\-to\-day operators to executives * Track and optimize time\-to\-value across your book of implementations, identifying what drives faster, stickier adoption **Process \& Infrastructure** * Apply and refine the implementation playbook — templates, checklists, escalation paths, and success criteria * Maintain implementation KPIs and reporting to give the business visibility into onboarding health and velocity * Identify patterns across deployments and feed them back into product to improve configurability and reduce implementation complexity over time **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner with Sales on pre\-sales scoping calls to set realistic timelines and surface implementation requirements early * Hand off customers to CS with full context — ensuring a smooth transition and strong starting point for long\-term success * Serve as a key feedback loop into Product, translating implementation friction into actionable roadmap input **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 3\+ years of experience managing enterprise software implementations, system deployments, or complex client onboarding — backgrounds in B2B SaaS, management consulting, CPG, systems integration, or similar are all welcome * Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects with competing priorities, stakeholders, and timelines * Strong project management skills — you're comfortable owning a plan, running a status call, and escalating when something's off track * Technical curiosity and comfort: you don't need to be an engineer, but you should be able to dig into data, configure software, and troubleshoot without hand\-holding * Experience working with CPG, retail, or supply chain customers is a plus — but not a requirement * Builder mindset: you're energized by operating within process while still spotting opportunities to improve it * Excited to be in our NYC headquarters 5 days a week **Who You Are** --------------- * You love working with customers and have a deep sense of customer service and success. * You thrive in fast\-paced environments and care deeply about the quality of your work. * You’re an owner \- autonomous, self\-directed, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. * You’re collaborative, organized, and kind—you make the people around you better **Perks \+ Benefits** --------------------- * **Equity** — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build * **Fully paid health coverage through Aetna** — we cover 100% of employee premiums * **Top\-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian** * **Carrot Fertility Pro** — comprehensive fertility and family\-forming support * **12 weeks of paid parental leave** * **Unlimited PTO** — plus regular 4\-day holiday weekends we actually take * **401(k) through Vestwell** * **Paid relocation support** — we’ll help you make the move to NYC * **Fully equipped workspace state or local laws.* Compensation Range: $110K \- $185K

jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role** ------------------ We are seeking an Electrical Design Engineer to join the electrical design team for Crusoe's modular data centers and to stay with each deployment from design through construction and commissioning. You will be the technical link between Crusoe's design team, Crusoe Industries (which manufactures our modular data centers), construction partners, and Cloud customers. You will adapt modular designs to each site and carry field lessons back into the next design iteration. This position requires an electrical professional who thrives at the intersection of facility engineering and product design, and who is comfortable in both the design office and the field. The role is in\-office in Denver. Travel is anticipated at 40% to support factory acceptance testing, supplier visits, and site deployments. **What You'll Be Working On** ----------------------------- * Design and specify the electrical systems for modular data center deployments, including MV/LV distribution, UPS, generators, switchboards, and RPPs, with high\-availability requirements. * Take site\-specific designs from schematic through construction\-ready sets, and review drawings, submittals, and shop drawings from design partners against the Basis of Design. * Audit short\-circuit, protection, arc\-flash, and load flow studies. * Develop and maintain installation details for modular electrical systems, and support the roadmap with R\&D as new technologies and configurations are explored. * Resolve RFIs and Field Engineering Directives during construction, and support installation quality checks and factory witness testing. * Support commissioning (Levels 1\-5\) with Crusoe's Cx team, reviewing procedures and results for technical accuracy. * Capture lessons learned from the field and feed them back into design templates. * Be an electrical safety champion with Crusoe's construction partners. **What You'll Bring to the Team** --------------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field. * 7\+ years of electrical design experience in data centers or other mission\-critical facilities, with exposure to construction or commissioning. * Working knowledge of the NEC and relevant NFPA/IEEE standards. * Proficiency with AutoCAD or Revit and a power systems analysis tool (ETAP or SKM). * A track record of taking designs through construction and troubleshooting field issues with practical, code\-compliant solutions. * Ability to manage ambiguity and move between customer discussions and detailed engineering. * Strong communication skills for both technical and non\-technical audiences. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Active Professional Engineer (PE) license. * Experience designing or installing modular, prefabricated, or edge data centers. * Understanding of how AI compute loads affect power distribution, from the utility transformer to the server rack. * Experience with BESS or alternative energy inputs, or with SCADA and EPMS. * Experience in a fast\-paced design/build environment. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 \-$180,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: AI Engineer, Trading Ops & Management
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly analytical and technical professional to spearhead the evolution of our trading infrastructure. This hybrid role combines the fast\-paced execution of a Trading Operations Specialist, the analytical rigor of a Risk Manager, and the technical capabilities of an AI\-focused Developer. The successful candidate will not only manage daily operational workflows and risk monitoring but will also lead the digital transformation of these functions. You will leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, and advanced scripting to automate legacy manual processes, improve predictive risk modeling, and build real\-time performance visualization tools and analyses. ### **Key Responsibilities:** 1\. Trading Operations and Performance Analysis with AI * Manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of trades across multi\-asset classes. Develop agentic AI workflows using Python (ML) and MLOps tools to automate manual operations and reconciliations * Perform daily P\&L attribution and explain variance by decomposing market moves, Greeks, and new activity. Leverage AI/ML frameworks (e.g., OpenAI API, LangChain, or local LLMs) to build intelligent agents for anomaly detection in trade data and automated commentary generation for P\&L reports. * Ensure data integrity across trading systems, middle\-office platforms, and downstream finance ledgers. * Use AI tools to build reporting and analyses on trading performance and perform adhoc business analytics 2\. jobs.description: **About Cyngn, Inc.** Based in Mountain View, CA, Cyngn is a publicly\-traded autonomous technology company. We deploy self\-driving industrial vehicles \-**specifically autonomous tuggers**\- to factories, warehouses, and other facilities throughout North America. To build this emergent technology, we are looking for innovative, motivated, and experienced leaders to join us and move this field forward. If you like to build, tinker, and create with a team of trusted and passionate colleagues, then Cyngn is the place for you. **Key reasons to join Cyngn:** **We are small and big.** With under 100 employees, Cyngn operates with the energy of a startup. On the other hand, we’re publicly traded. This means our employees not only work in close\-knit teams with mentorship from company leaders—they also get access to the liquidity of our publicly\-traded equity. **We build today and deploy tomorrow.** Our autonomous vehicles aren’t just test concepts—they’re deployed to real clients right now. That means your work will have a tangible, visible impact. **We aren’t robots. We just develop them.** We’re a welcoming, diverse team of sharp thinkers and kind humans. Collaboration and trust drive our creative environment. At Cyngn, everyone’s perspective matters—and that’s what powers our innovation. **About the role** You build IT infrastructure rather than just keep it running. This is a hands\-on, fully onsite role in Mountain View, and you will be the second member of a two\-person IT function supporting engineering, operations, and business teams. That structure is the pitch and the catch. You own real systems from day one — identity, device fleet, network, and the automation that holds them together. You will also still unjam a printer, because two people means everyone is hands\-on. What separates this from a help desk job is the mandate: your job is to reduce support volume, not absorb it. We want someone who sees the same ticket three times and writes the script, policy, or doc that stops the fourth. Cyngn builds autonomous driving technology for industrial vehicles, so you will support a mixed environment of corporate laptops, Linux engineering workstations, lab hardware, and test infrastructure. If you have only ever supported a pure SaaS office, this will stretch you in a good way. **What you'll do** * Administer and improve identity and access as a system: design and maintain groups, roles, policies, and MFA enforcement in JumpCloud and Google Workspace, and keep SaaS access consistent across Slack and the rest of the stack * Administer and improve the device fleet: MDM policy, imaging and provisioning pipelines, patch and compliance reporting across macOS, Windows, and Ubuntu * Automate the repetitive work — onboarding and offboarding, access provisioning, inventory reconciliation, reporting — with scripting and the APIs of the tools we already run * Administer and contribute towards the office and engineering network: improve security and user experience * Support engineering infrastructure, including Linux workstations and shared compute resources * Ensure compliance of corporate endpoints and SasS services * Own Tier 1 \+ 2 service desk tickets * Evaluate and implement new tooling: run the trial, make the recommendation, own the rollout * Write and maintain documentation and runbooks so recurring issues become self\-service * Conduct POCs of new solutions for the company * Manage hardware and software inventory, license assignments, and renewal tracking Occasional after\-hours or weekend availability may be needed for planned work such as office moves, equipment refreshes, network changes, or system maintenance. **Priorities: 3\-12 Month Goals** ***First 3 Months*** * Take full ownership of onboarding and offboarding across macOS, Windows, and Ubuntu, and implement zero\-touch where feasible * Own the service desk, serve as the first point of contact for all support tickets and escalations * Fully understand and master the IT asset lifecycle end to end: procurement, assignment, recovery, and retirement ***By 4\-6 Months*** * Implement a patch management program that covers all personnel workstations * Fully audit internal company resources and harden security posture * Document and clean up network segmentation, including the boundary between corporate and engineering environments * Build out the internal knowledge base and measurably reduce the top recurring ticket drivers ***By 6\-12 Months*** * Automate and standardize IT operations across onboarding/offboarding, endpoint provisioning, software deployment, and routine administrative workflows, ensuring appropriate approvals, auditability, and alignment with established policies. * Mature endpoint compliance and vulnerability management by maintaining consistent patching, security baselines, monitoring, and risk\-based remediation across macOS, Windows, and Ubuntu. * Strengthen identity and access management through least\-privilege enforcement, period nce * Experience in a hardware, robotics, manufacturing, or lab environment * Cloud infrastructure exposure (AWS, GCP) * Certifications such as CompTIA Network\+ or Security\+, or a vendor equivalent ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision) through Aetna, Kaiser Permanente, and Guardian, with multiple plan tiers to choose from * Ancillary benefits including accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity plans (Voya) * Company\-paid basic life insurance, plus voluntary (supplemental) life for you and your dependents * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, fully paid by Cyngn * HSA and FSA (Health \& Dependent Daycare) * Employee Assistance Program * 1:1 Health Concierge * Company 401(k) * Commuter Benefits * Flexible PTO policy * Paid Parental Leave * Daily lunches for in\-office employees and fully\-stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages ### **What You Can Expect (Cyngn’s interview process)** * A real person will review your application * We’ll kick off the process with a one\-sided video interview where you’ll share a little more about yourself and we’ll get some basic questions out of the way * A Recruiter touch point will go over the process in more detail and answer your questions * A 45\-minute interview with the hiring manager * A full\-loop interview process consisting of 3\-4 additional conversations to gauge technical and soft skills and culture fit. * A final onsite interview with the team. *W**e may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, and now we’re expanding our platform to solve broader sales planning challenges. Recognized by industry analysts like Forrester and G2 and backed by top\-tier investors, including Sequoia, ICONIQ, Accel, and Sapphire Ventures, we empower high\-growth companies like Netflix, Figma, and Stripe with the flexibility and insights needed to drive revenue performance. Join a talented, fast\-growing team committed to solving some of the most complex and impactful problems in sales performance management. ### **About the Role** We're looking for a GTM Engineer to design, build, and maintain the agentic GTM motions that generate pipeline at scale. Sales or marketing ops and domain experience is helpful, but this is not a traditional sales or marketing ops role. You will deploy agents that book meetings and generate pipeline, while building the shared knowledge layer that powers every GTM agent across the team. Success in this role will be measured in pipeline dollars sourced to motions you built, BDR and AE time saved, and a robust system of context that makes every agent in the org smarter over time. This is a builder role in an emerging field. We're heavily prioritizing learning velocity and a growth mindset over years of experience. We’re especially interested in seeing what you’ve built in this recent window of dramatic LLM\-driven technological and market change. The landscape is shifting fast, and we need someone who ships, measures, iterates, and isn't waiting for a playbook to be written for them. ### **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and optimize automated outbound sequences with agentic workflows that personalize at scale. * Work alongside marketing and GTM teams to generate pipeline from agentic GTM motions end to end: prospecting logic, enrichment, sequencing, measurement, and continuous improvement. * Build and maintain a shared system of context that powers agents used by Marketing, BDRs, and AEs across the organization. * Deploy automations that multiply BDR and AE effectiveness: auto\-research, meeting prep, call briefings, and follow\-up workflows that increase logged activity (emails, calls, meetings). * Instrument and report on sequence performance (open rates, reply rates, meeting set rates, pipeline sourced), translating metrics into an experimentation roadmap to drive continuous improvement. * Collaborate with BDR leadership and Marketing to align agentic motions with target segments, campaigns, and the buyer journey, ensuring automated outreach complements human\-led efforts. * Evaluate, integrate, and maintain the tech and tool stack (Clay, coding agents, enrichment providers, sequence platforms) required to run agentic GTM at scale. ### **Requirements** * You’ve vibe\-coded something interesting. Show us what you’ve made! * Demonstrated projects using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), Clay, or similar martech tools to build genuinely agentic solutions, not just templates or simple automations. * Domain experience in GTM Engineering, Sales Development, Marketing, Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, or Revenue Operations, with hands\-on experience building automated workflows. * Data\-driven mindset with the ability to instrument experiments, read results, and iterate quickly. * Excellent written communication: you'll be authoring the templates, prompts, and frameworks that agents use to represent the company. ### **Nice to Have** * Strong working knowledge of B2B outbound sales motions: sequencing, prospecting, enrichment, intent signals, and pipeline measurement. * Comfort writing and debugging code (Python, JavaScript, or similar) to connect APIs, manipulate data, and build custom automations. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to be fluent enough to ship. * Familiarity with MAPs, CRM, and sales engagement platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, or similar). * Familiarity with enrichment tools (ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clearbit), intent data platforms (UserGems, Bombora, 6sense), or building multi\-step AI agent workflows. ### **Core Competencies** * Builder instinct: builds solutions to problems rather than waiting for a vendor or a process to be handed down. Ships fast, measures, iterates. * Learning velocity: picks up new technology quickly and adapts as the landscape shifts. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and figuring things out in a nascent field. * Systems thinking: sees how individual automations connect to the broader GTM motion and builds with composability and shared context in mind. * Cross\-functional collaboration: works fluidly with BDRs, AEs, marketing, and ops to align automated motions with human\-led efforts. * Operational rigor: maintains quality standards across agent outputs, data flows, and reporting. * Growth mindset: treats every sequence as an opportunity to learn. Curious about what's working, honest about what isn't, and energized by the pace of change in AI\-powered GTM. The compensation offered for this position will depend on numerous factors, including individual proficiency, anticipated performance, and the location of the selected candidate. **The OTE salary range for this role is $140,000 – $200,000**. Compensation for candidates hired in Canada will be provided in Canadian dollars and may differ from the ranges listed above due to currency conversion. Our OTE salary is just one component of CaptivateIQ's competitive total rewards package, which also includes equity, comprehensive health benefits, and other perks and benefits.*CaptivateIQ participates in E\-Verify, web\-based system that allows enrolled employers to confirm the eligibility of their employees to work in the United States* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Blood Platform
jobs.description: **At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.** We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting\-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: *“What would I do if this patient were my mom?”* That question drives everything we do. But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose. **Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.** **Position Summary** Caris Life Sciences is one of the largest precision\-oncology platforms in the world, serving hundreds of thousands of molecular cases a year and growing at double\-digit rates. Behind every case is a matched molecular, imaging, and clinical\-outcomes data estate few organizations anywhere can rival, and the clinical software that drives the lab's instruments and processes, captures results, and delivers each patient's report. A patient and an ordering physician are waiting on every one of those reports. The Engineering Manager leads one of the front\-line teams that keep that software reliable and moving. This assignment leads the blood\-platform engineering team, spanning the laboratory information systems behind Caris Assure and Caris Detect blood operations. The team is growing with the blood product roadmap and pairs closely with its Product Manager counterpart. The Engineering Manager \- Clinical Software Products leads a front\-line engineering team in Caris Life Sciences' Clinical Software Engineering organization, reporting to the Senior Director, Clinical Software Engineering. This is a player\-coach position: the Engineering Manager owns delivery, quality, and operational health for an assigned platform team while staying technically engaged in design and code review. The platforms in scope are live, business\-critical clinical systems under SOX financial controls and FDA regulatory requirements, and the Engineering Manager is directly accountable for the supervision, change\-control discipline, and engineering standards those obligations demand. The engineering environment is modern and funded: frontier AI coding assistants are standard\-issue tooling, with agentic workflows across design, implementation, and test generation. Characterization tests and golden\-master replay validation serve as executable evidence for regulated change. Delivery runs on CI/CD with application\-level observability and risk\-based release governance aligned with current FDA Computer Software Assurance guidance. Modernization of established systems is active, funded engineering work. The Engineering Manager runs the team on this model and is accountable for making automation\-first practice its daily norm. **Job Responsibilities** * Manage a front\-line team of software engineers: hiring, onboarding, performance management, coaching, and career development. * Own delivery for the assigned platform: sprint planning, prioritization with the paired Product Manager, estimation, and predictable release execution under regulated change control. * Remain technically engaged: participate in design and architecture reviews, perform code review at a meaningful cadence, and hold the team's engineering standards (testing, documentation, observability) to the level a SOX/FDA\-gated estate requires. * Run the team on an automation\-first operating model: recurring manual engineering and operational work is a defect to engineer away, AI\-assisted workflows are standard daily practice, and automated test and evidence coverage is a first\-class delivery responsibility. * Onboard engineers into the regulated environment, including structured knowledge transfer when a new team member absorbs existing platform scope. * Partner with Application Site\-Reliability Engineering on production readiness, incident response, and post\-incident remediation for the assigned platform, keeping production access inside segregation\-of\-duties requirements. * Maintain team health at a sustainable pace: balanced on\-call/support load, managed work\-in\-progress, and early escalation of capacity risks. * Bring team\-level facts to quarterly capacity and hiring planning: throughput, support load, and skill coverage. * Keep compliance moving at the pace of delivery: change\-control records, review evidence, and documentation to SOX and FDA standards for all team output. * Embed secure SDLC practices in the team: OWASP Top Ten awareness in design and code review, and penetration testing coordinated early in development. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2\+ years of direct people\-management or formal team\-lead responsibility for a production software team. * Delivered and operated software subject to FDA, SOX, CLIA, HIPAA, or equivalent regulated\-environment controls. * Managed delivery with agile/scrum practices, including planning, estimation, and stakeholder communication. * Hired and onboarded software engineers. * Led teams that apply automation and AI\-assisted engineering practices in daily delivery, including automated testing, CI/CD, and scripted operations. **Preferred Qualifications** * Worked in healthcare, clinical laboratory, diagnostics, or life sciences software environments. * Demonstrated ability to stay technically engaged while managing: substantive contribution to design review, code review, and architectural decisions on a live production system. * Stood up or reshaped a team while maintaining delivery continuity. * Managed teams that operate production systems with formal on\-call rotations. * Familiarity with structured knowledge\-transfer practices when teams absorb existing platform scope. **Physical Demands** * Ability to sit, stand, and work at a computer for extended periods. **Training** * All job\-specific, safety, and compliance training is assigned based on the job functions associated with this employee. **Other** * This role may require periodic travel to other Caris sites or partner locations. After\-hours response to emergency production issues and participation in escalation rotations may be required. **Conditions of Employment:** Individual must successfully complete pre\-employment process, which includes criminal background check, drug screening, credit check ( applicable for certain positions) and reference verification. This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Caris Life Sciences is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.
