jobs.title: Utility Program Outreach Engineer II
jobs.description: About This Opportunity We are seeking a Utility Program Outreach/Engineer II who is responsible for delivery of utility\-funded program offerings to commercial and industrial customers. The Outreach Engineer acts as the single point of contact for coordinating our client’s custom offering and resources, represents the programs to commercial and industrial end users, and facilitates the development and implementation of energy saving projects. The Outreach Engineer is a facilitator between the customer, contractor or vendor, Energy Efficiency Service Provider (EESP), and our client with a focus on integrating the clients' programs and resources with the customer’s existing goals. Future\-Focused AI\-Ready Culture At Cascade Energy, we’re actively shaping how AI gets deployed in the real world, in our tools, our client engagements, and our daily work. Our approach has always been relationship\-driven and expertise\-led, and AI is how we multiply the impact of both. Successful Cascadians are curious and resilient. They embrace change, seek smarter ways to create impact, and take ownership of their own growth. We embed AI into our work in ways that are responsible and human\-centered, and we actively develop our people to deploy it creatively and confidently. We believe the future belongs to organizations that pair emerging technology with genuine human expertise. That future is being built here. . . .come be a part of it! What You Will Be Doing Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. * Oversee projects through implementation and M\&V, including tracking and baseline data analysis, to deliver on time and to custom quality guidelines * Manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced consulting environment, shifting easily between big picture and details * Identify and develop energy efficiency projects to fill custom pipelines and meet savings goals * Build long\-term relationships with end users, energy efficiency service providers, and other stakeholders * Serve as the single point of contact between our client, end users, vendors, and program staff * Conduct site visits and scoping\-level analysis of energy project opportunities This is a full\-time, exempt position located in the greater Chicagoland area. Travel is anticipated for this role at about 20%\-30% of the tie, primarily day trips. Qualifications **Applicants for this role are required to have:** * BA/BS degree in Engineering or equivalent combination of education and related experience * Project management experience, preferably in energy efficiency or related industry * Understanding of, or experience in commercial facilities, manufacturing, and/or water/wastewater industries A successful candidate should also demonstrate these preferred characteristics and/or skills: * Forward thinking combined with a can\-do attitude * Effective communication skills with people of all levels of an organization * Solid understanding of general industrial technologies For candidates whose experience may not align perfectly with all these preferred skills but can see themselves adding value in this role, we encourage you to still apply. Cascade is dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace and places strong importance on learning and development. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. Compensation \& Benefits The annual salary range for this full\-time, exempt position in greater Chicagoland area is $77,400 \- $108,900\. At Cascade, transparency and fairness are core to how we work. We post the salary range for every role because we value clarity and equity. Our offers are thoughtfully determined based on factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and internal equity, to ensure fairness. We aim to ensure consistency and integrity in every decision. Our total rewards include competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing and financial security. We provide health, dental, and vision coverage, along with flexible spending and health savings account options that include employer contributions. Additional benefits include life insurance, short\- and long\-term disability coverage, paid parental leave, and a 401(k)\-retirement plan with a guaranteed 3% employer contribution. Cascade is proud to offer an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), annual cash performance bonuses, paid vacation and sick time, and an inclusive, flexible holiday policy. To further support wellbeing, we provide a $500 contribution that can be applied to an HSA, FSA, or Lifestyle Spending Account. Application Process We would appreciate a current resume with your application. We would also appreciate a letter of interest describing why our team or the position resonates with you, and how your experience makes you a great choice for the role. * Please, no phone calls. * Please, no outside recruiters or agencies. * Cascade Energy is not able to provide sponsorship for work authorization in the U.S., which includes OPT. Click here to join our Talent Community \-\- it’s the best way to keep up with and learn more about Cascade Energy! In occasional mailings, we’ll brief you on our industrial decarbonization efforts and share more about our company culture and what makes Cascade a great place to join and to grow. About Us Cascade Energy is a leading provider of energy efficiency, energy management, decarbonization, and sustainability solutions for the industrial, commercial, and public sectors across North America. We have a 30\-year history of delivering high\-value services through electric and gas utility\-offered programs and directly to industrial and commercial enterprises. Our reputation for stellar, high\-quality work has expanded our reach throughout North America to serve clients ranging in size from small to Fortune 500 companies in their pursuit of wide\-ranging decarbonization and energy savings objectives. Cascade Energy has 14 offices throughout the US and employees in 30 states. Why Work at Cascade? As a 100% Employee\-Owned Company (ESOP), Cascadians foster and value a culture of equals, initiative, and ownership. Our teams reflect our core company values: Do the Right Thing; Put Others First; Seek Shared Success; Learn Constantly; and Be Industrious. Our customers are vitally important to us, and we pride ourselves on stellar customer service. Our team members are a dedicated and diverse group of ambassadors, representing Cascade Energy, striving to embody our values, ensure we are responsive, and consistently delighting our customers. In alignment with our values and doing better, Cascade Energy celebrates and values diversity as vital for increased creativity and innovation and faster problem solving, and we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect, free of discrimination and harassment. Learn more about what we do to create a welcoming environment at Cascade by visiting Culture and Belonging \| Cascade Energy. Cascade promotes a healthy work\-life balance and appreciates employee contribution in all areas. We walk the talk about our commitment to learning constantly, with a focus on the ongoing development of every team member. Cascade is a strong supporter of flexible working arrangements, and offers role\-dependent options for remote, hybrid, and in\-office work. AI Usage During our Recruitment Process We value doing the right thing and authenticity in our hiring process. All application materials, including resumes, cover letters, and assessments, must reflect your own original work. The use of AI tools including Gemini, Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, other large language models or generative AI, Grammarly, and resume builders to assist is acceptable only when your personal experiences, voice, and descriptions of your knowledge, skills, abilities, and other qualifications are accurately and meaningfully represented. Submission of work that is not your own or the use of AI impersonation or deepfake simulators during screening calls and videos will disqualify you from consideration. AAP/EEO Statement Cascade is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion and religious practices, sex (including pregnancy, gender expression, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or family, marital, or veteran status. To request a reasonable accommodation during the application and interviewing process, please contact the Cascade recruiter. Cascade Energy uses the federal E\-Verify system to determine eligibility for work in the United States and conducts post\-job offer, pre\-employment drug screening.

jobs.title: Staff Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** ‎ At Castlight, we are looking for a Staff Frontend Engineer to serve as a high\-impact individual contributor across our consumer health products. You will architect and deploy white\-labeled micro\-frontends, obsess over the details that make web experiences feel exceptional, and operate with a fast\-paced, high\-agency mindset to solve critical user problems week after week. ‎ **How will you make an impact \& Requirements** ‎ **Who You Are:** * **A Craftsperson of Experience:** You are obsessed with the nuances of UX that make an application "feel right"—going far beyond pixel\-matching a design spec to deliver fluid, intuitive, and responsive interfaces. * **A Micro\-Frontend Architect:** You thrive in complex web environments, knowing how to build, scale, and deploy white\-labeled micro\-frontends that integrate seamlessly across diverse consumer touchpoints. * **A High\-Agency "Lone Wolf":** You operate with incredible autonomy. You don't wait for a rigid ticket backlog; you look at the product, figure out the highest\-impact thing you can build or fix this week, and execute fast. * **Agile \& Flexible:** Frameworks are just tools in your belt. While our core ecosystem relies on Angular, you bring deep mastery in modern JavaScript/TypeScript (React, Vue, or Angular) and adapt quickly to tackle the next big challenge. * **Mission\-Driven \& Relentless:** You embrace nimble environments. You seek to eliminate operational friction where you can, push through obstacles when you must, and maintain a high standard of engineering excellence along the way. **Who We Are:** At Castlight, we’re making it as simple as humanly possible for people to navigate the complicated, often frustrating, world of healthcare. We partner with America’s largest employers and health plans, transforming employee benefits into a deeply personalized and guided journey for millions of users. What we build genuinely helps people live happier and healthier lives. **What You'll Do:** Reporting into Engineering Leadership, you will serve as a premier Individual Contributor driving the frontend architecture of our consumer health platforms. You’ll be surrounded with the modern tools and resources you need, given clear ownership, and empowered to operate with maximum speed and impact. In this role, you will: * **Architect \& Scale:** Design, build, and maintain high\-performing, white\-labeled micro\-frontends using Angular, TypeScript, and modern web standards. * **Elevate UX Performance:** Polish consumer\-facing applications to deliver elite performance, accessibility, and micro\-interactions that elevate the overall user experience. * **Drive Weekly Impact:** Prioritize ruthlessly in a fast\-paced environment, identifying and executing on high\-leverage opportunities that move the business and product forward. * **Set Frontend Standards:** Serve as a subject matter expert across frontend architectures, establishing best practices for state management, component reusability, and build pipelines. **Skills \& Qualifications:** * **Technical Expertise:** 8\+ years of professional frontend software engineering experience with deep mastery of modern JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS/SCSS. * **Framework Proficiency:** Expert\-level knowledge in Angular or equivalent deep mastery in modern React/Vue with a proven track record of quick technology adaptation. * **Architecture Experience:** Hands\-on experience designing, deploying, and maintaining micro\-frontend architectures and white\-label design systems at scale. * **Product \& UX Intuition:** A sharp eye for UI design details, rendering performance, web vitals, and creating delightful user interactions. * **Autonomous Execution:** Strong track record as a high\-impact individual contributor who can take ambiguous requirements and ship polished production code quickly. * **Communication:** Ability to articulate complex architectural decisions and technical trade\-offs to both engineering peers and business stakeholders. **What You'll Get:** * **Competitive Compensation:** A highly competitive salary and benefits package. * **Autonomy \& Empowerment:** Work as a trusted high\-impact contributor with minimal bureaucracy and maximum freedom to ship great work. * **Growth Opportunity:** Build high\-visibility, consumer\-scale applications using modern web technologies across critical healthcare touchpoints. * **Work That Matters:** You aren't just writing JavaScript; you're building seamless access points that help millions of people navigate their health and care. ‎ **Compensation Range:** $131,243\.00 to $196,865\.00 *The anticipated base salary range represents the Company's good\-faith estimate of the compensation it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. jobs.title: Staff Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** ‎ At Castlight, we are looking for a Staff Full Stack Engineer who brings deep proficiency across both frontend and backend technology. As a high\-agency operator who seamlessly bridges Angular micro\-frontends with Java Spring and Python microservices on GCP, you will partner with product leadership to build complete 0\-to\-1 experiences and drive end\-to\-end execution for millions of users. If you are a true jack\-of\-all\-trades who naturally operates as the ultimate escape hatch when execution speed matters most, we want to talk to you. ‎ **How will you make an impact \& Requirements** ‎ **Who You Are:** * **A True Full\-Stack Engineer:** Jack\-of\-all\-trades and master of them too. You operate comfortably across the entire technology stack—from deep backend architecture in Java Spring and Python to fluid micro\-frontends in Angular, seamlessly switching context where others see boundaries. * **Unapologetically High\-Agency:** You don't wait for rigid handoffs or endless alignment meetings. If a feature needs a new API endpoint, a microservices update on GCP, and an intuitive UI component, you take full ownership and ship it end\-to\-end. * **Obsessed with End\-to\-End Craft:** You care just as much about the micro\-interactions and responsiveness of a web application as you do about the throughput, resilience, and latency of the microservices powering it. * **The Ultimate Escape Hatch:** When time is critical and something needs to be built or shipped *right now*, you are the engineer we call. You cut through red tape, figure out a path forward, and deliver under pressure without missing a beat. * **Mission\-Driven \& Relentless:** You embrace nimble, fast\-moving environments. You seek to eliminate unnecessary friction, navigate complex systems effortlessly, and take pride in building software that directly impacts millions of people. **Who We Are:** At Castlight, we’re making it as simple as humanly possible for people to navigate the complicated, often frustrating, world of healthcare. We partner with America’s largest employers and health plans, transforming employee benefits into a deeply personalized and guided journey for millions of users. What we build genuinely helps people live happier and healthier lives. **What You'll Do:** Reporting into Engineering Leadership, you will serve as a premier Staff Individual Contributor driving end\-to\-end technical execution across our consumer health products. You will be equipped with modern tools, given clear ownership, and empowered to build complete user experiences from the database layer to the frontend UI. In this role, you will: * **Build End\-to\-End Solutions:** Architect, write, and deploy complete product slices—building scalable Java Spring / Python backend services on GCP and crafting white\-labeled micro\-frontends in Angular. * **Drive Rapid POCs \& Prototyping:** Partner directly with Product Managers to take raw 0\-to\-1 ideas and rapidly transform them into polished, production\-ready experiences. * **Elevate Engineering Standards:** Raise the bar for code quality, deployment speed, and system architecture across both frontend and backend domains. * **Optimize Full\-Stack Performance:** Bridge the gap between server response times and client\-side rendering to create ultra\-fast, seamless consumer experiences for millions of users. **Skills \& Qualifications:** * **Technical Experience:** 8\+ years of software engineering experience spanning both frontend and backend software development at scale. * **Backend Mastery:** Strong expertise in Java (Spring / Spring Boot) and/or Python, with a track record of building resilient, high\-throughput RESTful microservices on GCP. * **Frontend Mastery:** Deep expertise in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and frameworks (Angular preferred, but React/Vue expertise welcomed) with experience building scalable micro\-frontends or design systems. * **Full\-Stack Ownership:** Proven capability to take complete ownership of complex features, delivering both backend endpoints and UI components end\-to\-end. * **Systems \& Architecture:** Comfortable working with cloud infrastructure (GCP), CI/CD pipelines, containerized environments, and micro\-frontend architectures. * **Communication:** Exceptional ability to articulate end\-to\-end architectural decisions, trade\-offs, and product requirements across both technical and non\-technical teams. **What You'll Get:** * **Competitive Compensation:** A highly competitive salary and benefits package. * **Unmatched Autonomy:** Full freedom to operate across the entire stack with minimal bureaucracy and zero context\-switching friction. * **High\-Visibility Impact:** Direct ownership over key consumer features that scale to millions of healthcare users. * **Work That Matters:** Build technology where seamless user experience and backend efficiency directly enable people to access the healthcare they need. ‎ **Compensation Range:** $131,243\.00 to $196,865\.00 *The anticipated base salary range represents the Company's good\-faith estimate of the compensation it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs.*

jobs.title: Data Engineering & Analytics Senior Manager
jobs.description: Description: **Coverage Insurance Experts that guide you from enrollment to peace of mind!** At Catch Coverage, we’re more than an Insurance organization, we’re a team of dedicated, compassionate professionals united by a mission to improve lives and elevate the customer experience. When you join us, you become part of a forward\-thinking, customer\-focused culture that invests in your growth, supports your well\-being, and empowers you to make a meaningful impact on people’s everyday lives. If you’re ready to advance your career in a dynamic, innovative, and genuinely supportive environment, apply today and discover why Catch Coverage is shaping the future of Insurance. **Job Position: Data Engineering \& Analytics Senior Manager** **Job Location:** This position is based in our Clearwater, FL or Fort Lauderdale, FL office. Candidates who live within 50 miles of either office will be required to work on\-site at that location. Candidates who live outside this radius may be considered for a remote work arrangement, subject to company approval and business needs. Remote eligibility is not guaranteed. **PURPOSE OF THE JOB:** The Data Engineering \& Analytics Senior Manager is responsible for making sure Catch Coverage's data is accurate, connected, and trusted across the business. Our call center, Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) operation, and distribution business generate data on calls, leads, enrollments, carrier commissions, agent licensing and contracting, and marketing spend. This role brings it together so leaders can see what is happening and make better decisions. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will set the direction for our data platform, build and maintain the pipelines and data models behind it, and manage a small team that grows with the function. You will turn complex data into reliable reporting and forecasting for operations, sales, compliance, and finance, while protecting sensitive customer information. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Own architecture, build\-versus\-buy decisions, and standards across Snowflake, AWS, orchestration, transformation, and third\-party tooling * Build and run production ETL/ELT pipelines from REST APIs, cloud storage, CRM, Genesys Cloud, Retreaver, carrier and licensing/contracting sources, and book\-of\-business systems, with testing, monitoring, alerting, and documentation * Manage Snowflake operations, including role\-based access, warehouse sizing, query performance, Protected Health Information (PHI) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) handling, and consumption cost control * Own incident response, including on\-call and escalation procedures, root\-cause analysis, and recovery runbooks * Build dimensional models and curated marts for agents, agencies, carriers, plans, leads, calls, enrollments, policies, and commissions * Deliver a semantic layer and analytics\-ready datasets that power dashboards and controlled self\-service * Produce call center volume and staffing forecasts, including Annual Enrollment Period and Open Enrollment Period seasonality, and commission and revenue forecasts * Support segmentation, attribution, experimentation, and predictive models (such as lead scoring and agent attrition) where they change a decision * Lead, coach, and set priorities for the data team, and hire as the roadmap justifies * Maintain a written quarterly roadmap and intake process for new data requests * Partner in person with operations, sales, compliance, finance, and technology leaders to define requirements and drive adoption of the numbers * Own the data function budget (Snowflake, AWS, software, contractors, vendors), forecast spend, and bring renewal and investment recommendations to leadership Requirements: * 7\+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related role, including 2\+ years leading or mentoring a data team and making architecture or technology decisions * Advanced, current Snowflake experience: data modeling, SQL optimization, RBAC, warehouse and workload management, and cost management * Advanced SQL and strong Python, with a track record of building and running production ETL/ELT pipelines and API integrations * Deep knowledge of data warehousing, dimensional modeling, data quality testing, observability, and cloud object storage * Working statistical competence: forecasting, segmentation, experimentation design, or predictive modeling applied to business decisions * Experience owning or materially influencing a cloud, software, or vendor budget * Ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs to non\-technical executives, and to say no with a reason * Ability to work on\-site in Fort Lauderdale or Clearwater, Monday through Friday **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * AWS (S3, Lambda, Glue, EventBridge, IAM) * dbt or a comparable transformation framework * Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect * Git\-based workflow and CI/CD for data * Contact\-center, CRM, insurance distribution, lead\-generation, or performance\-marketing data; Medicare or Affordable Care Act (ACA) experience is a strong plus * Experience handling Protected Health Information (PHI) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) under the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), and working with compliance teams on Centers for Medicare \& Medicaid Services (CMS) and Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) reporting * Bachelor's degree in a technical or quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience **BENEFITS:** * Paid Holidays (6\) * Paid Time Off * Medical Insurance, National Plan Options * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * 401(k) with portion of Co Match * Voluntary Life and Accidental Death \& Dismemberment (AD\&D) * Plans including Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity * Employee Assistance Program * Bereavement Leave \& Jury Duty Pay

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **Career Area:** Manufacturing**Job Description:** **Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.** When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Caterpillar Inc. is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer specialized in Assembly at the North Little Rock facility in Arkansas. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the design, implementation, and maintenance of processes and tooling. **WHAT YOU WILL DO:** * Creating and maintaining work instructions, tool lists, inspection guides, Control Plans, PFMEAs and SFMEAs for automation and other manufacturing processes. * Support new product introductions and continuous improvement efforts around people, quality, velocity, and cost for assembly processes. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives participating in Lean Manufacturing projects and 5S improvements. * Engages in creative problem\-solving to address operational issues, including ergonomics and safety, efficiency improvements, process bottlenecks, and quality concerns related to automation and other manufacturing processes. * Works with internal and external suppliers to develop and manage projects, ensuring efficient and cost\-effective systems and processes to produce quality products. * Provide manufacturing technical support in process controls for assembly and other manufacturing processes. * Monitor and improve equipment reliability by identifying and addressing problem areas, performing root cause analysis, and being the technical expert for the value stream. * Ensures compliance with all manufacturing standards, procedures, and safety guidelines, including both Caterpillar and OSHA compliant procedures. **WHAT YOU WILL HAVE:** * Degree requirement: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or closely related discipline OR equivalent technical experience plus demonstrated competence of significant engineering and/or operational experience related to automation and manufacturing. * Technical expertise in the latest manufacturing technologies such as AI, automation, and robotics. Hands\-on experience with equipment setup, diagnostics, and optimization with the ability to develop and deploy robotic solutions. * Lean Manufacturing: Demonstrated ability to apply lean manufacturing tools and methodologies in a production environment. * Manufacturing Processes: Expertise in manufacturing safety related to automation, knowledge of existing product manufacturing methods and technology and the ability to execute, plan and manage the manufacturing assembly process. * Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Strong critical\-thinking and decision\-making skills, with experience in evaluating options, predicting impact, and advising others. **TOP CANDIDATES’ MAY ALSO HAVE:** * Experience with 3D modeling programs (NX or Creo) * Experience with automation of assembly processes * Extensive knowledge of Lean manufacturing principles * Ability to work with a diverse group of employees and customers * Good communication, interpersonal and teamwork skills * Proficient with all Microsoft Office 365 products * Experience with SAP * Ability to analyze and interpret various types of data to make informed decisions **ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:** * This position requires the selected candidate to work on\-site five days a week in the North Little Rock, Arkansas facility * Domestic relocation is not available * Visa sponsorship is not available **Summary Pay Range:** $89,210\.00 \- $133,810\.00 Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar. **Benefits:** Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. This is a summary list of benefits. * Medical, dental, and vision benefits\* * Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holidays, Volunteer, etc.)\* * 401(k) savings plans\* * Health Savings Account (HSA)\* * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)\* * Health Lifestyle Programs\* * Employee Assistance Program\* * Voluntary Benefits and Employee Discounts\* * Career Development\* * Incentive bonus\* * Disability benefits * Life Insurance * Parental leave * Adoption benefits * Tuition Reimbursement * These benefits also apply to part\-time employees Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.**Posting Dates:** October 26, 2026 \- November 8, 2026 Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen. Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply. Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

jobs.description: Req ID: 141775 Region: Americas Country: USA State/Province: California City: San Jose **General Overview** -------------------- Functional Area: Information Technology (ITM) Career Stream: Enterprise Architecture (ARCH) Role: Director (DR1\) Job Title: Director, IT Enterprise Solution Architecture 1 Job Code: DR1\-ITM\-ARCS Job Level: Level 12 Direct/Indirect Indicator: Indirect **Role Overview** ----------------- The **Director, DevOps \& AI Support Leader** is responsible for building and operating the modern platform engineering, CI/CD build automation, AI developer enablement infrastructure, and specialized developer desktop environments that support 2,500 hardware and software product engineers. Reporting directly to the VP, HPS Product \& Engineering IT, this role leads the internal developer platform strategy to enable execution velocity. The Director balances high\-throughput build pipelines and state\-of\-the\-art AI developer tools (Vertex AI, code generation, autonomous agents) with robust model security boundaries and containerized infrastructure guardrails. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **1\. DevOps \& Pipeline Automation** * Architect, scale, and optimize automated CI/CD runners, containerized build environments, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) deployment pipelines across cloud and on\-premises systems. * Minimize build, test, and pull\-request wait times for silicon simulation, firmware compilation, and software engineering toolchains. * Standardize automated artifact management, release packaging, and deployment orchestration across R\&D squads. **2\. R\&D AI Enablement \& Governance** * Oversee the deployment and operational governance of the AI Control Tower, enterprise Vertex AI cloud environments, and autonomous AI agents. * Manage IDE code\-completion infrastructure (GitHub Copilot, Cursor instances) and LLM toolchain integration across developer workstations. * Enforce strict AI prompt and data privacy boundaries to ensure proprietary silicon IP, firmware binaries, and source code do not leak to external AI models. **3\. Developer OS \& Workplace Engineering** * Direct dedicated Linux desktop engineering and endpoint optimization to deliver high\-performance local development environments for product engineers. * Partner with Global IT Operations to integrate required endpoint security controls (e.g., ThreatLocker, container isolation) without creating developer friction or performance degradation. **4\. Team Leadership \& Strategic Execution** * Directly manage and mentor a distributed team of senior DevOps engineers, AI specialists, Linux OS engineers, and cloud\-native security leads across Santa Clara, Toronto, and CRT. * Establish Developer Experience (DevEx) KPIs tracking build success rates, pipeline latency, system uptime, and AI tool productivity gains. **Key Qualifications \& Experience** ------------------------------------ * **Experience:** 10\+ years of progressive leadership experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or R\&D Systems Engineering within high\-growth technology, semiconductor, or networking hardware/software companies. * **Engineering Scale:** Proven track record supporting large\-scale R\&D organizations (2,000\+ hardware and software engineers) operating at high velocity. * **Technical Depth:** Deep expertise in CI/CD pipeline orchestration (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), Kubernetes, containerization, and IaC (Terraform, Ansible). * **AI \& Automation:** Hands\-on experience deploying enterprise AI developer tools (Vertex AI, local LLMs, AI coding assistants) and implementing AI governance guardrails. * **OS \& Endpoint Knowledge:** Strong background in Linux desktop distributions (Ubuntu, RHEL) optimized for developer environments. * **Leadership \& Communication:** Outstanding executive presence with the ability to interface directly with HPS product engineering directors, CTO architects, and central Celestica IT leadership. **Physical Demands** -------------------- Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment. Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required. **Notes** --------- This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time. Celestica is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This policy applies to hiring, promotion, discharge, pay, fringe benefits, job training, classification, referral and other aspects of employment and also states that retaliation against a person who files a charge of discrimination, participates in a discrimination proceeding, or otherwise opposes an unlawful employment practice will not be tolerated. All information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Celestica is an E\-Verify employer.

jobs.title: Incident Response Analyst I
jobs.description: **Position Purpose:** Investigates security incidents, recommends enhancements to improve security, identifies common attack patterns targeting the organization's externally facing assets, and contributes to the implementation of scalable and preventative security measures. Assists with the execution of the enterprise Incident Response Plan. Supports enterprise\-wide remediation efforts coordinated by DFIR and contributes to briefings and reporting for leadership. **Key Details:** Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment\-based visa types H\-1B, L\-1, O\-1, H\-1B1, F\-1, J \-1, OPT, or CPT. * Triages and investigates security alerts, events, and notifications end to end across endpoint, email, identity, and network telemetry according to agreed alert priority levels, and escalates confirmed or suspected incidents to DFIR in accordance with defined escalation criteria. * Analyzes reported and detected phishing and malicious email to determine disposition. * Documents investigation steps, findings, and dispositions in the case management system. * Executes approved containment actions, such as indicator of compromise (IOC) blocking and host isolation. * Identifies detection tuning and automation opportunities to reduce manual effort. * Supports the review of security configurations on Centene’s production information systems and networks when gaps are identified during investigations. * Assists with the prevention and resolution of security breaches and ensures incident and response management processes are initiated. * Assists with access authorization reviews and access controls validation when required to support security investigations. * Contributes to the development of automated scripts, response playbooks, and other programmed responses which are launched when an attack against Centene’s systems has been detected. * Collaborates with Information Security Architects, Information Security Engineers, and software or hardware stakeholders at Centene. * Integrates third\-party attack monitoring services and threat reporting services into internal CIRT (Cyber Incident Response Team) communications systems. * Performs other duties as assigned. * Complies with all policies and standards. **Education/Experience:** A Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g., statistics, mathematics, engineering, computer science) and requires 0 – 2 years of related experience. Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position. Or completion of a Centene\-sponsored emerging talent program. **Technical Skills:** Skills may be gained through academic, lab, internship, or professional experience. *Baseline:* * Networking fundamentals (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP) and network and infrastructure technologies, including routers, switches, and firewalls. * Windows and Linux operating system fundamentals. * Log analysis and investigation of security events. * Knowledge of indicators of compromise (IOCs) and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) used by threat actors. *Preferred:* * Hands\-on familiarity with endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools (e.g., CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint). * Hands\-on familiarity with SIEM platforms and query languages (e.g., Splunk SPL, KQL, SQL). * Familiarity with email security platforms (e.g., Proofpoint) and phishing analysis. * Familiarity with the MITRE ATT\&CK framework. * Basic scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Python). **Soft Skills:** * Beginner \- Seeks to acquire knowledge in area of specialty. * Beginner \- Ability to identify basic problems and procedural irregularities, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. **License/Certification:** * CompTIA Security\+, Microsoft SC\-200, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, ISC2 CC preferred but not required. Pay Range: $30\.58 \- $55\.09 per hour **At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day.** You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday. Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job\-related factors permitted by law, including full\-time or part\-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility. Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the LA County Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer, Data Products
jobs.description: CentralReach is a leading provider of autism and IDD care software for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), multidisciplinary therapy, and special education. Trusted by more than 200,000 users, we enable therapy providers, educators, and employers to scale the way they deliver ABA and related therapies with innovative technology, market\-leading industry expertise, and world\-class customer satisfaction. CentralReach's Data Products team is seeking a Senior Sales Consultant to own the technical side of every data opportunity we pursue. jobs.title: Associate AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: Description: CleanSlate Technology Group (CSTG) is a modern technology consulting firm transforming how organizations use Data, AI, and Cloud Modernization to fuel innovation. As a top\-tier cloud partner, we design and deliver AI solutions and modern data platforms that unlock the power of data, accelerate transformation, and enable businesses to build what's next. We help clients accelerate their AI journey with security and governance built on a strong data foundation. With an operational mindset, we break through legacy limitations, simplify complexity, and create future\-ready technology foundations that inspire new possibilities. At CSTG, you'll be part of a team that empowers organizations to innovate faster, make smarter decisions, and compete boldly in a rapidly evolving digital world. Through our Data and AI Practice, we partner with clients to build scalable, reliable data foundations across AWS and Azure. Our focus is on modern data engineering, developing data platforms and pipelines that enable analytics, machine learning, and AI in real world production environments. We believe strong data engineering is critical to making AI useful, trustworthy, and sustainable. CSTG consultants combine proven engineering practices with a hands\-on consulting mindset, helping clients move from strategy to implementation while delivering solutions aligned to real business needs. **What does your team look like:** Our teams bring together CSTG consultants and client stakeholders to solve complex data and AI challenges. As an Associate AI/ML Engineer, you will collaborate with AI/ML, data, and application engineers, developing your primary skills in AI and machine learning while learning how data platforms and applications support reliable, production\-ready solutions. We value curiosity, practical problem\-solving, and a willingness to learn from others. **What does your role look like:** As an Associate AI/ML Engineer in CSTG’s Data and AI Practice, you will support client delivery by completing well\-defined development, testing, and documentation tasks with guidance from experienced engineers. Your work will contribute to AI and machine learning solutions, including generative AI and agent\-based use cases, that become part of client production systems. Associate AI/ML Engineers apply established techniques and learn AI and ML engineering best practices through assigned project work, code reviews, and feedback from experienced team members. You will communicate progress, ask questions, and raise blockers within the delivery team. As you build familiarity with the work, you will participate in client discussions with support from more experienced consultants. Success in this role means completing assigned work with increasing independence, incorporating feedback, documenting results, and building sound engineering habits. Your focus will be on reliable contributions to team delivery while developing experience with real\-world AI solutions. **Responsibilities:** * Development and integration: Complete assigned development tasks for client AI and machine learning solutions, including generative AI and agent\-based capabilities, using established approaches and guidance from experienced engineers. * Build and test defined components of AI workflows, services, and integrations alongside data and application platforms, following team designs and review processes. * Apply established AI techniques, patterns, and tools to solve well\-defined problems. * Testing and evaluation: Run established tests and evaluation procedures, document results and model limitations, and raise unexpected outputs or data quality concerns for review. * Participate in design discussions, reviews, and team feedback sessions. * Production delivery support: Collaborate with data and application engineers on assigned tasks that help prepare AI solutions for production, following established testing, deployment, and review procedures. * Responsible AI: Follow project guidance for data usage, bias, transparency, and privacy. Document concerns and seek guidance before using data or sharing outputs when requirements are unclear. * Code quality and documentation: Write clear, maintainable code for assigned tasks, participate in code reviews, incorporate feedback, and document implementation details and test results. * Continue developing skills in AI, machine learning, and production delivery practices. Requirements: * Foundational hands\-on experience building or supporting AI or machine learning solutions through professional work, internships, coursework, research, or personal projects. * Foundational Python skills, including the ability to write, read, and debug simple code for data preparation or AI and machine learning tasks; experience may come from work, coursework, or projects. * Familiarity with machine learning, generative AI, or agent\-based approaches. * Foundational experience preparing or working with structured or unstructured data for AI use cases, including checking data quality; coursework and project experience are welcome. * Foundational understanding of version control and tooling such as Git * Exposure to deploying solutions across multistage environments (development, test, and production) * Familiarity with AWS, Databricks, or Azure services. * Understanding of foundational data engineering concepts, such as data pipelines and data quality. * Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly within a team and with client stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Exposure to LLM platforms or tools such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, or similar. * Agentic tooling like AWS Quick/Claude/Copilot/OpenClaw/Dots/Grok Bot. * Exposure to Agentic development with tooling like Claude Code/Kiro/Cursor. * Exposure to MLOps practices, including model versioning or monitoring. * Experience working alongside data engineering teams on shared solutions. * AWS, Azure, or entry\-level AI/ML certifications. * Databricks or Snowflake certifications or willingness to obtain them. * Claude certifications or a willingness to obtain them.

You'll set the technical direction for how we design, evaluate, ship and operate agents, and stay hands\-on building the foundations our teams use. observability, incident investigation and safe rollout of system changes. * An understanding of security risks in agent systems, including prompt injection, unsafe tool execution and exposure of **Model access:** Managed cloud model platforms, direct provider APIs and multi\-provider gateways. **Nice To Have** ---------------- * Experience with GCP, Go or Kubernetes. * Experience building sandboxed environments for agents that execute untrusted code or interact with external systems. * Offensive security, application security or security tooling experience. * Experience introducing AI coding tools across engineering teams and measuring their impact. * Public writing, talks or open\-source contributions related to agent engineering. ### **Why You Should Join Us** * Grow in a BENEFITS * Competitive base salary and bonus potential * Medical, dental, life, and short/long\-term disability insurance * Generous 401(k) match * Generous vacation * Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) * Paid company holidays * Summer hours half day Fridays * Flexible hours * Employee development and growth opportunities

The successful candidate will bring expertise in Drupal/PHP development, AWS cloud environments, Kubernetes, and Agile delivery while guiding architecture decisions, code reviews, testing, and production releases. The Engineering Lead will report to the Product Manager and balance feature delivery with long\-term maintainability, security, and privacy requirements. Candidates must be willing to participate in proposal\-related technical oral presentations if the team advances in the procurement process. **In this role you can expect to:** =================================== * Lead the engineering team through application design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvement. * Provide hands\-on development support, code reviews, technical troubleshooting, and engineering mentorship. * Direct Drupal/PHP application development, API integration, and modernization of existing software components. * Translate federal customer requirements and user stories into technical designs, engineering tasks, and acceptance criteria. * Guide implementation of CI/CD pipelines using approved technologies such as Jenkins, GitHub, SonarQube, Snyk, and Artifactory. * Integrate secure coding practices, automated testing, vulnerability remediation, and DevSecOps controls throughout the development lifecycle. * Coordinate containerized application development, cloud migration, and deployments using Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS). * Collaborate with the System Architect on AI\-assisted development tools operate within authorized federal environments and comply with applicable security and privacy requirements. * Communicate technical risks, architectural trade\-offs, and development priorities clearly to federal product and program leadership. * Support application monitoring, incident resolution, root cause analysis, and continuous performance improvement. * Coordinate engineering assignments, Agile workflows, dependencies, and milestones with the Product Manager to maintain delivery commitments. **Basic Qualifications:** ========================= * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. * At least 10 years of experience in software development, including at least 5 years leading software engineering teams. * Strong hands\-on experience with Drupal architecture, custom module development, PHP, and application modernization. * Experience developing, deploying, and maintaining applications in AWS cloud environments. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS). * Practical experience with Jenkins, GitHub, SonarQube, Snyk, Artifactory, and automated CI/CD pipelines. * Experience with REST APIs, authentication, authorization, enterprise integrations, and modern application architectures. * Experience leading Scrum teams, managing technical backlogs, and delivering iterative software releases. * Knowledge of secure coding, static and dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST), vulnerability remediation, and federal cybersecurity requirements. * Familiarity with approved AI\-assisted software development tools, responsible AI governance, and human\-in\-the\-loop validation. * Demonstrated ability to guide engineering decisions, review code, mentor developers, and resolve complex production issues. * Experience supporting healthcare IT applications or initiatives, with an understanding of privacy\-sensitive environments and secure management of healthcare information. * Demonstrated leadership of a small engineering team, typically three to five people, including work planning and milestone delivery. Technical lead or lead architect experience is acceptable; a formal people\-manager title is not required. * Experience delivering applications with enterprise\-wide scope and impact, including coordination across technical and business stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications:** ============================= * AWS Certified Developer \- Associate or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer \- Professional. * Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) or equivalent Kubernetes certification. * Experience supporting federal healthcare agencies or large\-scale Government enterprise applications. * Experience with Drupal upgrades, custom modules, and PHP application modernization. * Familiarity with federal NIST SP 800\-53 security controls. * Experience implementing automated testing, security scanning, and vulnerability remediation within CI/CD pipelines. * Experience implementing Section 508 accessibility requirements in web applications. * Experience integrating AI\-assisted development tools with appropriate security controls and human\-in\-the\-loop validation processes. Certifications listed above are preferred; no certification is required for this position. **About Connsci** ================= At Connsci, our mission is to be a trusted strategic partner for our clients, helping them achieve impactful results by addressing mission\-critical issues that affect their bottom line. We recognize the importance of customizing our services to best fit our clients' needs and understanding what it takes to propel their organizations forward. By implementing industry\-leading best practices and leveraging our multifaceted experience and expertise, we deliver services that are essential for any organization aiming to reach its goals. **What You Can Expect:** ======================== * **Collaboration and Innovation:** Work in an environment where collaboration and innovation are key. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to projects that make a real difference for our clients. * **Professional Growth:** Be part of a team that values professional development. We offer opportunities for growth and advancement, allowing you to enhance your skills and career. * **Impactful Work:** Engage in meaningful work that addresses mission\-critical issues and supports organizations in achieving their goals. By joining Connsci, you'll become part of a dedicated team that is committed to delivering strategic, impactful solutions tailored to our clients' unique needs, enabling them to achieve their goals with confidence and efficiency. If you're passionate about cybersecurity and IT services, and eager to contribute to a dynamic team, we encourage you to explore opportunities with us. Connsci is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. jobs.title: Lead AI & Automation Engineer – Business Process & Healthcare Operations
jobs.description: ### **About the role** We operate multiple businesses, including pharmacy and senior\-living operations, and are building an internal AI and automation capability. We are looking for **one highly hands\-on engineer and problem solver** who can work directly with ownership and employees to identify inefficient processes, repair existing automation, build better systems, integrate software and deploy practical AI throughout the organization. This is **not a strategy\-only AI position and not a prompt\-engineering position**. You should be someone who can observe a broken business process in the morning, understand the systems and data behind it, troubleshoot logs and APIs, build or improve the solution, test it, deploy it and then teach employees how to use it. One of your first priorities will be evaluating and improving existing third\-party bots and automations used in our pharmacy operations. You will become our internal technical owner: understanding what vendors have built, diagnosing problems, determining what should be fixed versus replaced, and making sure our company owns and understands its technology. ### **What you will do** * Spend significant time with employees observing real workflows and identifying repetitive work, data\-entry problems, bottlenecks, errors and opportunities for automation. * Audit, troubleshoot and improve existing bots and vendor\-built automations, including workflows currently supported by outside vendors. * Build production AI and automation solutions using software, APIs, workflow platforms, databases and appropriate AI models. * Integrate business and healthcare systems through APIs, webhooks, database connections, secure file exchange and, where necessary, RPA/UI automation. * Automate document and data\-processing workflows involving PDFs, forms, structured files and other operational information. * Build AI\-assisted workflows with appropriate validation, evaluation, exception handling and human review. * Create reliable systems with logging, monitoring, retries, alerts and clear failure states. * Work with regulated healthcare information and follow company HIPAA/security policies. * Maintain all source code, workflows and documentation in company\-controlled repositories and systems. * Quantify the impact of projects: labor hours eliminated, cycle time, error rates, automation success rate and employee adoption. * Train employees to use AI safely and productively in their own work. * Create reusable AI tools and standards so improvements spread across our pharmacy, senior\-living and other businesses. * Manage technical vendors and hold them accountable for documentation, access, reliability and deliverables. * Work directly with ownership to turn ideas into operating systems rather than presentations. ### **What we are looking for** **Required** * Approximately 5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering, systems integration, automation engineering or equivalent real\-world experience. * Demonstrated history of personally building and deploying production software or automation—not just managing developers. * Strong Python or comparable software\-development skills. * Strong experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, authentication and systems integration. * SQL and practical data\-processing experience. * Experience debugging production systems using logs, error traces and systematic root\-cause analysis. * Experience with Git and professional source\-control practices. * Experience with at least one workflow/automation platform such as n8n, Microsoft Power Automate, Make, Zapier, UiPath or similar. * Hands\-on experience integrating modern LLM/AI APIs into real workflows. * Understanding of testing, AI evaluation, exception handling, observability and production reliability. * Ability to explain technical issues clearly to nontechnical employees. * Curiosity about how businesses actually operate and willingness to sit with employees and watch the work being done. * Willingness and ability to work regularly on\-site in Milton, PA. **Strongly preferred** * Experience in pharmacy, healthcare, senior living or another regulated environment. * Experience handling PHI or other sensitive regulated data. * Familiarity with HIPAA security considerations and Business Associate Agreement requirements. * Familiarity with healthcare interoperability such as FHIR, HL7 and/or NCPDP. * Document\-processing/OCR experience. * RPA experience for legacy systems without modern APIs. * Experience with Docker and AWS, Azure or Google Cloud. * Experience with process mapping, Lean/Six Sigma, root\-cause analysis or operational improvement. * Experience managing outside development or automation vendors. ### **Hybrid schedule** This is **not a fully remote job**. During approximately the first 60–90 days, we expect the successful candidate to spend about four days per week on\-site learning our systems and observing workflows. After the initial discovery and implementation period, we expect the normal schedule to transition to approximately two to three days per week on\-site, depending on active projects. Relocation or signing assistance may be available for an exceptional candidate. ### **What success looks like** Within your first 90 days, you should understand our critical automation environment, establish visibility into existing bot failures, improve several high\-value workflows, put company ownership/documentation standards in place, and provide ownership with a prioritized roadmap of additional AI and automation opportunities. Over time, your job is simple to describe: **Find work that should not require as much human effort as it does today, design a safe and reliable better way, implement it, measure it and make it stick.** ### **Compensation** **Base salary: $150,000–$180,000**, depending on demonstrated capability and experience. Performance bonus. Benefits. Relocation/signing assistance available where appropriate. ### **To apply** Please submit your resume and, where available, links to GitHub, technical projects, portfolio material or other examples of systems you have built. In your application, briefly describe one automation or integration that you personally took from problem identification through production deployment. Tell us what systems were involved, what you personally built, what went wrong along the way and what measurable result the project produced.

jobs.title: IT Infrastructure Administrator
jobs.description: DCI Donor Services (DCIDS) is looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic team member to join us to save lives!! Our mission at DCIDS is to save lives through organ and tissue donation, and we want professionals on our team that will embrace this important work!! We want people to join our team in the role of IT Associate Infrastructure Administrator. The IT Associate Infrastructure Administrator supports the day\-to\-day operation, administration, security, and maintenance of DCIDS technology infrastructure, including servers, networks, cloud services, endpoint platforms, and telecommunications systems. This role serves as an escalation point for technical support issues and performs routine infrastructure administration under established standards and procedures. The position requires broad working knowledge and ongoing technical development across systems, networking, telecommunications, cloud services, infrastructure security, and security monitoring. **COMPANY OVERVIEW AND MISSION** For over four decades, DCI Donor Services has been a leader in working to end the transplant waiting list. Our unique approach to service allows for nationwide donation, transplantation, and distribution of organs and tissues while maintaining close ties to our local communities. DCI Donor Services operates three organ procurement/tissue recovery organizations: New Mexico Donor Services, Sierra Donor Services, and Tennessee Donor Services. We also maximize the gift of life through the DCI Donor Services Tissue Bank and Sierra Donor Services Eye Bank. Our performance is measured by the way we serve donor families and recipients. To be successful in this endeavor is our ultimate mission. By mobilizing the power of people and the potential of technology, we are honored to extend the reach of each donor’s gift and share the importance of the gift of life. We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. With the help of our employee\-led strategy team, we will ensure that all communities feel welcome and safe with us because we are a model for fairness, belonging, and forward thinking. **Below are some of the key accountabilities/qualifications this position will hold:** * ### **Infrastructure Support \& Administration** + Administer and support assigned servers, infrastructure systems, cloud services, network components, and telecommunications platforms. + Perform routine system and infrastructure configuration, maintenance, patching, upgrades, and troubleshooting in accordance with established procedures and standards. + Monitor infrastructure availability, performance, and alerts and respond to identified issues. + Install, replace, label, document, and troubleshoot assigned infrastructure hardware, including network, server, telecommunications, and related site equipment. + Support infrastructure changes and deployments at new and existing locations, including staging, implementation, testing, validation, documentation, and operational handoff. + Maintain accurate system, network, configuration, inventory, asset, and operational records, including assigned configuration items and change records within the organization’s IT service management platform. + Coordinate with vendors, service providers, site contacts, and internal IT teams to support installations, maintenance, outages, troubleshooting, testing, and escalation follow\-up. + Support infrastructure and connectivity at assigned office and remote locations, coordinating onsite and remote activities as needed. * ### **Network \& Telecommunications Support** + Troubleshoot network connectivity, wireless, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and related infrastructure issues. + Assist with the configuration and maintenance of switches, wireless infrastructure, firewalls, and other network components within assigned authority. + Administer and troubleshoot routine telecommunications functions and services, including phones, extensions, voicemail, call routing, connectivity, call quality, and related VoIP services. * ### **Systems \& Cloud Administration** + Assist with administration and maintenance of Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, virtualization, cloud services, endpoint\-management platforms, backup systems, and other assigned infrastructure technologies. + Perform routine account, group, access, authentication, and system configuration activities within assigned authority. + Troubleshoot server, application, endpoint, and cloud\-service issues escalated from technical support.### **Technical Support \& Escalation** + Investigate and resolve escalated incidents requiring infrastructure\-level troubleshooting or administrative access, including issues involving endpoints, applications, accounts, servers, networks, telecommunications, and related systems. + Escalate complex or specialized issues to System Administrators, Network \& Telephony Engineers, Information Security personnel, vendors, or IT leadership as appropriate. + Develop troubleshooting procedures and knowledg  including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, wireless networks, and VPN technologies. + Working knowledge of ITSM and ITOM concepts and tools, including incident, change, configuration, asset, and service\-management practices; experience using ServiceNow preferred. + Working knowledge of infrastructure security concepts and practices, including vulnerability management, endpoint protection, secure configuration, security logging and monitoring, incident response, and initial review of authentication, endpoint, network, and system activity. + Understanding of identity and access management concepts, including account lifecycle, least privilege, multifactor authentication, privileged access, and secure administrative practices. + Familiarity with virtualization and cloud infrastructure. + Familiarity with VoIP and enterprise telecommunications technologies. + Working knowledge of endpoint management, software deployment, patching, infrastructure monitoring, and backup technologies. + Ability to troubleshoot issues across endpoints, applications, systems, networks, and telecommunications services. * ### **Key Competencies** + Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving abilities. + Effective communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. + Ability to work independently within established authority, exercise sound technical judgment, and recognize when issues require specialized escalation. + Ability to prioritize and coordinate multiple incidents, service requests, maintenance activities, and project assignments. + Strong attention to detail and technical documentation. + Commitment to customer service and continuous improvement. + Demonstrated interest and ability to develop proficiency across multiple infrastructure disciplines. * **Physical Traits** ------------------- + Sits, stands, bends, walks, and works in office areas, equipment rooms, and network closets. + Communicates effectively verbally and in writing. + Uses computers, hand tools, testing equipment, ladders, and related technology equipment. + Lifts and carries technology equipment weighing up to 50 pounds, with assistance when appropriate.**Work Environment** -------------------- + Hybrid work model with a combination of remote and onsite responsibilities based on operational, project, and maintenance needs. + Onsite presence is required for activities such as hardware installation, infrastructure deployments, network upgrades, telecommunications configuration, and emergency response. + Standard office conditions when onsite, including extended periods working at a computer. + May require scheduled after\-hours work and participation in an on\-call rotation for critical maintenance, outages, or incident response. + Travel to DCIDS locations may be required to support infrastructure installations, maintenance, and troubleshooting. **\*\*New employees must have their first dose of the COVID\-19 vaccine by their potential start date or be able to supply proof of vaccination.\*\*** **We offer a competitive compensation package including:** * Up to 176 hours of PTO your first year * Up to 72 hours of Sick Time your first year * Two Medical Plans (your choice of a PPO or HDHP), Dental, and Vision Coverage * 403(b) plan with matching contribution * Company provided term life, AD\&D, and long\-term disability insurance * Wellness Program * Supplemental insurance benefits such as accident coverage and short\-term disability * Discounts on home/auto/renter/pet insurance * Cell phone discounts through Verizon *You will receive a confirmation e\-mail upon successful submission of your application. The next step of the selection process will be to complete a video screening. Instructions to complete the video screening will be contained in the confirmation e\-mail. Please note \- you must complete the video screening within 48 hours from submission of your application to be considered for the position.* **DCIDS is an EOE/AA employer – M/F/Vet/Disability.**

jobs.title: Senior Research Engineer, AI Assisted Chip Design, DeepMind
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages. * 3 years of experience building and shipping technical products.
