You will solve complex challenges across all design stages, improve Gemini for silicon applications to streamline hardware design and verification, enhance efficiency, and reduce time\-to\-market.Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer varied learning opportunities and career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Architect, build, and scale multi\-turn agentic flows with Gemini and evolutionary workflows (e.g., AlphaEvolve) for improving chip design. * Develop and curate LLM benchmarks for chip design to evaluate and advance frontier model capabilities. * Leverage scalable evaluation and Reinforcement Learning (RL) post\-training workflows to improve Gemini models for chip design. * Build on the momentum of landmark AI\-for\-silicon breakthroughs, where our AI\-driven RTL and logic optimization methods have delivered substantial power, performance, and area (PPA) improvements on flagship production chips, and help shape the future of the chip design industry. * Use AI to solve some of the most complex tasks in automating chip design, such as spec\-to\-RTL generation, RTL optimization, RTL debugging, and automated Design Verification (DV). Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, Agentic Red Team, DeepMind
jobs.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; Zürich, Switzerland**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in Red Teaming, Offensive Security, or Adversarial Machine Learning. * Experience with Large Language Model (LLM) architectures, agentic workflows (e.g., chain\-of\-thought reasoning), and AI vulnerability classes. * Experience developing exploits for GenAI models (e.g., prompt injection, adversarial examples, training data extraction). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience working in a consulting capacity with product teams or in a "startup\-like" environment. * Familiarity with AI safety benchmarks, evaluation frameworks, and fuzzing techniques. * Ability to translate complex probabilistic risks into actionable engineering fixes for developers. * Excellent coding skills in Python, Go, or C\+\+ with experience building security tools or automation. **About the job** ----------------- At Google DeepMind our mission is to build the world's first general\-purpose learning agent. Central to this mission is the complex task of measuring the intelligence of our prototypes. As a Software Engineer, you will be working with the cutting edge AI agents developed by our exceptional team of Machine Learning and Neuroscience research scientists. Your responsibilities will include everything from creating systems for agent testing using 2D and 3D games to developing test problems within physics simulators. You will create graphical visualization of results, build competitive agent leaderboards and test new algorithms on robots. To succeed in this role you will need to have a strong foundation in software engineering and enjoy working on a wide range of challenging problems within a mission\-driven team. As a part of the Agentic Red Team, you will be a specialized, high\-velocity unit within DeepMind Security. Your mission is to close the Agentic Launch Gap—the critical window where novel AI capabilities outpace traditional security reviews. As a Senior Security Engineer on the Agentic Red Team, you will be the primary technical executor of adversarial engagements. You will work with product builders, identifying architectural flaws during the design phase long before formal reviews begin. Your core focus will be to perform multi\-turn attacks on production\-level AI models, specifically targeting agentic behaviors like tool usage and reasoning chains. You will not only find vulnerabilities but also help close the loop by contributing to Auto Red teaming frameworks and defensive strategies, ensuring that your findings are codified into reusable guardrails for all Google agent developers. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Conduct rapid, security assessments on agentic services, focusing on vulnerabilities unique to Generative AI such as prompt injection, tool\-use escalation, and autonomous lateral movement. * Engineer and execute attack sequences that exploit non\-deterministic model behaviors, agentic logic errors, and data poisoning vectors. * Write code to transform manual vulnerability discoveries into automated regression testing frameworks ("Auto Red Teaming") that prevent regression in future model versions. * Partner directly with developers during the design and build phases to provide immediate feedback, effectively shortening the feedback loop between offensive findings and defensive engineering. * Maintain and expand a library of agent\-specific attack patterns and exploit primitives to establish release criteria for new models. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: Deseret First Credit Union is seeking an experienced Network Engineer to help design, implement, maintain, and improve the network and telecommunications infrastructure supporting our corporate offices, branch locations, data centers, voice services, and member\-facing systems. This position is part of DFCU's Network \& Telecommunications career track and is intended for an experienced networking professional who can operate beyond routine network administration. The Network Engineer will lead complex infrastructure changes, improve network resilience and performance, support network security and segmentation, and provide engineering\-level ownership for routing, switching, firewalls, SD\-WAN, wireless, carrier connectivity, and Cisco voice/contact\-center infrastructure. The successful candidate will work closely with Information Security, Systems Engineering, managed service providers, carriers, vendors, and business teams in a regulated financial\-services environment. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Design, implement, maintain, and optimize enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, VPN, firewall, and SD\-WAN infrastructure. * Support reliable network connectivity across DFCU branch locations, corporate offices, and data centers. * Engineer solutions for performance, capacity, high availability, redundancy, segmentation, monitoring, and secure connectivity. * Administer and support Cisco and Meraki networking technologies. * Support Palo Alto firewalls and Panorama, including troubleshooting, secure configurations, segmentation, VPN connectivity, logging, and approved firewall changes. * Support and improve SD\-WAN infrastructure, branch connectivity, circuit redundancy, and carrier services. * Support DFCU's Cisco phone and telecommunications platforms, including Cisco Unified Communications, UCCX/contact\-center services, SIP connectivity, call routing, QoS, and related integrations. Transitioning to a cloud\-based phone and meeting platform (UCaaS or VoIP) within 6 to 9 months. * Troubleshoot complex network and voice issues using packet captures, logs, monitoring tools, performance data, and structured root\-cause analysis. * Lead network upgrades, migrations, hardware refreshes, carrier changes, firewall changes, branch deployments, and other infrastructure projects. * Develop detailed implementation plans, test procedures, validation criteria, communication plans, and rollback procedures. * Participate in DFCU's formal CAB/change\-management process for production changes. * Maintain current network diagrams, IP addressing records, circuit inventories, configuration standards, recovery procedures, and technical runbooks. * Coordinate with carriers, MSPs, hardware vendors, telecommunications providers, and cabling contractors, and validate vendor recommendations and deliverables. * Participate in network\-related incident response, root\-cause analysis, and permanent corrective\-action planning. * Partner with Information Security on segmentation, firewall governance, vulnerability remediation, logging, investigations, audit evidence, and secure architecture. * Support disaster\-recovery and business\-continuity testing involving branch, corporate, data\-center, and telecommunications connectivity. * Assist with network capacity planning, lifecycle management, equipment refresh planning, and infrastructure modernization. * Provide technical guidance and mentoring to Network Administrators and other IT staff. * Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, improved monitoring, and reduction of operational risk. This is not an exhaustive list of all job duties. Other duties may be assigned at any time. * Requirements: **Required** * Approximately 5\-8 years of progressive enterprise networking experience, including network administration or network engineering responsibilities. * Strong hands\-on knowledge of enterprise routing, switching, wireless networking, firewalls, VPNs, and WAN connectivity. * Experience designing and implementing production network changes. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex network problems involving multiple technologies, vendors, and application dependencies. * Experience preparing implementation, testing, validation, and rollback plans for production changes. * Strong documentation and technical communication skills. * Ability to work effectively with internal teams, managed service providers, carriers, and technology vendors. * Ability to participate in planned after\-hours maintenance and critical incident response when necessary. * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Networking, or a related discipline preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered. **Preferred** * Financial services, credit unions, banking, or another regulated environment * Multi\-site or branch\-based enterprise networks * Palo Alto firewall administration and Panorama * Cisco/Meraki enterprise infrastructure and SD\-WAN implementation or migration * Cisco CUCM, UCCX, SIP, QoS, or enterprise voice/contact\-center environments * Zoom \& Teams platform administration. * Network segmentation and Zero Trust concepts * Carrier circuit management and vendor escalation * Disaster recovery and network\-resiliency testing * Network automation and formal CAB/change\-management processes * Supporting audit or regulatory examination requests **Preferred Competencies:** * Network design and engineering * Network security and risk management * Troubleshooting and problem\-solving * Network reliability and disaster recovery * Voice and communications systems * Project and change management * Technical documentation * Teamwork and vendor coordination * Technical leadership and mentoring * Continuous improvement and automation **Preferred Computer Skills:** * Cisco enterprise routing and switching; Cisco Meraki * Palo Alto Networks firewalls and Panorama * SD\-WAN, enterprise wireless, VPN technologies, MPLS, and internet circuits * TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLANs, trunks, STP, link aggregation, NAT, DNS, DHCP, NTP, SNMP, and syslog * Cisco Unified Communications / Cisco phone platforms; Cisco UCCX / contact\-center technologies * SIP, call\-routing dependencies, and QoS for voice and critical applications * High availability and failover, network monitoring, configuration management, and packet\-analysis tools * VMware and Microsoft infrastructure dependencies, cloud/hybrid network connectivity, and network automation or scripting Benefits: Full Benefits Package Salary: DOE

jobs.title: Sr Software QA Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company** Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health. We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. **Meet the team:** At Dexcom, our Software QA Engineering team plays a critical role in delivering life\-changing continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) technology to people around the world. This role sits at the intersection of firmware and algorithm, working closely with cross\-functional partners to ensure our embedded systems meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and performance expected in medical devices. You’ll join a driven and highly collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and design excellence. We are deeply engaged with firmware and algorithm development teams, contributing early and often throughout the product lifecycle. If you enjoy solving complex problems, learning new technologies, and making a real impact on patient outcomes, this is the place for you. **Where you come in:** * You bring a strong understanding of IEC 62304, 21 CFR Part 820, and other global regulatory requirements, and provide guidance to ensure compliance across software development activities. * You partner closely with firmware, algorithm, and cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality embedded software for medical devices. * You serve as a core team member representing Software QA, contributing throughout the product lifecycle. * You lead and influence the effective application, compliance, and continuous improvement of software development and validation processes. * You provide guidance on software design, testing, configuration management, tool validation, and system integration. * You lead and support pre\-market and post\-market risk management activities, including software anomalies, risk assessments, and CAPA. * You actively participate in design reviews, requirements analysis, and cross\-functional discussions to drive quality upstream. * You contribute to verification and validation activities across the SDLC, with a strong focus on risk\-based testing strategies. * You review and approve software design control deliverables and author key technical documentation (e.g., DHF artifacts, SOPs, protocols, and reports). * You assess change control impacts to ensure continued product performance and compliance. You will assume and perform other duties as assigned. * **What makes you successful:** * You bring experience in software quality or engineering across requirements analysis, design/development, product integration, and testing. * You can interpret software design and code to verify accurate implementation of requirements. * You have hands\-on experience in software development and/or software testing. * You communicate effectively and confidently present to all levels of the organization. * You are able to navigate complex problems, break them down, and drive projects to completion with minimal supervision. * You have experience working with embedded systems and firmware, including hardware/software integration and lab\-based testing environments. * You have experience in regulated industries (preferably medical devices) and are familiar with design controls, V\&V, and quality systems (e.g., FDA 21 CFR Part 820, IEC 62304, ISO 13485\). * You are knowledgeable in SDLC processes and modern development methodologies such as Agile and Waterfall. * You collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and clearly communicate complex technical concepts. * You bring a driven, hands\-on approach, with a curiosity to learn new technologies and a focus on delivering high\-quality outcomes. You must be able to support San Diego, CA (PST) business hours * **Nice to have:** * You hold an ASQ Certified Software Quality Engineer (CSQE) certification. * You have experience with continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems or wearable medical devices. * You bring a background in signal processing and experience validating algorithm\-driven systems. * You are familiar with real\-time operating systems (RTOS) and embedded development environments. * You have experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for embedded systems. You have experience using requirements management tools such as Jama. * **What you’ll get:** * A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave \#dexcomwarriors community . * A full and comprehensive benefits program. * Growth opportunities on a global scale. * Access to career development through in\-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement. An exciting and innovative, industry\-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve. * **Experience and Education Requirements:** Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, and a minimum of 5\-8 years related experience or Master’s degree and 2\-5 years equivalent industry experience or a PhD and 0\-2 years experience * Remote Workplace: Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. Ask about our Flex workplace option. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. jobs.title: (1118504) DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **DevOps Engineer** Irving, TX \| Onsite \| Full\-Time Diversified Services Network, Inc. (DSN) is seeking a full\-time DevOps Engineer to join our team in Irving, TX. We offer full benefits, PTO, 401k, and more! If you're looking to grow your career within an extremely reputable, stable Fortune 100 company \- let's talk! **Position Overview** Our client's heavy equipment generates and processes large volumes of real\-time data from sensors, onboard models, and control algorithms. As part of a broader digital strategy, the organization has developed an integrated family of machine\-based information technology products that interconnect mining equipment and provide real\-time guidance, tracking, monitoring, and supervisory control of operational mining fleets. These products link with other mining and business information systems as part of a larger technology\-enabled solutions vision. The DevOps Engineer will join a 10\-person operations team and own the design and implementation of automation that improves reliability, scalability, security, and delivery speed across the full software development lifecycle. Working with limited supervision, this engineer will collaborate daily with global teams in Brisbane, Australia and India. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and implement end\-to\-end automation solutions across build, test, deployment, and infrastructure lifecycles. * Build, maintain, and support robust CI/CD pipelines, proactively removing delivery bottlenecks and improving deployment reliability. * Partner with Agile delivery teams to define automation strategy, identify systemic inefficiencies, and drive continuous improvement. * Work with developers and quality engineers to standardize pipelines, environments, and workflows, reducing manual effort and operational risk. * Establish and maintain automation standards, best practices, and reusable templates across teams. * Own complex automation and deployment issues, performing root cause analysis and driving long\-term corrective solutions. * Coordinate across multiple Agile teams to identify, manage, and resolve technical dependencies affecting delivery and operations. * Align with enterprise and external teams to ensure solutions meet corporate architecture, security, and compliance standards. * Document automation designs, operational procedures, and runbooks in Confluence, and plan and track work in Azure DevOps. * Mentor junior engineers and peers, raising overall automation maturity within the organization. **Requirements** **Qualifications** **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor's degree required and 5\+ years of experience in automation, DevOps, or platform engineering roles with demonstrated ownership of complex systems. OR * Master's degree with 3 years of experience. OR * Associate degree with 10 years of experience **Required Technical Skills** * **CI/CD:** Enterprise\-scale CI/CD tooling and practices, including Jenkins, GitHub, and Azure DevOps. * **Cloud \& Containers:** Hands\-on experience with AWS services and containerized, orchestrated platforms using Kubernetes. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Scripting and coding for Infrastructure as Code (IaC). * **Databases:** Experience with database platforms and services, including SQL Server and Postgres. * **Microservices:** Proven experience supporting microservices\-based architectures in production environments. * **Development:** Working knowledge of .NET, Java, and/or Python sufficient to review code, troubleshoot issues, and contribute where needed. * **Compliance:** Solid understanding of quality and compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO) and how they apply to automated delivery pipelines. * **Communication:** Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical decisions across teams. **Preferred** * Microsoft Azure certification, such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent. **Benefits** * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Vision Insurance * Disability insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Paid Holidays Please follow the link to our website for a list of job openings in Engineering, IT, Project Management, and more! https://www.dsnworldwide.com Salary expectations: 120,000\-125,000 per annual

jobs.description: As an employee\-owned company, DMA prioritizes employees. Low turnover rates and tenured teams are living proof: * 2026 Great Places to Work Certified * Employee stock ownership program eligibility begins on day one of employment (ESOP contribution is targeted at 6% of your annual compensation) * Company paid parental leave * Generous time off package * Multiple benefit plans, eligibility begins on day one of employment * Culturally focused on work/life balance, and the overall wellness of our employees This is a hybrid position with an expectation to be in our Fort Wayne, IN or Indianapolis, IN office a minimum of two days per week. This position does not qualify for relocation assistance. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. This position does not qualify for employment\-based sponsorship. **Position Summary** The Lead Engineer, Enterprise Architecture is a senior, hands\-on architecture leader responsible for establishing DMA’s future\-state technology architecture and ensuring that significant business and technology initiatives are intentionally aligned with the company’s strategy, enterprise capabilities, and long\-term technology direction. The role leads a small architecture team and operates as a player\-coach: setting enterprise direction, shaping complex solutions before delivery begins, and personally contributing to high\-impact solution design. This role partners with business leaders, IT leadership, security, data, systems, engineering, delivery teams, and vendors to translate business needs into practical solution options. It establishes architecture standards and governance, guides build\-versus\-buy decisions, identifies cross\-system dependencies and risks, and helps DMA move from an organically grown environment toward a coherent target state. The position also provides architecture leadership for emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence. Innovation is pursued selectively to advance business outcomes and the approved enterprise architecture, rather than as a separate objective. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Define and maintain DMA’s current\-state, future\-state, and transition architecture, including enterprise standards, principles, reference architectures, and reusable solution patterns. * Partner closely with business leaders and stakeholders to understand strategic objectives, business capabilities, operational challenges, and emerging needs, translating them into practical technology strategies and solution approaches. * Engage early in business initiatives to help shape requirements, evaluate alternatives, identify dependencies, and ensure proposed solutions address the underlying business need before significant investment or development begins. * Ensure major technology initiatives align with DMA’s business strategy, enterprise capabilities, security requirements, data strategy, platform direction, and long\-term technology roadmap. * Lead solution architecture for significant business and technology requests, developing solution options, conceptual architectures, trade\-offs, risks, dependencies, and implementation recommendations. * Facilitate architecture and solution\-design discussions across business stakeholders, engineering, data, security, systems, delivery teams, and external vendors to drive well\-informed decisions. * Establish and lead architecture governance, including solution reviews, architecture standards, design decisions, exceptions, dependencies, and technical risk management. * Lead build\-versus\-buy evaluations and assess third\-party solutions for business fit, enterprise alignment, integration, security, data considerations, scalability, supportability, and long\-term maintainability. * Provide architecture leadership for AI\-enabled solutions, including generative AI, intelligent agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), document intelligence, automation, Microsoft Copilot, and other emerging technologies. * Help establish architectural standards and governance for AI solutions, partnering with security, data, systems, legal/compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are appropriately designed, governed, and operationalized. * Partner with engineering leads and delivery teams to validate technical feasibility and translate approved architectures into implementable designs while maintaining alignment with the broader enterprise direction. * Identify opportunities to reduce architectural fragmentation, redundant capabilities, technical debt, unnecessary complexity, and inconsistent technology patterns across DMA’s environment. * Support technology investment and portfolio decisions by identifying opportunities for enterprise reuse, shared capabilities, platform consolidation, modernization, and strategic technology adoption. * Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 2 \- 3 technical professionals while remaining personally engaged in high\-impact enterprise and solution architecture work. * Communicate architecture direction, solution recommendations, investment implications, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to executives, business leaders, and technical teams, building organizational alignment around key technology decisions. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Education and Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered. * 10\+ years of progressive experience in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, software engineering, systems design, platform architecture, or related disciplines. * needs into structured options, architecture recommendations, and decision\-ready materials. * Experience evaluating build\-versus\-buy alternatives, third\-party platforms, vendor solutions, and total lifecycle implications. * Strong working knowledge of cloud architecture, APIs and integration patterns, identity and access management, data platforms, security principles, system lifecycle management, and modern software delivery. * Practical experience solutioning AI\-enabled capabilities, including generative AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, intelligent agents, automation, and enterprise knowledge solutions. * Experience with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365; experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI services, or comparable enterprise AI platforms is standards, and executive presentations. * Experience in professional services, tax, financial services, or another information\-intensive and regulated environment is a plus. jobs.title: Developer - ETL Cloud Data Engineer - Level 2
jobs.description: At Duke Health, we're driven by a commitment to compassionate care that changes the lives of patients, their loved ones, and the greater community. No matter where your talents lie, join us and discover how we can advance health together. **About Duke Health Technology Solutions** Pursue your passion for caring and innovation with Duke Heath Technology Solutions, which is dedicated to the transformation, development, and management of enterprise information technology solutions across Duke Health. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Applications), Full Stack
jobs.description: Many structural heart patients suffer from heart failure with limited options. Our Implantable Heart Failure Management (IHFM) business's AI, Product and Platforms organization is at the forefront of addressing these unmet patient needs through pioneering technology that enables early, targeted therapeutic intervention. Our innovative solutions are not just transforming patient care but also creating a unique and exciting environment for our team members. At Edwards Lifesciences, the Implantable Heart Failure Management (IHFM) AI, Product and Platforms organization designs and builds the software and data products that clinicians and patients depend on. As a Senior Software Engineer (Applications), Full Stack, you own the application and service architecture for a web product area, build the patterns and shared components others follow, and are first in line for the production health of what you ship. Based in Irvine, CA, you'll join a high\-impact medtech innovation hub in the heart of Orange County, collaborating in person with cross\-functional teams to shape patient\-focused technology. **How you'll make an impact:** * Product\-area architecture. Design and own the application architecture for a web product area: state management, routing, data fetching against Platform APIs, rendering strategy, design system implementation, and experimentation. * APIs and security. Own customer\-facing performance and quality metrics, such as Core Web Vitals, API latency, and error rates, and build the fixes that move them. * Cloud deployment. Design and deploy your web applications on the cloud (AWS or GCP) using containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code, within the standards and security controls that Platform and DevSecOps own. * Patterns and modernization. Build the patterns and shared components others follow, review designs and code against them, and drive targeted modernization in your area, such as Angular to React and BFF to Platform APIs. * Design control. Produce the architecture documents, verification tests, and traceability for your area's design outputs, and understand how they contribute to the Design History File under IEC 62304\. * Production ownership. Serve as a trusted on\-call lead for web surfaces, lead root\-cause analysis, and resolve complex production issues affecting clinicians and patients, including issues that trace into Platform\-owned services you contribute to. * Mentorship. Mentor P1 and P2 engineers, review their designs and code, and participate in hiring. **What you'll need (Required):** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or related field plus four years of experience \-or\- Master’s degree plus three years of experience. * Deep proficiency in React or Angular with TypeScript and working proficiency in a server\-side stack such as Node.js, Python, Java, Go, or Rust. * Demonstrated experience designing application architecture and API contracts, including state management, data fetching, and integration with internal and third\-party systems. * Experience deploying and operating applications on a cloud platform (AWS or GCP), including CI/CD and containers. * Experience owning the performance, reliability, and production health of end\-user\-facing software. * Strong communication skills, including effective collaboration with distributed teams across time zones, and the ability to set standards within a secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), including CI/CD and automated testing. **What else we look for (Preferred):** * Experience in medical device software (SaMD), or other regulated classes of device software, under IEC 62304, ISO 13485, and FDA design controls. * Experience leading a frontend modernization, such as Angular to React. * Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK) and container orchestration (Kubernetes). * Experience with design system implementation and design tokens, including tooling such as Figma and Tokens Studio. * Familiarity with EMR / EHR integration via HL7, FHIR, or IHE. * A cloud certification, such as AWS Solutions Architect or Developer, or a GCP equivalent. * Familiarity with usability engineering and human factors (IEC 62366\-1\). jobs.description: Discover Your Career at Emory University: Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world\-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community. Description: The Lead Data Engineer provides technical leadership and hands\-on engineering expertise for the development and operation of Emory University’s Unified Data Platform (UDP), built on Microsoft Fabric. The role leads to the integration of data from HR, Finance, Student, Research, and other enterprise applications to support analytics, reporting, research, and institutional decision\-making. Working closely with architects, researchers, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams, the lead translates requirements into reliable, scalable, and governed data solutions. This position guides engineering delivery, mentors team members, establishes development standards, and resolves complex technical issues while contributing directly to pipeline development and production support. Microsoft Fabric experience is preferred. Candidates with strong experience in Azure Synapse or Databricks with PySpark, and the ability to apply that experience to Microsoft Fabric, will also be considered. The role requires sound judgment in data quality, security, governance, and the handling of sensitive university and research data. define source\-to\-target mappings, incremental load strategies, and reconciliation requirements. * Guide implementation of bronze, silver, and gold data layers, including data transformation, dimensional modeling, and curated datasets for reporting and analytics. * Establish and review standards for coding, testing, documentation, version control, and deployment; conduct code reviews and mentor data engineers. * Coordinate engineering tasks and technical dependencies with Business Analysts, Project Managers, Data Analysts, Architects, and source system owners; communicate delivery progress, risks, and resource needs. * Implement data quality checks, reconciliation controls, monitoring, alerting, error handling, and recovery procedures to support reliable production processing. * Troubleshoot complex pipeline and data issues; tune SQL, Spark workloads, and orchestration to improve performance, scalability, and efficient use of platform capacity. * Apply institutional data governance and security standards, including access controls, metadata, lineage, and appropriate handling of sensitive data; support HIPAA requirements where applicable. * Work with researchers and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical specifications and explain design choices and data limitations clearly. * Create and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, source mappings, and support procedures; coordinate production deployments and knowledge transfer. * Support existing UDP and Enterprise Business Intelligence (EBI) integrations and services, balancing operational needs with project delivery priorities. * Evaluate emerging technologies and develop focused proofs of concept that address identified business or engineering needs. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: * Strong experience designing and maintaining data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes across multiple source systems. * Proficiency in Python, SQL, and Apache Spark (PySpark) * Experience with modern data platforms such as Azure Fabric (preferred), Azure Synapse Serverless, or Databricks * Ability to work with large, complex, and distributed datasets * Solid understanding of data modeling concepts and best practices * Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, and data quality frameworks * Ability to lead technical design discussions, review code, mentor engineers, and guide delivery across multiple workstreams * Experience with CI/CD practices and proficiency with version control systems like Git * Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration and monitoring tools Like Airflow, Azure Data Factory or similar frameworks * Understanding of biomedical informatics methodologies is a plus * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking abilities * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences. * Ability to prioritize engineering work, identify delivery risks, and adapt to changing business and platform requirements. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on, analytical problem solver with experience in high\-volume manufacturing, material handling automation, logistics, and continuous improvement. The role reports to the Director of AME \& Automation and is part of the Engineering team. **What You’ll Do** * Develop automation strategies for receiving, storage, kitting, sequencing, line\-side delivery, finished goods, dunnage, and empty\-container return. * Analyze material flow, inventory movement, forklift activity, routes, and replenishment processes to improve safety, quality, productivity, and throughput. * Develop and maintain material layouts, storage concepts, line\-side presentation standards, traffic paths, and end\-to\-end material flow designs for MSS and VAA operations, balancing safety, space utilization, labor, inventory, throughput, and launch requirements. * Partner with plant leadership and cross\-functional teams to define current\-state constraints, validate root causes, and implement practical solutions for material flow, congestion, line\-side delivery, storage, quality, productivity, and capacity challenges. * Specify and Git, or similar version control systems; Linux build systems and Linux kernel development + Knowledge of digital control interfaces, such as Ethernet, CAN, USB, SPI, I2C or high speed serial + You'll be a great communicator (verbally and with the written word) as you'll work closely with team members to review schematics and new designs. + You've got a strong knowledge of communication buses: CAN, USB, Serial, I2C, SPI. + You're capable of designing hardware solutions using PIC and ARM embedded microcontrollers. + Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment. + Involvement in full product life cycle from prototype to production. + Flexible and adaptable with a willingness to work in ambiguous environments. + Broad technical skill set spanning hardware and software, with the ability to work on both hardware and software projects, while learning new skills. + Comfortable learning new tools (including LLMs), technologies, and disciplines as projects demand. ### **Education and Experience:** + Bachelor or Master of science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science or a related field is required + At least 6 years experience with various Embedded Operating Systems: Linux; jobs.title: System Administrator
jobs.description: About Evergreen Goodwill Evergreen Goodwill of Northwest Washington is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization founded in 1923 that helps people get jobs across Northwest Washington by offering high\-quality free job training, education and job placement. Goodwill empowers individuals to overcome barriers to working, by providing comprehensive support and connecting them with life changing job opportunities, ensuring they are career\-ready and can support themselves and their families. The organization employs over 2,000 people, operates five job\-training centers, 23 nonprofit retail stores and more than 27 donation sites in King, Snohomish, Skagit, Whatcom and Kitsap Counties. Every day, Evergreen Goodwill connects people with the jobs, services and skills they need — because Jobs Change Lives. We are committed to creating and sustaining a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion (DEI) and are focused on creating a joyful, inclusive and successful organization. System Administrator **Reports to:** Sr. Manager, IT Services **Band:** $65,000\-73,000 **Location:** Seattle Administration, Hybrid \- 3 days in office, 2 remote Position Summary We are hiring a System Administrator to serve as the Level 3 escalation point for our service desk. You will resolve the most complex end\-user, endpoint, and application issues that Level 1 and Level 2 can't close, and handle the admin\-level work that keeps our stores and corporate users productive. This is a strong fit for an experienced helpdesk or desktop support technician who is ready to own the hardest tickets, set the standard for the team, and build toward a systems engineering career. Key Responsibilities Domain ownership * Own tickets escalated from Level 1 and Level 2, drive them to resolution, and document root cause and fixes in the knowledge base * Troubleshoot complex Windows endpoint, application, printing, and peripheral issues, including problems that span multiple users or sites * Handle day\-to\-day account and access work — user onboarding and offboarding, Active Directory and Microsoft 365 accounts, group membership, password and MFA resets, and license assignment * Manage endpoints through device management tooling: imaging and deployment, software packaging, patch compliance, and policy assignment * Provide remote support to 24 retail locations, including point\-of\-sale, store devices, and local connectivity issues, and coordinate on\-site work when needed * Identify recurring issues and trends, propose fixes, and escalate infrastructure problems to Systems Engineering with clear, well\-documented handoffs * Mentor Level 1 and Level 2 technicians, review ticket quality, and write troubleshooting guides and runbooks * Support infrastructure and identity projects with end\-user rollout, testing, and communication * Participate in scheduled maintenance windows and an on\-call rotation Standards and engineering practice * Set the build, configuration, and operational standards the systems team works to. Write them down * Review designs and significant changes before they reach production * Define what "production\-ready" means for infrastructure work, and hold work to it * Work within enterprise architecture and change management standards, and help shape them Infrastructure and modernization * Lead infrastructure projects: virtualization migration, identity rollout, endpoint modernization, store technology deployment * Design and build, hands\-on. This is not a review\-only role * Automate at the level of the environment, not just your own tasks — configuration management, provisioning, and infrastructure\-as\-code where it earns its place Security and resilience * Own security posture within your domain: patching discipline, access model, hardening standards, and vulnerability response * Own backup, restore verification, and disaster recovery testing. Prove the restores work Vendor and asset management * Manage vendor relationships for platforms and hardware in your domain, including evaluation and selection input * Own asset standards and lifecycle planning, and the budget input that follows from them Multiplication * Raise the capability of the systems engineering team through review, standards, and teaching * Mentor Level I and II engineers, and be explicit with them about what reaching the next level requires * Document your work so someone else can carry it Job\-Specific Qualifications * 3\+ years of helpdesk, desktop support, or service desk experience, including time handling escalated or Tier 2/3 tickets * Strong Windows 10/11 troubleshooting skills across OS, applications, drivers, and peripherals * Working knowledge ofActive Directory and Microsoft 365 administration — users, groups, mailboxes, licensing, and basic Group Policy * Experience with endpoint management and remote support tools (Intune, SCCM/ConfigMgr, or similar) * Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi\-Fi, and VPN troubleshooting from the endpoint side * Basic scripting for routine tasks — PowerShell preferred * Clear written communication and a habit of documenting your work for others to follow * Good judgment about what you can resolve on your own and what needs to go to Systems Engineering Other / Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting multi\-site or retail environments, including point\-of\-sale systems * Exposure to Entra ID, SSO, conditional access, or MFA tooling * Experience with ticketing, asset management, and knowledge base platforms * Familiarity with Windows Server, virtualization, or backup tools * Experience training or mentoring other technicians * Relevant certifications (CompTIA A\+, Network\+, or Security\+; Microsoft 365 or Endpoint Administrator) or equivalent practical experience Minimum Education Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience. Demonstrated work carries more weight than credentials. Everyone Is Welcome When you join Evergreen Goodwill, you join a truly vibrant community. We value the things that make us different and unique. From diverse international and ethnic backgrounds, to languages, identities, ages, orientations, and beyond, Evergreen Goodwill celebrates individual and cultural diversity. Why work at Evergreen Goodwill? A health plan that includes medical, dental, vision and prescription coverage 100% Employer\-paid life, accidental death and dismemberment (AD\&D), and long term disability insurance (for salaried employee) Voluntary supplemental coverage for life, accident, illness, and short\- and long\-term disability Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) Plan Roth and 403(b) Retirement Savings Plan program Paid vacation, (9\) holiday and sick time Limited paid time off for Jury Duty and Bereavement Leave Employee discounts Employee referral bonus Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Mentorship Program Career Advancement Opportunities Paid Job Training **EEO Statement:** Evergreen Goodwill of Northwest Washington is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Staff / Platform Security Engineer

The engineer will identify security risks, design and implement scalable security solutions, establish practical security requirements and guardrails, and partner across technology teams to drive their adoption. The ideal candidate has the technical depth to engineer and troubleshoot complex security solutions, along with the initiative and leadership to define how technologies should be securely deployed, configured, and operated across FINRA.**Essential Job Functions:** * Partner with stakeholders to promote compliance with internal and external security requirements, policies, and standards, and develop technical approaches for improving and measuring compliance. * Develop, own, and continuously improve security standards, technical guidelines, secure configuration requirements, and guardrails for endpoint and workspace technologies. * Assess the security posture of platforms and technologies against established standards; identify gaps and systemic risks; develop technical strategies and solutions to reduce those risks. * Review, develop, and maintain information security policies, standards, guidelines, procedures, and technical documentation, with particular emphasis on actionable technical standards. * Apply security engineering principles, established processes, and technical expertise to identify, validate, prioritize, and reduce security risks across FINRA's technology environment. * Engineer, automate, operate, and continuously improve security controls, emphasizing scalability, consistency, reliability, and measurable risk reduction. * Provide security engineering guidance and technical expertise for the secure adoption, configuration, deployment, and operation of new and existing technologies. * Architect, design, implement, and maintain security controls and solutions that protect endpoint, workspace, and related technology platforms. * Partner with technology owners, engineers, architects, and other security teams to translate security requirements into practical, scalable engineering solutions and drive adoption of security standards across FINRA. * Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness and health of security controls; investigate discrepancies or control gaps; and drive technical remediation through resolution. * Review and analyze security findings, telemetry, and control output across multiple data sources to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies; prioritize risks; determine root causes; and develop repeatable technical methods for identifying and remediating security issues. * Evaluate emerging security technologies, techniques, capabilities, and tools, and provide technical recommendations based on FINRA's security requirements and technology strategy. * Lead or co\-lead security engineering initiatives and cross\-functional projects that improve security capabilities, processes, automation, and the overall security posture of FINRA. * Identify opportunities to improve existing security processes, controls, and engineering practices and take ownership of driving appropriate improvements. * Provide technical leadership, knowledge sharing, and mentoring to engineers and other technology professionals. * Assist with adherence to technology policies and comply with all applicable security controls. * Ensure work products meet or exceed FINRA standards and demonstrate FINRA's values through technical excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. * Collaborate effectively, both in person and virtually, in furtherance of FINRA's mission of investor protection and market integrity. **Education/Experience Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline with at least three (3\) years of related experience, or equivalent training and / or work experience. * Experience must include direct experience in more than one of the following areas: securing networks and systems architecture, design and implementation, secure software assurance, intrusion detection, defense and incident response, security configuration management, access controls design and implementation and security policy and standards development. * Knowledge of communications protocols. * Experience with one or more Cyber Security tools, including: Configuration Assessment, Log Aggregation, Integrity Verification, Web Application Security Testing, Network Access Control System, Network Intrusion prevention systems, and Endpoint Security Solutions. * Strong written and verbal technical communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to develop effe includes military leave, jury duty leave, bereavement leave, voting and election official leave for federal, state or local primary and general elections, care of jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Applied AI - Hybrid (LLM, Agentic, Claude Code, MCP)
jobs.description: FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision\-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations. **We are currently seeking** **Principal Software Engineer** **to design, build, and ship AI\-powered products that leverage large language models (LLMs) and agentic technologies. In this role, you will move quickly from prototype to production, turning emerging AI capabilities into reliable, high\-quality solutions for FactSet’s clients. You will be a technical leader and force multiplier who sets engineering standards for applied AI, mentors other engineers, and helps shape the direction of our AI product portfolio.** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- You possess deep expertise in software engineering and best practices and hands\-on experience **building LLM\-based and agentic systems** , spanning orchestration, tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and observability. Proficient in AI\-assisted development, you leverage tools such as **Claude Code** within your daily workflow and have a strong command of the modern **AI\-driven development lifecycle** — from planning and development to review, testing, and deployment. You thrive in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments where models, requirements, and tooling evolve rapidly, and you bring the technical rigor and autonomy to navigate them effectively. A collaborative and constructive voice, you set a high technical bar, drive architectural excellence, and actively contribute to the long\-term direction of both product and platform. **What You'll Do** **Build, test, and deploy AI\-powered software:** * Design and develop production\-grade LLM and agentic applications, including multi\-step agents, tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation, and workflow orchestration. * Deliver stable, high\-quality features adhering to best practices in testing, CI/CD, and operational readiness. * Build and maintain evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring to optimize quality, safety, latency, and cost of AI\-driven features. * Rapidly prototype and iterate on emerging approaches, hardening successful solutions for production. Leverage AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to accelerate delivery while upholding quality, security, and maintainability standards. * **Technical leadership, mentorship, and AI development standards:** * Lead code and design reviews, providing feedback that elevates team quality, including rigorous evaluation of AI\-generated code. * Mentor engineers on applied AI patterns, agent design, and effective use of AI coding assistants, including prompting, task decomposition, and output verification. * Define and evolve team standards for AI\-assisted development, encompassing code review, testing, security, and responsible use of AI tooling across the development lifecycle. Stay current with advances in LLMs, agent frameworks, and developer tooling, translating insights into actionable practices for the team. * **Cross\-functional collaboration:** * Partner with product managers, designers, architects, direct managers, and engineering peers to define the right solutions and scope. Plan and drive projects effectively, communicating tradeoffs, risks, and progress clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * **Support and continuous improvement:** * Respond to bugs, incidents, and feature requests, engaging effectively across the full development and feedback lifecycle. Diagnose and resolve AI\-specific issues, including non\-deterministic behavior, hallucinations, model regressions, and prompt or tool failures. * **Design, strategy, and innovation:** * Lead and participate in architecture discussions and brainstorming to shape new features and platform capabilities. * Evaluate and introduce new AI\-enabled development tools and workflows that improve team productivity and product quality. Develop deep proficiency in FactSet’s products and data and contribute to the forward direction of our AI strategy. * **What We're Looking For** **Required Skil  including building scalable, observable, and maintainable systems. * Experience designing evaluation approaches for non\-deterministic systems and iterating on quality using data. * Demonstrated ability to give and receive code review feedback and to contribute forward\-looking design ideas. * Proven ability to mentor and coach other engineers on using **AI coding assistants** effectively, and to help establish AI development standards and guardrails for a team or organization. Ability to articulate FactSet’s business, client base, and how your work fits into the bigger picture. * **Desired Skills** * Experience with financial data, analytics, or investment workflows. * Familiarity with **cloud platforms** , containerization, and modern **MLOps/LLMOps practices.** * Experience with model evaluation, fine\-tuning, or optimization for latency and cost. * Experience building custom tooling for AI\-assisted development, such as MCP servers, reusable skills, subagents, or agent configuration conventions. * Contributions to AI developer tooling, internal platforms, or open\-source projects. * Proven ability to thrive in dynamic environments: adapting to shifting requirements and quickly learning new models, tools, and practices. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence without direct authority. Track record of mentoring other engineers and raising team standards. * **What's In It For You** At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means: * The opportunity to join an S\&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start\-up. * Support for your total well\-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and flexible “moments that matter” days. * Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives. * A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions. * Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development. Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging. * Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications. The budgeted salary range for this position in the states of Connecticut and New York is **$180,000\.00 \- $235,000\.00** **Company Overview:** FactSet ( NYSE:FDS \| NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy\-side and sell\-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next\-generation workflow solutions, and client\-centric specialized support. As a member of the S\&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn . At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. FactSet participates in E\-Verify
