jobs.title: Senior Business Systems Developer
jobs.description: OUR MISSION Family Reach is a national 501(c)(3\) nonprofit dedicated to removing the financial barriers standing between cancer patients and their treatment — such as loss of income, increased out\-of\-pocket expenses, and socioeconomic factors. When faced with these financial barriers, families have to make impossible decisions like choosing between paying for treatment or basic essentials like housing, food, and transportation. No family should have to choose between their health and their home — and we won’t stop until that’s the reality. POSITION OVERVIEW The Senior Business Systems Developer will lead the development, enhancement, and maintenance of Family Reach's Salesforce platform and connected technology systems, supporting the organization's ability to deliver programs, engage donors, and operate efficiently. This role will serve as a senior technical resource across Salesforce development, website functionality, system integrations, and automation. Working closely with the Senior Salesforce Solutions Manager, Director of Salesforce Operations, and cross\-functional teams, this individual will translate organizational needs into scalable, secure, and sustainable technical solutions. The ideal candidate will bring strong Salesforce development expertise, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Experience Cloud, alongside experience with Python, APIs, and web technologies. This position requires someone who can work independently, solve complex technical challenges, and help strengthen Family Reach's technology infrastructure. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Systems Development \& Technical Solutions * Design, develop, and maintain custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, HTML, JavaScript, and CSS. * Build and maintain Apex classes, triggers, batch processes, queueable jobs, and test classes following development standards. * Develop Python scripts and other technical solutions to support data management, automation, and operational efficiencies. * Build and maintain custom integrations between Salesforce and external platforms using REST and SOAP APIs, Apex callouts, Platform Events, and Named Credentials. * Lead code reviews, establish development best practices, and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and maintainable. * Evaluate technical requirements, recommend solutions, and identify opportunities to streamline existing processes. Website, Experience Cloud \& Integrations * Develop and maintain Salesforce Experience Cloud sites, including patient\- and family\-facing applications. * Support the development and maintenance of Family Reach's website, including WordPress functionality and integrations with Salesforce. * Collaborate with internal teams to improve website functionality, user experience, accessibility, and performance. * Manage external user access, sharing permissions, and security across Salesforce\-connected applications. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues in partnership with Salesforce Operations. * Identify opportunities to improve connectivity and data consistency across organizational systems. Salesforce Administration \& Operational Support * Develop and maintain complex Salesforce Flows and determine when custom development is more appropriate than declarative solutions. * Support the migration of legacy Workflow Rules and Process Builder automation to Flow. * Provide advanced Salesforce administration support, including permissions, security, sharing settings, and system configuration. * Manage deployments, testing, and releases across sandbox and production environments. * Serve as an escalation resource for complex technical support requests and system issues. * Support ongoing system optimization, data integrity, and operational improvements. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Solution Design * Partner with the Senior Salesforce Solutions Manager and Director of Salesforce Operations to translate business requirements into technical solutions. * Collaborate with Programs, Development, Data, Operations, and other departments to identify technology needs and opportunities for improvement. * Support technical initiatives that extend beyond Salesforce, including website development, automation, and data integrations. * Evaluate project feasibility, estimate development effort, and communicate technical risks and tradeoffs. * Maintain documentation of technical solutions, system architecture, and development processes in Confluence. * Contribute to technology planning and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization. Technical Leadership \& Knowledge Sharing * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other developers and team members. * Establish and promote development standards, code quality, and documentation best practices. * Support training and knowledge sharing to strengthen internal technical capabilities. * Proactively identify opportunities to improve system performance, efficiency, and long\-term sustainability. QUALIFICATIONS Required Qualifications * 5\+ years of Salesforce experience, including at least 3 years of hands\-on development using Apex, SOQL, and Lightning Web Components. * Experience developing Python scripts or similar solutions for data processing, automation, and integrations. * 2\+ years of experience building and maintaining Salesforce Experience Cloud sites. * Demonstrated experience designing and implementing custom API integrations between Salesforce and external platforms. * Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, security, administration, and deployment processes. * Experience with source control and deployment tools such as Git, Salesforce CLI, or DevOps Center. * Experience translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions. * Strong troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and analytical skills. Required Certifications * Salesforce Administrator * Salesforce Platform App Builder * Salesforce Platform Developer I Preferred Qualifications * WordPress development experience, including PHP and Gravity Forms. * Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud and Nonprofit Success Pack (NPSP). * Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud. * Salesforce Platform Developer II, Experience Cloud Consultant, or Nonprofit Cloud Consultant certification. * Experience supporting nonprofit organizations or mission\-driven technology initiatives. * Familiarity with UI/UX design principles and web accessibility standards. Skills \& Attributes * Strong systems thinker with the ability to design solutions for scalability, security, and maintainability. * Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable recommendations for non\-technical stakeholders. * Comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities with minimal oversight. * Collaborative and solutions\-oriented, with a willingness to support evolving organizational needs. * Proactive in identifying opportunities to improve processes and technology. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality. * Enjoys mentoring others and sharing technical knowledge. * Adaptable and eager to learn new technologies. * Passion for Family Reach's mission. FAMILY REACH VALUES Family Reach is inclusive of all racial, ethnic, and cultural minorities; LGBTQIA\+ individuals, individuals with disabilities, individuals that are neurodivergent, and individuals from all educational backgrounds. We encourage multiple perspectives and experiences, support a multicultural environment, and are dedicated to building our leadership and staff to reflect these values and the diverse communities we serve. COMPENSATION The salary range for this position is $65,000–$75,000\. Family Reach offers an attractive benefits package, including, but not limited to, an annual performance bonus, medical, dental, vision, retirement plan, and generous vacation and leave policies.

jobs.title: Senior Instrumentation & Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **About Fervo Energy** ---------------------- Fervo Energy (NASDAQ: FRVO) is a modern power company developing next\-generation geothermal resources to meet the growing demand for affordable, reliable, 24/7 carbon\-free energy. Our mission is to transform geothermal into America's most dependable and affordable source of clean, around\-the\-clock power. By combining innovations in horizontal drilling, fiber\-optic sensing, and advanced reservoir engineering, Fervo has developed a repeatable approach to building utility\-scale enhanced geothermal systems. Our flagship Cape Station development in Utah is planned to deliver 500 MW of firm, carbon\-free power, and we are advancing a development pipeline of more than 50 GW. Join us and work alongside world\-class engineers, geoscientists, operators, project builders, and business leaders working to make geothermal a cornerstone of a more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy future. **Position Description** ------------------------ Fervo is working to build the most cost\-effective, repeatable geothermal power plants in the world. Joining Fervo's GeoBlock engineering team means solving frontier technical problems with immediate real\-world impact, accelerating the clean energy transition and reinventing the way infrastructure is built. We are seeking engineers who are excited by Fervo's mission, the opportunity to drive meaningful and impactful innovation, and the prospect of maintaining extreme ownership over the cost and constructability implications of their designs, knowing that each decision they make impacts the speed and scale of Fervo's mission. As a Senior Instrumentation \& Controls Engineer, you will be a technical leader in the design and optimization of instrumentation \& controls systems for Fervo's innovative power plants. You will apply advanced engineering judgment and first\-principles analysis to develop high\-performance, cost\-effective plant designs, while mentoring junior engineers and influencing cross\-disciplinary decision\-making. As Fervo transitions from first\-of\-a\-kind projects to scaling deployment of its plants, you will play a key role in driving standardization and efficiency improvements across projects. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design control system architectures for standardized 50 MW geothermal power blocks, including development of control philosophies, cause and effect matrices, control narratives, and I/O lists * Develop and maintain Ignition SCADA applications using Perspective, including server architectures, HMI screen development, tag configuration, alarming, historian integration, and report generation for geothermal facility operations * Program Allen\-Bradley PLCs (ControlLogix, CompactLogix) in Rockwell Studio 5000 using standard code blocks developed by Fervo's controls architecture team; contribute to the maintenance and evolution of that shared library as experience grows * Produce a complete I\&C drawing package including control system architecture drawings, panel designs, instrument loop diagrams, wiring diagrams, and low\-voltage wiring schematics * Review Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs) and instrument datasheets; size and select instrumentation including control valves, flow meters, pressure transmitters, and safety valves * Design and specify control panels including enclosure layout, component selection, and low\-voltage wiring; coordinate with panel fabricators through construction and factory acceptance testing * Configure and troubleshoot industrial communication networks including Modbus TCP/IP, EtherNet/IP, Profinet, and OPC\-UA; support fiber optic infrastructure design and installation coordination between field devices, PLCs, and SCADA * Support greenfield construction and commissioning activities at Fervo sites, including site visits, SAT support, loop checks, and coordination with instrumentation and electrical contractors * Collaborate with process, mechanical, and electrical engineering disciplines to ensure I\&C design is fully integrated across the standardized 50 MW Geoblock product; support HAZOP and PHA evaluations * Coordinate with IT/OT and cybersecurity teams to ensure control system designs meet network segmentation and secure remote access requirements * Troubleshoot process control, control network, and instrumentation problems in the field; support operations teams in identifying and resolving issues during startup and steady\-state operation **Qualifications** ------------------ ### ***Required*** * Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related degree from an ABET accredited program * 9\-12 years of experience in Instrumentation \& Control Engineering experience or related role * Strong working knowledge of industry standards and regulations. * Ability to lead and mentor junior staff. * Advanced oral and written communication skills, and a proven ability to write clear, thorough tech  coolers, heaters, rotating equipment (pumps and compressors), packaged equipment, valves \& specialty items * General understanding of all phases of project document production and the relationship between drawings and specifications. * Field experience preferred * Experience with process flow/P\&ID development, control narratives, Cause \& Effect charts, SIS design, instrumentation studies, valve and instrument sizing, and automation/control system architecture. * Ability to assist Process/Mechanical Engineers, support field evaluations and HAZOP/PHA reviews, and contribute to procurement (specifications, bid documents, instrument/PLC I/O lists). **Location** ------------ Fervo Energy has offices in Houston, TX, Golden, CO, Reno, NV, Oakland, CA, and Salt Lake City, UT. This position will be eligible for some hybrid work flexibility, but regular in\-office presence at the Houston, Texas OR the Oakland, CA OR the Reno, Nevada office will be required. **Compensation** ---------------- Fervo provides a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, short\-term and long\-term disability, flexible paid time off, and paid parental leave. Additionally, Fervo offers an incentive stock options program, a bonus incentive program, and a 401(k) plan with an employer match. Fervo Energy is providing the compensation range and general description of other compensation and benefits that the company in good faith believes it might pay and/or offer for this position based on the successful applicant's education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities in addition to internal equity and geographic location. Expected Salary: $140,000 – $170,000 based on location and experience. Fervo Energy reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant's sex or other status protected by local, state, or federal law. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- * Fervo offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well\-being, and life outside of work. Benefits for eligible employees include: * Medical, dental, and vision plan options * Employer\-paid basic life insurance and short\-term and long\-term disability coverage * A 401(k) plan with up to 6% match * Flexible paid time off and paid parental leave * Family\-building, fertility, hormonal health, pregnancy, postpartum, and parenting support through Carrot * A dependent care FSA for eligible child and elder care expenses * An annual Lifestyle Spending Account for eligible wellness expenses, including fitness, financial planning, pet insurance, and pet care * Employee ownership opportunities through Fervo's Employee Stock Purchase Program, as well as LTI and bonus opportunities for eligible roles Benefits and programs are subject to eligibility requirements and may change. **Our Workplace** ----------------- Fervo Energy highly values having employees work in the office to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. This role follows a hybrid schedule, with team members expected to work in the office three days per week. Fervo considers this in\-office schedule an essential function of the role. Your recruiter can share more information about the schedule. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Fervo Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, gender, religion, marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sex, genetic information, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local law. Fervo also prohibits discrimination based on the perception that an individual has any of these characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of these characteristics.

jobs.description: **About Fervo Energy** ---------------------- Fervo Energy (NASDAQ: FRVO) is a modern power company developing next\-generation geothermal resources to meet the growing demand for affordable, reliable, 24/7 carbon\-free energy. Our mission is to transform geothermal into America's most dependable and affordable source of clean, around\-the\-clock power. By combining innovations in horizontal drilling, fiber\-optic sensing, and advanced reservoir engineering, Fervo has developed a repeatable approach to building utility\-scale enhanced geothermal systems. Our flagship Cape Station development in Utah is planned to deliver 500 MW of firm, carbon\-free power, and we are advancing a development pipeline of more than 50 GW. Join us and work alongside world\-class engineers, geoscientists, operators, project builders, and business leaders working to make geothermal a cornerstone of a more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy future. **Position Description** ------------------------ The Senior Technical Product Manager, Internal Software will lead the development of internal software tools across Fervo. This role is the connective tissue between our internal users and the engineers building the tools they need, turning ambiguous internal needs into clear, actionable product requirements. Unlike a traditional product role focused on external customers, you will work across engineering, construction, drilling, completions, supply chain, finance, and operations to understand how work gets done and to identify the workflows that slow execution. The ideal candidate is a deeply technical product manager, or a former software engineer who can code, partner credibly with engineers, and move comfortably between product strategy and software execution. Experience in geothermal, energy, drilling, or construction is not required. In the near term, this role will own product direction, technical scoping, delivery, adoption, and build\-vs\-buy decisions, and over time has the potential to evolve into leadership of Fervo's internal software development team as the function scales. Beyond strong software judgment and product instincts, the ideal candidate brings comfort with ambiguity and the ability to build useful tools quickly in a fast\-moving environment. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Product Ownership:** Own internal software product development from idea to adoption. Work closely with teams across Fervo to understand their workflows, pain points, operating rhythms, and decision\-making needs, and translate ambiguous business problems into clear product requirements, technical specs, user stories, and success criteria. Design for a connected software ecosystem rather than one\-off applications, ensuring tools integrate with existing systems, data sources, and future internal platforms. Measure success through adoption, workflow improvement, and business impact, not just shipped features. * **Engineering Partnership:** Partner closely with software engineers, contractors, and technical partners to scope, sequence, and deliver internal tools. Bring enough software fluency to evaluate technical tradeoffs, ask tough questions, and make pragmatic implementation decisions. Write clear technical product requirements, and own delivery cadence, backlog management, sprint planning, stakeholder updates, and risk escalation. Contribute technically when helpful, especially in early prototyping, agentic coding workflows, technical review, or lightweight implementation support. * **Tools for Fast\-Moving Teams:** Develop software that improves how Fervo manages complex work across engineering, construction, project execution, documentation, scheduling, modeling, procurement, and operations. Identify where teams rely on manual processes, disconnected data, or inefficient tools, and build products that are simple, usable, and practical. Sit with users before and after launch, and create feedback loops that drive continuous product improvement. * **Build\-vs\-Buy Decisions:** Audit Fervo's current internal software stack and identify where existing tools are sufficient, where they need better integration, and where purpose\-built software would create meaningful leverage. Recommend build, buy, integrate, or retire decisions based on business value, implementation cost, maintainability, and long\-term scalability. Serve as Fervo's internal expert on the resource requirements and tradeoffs of developing software in\-house, avoiding both overbuilding and tolerating broken workflows. * **AI\-Enabled Workflows:** Partner with Fervo's AI and machine learning team to integrate internal data, models, and automation into the tools you build. Identify practical, high\-value opportunities for LLMs and agentic workflows to reduce repetitive manual work, including document parsing, report generation, data entry, workflow automation, and decision support. Use modern coding and AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate prototypin heduling software, enterprise applications (such as ERP), operational systems, or platform products * Experience in a startup, scale\-up, or small high\-ownership technical team * Experience working with or managing software engineers, contractors, or technical vendors * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar platforms * Experience integrating software with third\-party systems, APIs, databases, internal data platforms, or business applications * Experience supporting teams that manage complex operational workflows, such as construction, engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, infrastructure, or capital projects * Interest in eventually helping build and lead an internal software development team **Location** ------------ This role may be based in Fervo's Houston, TX or Oakland, CA office. Hybrid work is available. Some travel between Fervo offices and project sites may be encouraged. **Compensation** ---------------- Fervo provides a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, short\-term and long\-term disability, flexible paid time off, and paid parental leave. Additionally, Fervo offers an incentive stock options program, a bonus incentive program, and a 401(k) plan with an employer match. Fervo Energy is providing the compensation range and general description of other compensation and benefits that the company in good faith believes it might pay and/or offer for this position based on the successful applicant's education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities in addition to internal equity and geographic location. Expected Salary: $180,000 – $250,000 based on location and experience. Fervo Energy reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant's sex or other status protected by local, state, or federal law. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- * Fervo offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well\-being, and life outside of work. Benefits for eligible employees include: * Medical, dental, and vision plan options * Employer\-paid basic life insurance and short\-term and long\-term disability coverage * A 401(k) plan with up to 6% match * Flexible paid time off and paid parental leave * Family\-building, fertility, hormonal health, pregnancy, postpartum, and parenting support through Carrot * A dependent care FSA for eligible child and elder care expenses * An annual Lifestyle Spending Account for eligible wellness expenses, including fitness, financial planning, pet insurance, and pet care * Employee ownership opportunities through Fervo's Employee Stock Purchase Program, as well as LTI and bonus opportunities for eligible roles Benefits and programs are subject to eligibility requirements and may change. **Our Workplace** ----------------- Fervo Energy highly values having employees work in the office to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. This role follows a hybrid schedule, with team members expected to work in the office three days per week. Fervo considers this in\-office schedule an essential function of the role. Your recruiter can share more information about the schedule. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Fervo Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, gender, religion, marital status, registered domestic partner status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sex, genetic information, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local law. Fervo also prohibits discrimination based on the perception that an individual has any of these characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of these characteristics.

jobs.description: **Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.** ### **Job Description:** **Job Summary** Deliver on the vision of the business by developing, researching, and recommending appropriate models, methods, tools, and technologies to achieve business\-unit\-wide solutions. Contribute to technology strategy in partnership with stakeholders across the business. Design, build, and support runtime services, platforms, and applications that power AI\-enabled experiences at scale, and help identify and mitigate technical risks in the solutions you deliver. **The Role** You will be part of the team responsible for the creation and support of the Cognitive Computing Platform. This platform enables customers to interact with Fidelity in natural language across the channels that are important to them. You’ll help deliver reliable runtime services and operational practices that allow teams to run AI\-enabled solutions consistently and safely, including dynamic experiences rendered within conversational chat. **The Team** As part of the team, you will implement solutions that enable customers to get the most out of what Fidelity can offer. You will create intuitive and highly engaging conversational experiences that help digitally savvy customers take control of their finances and feel confident in the choices they make. **The Expertise You Have (Preferred Qualifications)** Broad experience across the full software development and delivery lifecycle, from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and ongoing support. * Strong engineering proficiency in Node.js and Python, with the ability to design and implement scalable, maintainable backend services. * * Experience building enterprise‑grade conversational and interactive UI components using REACT, vue frontend frameworks, along with hands‑on experience using front‑end testing frameworks like Jest, Cypress, or Playwright. Hands\-on experience working with NoSQL data stores such as MongoDB, DynamoDB, or ElastiCache, including data modeling and performance optimization. * Solid grounding in DevOps/SRE practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, reliability engineering, and building production systems with an operational mindset. * Proven experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, using Service‑Oriented Architecture, and applying strong Object‑Oriented Programming principles. * Familiarity with OpenAPI/Swagger and structured JSON‑based service contracts, including versioning and documentation best practices. * Practical experience working within Agile development methodologies, collaborating closely with cross‑functional teams to deliver iterative value. * * Exposure to major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), including hands\-on experience with cloud‑native services, deployment pipelines, and distributed architectures. **AI / GenAI Skills (Preferred)** * Working knowledge of LLM concepts (prompting patterns, token limits, latency considerations) * Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) fundamentals and embedding\-based search concepts * Model evaluation basics (quality, safety, and regression testing) using modern evaluation frameworks and benchmark datasets * Responsible AI practices (guardrails, privacy considerations, and secure usage patterns) * Operational awareness for GenAI solutions (cost, performance, reliability, and safe usage) * Understanding of observability for LLM\-based applications, including logging/metrics/tracing at the prompt and inference layers. **Education / Certifications (Helpful)** * Undergraduate degree (BS, BA, etc.) or equivalent work experience * Relevant cloud, DevOps/SRE, or AI/ML certifications are a plus **The Skills You Bring** * Strong desire and ability to learn new technologies and approaches * Ability to synthesize business needs into scalable technology solutions * Ability to work across organizations and drive positive outcomes * Comfort operating in a polyglot development environment * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * Ability to collaborate with data science and product teams to operationalize AI use cases **The Value You Deliver** * Build and deliver scalable solutions on a scrum team benefiting multiple business units * Work across an empowered and autonomous organization to achieve the best outcomes * Contribute to a developer culture of quality and sustainability through automation * Share knowledge and provide technical guidance to peers through code reviews and design discussions * Help teams operationalize GenAI solutions with attention to reliability, safety, and repeatability Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model Fidelity is transitioning to a full\-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles. ### **Certifications:** ### **Category:** Information Technology Please be advised that Fidelity’s business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement\-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self\-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. Those laws and regulations may restrict Fidelity from hiring and/or associating with individuals with certain Criminal Histories.

jobs.title: Web Application Developer
jobs.description: Job Overview Field Nimble developed web\-based and mobile field service management software designed to help small residential service contractors manage customers, scheduling, work orders, estimates, invoicing, and payments. The Web Application Developer role described below is a proposed job description, not a verified current vacancy. The developer would help build, maintain, and improve responsive web applications that simplify business workflows, improve usability, and support reliable data management. Key Responsibilities * Design, develop, test, and maintain responsive web applications. * Build user\-friendly interfaces and reusable front\-end components. * Develop server\-side functionality, APIs, and application integrations. * Work with databases to store, retrieve, and manage application data. * Improve application performance, accessibility, reliability, and security. * Troubleshoot bugs and resolve technical issues across browsers and devices. * Integrate third\-party services and business tools where required. * Collaborate with product, design, QA, and engineering team members. * Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. * Document application features, technical decisions, and development procedures. * Contribute to improvements in scheduling, customer management, work orders, and invoicing workflows. Required Skills * Experience developing and maintaining web applications. * Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. * Familiarity with a front\-end framework such as React, Angular, or Vue.js. * Understanding of server\-side development and REST APIs. * Experience working with relational databases and SQL. * Familiarity with Git and software development best practices. * Knowledge of responsive design, cross\-browser compatibility, and web security. * Strong debugging, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Preferred Skills * Experience with cloud\-hosted applications or software\-as\-a\-service platforms. * Familiarity with payment integrations, invoicing systems, or customer management software. * Experience improving application performance and accessibility. * Knowledge of automated testing and continuous integration/deployment. * Understanding of Agile development practices. * A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. About the Company Field Nimble was a Buffalo\-based software business that developed field service management tools for small contractors, particularly businesses in HVAC, plumbing, and electrical services. Its software supported customer management, scheduling, dispatching, estimates, work orders, invoicing, and payment processing. Public company records indicate that Field Nimble was acquired by Pointman in 2017\. Its current operating status and whether it independently hires employees should be verified before publishing this listing. Compensation and Employment Details The proposed salary range of **$75,000–$100,000 per year** is an estimate for drafting purposes only. It is not a confirmed Field Nimble salary range or an advertised offer. Confirm the current employer, active vacancy, work location, salary, benefits, and employment type before publishing this description. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Flexible schedule * Relocation assistance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness. Say hello to a rewarding career, and come join a leading provider of mission\-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands. **Job Description:** We are looking for a Software Engineer who will be responsible for adding new features, maintaining existing functionality, and providing support to First Advantage's key products. Working on this high\-volume, security intensive application, the Software Engineer will execute full life cycle software development and integrate components into a fully functional system, as well as develop software verification plans and quality assurance procedures. Additionally, they will document and maintain software functionality and tailor and deploy software tools, processes and metrics, and apply industry standards and best practices. * + **For compliance reasons, all personnel must be United States Citizens and have, for 3 of the past 5 years, resided in the United States OR worked for the United States overseas in a federal or military capacity OR be a dependent of a federal or military employee serving overseas. In addition to our standard pre\-employment background check and drug screen, you will be required to undergo additional checks to obtain an LAR certification via the the proper channels in order to be in this role.** **Key Responsibilities:** * Plan application design by clarifying goals; design functionality * Extend and improve software systems by implementing enhancements; monitor performance and results; identify and evaluate improvement options; introduce new technology * Update and extend code coverage unit testing and related automated software quality assurance * Design and apply standards and best practices to secure and protect systems from malicious and intentional misuse * Design, deploy, and manage cloud deployments using standardized tools, repeatable automated processes, and auditable accountability gates * Support production releases; fulfill client queries and identify bugs or enhancements in application * Update job knowledge, by participating in educational opportunities, reading professional publications, and/or participating in professional organization * Collaborate with and support teammates in the above **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent education or experienc * 3\+ years hands\-on experience in programming Microsoft C\# (preferred) or equivalent * 3\+ years hands\-on experience with relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server * Must be able to demonstrate competence with object\-oriented principles, design patterns, multi\-tiered architectures, and software development best practices * Experience in web API, RESTful API design, JSON, XML or other common standards, data structures and protocols commonly used in creating internet services * Experience with Vue.js (or equivalent frameworks) and TypeScript or JavaScript * Experience with Azure or AWS (or equivalent cloud platforms); working knowledge of security and scalability fundamentals * Ability to efficiently and effectively diagnose, debug, and resolve code issues * Methodical and tenacious approach to troubleshooting complex problems * Most importantly, the attitude to be a respectful and great communicator and collaborator **Preferred Qualifications:** * No\-SQL Databases (e.g. CosmosDB, MongoDB) * MVC, MVVM * Competent with MS Visual Studio, VSCode, and Git source control * Experience with Azure monitoring **Why First Advantage is Your Next Big Career Move** First Advantage is going through a technology transformation! We are looking for experts who are excited to work with advanced technologies and provide best\-in\-class user experiences, drive the development and deployment of scalable solutions, and smoothly guide our agile teams and clients through meaningful changes as we continue to expand our impact. **What Are You Waiting For? Apply Today!** You have learned a little about us today – we want to learn about you! If you think this position and our company are a great fit for your areas of interest and expertise, tell us about you by applying now! *The salary range for this position is approximately $110,000\-140,000 base annually. This range reflects our good faith estimate to pay fairly as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate’s experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process.* **We have great people here and are looking for more. Come join us!** Follow us: * Facebook * Instagram * LinkedIn * X * YouTube ***Equal Employment Opportunities at First Advantage*** *First Advantage is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a workplace and recruitment process that is free from unlawful discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. Employment decisions at First Advantage are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate in any aspect of employment on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, religion, creed, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or family status, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack TypeScript Developer
jobs.description: Description: \*\*Local candidates only.\*\* Applicants must currently live in the Phoenix metro area (Gilbert, Mesa, Chandler, Tempe, and surrounding Valley cities). Applications from outside the Valley, including out\-of\-state remote candidates, are automatically rejected. \#\# Location and In\-Person Expectations This is a remote position with regular in\-person time. We get together for team lunches, company updates and training, and ad hoc conference room sessions when a project benefits from whiteboarding it out together. Day to day work happens wherever you work best. \#\# About Us Five Guys Roofing is a well\-established roofing company dedicated to leveraging technology to improve the experience of both our customers and our employees. Our culture is deeply rooted in family values and a strong commitment to service. Some of what you build here reaches beyond Five Guys Roofing itself. Several companies operate under the same umbrella, and the systems we develop often serve more than one of them. \#\# How We Work We run with startup energy inside an established company. That means collaboration and iterative improvements are more important than chasing perfection: get a working version in front of the people who will use it, learn what breaks, and make it better. Ownership inspires the best ideas, so we work independently on most tasks and bring the team in for feedback along the way. Our mission is a sales and fulfillment experience that stays personal while using technology to put us a decade ahead of our industry. We live the company values of Family, Service, and Accountability by keeping our word on dates, saying things plainly, raising problems early, learning what customers actually need before we build, and investing in the platform we own. \#\# Position Overview We are looking for a senior full\-stack developer who is comfortable scoping, planning, and shipping projects with minimal supervision. You will join a small team of developers who are available for feedback and direction, but you will own your work end to end. We value well\-rounded people who manage their own time, set realistic deadlines and hit them, and can carry more than one project at a time. This is a senior role. You should be able to walk into an unfamiliar part of the codebase, figure out how it works, and make a good decision about what to do next. \#\# Key Responsibilities * Develop and maintain web applications using our tech stack. * Own projects from idea through deployment: scope the work, put a quick prototype in front of stakeholders, set delivery dates, and communicate clearly when something is at risk. * Ship early, gather feedback, and iterate rather than waiting for a perfect first release. * Collaborate with departments across the company to build tools that improve efficiency, automate repetitive work, and strengthen outreach. * Integrate third\-party services and APIs into our internal systems and customer\-facing experiences. * Manage the full software development lifecycle: testing, debugging, deploying, and supporting what you ship. * Communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical teammates, vendors, partners, and occasionally customers. * Evaluate emerging tools and technologies and recommend improvements that keep our stack modern and maintainable. \#\# Tech Stack Here is what you would be working in day to day: * \*\*TypeScript\*\* across the stack * \*\*Node.js\*\* (AdonisJS) * \*\*Svelte / SvelteKit\*\* * \*\*PostgreSQL\*\* * \*\*Tailwind CSS\*\* or vanilla CSS * \*\*Tauri\*\* for desktop and mobile app builds * \*\*Rust\*\* where performance optimization calls for it \#\# How We Use AI AI is part of how we work every day. We do not ship vibe\-coded slop. Every AI\-assisted change has a developer at the helm who understands it, reviews it, and is accountable for it. In practice, we use AI for: * \*\*Prototyping:\*\* every project scope includes a disposable, AI\-built prototype on fake data, so stakeholders react to something real and edge cases surface before we commit to a build * \*\*Planning:\*\* breaking approved scope into phases and executable tickets, and pressure\-testing approaches before we write code * \*\*Building with guardrails:\*\* shared skills and custom MCP tools connect our AI to our own systems and build our team conventions right in, so consistency is automatic * \*\*Verification and QA:\*\* test coverage, edge case hunting, and reviewing our own work critically * \*\*Triage:\*\* working from real bug reports, logs, and error tracking to get to a root cause faster * \*\*Documentation:\*\* turning meeting notes into tickets and keeping internal docs and Linear accurate and current * \*\*In the product:\*\* AI also ships inside what we build, such as call transcription, summaries, and quality scoring The skill we care about is judgment: knowing when to reach for AI and how to use it well, and recognizing when your own experience points to a simpler solution. \#\# Recent Projects * A cloud phone system built in\-house, including a browser\-based softphone with call transfers, parking, and CRM lookup * AI\-powered call intelligence: transcription, summarization, and quality scoring for customer calls * A field capture and inspections system that turns photos and notes into branded customer reports * Consolidated four company applications onto one shared multi\-tenant platform * Storm mapping that matches hail, wind, and rain data to our job locations, with storm history for every property we serve \#\# Projects On Deck * A multi\-company, multi\-warehouse inventory system * A customer portal for homeowners and property managers, expanding phase by phase * Our own roofing CRM, replacing an off\-the\-shelf system and tying together calls, texts, email, estimates, and property records * A native mobile app for our phone system * A training and documentation platform (LMS) for onboarding and ongoing education If you enjoy building real tools that people use every day, and you want to do it inside a family\-oriented company that actually invests in technology, we would love to hear from you. Requirements: \*\*Local candidates only.\*\* You must currently live in the Phoenix metro area (Gilbert, Mesa, Chandler, Tempe, and surrounding Valley cities). Applications from outside the Valley are automatically rejected. \#\# Location Remote, with regular in\-person time for team lunches, company updates and training, and occasional project working sessions. \#\# Salary Range $100,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications. \#\# Tech Stack * \*\*TypeScript\*\* across the stack * \*\*Node.js\*\* (AdonisJS) * \*\*Svelte / SvelteKit\*\* * \*\*PostgreSQL\*\* * \*\*Tailwind CSS\*\* or vanilla CSS * \*\*Tauri\*\* for desktop and mobile app builds * \*\*Rust\*\* where performance optimization calls for it We don't expect anyone to be familiar with this whole stack on day one. Deep experience in a comparable stack, plus the ability to pick up the rest quickly, matters far more than exact prior experience. \#\# Qualifications * 6\+ years of professional software development experience * Strong proficiency in both front\-end and back\-end development * Solid grasp of the software development lifecycle, testing methodology, and debugging techniques * Track record of owning projects independently, committing to delivery dates, and meeting them * Comfort shipping a working first version and iterating on real feedback * Comfort working with AI tooling as a force multiplier rather than a replacement for understanding * Excellent communication skills: tailoring a message to the audience, collaborating closely with the team, sharing ideas openly, and speaking up early when problems arise * A growth mindset and genuine curiosity about how things work * Bonus: experience with CI/CD pipelines, marketing technology, CRM integrations, telephony, or the roofing industry \#\# Hiring Process * \*\*Round 1:\*\* a 30\-minute virtual screen. * \*\*Round 2:\*\* for candidates who advance, an in\-person interview with the team. It includes a challenge question to see how you plan, collaborate, and execute on a project. \#\# Additional Information A college degree is not required. Demonstrated experience and a commitment to continuous learning matter far more to us. In rare cases of system failure or emergency, we need someone willing to address the issue promptly, including on a weekend.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect
jobs.description: From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data\-driven. **About Us** Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry\-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. **About the Role** We're looking to hire a Solutions Engineer, Enterprise to join our Field Engineering team. As a Solutions Architect, you will be a trusted technical advisor to some of our largest and most strategic customers, helping them evaluate, adopt, and expand their use of dbt. You'll partner closely with Sales to understand customers' technical and business priorities, design solutions using the dbt platform, and demonstrate measurable value throughout the evaluation process. You'll work across the customer lifecycle—from technical discovery and evaluation through adoption and expansion—while partnering with Product, Engineering, and our technology partners to bring customer needs back into the business. This is a full\-time position based in the New York City metro area. **Technologies You'll Use** SQL, dbt, cloud data warehouses and lakehouses including Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery, AWS, jobs.title: Software Engineer, Networking
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ London; Austin, TX; New York, NY; Seattle, WA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Department** -------------- Production Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $173K – $279K • Offers Equity *To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US\-based job postings. Our compensation package includes base salary, equity for all full time roles, benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans.* *This range reflects a good\-faith estimate based on the applicable pay scale, the range previously established for this role, the compensation of individuals currently in equivalent positions, and/or the budgeted amount for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, and other factors.* *We welcome compensation discussions if this range doesn't meet your requirements. Outstanding candidates may be eligible for adjusted terms, plus meaningful equity that ensures you benefit directly from the company's long\-term performance.* *Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.* **About Fluidstack** ==================== We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built \- but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them \- with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization\-scale infrastructure for AI. **We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!** **How We Operate** ================== * **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. * **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible. * **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. * **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. * **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. **The Production Engineering Team** =================================== **Examples of key exciting problems the team is working on** * **Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket:** link diagnostics across router\-router and NIC\-to\-router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows exactly what's broken and why. At this scale, debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal. * **Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself:** from automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host\-to\-network layers. When a new site comes online every six months, manual repair doesn't keep up. * **Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing:** define requirements, alerting lifecycle, and health dashboards from scratch, for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s to 100s of GWs ahead. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it. **Role Scope** ============== * **Own network fleet health end to end.** Define the realtime monitoring requirements, build the alerting lifecycle, and ship the dashboards that give every on\-call engineer a true picture of network state across all sites. * **Build active debugging tooling.** Link diagnostics, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization — the tools that turn a network fault from a mystery into a solvable problem, fast. * **Turn repair into a pipeline, not a procedure.** Build the automation that takes a network failure from detection through parts management and return to service. Ticket integration, repair lifecycle pipelines, transceiver and optics tracking — owned, not improvised. * **Own network qualification and validation**. Build the frameworks that gate new sites and hardware into production. You define what a healthy network looks like before it carries traffic. * **Own end\-to\-end reliability, scalability, and operation of the network at\-scale.** Fluidstack is building one of the largest datacenter networks in the world and that can only be accomplished with aggressive automation, tooling, and incident discipline. **What We're Looking For** ========================== **The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly,** **tell us where you would.** * You treat toil as a bug. If diagnosing a link failure requires SSHing into boxes and running commands by hand, you build the tool that does it for you. * You think in systems. You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each propagate differently — and you build tooling that can tell them apart. * You move toward ambiguity, not away from it. You walk into the fog, build the map, and explain it to everyone else. * You learn at a steep slope. You reach real competence in an unfamiliar domain fast. We value this over existing expertise. * You carry a pager without flinching. You run the incident, write the postmortem, fix the systemic cause, and move on. * You're fluent with AI tooling. LLM APIs, MCP servers, and agentic frameworks, and you drive Claude Code, Cursor, or similar every day. * You've shipped production network tooling or automation that other teams depend on, and you're comfortable in any language using AI coding tools. * You’ve developed automation tools in Go and Python, are experienced in link diagnostics, optical networks, and understanding network monitoring (gNMI, gRPC, NETCONF, SONiC) * **Bonus:** RMA and repair lifecycle automation. Large\-scale datacenter fabric (BGP, ECMP, spine\-leaf). Out\-of\-band network management. **Salary \& Benefits** ====================== * Competitive total compensation package (salary \+ equity). * Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms. * Health, dental, and vision insurance. * Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms. We are committed to pay equity and transparency. Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law. *You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you* ***did not*** *receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application\- someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.* Compensation Range: $173K \- $279K

jobs.title: Director of Growth, US - AI Consulting
jobs.description: Focusteck, LLC is a 13\-year\-old software and AI consulting firm that builds AI agents, automation, and AI\-enabled custom software for mid\-market companies. We are a member of Anthropic's Claude Partner Network, and our engineers hold Claude certifications. We also deliver data, cloud/DevOps, Odoo and Salesforce consulting, with deep domain experience in SaaS, healthtech, and ecommerce. US mid\-market companies are asking the same question right now: how do we actually put AI to work? We have the delivery team to answer it. We need a US\-based hunter to put us in the room. **Why this role exists:** You will be the first dedicated US sales hire, own the US market end to end, and help take Focusteck to $1M\+ in ARR. You get the upside of a founding seller, with an experienced delivery team behind every deal you close. What you'll do Your mandate is simple: build a repeatable US pipeline and close new AI consulting revenue. **Build and close pipeline** * Own the full sales cycle for US accounts: prospecting, discovery, scoping, proposal, negotiation, and close. * Sell AI enablement, AI agents, workflow automation, and custom AI software to mid\-market companies (50 to 2,000 employees). * Land entry offers, such as fixed\-scope pilots and AI readiness workshops, then expand them into multi\-month delivery programs and retainers. * Run outbound across LinkedIn, email, phone, and your own network; target 15 to 20 qualified discovery meetings per month. **Open partner and referral channels** * Build relationships with private equity firms, fractional CTOs, and advisors who can open doors to multiple portfolio or client companies at once. * Co\-sell with technology partners, including the Claude Partner Network ecosystem. * Represent Focusteck at US industry events, meetups, and conferences. **Shape the go\-to\-market** * Turn client conversations into sharper offers, pricing, and case studies, working directly with the CEO. * Partner with our solution architects on discovery calls, demos, and proposals so every deal is scoped to deliver. * Hand off cleanly to delivery and stay close to accounts to drive renewals, expansions, and referrals. **Run a disciplined pipeline** * Keep CRM data current and forecast accurately every week. * Hit quarterly targets for pipeline created, new logos, and booked revenue. Who you are **Must\-haves** * 5\+ years of B2B sales in IT services, software consulting, or professional services, with at least 3 years in a quota\-carrying closing role. * A record of closing services deals of $50K to $500K\+ with mid\-market or enterprise buyers. * Hands\-on experience selling AI, data, cloud, or digital transformation services within the last 2 years. * An active US network of CTOs, COOs, VPs of Operations, or IT leaders you can call this quarter. * Comfort selling consultatively: you can map a buyer's workflow and find where AI saves time or money. * Self\-directed and entrepreneurial; you build your own pipeline without an SDR team. * Based in the US and authorized to work there. **Nice to have** * Experience selling for an offshore or nearshore delivery firm. * Relationships with private equity operating partners or portfolio companies. * Background in healthtech, SaaS, ecommerce, or financial services. * Familiarity with LLM platforms such as Claude, and with agentic AI use cases. Compensation This is a commission\-led role built for closers: a modest base, uncapped commission, and accelerators above plan. Target first\-year earnings at plan are $150K to $200K, with no ceiling. Component Details Base salary $30K to $40K per year New\-logo commission 15% of first\-year collected revenue Expansion and renewal commission 5% of collected revenue on existing accounts Accelerator 20% on new\-logo revenue above 100% of annual quota Partner\-sourced deals 3\.5% referral on deals opened through partners you recruit Annual quota $1\.5M in booked services revenue (ramped during the first 6 months) Ramp Non\-recoverable draw of $1\.5K per month for the first 6 months Payout Monthly, on cash collected Commission is uncapped. Top performers will have a path to Head of US Sales, with a team to build. Why join * **Sell what buyers are asking for.** AI enablement is the top priority for most mid\-market leadership teams right now. * **Proven delivery behind you.** 13 years of shipped projects, a certified Claude team, and solution architects on your calls. * **Founding\-seller upside.** Uncapped earnings, direct access to the CEO, and a real say in offers and pricing. * **Competitive pricing.** A global delivery model lets you win on value against larger US consultancies. * **Remote and flexible.** Work from anywhere in the US and run your own calendar. Pay: $30,000\.00 \- $40,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Paid time off Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: AI & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: The **AI \& Automation Engineer** is a hands\-on technical role responsible for designing, building, deploying, and supporting AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities, and automation solutions on Company\-approved AI platforms. The position transforms prioritized use cases into secure, supportable production solutions, develops reusable patterns and knowledge layers, and serves as the primary technical builder for the Company's AI and automation programs under the direction of the Senior Manager of Infrastructure and AI. **This position will require regular (every week) in\-person attendance at one of our Foley Equipment offices with a partial week work\-from\-home opportunity. At this time, fully\-remote is not available. Kansas City or Park City preferred.** **What you will do:****Solution Design and Development*** Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Foundry (topics, actions, tools, connected agents, knowledge sources) and publish them to approved channels such as Microsoft Teams. * Build the Power Platform components behind AI use cases: Power Automate flows, Dataverse data models and security roles, model\-driven and canvas apps, AI Builder prompts, and Adaptive Card review experiences in Teams. * Integrate agents and flows with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, data platform, Microsoft 365\) using connectors, REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool connections. * Move prototypes into production through environment strategy, solution packaging and application lifecycle management (ALM), publishing, and release validation. Assist with evaluating the cost of proposed solutions. * Write supporting code (Python, PowerShell, C\#, or JSON) where low\-code tooling falls short and use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and legacy code modernization. **AI Platform and Knowledge Engineering*** Deploy and manage Azure AI Foundry projects, model deployments, and agents using Company\-owned Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Cosmos DB so source data and vector indexes remain within the Company's tenant. * Build retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines (ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, vector and hybrid search) as reusable knowledge and context layers shared by multiple agents and automations. * Configure network isolation and identity for AI workloads, including private endpoints, private DNS, managed identities, and role\-based access control (RBAC), and troubleshoot connectivity and authorization failures across platform boundaries. * Write system prompts and agent instructions, implements tool calling and orchestration, and run evaluations (test sets, groundedness and accuracy checks, regression tests) before and after each release. **Security, Governance, and Responsible AI*** Build every solution in accordance with Company security and data protection requirements, including least\-privilege identities, scoped security roles, Entra ID app registrations, Power Platform data loss prevention (DLP) policies, sensitivity label requirements, and vendor and customer confidentiality obligations. * Verify each agent’s authentication model, including end\-user, maker, and agent\-author credentials, to ensure the agent returns only information the requesting user is authorized to access. Apply content\-safety controls, input and output validation, and human review for consequential actions. * Support the AI intake and review process with technical assessments, help identify and remediate unsanctioned AI usage, and support Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness, including permissions and oversharing remediation. **Operations, Support, and Enablement*** Monitor delivered solutions for accuracy, performance, usage, security, cost, and continued fit with the business need; track licensing, token, credit, and capacity consumption and recommended actions to control spend. * Provide third\-tier support and root\-cause analysis for production AI and automation solutions, including occasional after\-hours work for urgent issues or production automation failures. * Maintain documentation for each solution (business owner, purpose, architecture, data sources, access model, prompts, testing notes, support owner, change history, retirement criteria) and follow Company change, release, and lifecycle practices. * Deliver demos and technical training on approved AI tools, mentor citizen developers and IT colleagues on approved patterns and review their work for security and supportability before production. * Communicate the status, risks, dependencies, and expected business value of assigned use cases to the Senior Manager of Infrastructure and AI and business stakeholders. **Our ideal candidate:*** Strong understanding of generative AI, AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, automation, low\-code/no\-code development, and practical business process improvement. * Hands\-on experience with Micr ate, Power Apps, Dataverse, AI Builder), Fabric, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. * Working knowledge of Azure networking, Entra ID, managed identities, and role\-based access control as they apply to AI workloads. * Proficiency in at least one language (Python, PowerShell, C\#, or TypeScript), REST APIs, JSON, and Git. * Strong knowledge of data privacy, security, access controls, responsible AI practices, and change management. * Ability to diagnose problems across platform boundaries using logs, run histories, and vendor documentation, and to explain technical designs in plain language to leaders at all levels. * Must be well\-organized, practical, collaborative, and pay close attention to detail. * Ability to drive and valid driver’s license required. **Education and Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, or a related field is required. * Three years of proven experience in application development, automation, data, or related information technology work, including one year of experience building and deploying production generative AI solutions such as agents, RAG solutions, or LLM\-based automations. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure AI Foundry required. * Experience with Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, and ERP or CRM integration (Dynamics 365 or similar) preferred. * Microsoft AI\-102, PL\-400, or AZ\-204 certification preferred. **Physical Demands** (The physical demands described here must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.) Regularly required to sit, see, speak and hear —frequent and regular use of hands and fingers to handle or feel. Recurring close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Constantly use hands and fingers to perform computer keyboard work. The ability to drive, and availability and capability to travel for business purposes. **Work Environment** (The work environment characteristics described here represent those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.) Perform most of the work in a relaxed environment but may be exposed to outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Encounter different temperatures while driving and getting in and out of a vehicle. Encounter different climates when traveling. **What We Can Offer You:*** Competitive pay to recognize your valuable contribution * 401(k) with matching * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans * Basic Life \& AD\&D, short\-term disability, \& and long\-term disability * Wellness programs to focus on building healthy habits while earning prizes and cash bonuses throughout the year * Holiday, PTO, and Parental Leave, promoting work\-life balance and personal growth * Casual dress attire * Family\-owned company where you’re more than just another employee Foley Industries – Foley Equipment, Foley Power Solutions, Foley Rental, and SITECH Central – proudly stands at the forefront of progress, serving customers in Kansas and Western Missouri for over nine decades. With a dedicated team of over 1,000 employees, we are committed to delivering exceptional service, top\-quality parts and rentals, and unparalleled sales support across a comprehensive range of Caterpillar and allied construction equipment, power generation solutions, and cutting\-edge SITECH construction technology. As we continue to empower our customers' success, we invite you to explore the endless opportunities that await you at Foley. To learn more about our company and join our team of industry leaders, please visit www.FoleyEq.com.* *At this time Foley does not participate in any Visa sponsorship programs.*

jobs.title: Controls Engineer, Ford Energy
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: On\-site Ford Energy is a newly formed, wholly\-owned subsidiary of Ford Motor Company dedicated to accelerating U.S. energy independence. Leveraging Ford’s century of manufacturing excellence and world\-class battery energy storage systems (BESS) technology, Ford Energy designs, manufactures, and services grid\-scale and commercial DC battery energy storage systems (BESS). Ford Energy is uniquely positioned to capture the growing demand for reliable, US\-built energy storage systems. We are not just building batteries; we are building the infrastructure for the next generation of the American grid. Why Ford Energy? At Ford Energy, you have the backing of an industrial manufacturing powerhouse with the agility of a dedicated energy startup offering industry leading technology. We offer a competitive compensation package including performance\-based bonuses, Ford vehicle discounts, and the opportunity to shape the energy strategy of one of the world's most iconic brands. **In this position...** As a Controls Engineer, you will be on the ground floor launching a state\-of\-the\-art BESS manufacturing facility in Glendale, Kentucky. As a key member of our start\-up team, you will have a once\-in\-a\-lifetime opportunity to help build and program the automated systems that bring next\-generation energy storage products to the grid. In this critical role, you will: **Optimize with Precision:** Provide technical expertise to optimize highly automated manufacturing equipment and processes through visual systems, automation, and advanced levels of process control. **Innovate:** Apply an entrepreneurial mindset to deliver data\-driven controls solutions for battery cell and BESS module/container manufacturing lines. **Drive Excellence:** Be the go\-to technical expert for automation reliability, ensuring the facility operates with the precision required to deliver world\-class energy products. **What you'll do...** **Operational Excellence – Controls \& Automation** * Program, modify, and troubleshoot machinery utilizing Siemens (SP700\), Omron, or other PLC programming software and HMI screens. * Manage the interaction between servo systems, frequency conversion systems, and upper\-level computers;
