jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer (Lead)
jobs.description: **Senior Platform Engineer (Lead)** *AWS landing zone and Kubernetes platform for a HIPAA\-regulated public\-health data* platform · *Hybrid, Salt Lake City, Utah* We're looking for a senior platform engineer to build, from the first line of code, the AWS platform that will carry rural health data, and then run it in production. You'll own the landing zone and Kubernetes platform behind the project, a cloud\-based, open\-source semantic data model. The project will harmonize EHR, claims and public\-health data into one computable form and serves it through FHIR APIs. The platform holds protected health information. It is held to NIST SP 800\-53 moderate controls and the HIPAA Security Rule, with 99\.9% availability, a 15\-minute RPO, a 4\-hour RTO and a seven\-year tamper\-evident audit log. You'll build it alongside a dedicated team, and by the end of the term the whole environment must be rebuildable from code and ready to hand to the State. **THE ROLE AT A GLANCE** **Engagement** 1099 independent contractor; you work as part of HK's team **Term** November 2026 through September 2027; extensions for multiple years are possible, subject to performance and other variables **Commitment** Full time, 40 hours a week **Reports to** HK's Software/Development Director, with architecture direction from the program architect and security direction from the HIPAA Security Officer **Location** Hybrid, Salt Lake City, Utah; core hours 9:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m. Mountain; you must currently live in the U.S. and be able to travel to Salt Lake City approximately 25% of the time **Requirements** U.S. work authorization without sponsorship; current U.S. residence; identity verification with government\-issued photo ID, confirmed in person at the final interview; background check before any system access; HIPAA training before any access **Stack** AWS (us\-west\-2, DR in us\-east\-2\), EKS on Bottlerocket, Aurora PostgreSQL, MSK, S3 Object Lock, Keycloak, OpenSearch, OpenTofu, GitOps **WHAT YOU'LL DO** You take the platform from the first OpenTofu module to a production environment with a warm DR standby by spring, and you're the person who can rebuild it all from code. * **Build the AWS Organization as code:** separate accounts for management, security, log archive, sandbox, test, staging and production, plus OUs, IAM Identity Center with MFA, and organization\-wide CloudTrail and Config. * **Design the network:** private\-only VPCs across three AZs, egress inspected through Network Firewall, Transit Gateway, VPC endpoints, and Client VPN. You'll also set the partner connectivity patterns (site\-to\-site VPN, PrivateLink, mTLS with a private CA). * **Run Amazon EKS:** private endpoint, Bottlerocket nodes with Karpenter, pod security standards, Cilium network policies, upgrades, and capacity and cost tuning for Kafka and Spark. * **Operate the data services:** Aurora PostgreSQL (TLS, PITR, Global Database), MSK, S3 zones with Object Lock and cross\-region replication, ECR, Secrets Manager and AWS Backup, plus Keycloak, Prometheus and OpenTelemetry on the cluster. * **Own the delivery pipeline:** GitHub Actions with OIDC to AWS, OpenTofu plan and apply with policy gates, Argo CD, Helm conventions and Kyverno admission. Shipping should be easy for every engineering team on the program. * **Keep it** running: write the runbooks, lead the monthly restore drill and the annual cold\-rebuild test, take on\-call for severity\-1 platform incidents (15\-minute acknowledgment), and run post\-incident reviews. * **Report and hand over:** report monthly on availability, capacity and tagged AWS spend. You'll prove portability on open\-source equivalents (MinIO, Nessie, self\-managed PostgreSQL) and hand the platform to the State's team with documentation they can run it from. * **Lead:** guide a second platform engineer day to day and review the team's infrastructure changes. You'll be able to cover each other's on\-call. **YOUR FIRST 30 DAYS** The first three weeks are the critical path for the whole program. You'll pair with the Engineering team to stand up the landing zone, then hand it to the application teams. **Week** **What success looks like** **Week 1** Organization, accounts, SCPs, org\-wide logging and security services live; KMS key plan applied **Week 2** Sandbox VPC, EKS, Aurora, MSK, S3, ECR and Keycloak provisioned from code; Client VPN working **Week 3** OpenSearch SIEM baseline, CI/CD with signing and policy gates, Argo CD syncing, cost budgets and tags; platform handed to engineering **Week 4** Test environment built from the same modules; first partner connectivity pattern documented; first monthly cost report **WHAT YOU BRING** * **7\+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering, including 4\+ years running production Kubernetes on AWS (EKS strongly preferred).** * **Experience** operating a regulated workload (HIPAA, FedRAMP, PCI) and the ability to explain what the regulation changed about the design in healthcare\-specific environments. * Deep Terraform or OpenTofu: multi\-account organizations, modules, remote state, and policy as code (OPA, Checkov or tfsec). You've built an AWS Organization from zero before. * Hands\-on with VPC design, Transit Gateway, Network Firewall, PrivateLink, IAM Identity Center, KMS, Aurora PostgreSQL, MSK or Kafka, S3 Object Lock, ECR and AWS Backup. * GitOps and CI: Argo CD or Flux, Helm, GitHub Actions, container image signing and SBOMs. * Observability: Prometheus and Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and log shipping to OpenSearch or Elasticsearch. * You write clear runbooks and ADRs, and you're comfortable leading and reviewing the work of one or two engineers. **NICE TO HAVE** * Karpenter and Bottlerocket in production; Cilium or Calico network policy. * Spark on Kubernetes and Iceberg tables; Strimzi or MSK operations at scale. * Keycloak or another OIDC provider; Kyverno or Gatekeeper. * AWS Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer Professional; CKA or CKS. * Public\-sector or healthcare delivery, and experience handing a platform over to a client team. **HOW WE HIRE** This role has production access to protected health information, so we verify every candidate carefully. These steps also protect you from recruiting scams that impersonate real employers. * Video interviews are live with cameras on. The technical interview is a live session, no take home components. * Finalists meet the team in person in Salt Lake City before any offer. * Before the contract is signed, we verify your identity with government\-issued photo ID (checked in person), confirm your W\-9 taxpayer information with the IRS, and verify your U.S. address, work history, and references. * We'll never ask you for money, equipment purchases, or banking details during the hiring process. * We only contact candidates from an @hkconsulting.com email address. If someone reaches out about this role from any other address, please don't respond.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Machine Learning Engineer** ==================================== **Location:** San Francisco or remote · Full\-time **About us** ------------ Hum’s mission is to learn how the Earth changes by building a “world model for the entire world”: one that represents the dynamics of Earth processes, forecasts what a place looks like next, and makes that understanding useful. Founded at the University of Waterloo and backed by top investors like HF0, Climactic, Onto Ventures and angels from Firebase and OpenTable, we are a small team working on some of the largest unsolved problems. **The role** ------------ As our Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you'll own the software and infrastructure that trains and serves our models, so our research scientists can stay focused on the models themselves. The rest of our engineering team is building the pipelines that ingest petabytes of earth observation and remote sensing data, and an agent that uses that data and our models to answer customer questions. You'll own everything in between, the path from ingested data into training, the systems that run experiments and large\-scale training, and the inference path that delivers model outputs to the agent. You'll work closely with those engineers to fit all the pieces together, and with our AI research scientists to make the models they dream up trainable, measurable, and servable at scale, from the first small experiment through full training runs. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own the ML platform.** Build and run the systems for experiment tracking, distributed training at scale, and serving inference, and keep them fast, reliable, and reproducible. * **Collaborate on the interfaces.** Work with our engineers and scientists to define and maintain the boundaries between data and training, data and inference, and inference and the agent. * **Enable multimodal training.** Build the data and model plumbing that lets us train on many sensors, observation types, and text in one model. * **Go from small to large.** Help our scientists prove ideas in fast, cheap experiments, then scale the winners to petabyte\-scale training runs. * **Make evaluation real.** Implement and improve our benchmarks and evaluation frameworks, both internal and user\-facing. * **Watch the meter.** Measure and optimize the cost and wall\-clock time of experiments, training, and inference. * **Support the agent.** Work with the product team on how the agent calls the model and consumes its outputs, and build the integration. **Requirements** ---------------- * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of relevant industry experience, including hands\-on machine learning engineering. * Proficiency building distributed, multi\-node training pipelines in PyTorch and Lightning. * Experience with AWS or another cloud platform, particularly the tooling for training and serving medium\-to\-large models. * Strong software engineering fundamentals: you write production\-quality Python and care about reliability, observability, and cost. * Fluent with modern agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) and current on how to use them well. **Bonus** --------- * Experience training large diffusion or transformer models, ideally on video or time\-series data. * Experience with multimodal or spatiotemporal data, geospatial data, or geoscience problems. * Experience serving models in production and integrating them with downstream applications or agents. * Startup experience, comfortable with a small, fast\-moving team. **Why us?** ----------- * **Work that matters for the planet.** Our customers in nature conservation, carbon removal, and government use our models to protect ecosystems and respond to a changing climate. We take positive impact seriously, including safety and guardrails, and you'll help us get it right. * **A team worth joining.** Founded at the University of Waterloo by PhDs and engineers who've built and shipped at scale, we're small, technical, and collaborative. You'll work alongside people who care about the problem as much as you do. * **Well backed.** $10M\+ raised from HF0, Inovia Capital, and Propeller Ventures, angels including the cofounders of Firebase and OpenTable, and partners like AWS and the United Nations. * **Compensation and upside.** Competitive salary, meaningful early\-stage equity, health, dental and vision. As one of the first AI hires, your equity stake reflects that.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer, Vehicle Controls
jobs.description: **About Harbinger** Harbinger is an American commercial electric vehicle (EV) company on a mission to transform an industry starving for innovation. Harbinger's best\-in\-class team of EV, battery, and drivetrain experts have pooled their deep experience to bring a first\-of\-its\-kind EV platform to support the growing demand for medium\-duty EVs and Hybrids. Harbinger: Familiar Form, Revolutionary Foundation. ### **Role Overview** Harbinger is looking for a Controls Engineer to join our Vehicle Controls team and help develop, validate, and debug the control algorithms that run our medium\-duty EV and hybrid platforms. Working primarily on supervisory controls (vehicle state management, powertrain and energy management, torque arbitration, and fault handling), you will turn system requirements into production\-quality Simulink/Stateflow models, verify them through model\-in\-the\-loop (MIL) testing, and debug them on real vehicles using CAN data. You will also support other control domains as program needs evolve. You will work closely with systems, EE, and vehicle test teams, and your work will directly shape how our vehicles drive, protect themselves, and perform for fleet customers. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, maintain, and improve control algorithms in MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow, with a primary focus on vehicle supervisory controls (vehicle state machine, charging controls, thermal management, drive modes, torque request and arbitration, energy management, and diagnostics/fault reactions). * Write, review, and refine software requirements derived from system\-level requirements; maintain traceability between requirements, models, and test cases. * Develop and execute model\-in\-the\-loop (MIL) test cases and test harnesses; analyze results, report coverage, and drive issues to closure. * Develop and maintain CI pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) that automate model checks, code generation, and regression testing. * Generate production code from models and review the generated C code to support integration with the embedded software team. * Develop and integrate OBD/UDS diagnostic functions, including DTC definition, fault detection and debounce, fault reactions, and DIDs; maintain diagnostic definitions in CDD/ODX and verify them on bench and vehicle using Vector tools. * Calibrate, tune control parameters and debug control behavior on bench, HIL, and vehicle by capturing and analyzing CAN logs with Vector tools (CANalyzer, CANape, vSignalyzer). * Perform root\-cause analysis on issues found in vehicle testing and in customer fleets using field data and logs, and implement and verify fixes in the model. * Participate in hands\-on vehicle testing at test sites and customer locations, including occasional travel. * Support model reviews, modeling guideline checks (e.g., MAB/MISRA\-style guidelines), and configuration management of models and test artifacts. * Collaborate with systems, calibration, embedded software, and vehicle test engineers to define interfaces (signals, CAN messages) and support vehicle integration and validation activities. * Support other control domains beyond supervisory controls (e.g., chassis, body, and auxiliary systems ) as program needs require. ### **Required Skills \& Experience** * 2\-5 years of experience developing automotive or vehicle control software using model\-based design. * Strong hands\-on proficiency in MATLAB, Simulink, and Stateflow for control algorithm development and debugging. * Experience applying control theory techniques such as PID control, LQR/optimal control, and Kalman filtering/state estimation to real systems. * Experience writing software requirements and developing and executing MIL test cases. * Working knowledge of C, including the ability to read and debug auto\-generated or hand\-written embedded code. * Experience with CAN communication and analyzing CAN logs using Vector tools such as CANalyzer, CANape, and/or vSignalyzer, including working with DBC files. * Experience calibrating control parameters on bench or vehicle (e.g., CANape with XCP and A2L files). * Solid understanding of control systems fundamentals and vehicle systems (powertrain, high\-voltage battery, inverter/motor, or vehicle state management). * Experience with version control (e.g., Git) and working in a structured software development process. * Comfortable working hands\-on with vehicles and safely around high\-voltage systems (HV safety training provided). * Valid driver's license and willingness to travel occasionally to test sites and customer locations. * Strong problem\-solving, debugging, and communication skills; comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment. * Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer, Mechatronics, or Controls Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with EV or hybrid vehicle supervisory controls, energy management, or powertrain controls. * Experie ), including integrating model\-generated code as AUTOSAR software components. * Experience with Embedded Coder, Simulink Test,, Model Advisor, or Polyspace, and with SIL/HIL testing (e.g., dSPACE, NI, Vector VT System). * Experience building CI pipelines for model\-based development (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, MATLAB CI/CD tools). * Familiarity with EV charging standards (SAE J1772, CCS, ISO 15118\). * Familiarity with ISO 26262 functional safety and ASPICE. * Experience with requirements management tools (e.g., Jama, Polarion, DOORS) and scripting for data analysis or test automation (MATLAB scripting, Python, CAPL). * Experience analyzing field or fleet data to resolve customer issues. * Master's degree in Controls, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. **Equal Opportunity** Harbinger is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. Harbinger is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at info@harbingermotors.com. **Candidate Data Privacy** Harbinger may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes ("Candidate Personal Data"). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Harbinger may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law. Harbinger may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our HR, legal, and finance teams, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Harbinger affiliates; and (iii) Harbinger's service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services. Harbinger may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions. Please note that we are currently not accepting applications from third party application services. Any unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles submitted in response to our job posting shall be considered the property of Harbinger and are not subject to payment of referral or placement fees if any such candidate is later hired by Harbinger unless you have a signed written agreement in place with us which covers the applicable job posting.

Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 25 pounds of force frequently, and/or 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. * The individual in this position will periodically walk, kneel, sit, crouch, reach, stoop, read/see, speak, push, pull, lift, stand, and finger/type. The frequency of each action varies by workflow and office activity. * Walking \- The person in this position needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, boxes, cabinets, etc. * Constantly operates a computer and other office machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, phone, computer, and computer printer. * The person in this position frequently communicates with employees and external stakeholders regarding a variety of topics related to office administration. * Constantly computes, analyzes, and conceptualizes mathematical calculations and formulas. * The person in this position regularly sits in a stationary position in front of a computer screen. * Constantly reads written communications and views mail submissions. Salaried positions (project engineers and above) participate in an annual bonus plan, subject to company and employee performance. Salaried employees (this is all salaried employees) are also eligible for a company cell phone or cell phone allowance in accordance with company policy. Further, salaried employees (project engineers and above) also receive either a vehicle or vehicle allowance in accordance with Hensel Phelps’ policies. Based on position location, a cost of living adjustment (COLA) may also be included (subject to periodic review and adjustment). **Equal Opportunity Employer Statement** ---------------------------------------- Hensel Phelps is an equal opportunity employer. Hensel Phelps is committed to engaging in affirmative action to increase employment opportunities for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Hensel Phelps shall not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, domestic partner status, pregnancy, disability, citizenship, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Our expert development, construction and facility services teams ensure that every project meets our clients’ goals and objectives. Over our 84\-year history, Hensel Phelps has evolved from a bid\-build general contractor to a full\-service building provider. **Our organization is comprised of three lines of business – development, construction, and facility services.** These groups work as a cohesive team, sharing ideas and knowledge from each discipline to provide our clients with the highest level of service. Our capabilities span from concept through the long\-term facilities management of projects, which means that our focus is on the complete life cycle of each project we build. Hensel Phelps Facility Services Group is uniquely qualified with decades of facility experience. The Facility Services Group specializes in facility solutions, building systems integration, specialized construction, and facility management. **Our team provides best\-in\-class operational solutions** with technical knowledge and subject matter experts of building systems, envelopes, campus, and client operations.

jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- **Imagine Everything. Build the Future with Hexion.** At Hexion, we push boundaries, rethink possibilities, and create real impact. We activate science to deliver progress—developing breakthrough solutions that strengthen industries, protect communities, and drive a more sustainable future. **This is where bold thinkers, problem\-solvers, and innovators come together to shape what’s next.**Whether you're engineering advanced materials, transforming manufacturing technologies, or leading strategic innovation, your ideas and actions leave a lasting mark. With an unwavering commitment to safety, partnership, belonging, and impact, we empower you to lead change and strengthen industries worldwide. **Your Future Starts Here.** If you’re ready to push limits, reimagine what’s possible, and create the extraordinary, Hexion is where you belong. **Anything is possible when you imagine everything.** **Position Overview** --------------------- The AI Project \& Operations Manager is a hands\-on senior individual contributor responsible for driving current\-quarter delivery while building the operating systems that improve future execution. The role combines end\-to\-end technology program management with business and delivery operations across Smartech AI. Smartech AI develops AI software for wood panel mills, including oriented strand board (OSB), particleboard and medium\-density fiberboard (MDF) operations. Its Board Health platform gives mills real\-time visibility into sources of value loss across flow, moisture, furnish, adhesive, cure and board quality. With the platform live at its first mill, this role will help move the business from pilot deployment to a repeatable, scalable launch model. This individual will align Platform and IT, R\&D, and Customer Delivery through clear priorities, disciplined planning, operating cadence and consistent follow\-through. The role leads through influence and execution rather than formal headcount authority. **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own quarterly commitments across engineering, R\&D and customer delivery, including scope, schedules, dependencies, risks, decisions and stakeholder reporting. * Lead coordinated planning across multiple technical and delivery teams, translating shared priorities into executable plans with clear owners and milestones. * Identify at\-risk initiatives early and develop recovery plans that align stakeholders, resolve dependencies and restore delivery confidence. * Establish and run the operating cadence for the business, including planning cycles, business reviews, decision tracking and action follow\-through. * Build and maintain executive\-ready KPIs and dashboards that provide visibility into delivery progress, operational health, risks and business outcomes. * Design practical processes, handoffs and playbooks that support repeatable customer launches and scale as the organization grows. * Connect the Platform and IT team responsible for cloud data architecture, plant connectivity and deployment with the R\&D and Customer Delivery teams, coordinating the integration and deployment of manufacturing software \- including Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM/MOS) platforms \- and supporting operational adoption in plant environments. * Coordinate a globally distributed data science and modeling organization, including team members in Israel, across time zones and functional boundaries. * Partner with customer success managers and forward\-deployed engineers to support mill connectivity, training, adoption and value realization. * Use tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira to create transparency, manage execution and maintain accountability across workstreams. * Communicate complex delivery issues, trade\-offs, risks and decisions clearly to engineers, field teams, customers and senior leaders. * Continuously improve the operating model by applying lessons learned from current deployments to future planning and launch execution. **Competencies** ---------------- KPIs * On\-time delivery of quarterly commitments across engineering, R\&D and customer delivery. * Improved visibility and predictability of milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions and actions. * Recovery and stabilization of at\-risk workstreams. * Adoption and effectiveness of operating cadences, dashboards, handoffs and playbooks. * Reduction in avoidable delivery friction between platform, modeling and customer\-facing teams. * Increasing repeatability and scalability of customer launch a  * Clear Communication: Communicates concisely and credibly with engineers, field teams, customers and senior leaders. * Continuous Improvement: Turns lessons from current\-quarter execution into a stronger operating model for future quarters. * Learning Agility: Builds fluency in industrial manufacturing, plant connectivity and AI\-enabled software delivery. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * 10\+ years of experience managing complex technology projects from initiation through delivery, including scope, schedule, dependencies, risks and stakeholder reporting. * Demonstrated success leading coordinated planning across multiple engineering or technical teams, such as quarterly planning or release\-train planning, with measurable delivery results. * Proven experience recovering at\-risk projects through clear plans, stakeholder alignment and disciplined execution. * Hands\-on experience with project management and delivery tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira. * Experience delivering, integrating or deploying manufacturing software in plant environments, particularly Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM/MOS) platforms, with demonstrated ability to support operational adoption. * Experience designing and operating business rhythms, including business reviews, planning cycles, decision logs and action tracking. * Demonstrated experience building KPIs and dashboards used by executives to support decisions. * Experience creating scalable processes, handoffs and playbooks that were adopted by others and evolved as a team or business grew. * Experience leading or coordinating large, globally distributed engineering and quality assurance teams across time zones without relying on formal authority. * Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills across technical teams, field organizations, customers and senior leadership. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience delivering digital or software products in an industrial, chemical or manufacturing company, ideally with commercial\-facing products used by external customers. * Prior software development leadership experience, such as developer, lead developer or engineering manager. * Startup or early\-stage experience, including moving an alpha, prototype or pilot into production and repeatable deployment. * Experience coordinating customer\-facing delivery teams such as customer success, implementation or field engineering. * PMP, Agile or equivalent recognized project management certification, combined with the judgment to scale process to fit the team and situation. * Familiarity with industrial data and plant\-connectivity technologies, including MES, MOM/MOS, historians, OPC and IoT platforms, or demonstrated ability and strong motivation to build fluency in these areas quickly. **Other** --------- We are an Equal Opportunity, Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, pregnancy, race, national origin, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran or military status, status as a qualified individual with a disability or any other characteristic protected by law. To be considered for this position candidates are required to submit an application for employment through our career site and, be at least 18 years of age. Any offer of employment will be conditioned upon successful completion of a drug test and background investigation, as well as authorization for the Company to conduct additional periodic background checks as required by the Chemical Facility Anti\-Terrorism Standards (CFATS) or regulations adopted by the department of Homeland Security or other regulatory agencies. A prior criminal record is not an automatic bar to employment, and the Company will conduct an individualized assessment and reassessment, consistent with applicable law, prior to making any final employment decision.

jobs.description: **Position Details** -------------------- Position Information **About Hofstra** At Hofstra University, intellectual curiosity is not just aspirational – it is central to how we engage on a daily basis. Hofstra faculty work within a diverse scholarly community committed to student success, intellectual discovery, free inquiry, inclusivity, and collaboration. Enrolling more than 10,000 students, Hofstra offers students an array of undergraduate and graduate academic programs spanning the arts, humanities, sciences, business, engineering, law, health care, communications, and more. Our accomplished faculty collaborate with students to explore interdisciplinary questions and produce innovative research that lays the foundation for future personal and professional success. With a beautiful campus in Hempstead, NY, Hofstra’s location seamlessly merges the tranquility of coastal suburban living with the boundless opportunities of nearby New York City. Hofstra University is dedicated to recruiting and retaining a highly qualified and diverse academic community of students, faculty, staff, and administrators respectful of the contributions and dignity of each of its members. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive community. **Position Title** Research and Learning Services Librarian – Engineering, Sciences and Artificial Intelligence **Position Number** 896255 **Position Category** **School/Division** Library Operations **Department** **Full\-Time or Part\-Time** Full\-Time **Description** The Hofstra University Library invites applications for a tenure\-track appointment as Research and Learning Services Librarian for Engineering, Sciences, and AI, in the Department of Research and Learning Services. This librarian will provide research and instructional support to students and faculty in computing, engineering, and the natural sciences and advance AI initiatives within the library and the broader campus community. The successful candidate will understand issues surrounding AI in academia and develop teaching and learning initiatives and services that address them. This librarian will bring a growth mindset, approaching emerging trends in librarianship and academia with curiosity and imagination. The Research and Learning Services Librarian for Engineering, Sciences, and AI will initiate and cultivate relationships with faculty, centers, programs, and projects across campus to integrate library resources and services into teaching, learning, and research. The successful candidate will demonstrate familiarity with research methodologies, grant\-seeking and proposal writing, and emerging technologies sufficient to expand and strengthen library research support for faculty and students. The University Library supports Hofstra University’s mission of providing quality education in an environment that encourages and nurtures learning through the free and open exchange of ideas. It shares the University’s commitment to academic freedom and the transmission, advancement, and preservation of knowledge. Through collaboration with students, faculty, and administrators, the University Library supports the University’s curricular offerings and meets the community’s research and instructional needs. Responsibilities include: * Engage actively with faculty in computing, engineering, and the natural sciences to integrate information literacy into curricula and provide research support to students. * Establish and cultivate relationships with faculty to support disciplinary research and enrich library services and collections. * Collaborate with the Center for Excellence in Learning, Teaching, and Assessment to support faculty teaching and research. * Develop and deliver workshops, credit\-bearing course modules, tutorials, and online lessons, and integrate AI instruction into curricula to introduce or refine ethical, practical, and critical uses of generative and applied AI in disciplinary contexts. * Develop and implement training for librarians to support the ongoing effective use of AI tools. * Provide reference services, individual research consultations, library instruction, and specialized programs to students, faculty, and staff, both in person and online. * Perform collection development duties in accordance with department policy. * Participate in professional and service activities within the Hofstra University Library, the University, and the broader profession. * Conduct research, publish, and participate in scholarly activities to meet the Hofstra University Library’s criteria for reappointment and tenure. * Perform other related duties as assigned. **Qualifications** * An M.L.S. or M.L.I.S. degree from an ALA\-accredited program. * Experience providing public services in academic libraries. * Experience providing library instruction. * Familiarity with information use and research practices in computing, engineering, and the natural sciences. * Familiarity with AI literacy standards and discipline\-specific information literacy standards. * Experience using Springshare applications, such as LibAnswers, LibChat, and LibGuides. **Preferred Quals Summary** * Working knowledge of WorldCat Discovery, OCLC library management systems, and related systems. **Special Instructions** This is a tenure\-track faculty position. It will be filled at either the Instructor, Assistant, or Associate Professor rank, depending on qualifications. An additional graduate degree, scholarship, and university service are required for tenure consideration. Please upload the following with your application for consideration: * Cover letter * Curriculum vitae * Email address and phone number of three professional references All applications received by December 31, 2026, will receive full consideration. Inquiries should be directed to the Chair of the Search Committee Prof. William Caniano at William.Caniano@hofstra.edu . **Deadline** Open until filled **Tenure Track** Yes **Date Posted** 10/26/2026 **EEO Statement** Hofstra University is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to extending equal opportunity in employment to all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national or ethnic origin, physical or mental disability, marital or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. **Salary/Salary Range** $75,000\-$85,000 Additional Information *Hofstra University provides the above salary\* as a good faith estimate of the starting pay range which considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and education. In addition to the salary offered, we offer a collegial and inclusive culture, and a benefits program which includes generous paid time off, paid holidays, tuition remission for employees and eligible dependents, and a retirement plan with University contributions.* * *Salary ranges indicated for positions covered under a Collective Bargaining Agreement are in accordance with the CBA.*

jobs.title: Senior AI Platform Engineer – Agentic AI
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior AI Platform Engineer – Agentic AI to join our Data Engineering, AI \& ML Platform team. This role will help design and build the enterprise platform capabilities that enable teams to create, deploy, evaluate, observe, and operate production\-grade AI agents and intelligent applications at scale. You will work at the intersection of software engineering, AI platform engineering, Generative AI, agentic systems, data engineering, and MLOps. A major focus of the role will be building reusable platform capabilities for agent development, including reasoning and orchestration workflows, tool integration, enterprise knowledge retrieval, memory/context management, evaluation, observability, and responsible operation of AI agents. Rather than building one\-off AI applications, you will help establish reusable services, SDKs, patterns, and platform components that accelerate AI development across Honeywell. You will collaborate with data engineers, AI/ML engineers, application teams, architects, product teams, and domain experts to take emerging AI capabilities from experimentation to secure, reliable, production\-grade enterprise services. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role for an engineer who is comfortable solving ambiguous problems, developing platform capabilities, and turning rapidly evolving AI technologies into maintainable production systems. The role is based in Atlanta, GA on a hybrid basis. Note: For the first 90 days, new hires must be prepared to work onsite 100% Monday through Friday. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Agentic AI Platform** * Design and build reusable enterprise platform capabilities for developing, deploying, and operating AI agents and multi\-agent workflows. * Build frameworks and reusable components that allow agents to securely interact with enterprise APIs, data platforms, applications, tools, and knowledge sources. * Develop orchestration patterns using agentic AI frameworks, without coupling the platform to a single framework. * Build services supporting RAG and enterprise knowledge retrieval, including document ingestion, retrieval pipelines, vector/semantic search, grounding, citations, and contextual enrichment. * Develop systematic approaches for agent and LLM evaluation, including task success, response quality, grounding, tool\-use correctness, latency, reliability, and cost. Implement observability and tracing for agent execution so developers can understand agent decisions, model calls, tool calls, failures, performance, and resource consumption. * **AI Platform Engineering** * Design, build, and operate scalable platform services and APIs using Python and FastAPI or comparable production frameworks. * Build reusable APIs, SDKs, libraries, templates, and reference implementations that make it easier for engineering teams to develop and deploy AI applications. * Design cloud\-native AI platform services using technologies such as Azure, Kubernetes, Databricks, Azure * Machine Learning, MLflow, or equivalent platforms. * Develop production capabilities for model and application deployment, configuration, versioning, experimentation, evaluation, and lifecycle management. * Build automated CI/CD and testing pipelines for AI services, agent workflows, prompts/configurations, and supporting platform components. * Convert prototypes and notebook\-based experimentation into modular, testable, maintainable, production\-quality software. Design platform patterns for maintaining data quality, lineage, access control, and traceability across AI workflows. * **Production Engineering, Safety \& Reliability** * Build AI services with production software engineering practices covering testing, security, scalability, reliability, and maintainability. * Implement end\-to\-end observability, tracing, monitoring, and alerting across agent workflows, models, APIs, retrieval systems, and platform services. * Establish mechanisms for handling agent failures, tool failures, model errors, timeouts, retries, and degraded dependencies. * Implement appropriate guardrails, access controls, auditability, and human oversight for enterprise agentic AI workflows. * Optimize AI workloads for latency, throughput, infrastructure utilization, and model/token cost. * Diagnose complex production issues spanning AI models, orchestration, data, APIs, infrastructure, and applications. **YOU MUST HAVE** * 8\+ years of software, data platform, ML platform, or AI engineering experience, including designing, building, and supporting production\-grade systems. * Strong Python software engineering expertise, including API/service development, testing, debugging, packaging, design patterns, and modern software development best practices. * Experience building cloud\-native distributed applications and platforms using containers, Kubernetes, public cloud technologies, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and reliability engineering. * Hands\-on experience developing and deploying AI/ML and Generative AI solutions, including model serving, lifecycle management, monitoring, operational support, and production deployments. Experience building LLM and agentic AI applications, including RAG/grounding, enterprise data integration and retrieval (structured and unstructured data), orchestration frameworks, and tool/API integration. * **WE VALUE** * Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent agent orchestration frameworks. * Experience designing multi\-agent systems, agent tool ecosystems, planning/reasoning workflows, agent memory, or human\-in\-the\-loop patterns. * Experience with AI evaluation and observability platforms such as LangSmith, MLflow or equivalent tooling. * Experience with Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI services, Databricks, Kubernetes, or comparable AI/data platforms. * Experience with vector databases, semantic search, knowledge graphs, RDF/SPARQL, Neo4j, ontology engineering, or GraphRAG\-style knowledge systems. * Experience building AI systems that integrate with industrial IoT, operational technology, building systems, digital twins, or high\-volume telemetry. * Experience building developer platforms, SDKs, internal frameworks, or reusable engineering capabilities used by multiple development teams. Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * **ABOUT HONEYWELL** Honeywell International Inc. (NYSE: HON) invents and commercializes technologies that address some of the world’s most critical challenges around energy, safety, security, air travel, productivity, and global urbanization. We are a leading software\-industrial company committed to introducing state\-of\-the\-art technology solutions to improve efficiency, productivity, sustainability, and safety in high growth businesses in broad\-based, attractive industrial end markets. jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role:** The Quality Engineer plays a critical role in ensuring that products and processes meet stringent quality standards and regulatory requirements, particularly within regulated industries such as medical devices. This position is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining quality systems that drive continuous improvement and compliance with ISO 13485 standards. The Quality Engineer will lead root\-cause analysis efforts and corrective and preventive actions to resolve quality issues and prevent recurrence. They will collaborate closely with suppliers and cross\-functional teams to ensure that incoming materials and components meet quality expectations through first article inspections and ongoing supplier quality management. Ultimately, this role ensures that products are manufactured consistently to specification, enhancing customer satisfaction and minimizing risk to the organization. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related technical field. * Proven experience with Statistical Process Control (SPC) and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). * Familiarity with ISO 13485 standards and quality system regulations. * Experience conducting root\-cause analysis and implementing effective quality solutions. * Strong knowledge of supplier quality management and first article inspection processes. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Certification as a Quality Engineer (CQE) or equivalent. * Experience with Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD\&T) in a manufacturing environment. * Hands\-on experience with control plan development and implementation. * Background in medical device or highly regulated industries. * Proficiency with quality management software and data analysis tools. **Responsibilities:** * Develop, implement, and maintain Statistical Process Control (SPC) methods to monitor and improve manufacturing processes. * Lead Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) investigations by performing root\-cause analysis and driving resolution activities. * Manage supplier quality by conducting audits, evaluating supplier performance, and coordinating first article inspections. * Ensure compliance with ISO 13485 quality management system requirements and maintain documentation accordingly. * Create and maintain control plans and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD\&T) documentation to support product quality and manufacturing consistency. **Skills:** The required skills such as Statistical Process Control and Corrective and Preventive Actions are applied daily to monitor production quality and address deviations proactively. Root\-cause analytical skills enable the engineer to identify underlying issues and implement sustainable corrective measures. Supplier quality expertise ensures that all incoming materials meet stringent standards through first article inspections and ongoing supplier evaluations. Knowledge of ISO 13485 and quality systems guides the maintenance of compliant documentation and processes, ensuring regulatory adherence. Additionally, skills in Geometric Dimensioning and Control Plan development support precise manufacturing and consistent product quality, fostering continuous improvement across operations.

jobs.title: Data Engineer (DevOps / DataOps / Delivery Engineering) — Sr. Associate
jobs.description: Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes. Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long\-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer\-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. Join the Clinical Insights team as a key part of our engineering organization — a Data Engineer who helps keep clinical data pipelines and client\-facing applications running reliably across 10\+ client environments every single day. This role supports the full lifecycle of client data infrastructure and application delivery: SFTP ingestion, AWS data lake operations, application environment setup and deployment support, and pipeline monitoring and incident response, working closely with the team's DataOps lead. You'll sit at the intersection of DataOps, DevOps, and delivery engineering — comfortable helping configure a new client environment ahead of go\-live, triaging a failed Jenkins run before standup, and confirming yesterday's data loads actually landed. This is not a business intelligence or analytics role. You'll build and operate the infrastructure that the entire product and client delivery organization depends on. This role reports to the team's DataOps lead and works under their technical direction on environment provisioning, infrastructure changes, and architectural decisions. Role Summary In this role, you will: * Support daily operation and monitoring of data pipelines across 10\+ concurrent client environments, triaging failures (no\-data, bad\-data, and processing errors) and escalating complex issues to the DataOps lead before they affect client\-facing reporting. * Set up, configure, and support deployment of client\-facing applications — from environment setup through go\-live stabilization and ongoing support. * Validate that daily data flows complete successfully across all client environments — at a console/log level day to day, diving deeper into pipeline and application logs when something doesn't look right. * Support provisioning and configuration of new client environments — SFTP ingestion setup, instance provisioning, access controls, and coordination with client IT teams on file formats, schedules, and encryption — partnering with the DataOps lead on more complex setups. * Contribute to the team's CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins), AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3, Lambda, EventBridge, IAM), and Posit Connect analytics hosting platform, under the DataOps lead's direction. * Build and maintain monitoring and alerting for pipeline health — distinguishing failure types, reducing false alarms, and keeping the team ahead of client\-visible data issues. * Maintain runbooks and documentation so operational knowledge is transferable, not siloed in one person's head. Key Responsibilities Application Deployment \& Support * Help set up and configure client application environments ahead of deployment, including app and infrastructure configuration. * Run and support production deployments, including go\-live stabilization and post\-launch monitoring. * Validate that daily data loads and refreshes complete successfully for every client application — console\-level checks as the first pass, with deeper investigation when volumes or completion look off. * Investigate application and data load issues when flagged, diagnosing root cause across the pipeline and application layers, with support from senior team members on complex cases. Data Pipeline Engineering * Build and maintain client\-specific data ingestion pipelines (SFTP, S3, event\-driven triggers, file validation), with architectural guidance from the DataOps lead. * Build and maintain standardized data validation scripts — a reusable QA framework applied across client environments. * Ingest historical data for new client onboardings and resolve data quality incidents (missing files, null values, file extension issues, reprocessing). * Support the team's upcoming migration of the data lake and core tab s. * Handle SAML/SSO certificate management and PGP encryption setup for secure client file delivery. * Help enforce code repository governance — branch protection, PR approval requirements, and deployment controls. DevOps \& CI/CD Build and maintain Jenkins\-based CI/CD pipelines (dev staging* production). * Set up and validate development and staging environments. * Maintain runbooks for all operational procedures. * Support the team's Docker\-based mono repo deployment architecture across client environments. * Execute and document client offboarding processes. Security \& Compliance * Support Huron mandatory compliance activities, PHI data classification, and audit control documentation. * Manage certificate renewals, access restriction enforcement, and credential rotation (SMTP, IAM). Required Qualifications * U.S. work authorization is required. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). * 2\-3\+ years of experience in data engineering, DevOps, or DataOps roles, including hands\-on experience supporting production data pipelines. * Strong hands\-on experience with **AWS data pipeline infrastructure** — S3, Athena, Lambda, EC2, and event\-driven architectures (SNS/SQS). * Strong **Python** scripting ability for data ingestion, validation, and pipeline automation; comfort with **Bash**. * Experience with **CI/CD pipelines** (Jenkins or equivalent) and Git\-based version control practices (branch protection, PR workflows). * Experience setting up, configuring, and supporting application deployments — not just writing pipeline code. * Experience managing multi\-client or multi\-tenant data environments, including onboarding and provisioning new environments. * Experience participating in incident response and root cause analysis for data pipeline and application issues — this is an operations\-heavy role, not a build\-only role. * Comfortable working as a generalist across infrastructure, data engineering, and DevOps simultaneously, in a fast\-moving, client\-driven environment where priorities can shift mid\-sprint. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with **Snowflake** or other modern cloud data warehouse platforms — the team is migrating its data lake and core tables to Snowflake as its next major infrastructure initiative. * Posit Connect or R/Shiny environment familiarity. * Docker and containerized deployment experience. * SAML/SSO certificate management and cloud security practices (IAM key rotation, PGP encryption). * Healthcare data environment experience — SFTP clinical file delivery, PHI handling, HL7/ADT familiarity. * Experience building monitoring and alerting systems for data pipelines. * Occasional direct client IT coordination experience (file delivery issues, certificate renewals, data quality questions). The estimated base salary for this job is $110,000 \- $150,000 USD. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $126,500 \- $172,500 USD. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future. \#LI\-CL1 \#LI\-REMOTE **Position Level** ------------------ Senior Associate**Country** ----------- United States of America

jobs.description: About IMG Academy IMG Academy is the world’s leading sports education brand, providing a holistic education model that empowers student\-athletes to win their future while preparing them for college and for life. IMG Academy has been nationally recognized by organizations including Sports Business Journal, USA Today, and the Best and Brightest Companies to Work For for its workplace culture, innovation, and commitment to developing people both on and off the field. IMG Academy provides growth opportunities for student\-athletes and partners through an innovative suite of on\-campus and online experiences: * Boarding school and camps, delivered on a state\-of\-the\-art campus in Bradenton, Florida * Online coaching through IMG Academy\+, focused on personal development through the lens of sport and performance * Online college recruiting through NCSA College Recruiting and SportsRecruits, providing industry\-leading recruiting education, tools, and access to a network of more than 40,000 college coaches for student\-athletes, families, club coaches, and event operators * Elevate by IMG Academy, a performance and personal development solution that delivers mindset, leadership, and wellbeing programming to schools, colleges, and organizations through a combination of digital content and immersive experiences **Position Summary:** The Software Engineering Manager role is responsible for leading a team of software engineers working to implement features and functionality on our mobile application and supporting systems. In this role, you’ll combine strong technical judgment and hands on coding with a genuine passion for developing people \- driving both engineering excellence and meaningful product outcomes that impact athletes’ futures. You will work closely with product to negotiate the scope and shape the features to deliver business value. Members of the team are responsible for the development, maintenance, and operation of our Reactive Native mobile application and its related service as well as administration web platform. Software developed by this team includes a React Native mobile application deployed to both the iOS and Android stores, as well as backend services in Typescript, Go or Python, deployed via Kubernetes to AWS infrastructure, and communicating with multiple backing services (PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenSearch. Kafka) and SaaS tools (Auth0, Shopify, Contentful). **Position Responsibilities:** People Management \& Coaching * Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 4 \- 6 software engineers across varying experience levels * Own the full employee lifecycle for your team: hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and retention * Conduct regular 1:1s and provide direct, actionable feedback that helps engineers grow * Work with other technical leaders to create a culture of innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. Technical Leadership * Work across engineering teams to set and uphold engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, and system design * Participate in and guide architectural decisions, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable * Stay technically engaged and meaningfully review design documents, unblock engineers, and assess trade\-offs — without being in the critical path of delivery * Champion engineering best practices across the broader engineering organization * Drive reduction of technical debt and proactively manage platform health Delivery \& Execution * Work with your engineers, in both a hands\-on and leadership capacity, to develop loosely coupled, well tested, and maintainable code * Use AI tools such as Claude Code, Copilot or Cursor to accelerate development * Collaborate with the Product Management team to craft technical solutions that meet internal and external customer needs. * Collaborate with Infrastructure Engineering and Security teams to employ standard infrastructure components, release code with increasing volume and velocity in a self\-service fashion and meet company security standard. * Identify and remove blockers, manage dependencies across teams, and escalate risks early. * Balance short\-term delivery needs with long\-term platform investments * Provide on\-call support on a rotating basis with your team (roughly 1 week per month; very low incident rate). **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** * 5\+ years minimum experience in React Native mobile engineering * Experience maintaining and extending mobile back\-end or other API applications in an engineering management or tech lead role * Experience deploying binaries to the Google Play and iOS app stores. Experience using Expo built tool a plus * Experience with cloud\-based development environments (primarily AWS) * Experience with 12\-factor applications and modern development practices. * Experience with automated infrastructure provisioning and continuous deployment. * Familiarity with relational databases (e.g. Postgres) and non\-relational data stores (e.g. Redis, OpenSearch) * Familiarity with event\-driven application architecture concepts. * Familiarity with software monitoring, telemetry, and incident response handling * Excellent communication skills; able to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders and business context for engineers * Experience with generative AI programming assistants * Experience working with and applying engineering metrics to increase the effectiveness of an engineering team * Experience working with product metrics to deliver business value * Ability to provide on\-call support on a rotating basis is required. \#LI\-TR1 **Background Requirements:** * Requires a background check upon offer Some positions, particularly those that have responsibilities working with student\-athletes and supporting IMG Academy on campus with events involving minors, may require a L2 background screen. The requirement will be communicated during onboarding, and instructions for submission of level 2 backgrounds will be provided. Learn more about the screening process and requirements by visiting the Florida Care Provider Background Screening Education \& Awareness website: https://info.flclearinghouse.com. **Benefits:** As a full\-time member of our team, you will enjoy a comprehensive offering listed below. Connect with your talent acquisition specialist to learn more about benefits for our part\-time roles. * Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision * Flexible Spending Account and Health Savings Account options * 401k with an Employer Match * Short Term and Long Term Disability * Group and Supplemental Life \& AD\&D * Gym Discount Program * Pet Insurance * Wellbeing Program * and more! Don’t meet every single requirement? We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **Get to know us better:** www.ncsasports.org www.ncsasports.org/careers NCSA provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: AI Developer
jobs.description: **Job Title \- AI Native Developer** **Duration \-** 90 Days Initial Engagement (20 Hours/week) **Work Mode\-** Onsite **Work Location\-** Plano, Tx **Position Summary:** We are hiring a Senior AI Native Developer to join an active client engagement in the restaurant technology space. This is a hands\-on, on\-site role with a dual mandate: driving development execution as a Senior Engineer and acting as a client\-embedded technical liaison — a Product Owner / Technical Lead hybrid — working alongside the client's CTO, stakeholders, and ISHIR's India\-based development team. This role suits someone who thrives in ambiguity, translates business requirements into shipped code, and is equally comfortable presenting to executive stakeholders and writing production\-grade AI features in the same week. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** **Client Delivery \& On\-site Presence** * Serve as the primary on\-site technical for the client engagement — attend stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and stakeholder sessions * Represent ISHIR's delivery team with clarity and professionalism; communicate progress, risks, and decisions to CTO and CFO\-level stakeholders * Facilitate product discovery, requirements refinement, and architecture review sessions on\-site * Own the client relationship day\-to\-day, proactively flagging issues before they escalate **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** **Must\-Have** * 8\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building AI/ML or LLM\-integrated products * Proven ability to work directly with clients — comfortable in executive meetings and boardroom\-level presentations * Strong full\-stack background: React or equivalent frontend * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI) — prompt engineering, RAG, tool/function calling * Solid agile delivery experience: sprint planning, backlog grooming, coordinating distributed engineering teams * US\-based with ability to travel on\-site to client locations (primarily Dallas, TX area) * Exceptional written and verbal communication — you write as clearly as you code **Strong Advantages** * Prior experience in a client\-facing technical lead, senior PO, or solutions architect capacity at a services or consulting firm * Familiarity with restaurant technology, hospitality SaaS, or B2B platform products * Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud\-native deployments (Azure preferred) * Hands\-on with agentic AI frameworks — LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar * Anthropic Claude Certified Architect (CCA\-F) or equivalent AI platform certification **ABOUT ISHIR** ISHIR is a digital innovation and enterprise AI services provider. We work with startups and enterprises to shape the future through accelerated innovation, deep technical expertise, access to global digital talent and a passion for complex problem\-solving. With our help, our clients overcome their most difficult digital challenges leveraging AI. We are not just consultants, we are partners in our clients’ success, assisting them with re(gaining) competitive edge by identifying opportunities for differentiation, industry disruption, scalable innovation, and go\-to\-market strategies that deliver successful outcomes. At ISHIR, we help bold businesses accelerate innovation through Talent, Speed\-to\-Market, and AI. We help make an impact by solving real problems using innovation, improved customer experiences and the right technologies. As an ISHIR employee, you will get the advanced training you need to be successful, and the opportunity to apply it. You must be passionate about technology, crave responsibility, and be eager to apply your knowledge to real business solutions for our startup and enterprise customers. These are the qualities of a person destined for success at ISHIR. ISHIR attracts a special type of individual—someone who is proactive, thrives on challenges, feeds off success, and looks at moving targets not as obstacles but as opportunities. ISHIR is an exciting place to work. It is imbued with an entrepreneurial spirit and promotes self\-reliance, open communication, and collaboration Pay: $100\.00 \- $120\.00 per hour Location: * Plano, TX 75023 (Preferred) Work Location: In person
