jobs.title: Principal Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Imagine Pediatrics is a tech enabled, pediatrician led medical group reimagining care for children with special health care needs. We deliver 24/7 virtual first and in home medical, behavioral, and social care, working alongside families, providers, and health plans to break down barriers to quality care. We do not replace existing care teams; we enhance them, providing an extra layer of support with compassion, creativity, and an unwavering commitment to children with medical complexity. **What You'll Do** As Principal Security Engineer with Imagine Pediatrics, you will set the technical vision for how we protect our systems, our data, and the children and families who trust us with their care. You will serve as a trusted security advisor to the VP, Information Security and work across the business to make secure the default way we build and run technology, partnering closely with Engineering on DevSecOps strategy and architectural improvements.. You will stay hands\-on with our hardest problems while raising the bar for the security team and the engineers around it. You will: * Set the technical vision for the security stack, including endpoint, email, data loss prevention, vulnerability management and penetration testing, network, application, and data security, and ensure it aligns with business and clinical strategy * Define long\-term cloud and identity security strategy across Microsoft Azure/EntraID and Amazon Web Services (AWS), including privileged access, phishing\-resistant MFA, and governance of non\-human identities such as AI agents, service accounts, and API keys, shaping secure infrastructure design patterns that influence company\-wide technical decisions * Lead security architecture review and threat modeling for Care Hub and connected services, including Medplum application\-layer controls (FHIR access policies, SMART scopes, Bots, and custom code) and data platforms such as Snowflake * Define DevSecOps strategy and standardize security gates across the SDLC and CI/CD pipeline, building on GitHub Advanced Security, OWASP Top 10 practices, software bills of materials, and prioritization of CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities * Serve as the senior technical escalation point (including in the on\-call rotation) for the most complex and highest\-stakes security events and strengthen incident playbooks, ransomware and critical\-SaaS exercises, and restoration testing against recovery targets * Monitor and advise on the evolving threat landscape facing healthcare including AI\-enabled and agentic attacks and its implications for business strategy * Ensure the organization can accurately demonstrate its security posture to payors, regulators, auditors, and other third parties, building documentation and evidence pipelines, including AI\-assisted ones, that scale with our HITRUST, HIPAA, and NIST compliance requirements. * Frame ambiguous, high\-stakes security questions for the organization and drive them to well\-reasoned, defensible answers delivering decision\-ready recommendations, risk rankings, and documented resolution pathways. * Ensure precision at the program level by driving guardrails such as automated configuration checks and drift detection, so misconfigurations are prevented systemically rather than caught individually * Shape the technical sequencing of our multi\-year security roadmap, contribute to quarterly engineering planning, and ensure the security program's execution aligns with company strategy and the timelines that matter to the business * Explore early\-stage ideas and proofs of concept to de\-risk future security initiatives before they are staffed or scoped * Champion thoughtful AI adoption within security to reduce manual effort, and guide how AI tools and AI\-enabled products are adopted securely across the company * Partner with engineering, product, IT, and clinical stakeholders to embed security into how we design, build, and operate our digital products, translating complex security concepts for non\-technical audiences * Mentor the security engineering team, coach engineers across technology on security craftsmanship, and shape the team's learning culture * Act as a trusted advisor to leadership, advocating for security engineers while aligning security decisions with business priorities, and demonstrate executive\-level composure in high\-stakes, ambiguous situations * Apply professional discretion and judgement when viewing sensitive and personal data or information in the process of conducting work * Other duties as assigned **What You Bring \& How You Qualify** First and foremost, you're passionate and committed to reimagining pediatric health care and creating a world where every child with complex medical conditions gets the care and support they deserve. You will need: * Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Business, Management, or a related field is desired; advanced degree a plus * Relevant license or rchitecture across AWS and Microsoft Azure/EntraID * Hands\-on application and product security experience, including threat modeling, secure SDLC and CI/CD design, and securing healthcare APIs (FHIR, SMART on FHIR); experience with Medplum is a plus * Experience leading detection and response programs, including partnering with MDR providers and leading the technical response to serious security incidents and data breaches * Extensive experience translating HITRUST and HIPAA Security Rule requirements into technical controls and supporting engagements with auditors, payors, and regulators * Experience using Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a transformative technology to enhance and automate security processes, and an understanding of the security risks AI systems introduce * Knowledge of IT systems such as AWS, Microsoft Intune, EntraID, CrowdStrike Falcon (EDR/SIEM), GitHub Advanced Security, Snowflake, JAMF, Meraki, and JIRA Service Management * Strong collaboration and coaching skills, with demonstrated success developing senior engineers * Comfort operating autonomously in ambiguity, exploring early\-stage ideas without well\-defined requirements * Experience working in a fast\-paced, hypergrowth, collaborative environment * Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation * Contributions to the broader security community, such as conference talks, publications, or industry threat intelligence sharing, are a plus **What We Offer (Benefits \+ Perks)** The role offers a base salary range of $195,000\-$225,000 in addition to annual bonus incentive, competitive company benefits package, and eligibility to participate in an employee equity purchase program (as applicable). When determining compensation, we analyze and carefully consider several factors including job\-related knowledge, skills and experience. These considerations may cause your compensation to vary. * Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance * Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA; Company\-funded HSA * 401(k) with 4% match, vested 100% from day one * Employer\-paid short and long\-term disability * Life insurance at 1x annual salary * 20 days PTO \+ 10 Company Holidays \& 2 Floating Holidays * Paid new parent leave * Additional benefits to be detailed in offer **What We Live By** We're guided by our five core values: **Our Values:** * **Children First.** We put the best interests of children above all. We know that the right decision is always the one that creates more safe days at home for the children we serve today and in the future. * **Earn Trust.** We listen first, speak second. We build lasting relationships by creating shared understanding and consistently following through on our commitments. * **Innovate Today.** We believe that small improvements lead to big impact. We stay curious by asking questions and leveraging new ideas to learn and scale. * **Embrace Humanity.** We lead with empathy and authenticity, presuming competence and good intentions. When we stumble, we use the opportunity to grow and understand how we can improve. * **One Team, Diverse Perspectives.** We actively seek a range of viewpoints to achieve better outcomes. Even when we see things differently, we stay aligned on our shared mission and support one another to move forward — together. **We Value Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging** We believe that creating a world where every child with complex medical conditions gets the care and support, they deserve requires a diverse team with diverse perspectives. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. People seeking employment at Imagine Pediatrics are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, or characteristics (or those of a family member), pregnancy or other status protected by applicable law.

Since 1977, we have grown to over 600 Associates and 30 locations across the United States, Puerto Rico, and Canada. Every day, we work to deliver on our Corporate Mission Statement: *"To be the market leader by delivering innovative financial and technology solutions to help our Customers, partners, and investors achieve their goals."* How do we do it? We empower and encourage our Associates to provide products and Customer service unparalleled in our industry. **FOR OUR ASSOCIATES:** * **At the office:** Depending on your location, we offer parking and commuter benefit programs to make your commute a little easier. * **Getting started:** We offer a comprehensive paid training program that helps you feel prepared and excited about your role. * **Staying healthy:** Our wellness program, WellWorks, along with our Employee Assistance Program for confidential support, helps you keep an eye on your short\- and long\-term goals. We also support your health and fitness by providing gym membership subsidies. * **Preparing for your future:** We offer a 401(k) with a company match. * **Company culture:** Our Associates are the foundation of our company, and we want you to enjoy working here. With company lunches, corporate outings, and even the occasional ice cream truck, you never know what will pop up to make your day. * **Peace of mind:** Our insurance benefits include medical, prescription, dental, vision, voluntary life/dependent life, group term life, and AD\&D. * **Time to recharge:** We offer paid time off — including vacation and sick time — along with paid holidays, in accordance with company policy and applicable laws. * **Equal Opportunity Employer:** Imperial PFS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make employment decisions in accordance with applicable law and prohibit unlawful discrimination based on race, religion, color, sex, gender, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. * **Reasonable Accommodations:** We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. Applicants who require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or hiring process may contact Human Resources to request an accommodation. **Overview:** The Enterprise Principal Architect is a highly visible, hands\-on technical leader who owns the architectural design and integrity of the organization's core systems. As the technical authority and go\-to resource for engineering teams, this leader partners with the CIO and senior technology leaders to set technical direction across .NET, Azure, Angular, and SQL Server. The role leads the evaluation of new technologies, tools, and standards. It also steps in on the most complex production issues to find root causes and put lasting fixes in place. The scope of this role is expected to grow, with a clear path toward VP of Architecture. **Key Responsibilities:** **Technical Leadership \& Design:** * Design and guide the architecture of complex, high\-scale systems built on .NET/C\#, Azure, Angular, and SQL Server. * Serve as the escalation point for complex production and performance issues, leading root cause analysis and defining preventive measures. * Conduct architecture and code reviews to ensure scalability, security, and maintainability. * Define and evolve architectural standards, patterns, and reusable frameworks across development teams. * Lead modernization efforts, including cloud migration, legacy re\-architecture, and microservices adoption. **Strategy \& Risk:** * Partner with the CIO and IT leadership to shape multi\-year technology roadmaps. * Evaluate emerging technologies, tools, and industry trends, including AI, and recommend adoption where they drive business value. * Assess enterprise\-level risks related to platform stability, vendor dependencies, and technical debt. **Collaboration \& Mentorship:** * Mentor senior engineers and architects across teams. * Explain technical tradeoffs clearly to both engineering teams and executive audiences. * Build alignment across teams to drive adoption of architectural standards. **Required Qualifications:** * 10\+ years in software engineering and architecture, with deep, current expertise in .NET/C\#, Angular, and SQL Server. * Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including App Service, Azure Functions (including Durable Functions), Azure Container Apps, and Azure Service Bus. * Deep SQL Server expertise in schema design, performance tuning, and query optimization. * Strong application security knowledge, including OWASP, Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2\.0, and JWT. * Solid understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines. * Proven track record designing and troubleshooting complex, distributed, high\-availability systems. * Ability to go deep technically (debugging, code review, architecture diagrams) and communicate effectively at the executive level. * Experience mentoring engineers and serving as a trusted technical authority across teams. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with microservices and containers, including Kubernetes and AKS. * Strong command of distributed system design patterns, such as Saga, CQRS, Circuit Breaker, and Façade. * Experience with AI tools, agentic workflows, and workflow automation. * Experience in a regulated or compliance\-heavy environment. * Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or TOGAF. **Why This Role:** This is a high\-visibility position with direct influence over the organization's technology direction. Reporting to the VP of Architecture with a dotted line to the CIO, you will shape how our core platforms are built and evolve. The role offers a clear growth path toward VP of Architecture. \***QUALIFIED CANDIDATE WILL BE LOCAL TO KANSAS CITY MO, OR WILLING TO RELOCATE.\*** \#IPFSUS

jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** At **In Tandem**, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods. We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments. If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter. As a **Staff\+ Builder**, you're on the frontier of continuously redefining how we deliver software and exercise judgement in a constantly evolving landscape — a true AI\-native builder expanding products and how they get built. Some of the best work here starts with no brief, no team and no playbook. We want someone who sees that as the appeal: who takes an idea from zero to one and cares personally whether it gets traction. This role exists to bring that way of working into In Tandem, wherever the organization needs it most. This is an evergreen role. We will shape the specific team and scope with you as we learn where your strengths meet the most important opportunities across our products and platform. As we move through conversations, we will discuss the concrete problem area, collaborators, and expectations for the opening we are considering together.### **What you will do:** * **Seek out problems worth building for.** Talk with users, learn from support and product data, and pay attention to changes in our markets. Turn those signals into a clear view of what matters, then take initiative inside shared priorities, and bring partners along as you learn. * **Take it from zero to one.** Start where there is no structure. Get a first version in front of real users quickly, find out whether anyone cares, and do the unglamorous work that earns early traction. Own the outcome, not just the code. * **Carry useful work into production.** Shape a focused first version, build it, and learn from real use. Define how you will judge success before you build, then use the evidence to improve, expand, or stop the work. * **Raise the pace and quality of engineering.** Identify places where an AI\-enabled workflow can shorten the path from idea to shipped software. Build the tools, context, checks, and feedback loops that let other engineers use it with confidence. * **Own the hard decisions.** Move work forward when requirements are incomplete, make your reasoning visible, and bring consequential tradeoffs to the right partners. Choose when to prototype, when to invest in durable architecture, and how to verify that a system is correct, safe, and useful. * **Connect the pieces.** Work across product and engineering boundaries. Bring depth in a core platform and enough range across APIs, web, mobile, and infrastructure to help a feature succeed end to end. * **Make others stronger.** Share working examples, explain tradeoffs clearly, invite criticism, and help teams adopt what proves effective. ### **What strong work could look like:** The shape of the work will depend on the team. Examples include:* Recognizing a recurring difficulty in a family workflow, validating it with users and partners, and shipping a focused improvement across client and service boundaries. * Launching something small with no existing team or process, getting it to its first real users, and iterating on their feedback until it was adopted or you chose to stop. * Turning a promising agent prototype into a reliable engineering workflow with evaluation, tests, observability, and clear human review points. * Removing a recurring bottleneck in delivery so teams can make more high\-quality changes with less coordination. * Connecting an emerging user or market need to our product strategy, testing the opportunity with a small build, and using the result to decide whether it deserves more investment. These are examples of the work this role might own, not claims that those projects are planned or assigned. ### **What you bring:** * Staff\-level impact as a hands\-on engineer: you have shaped technical direction, built important systems, and helped other people deliver stronger work. * An owner's mindset. You've started something with little structure, such as a product, feature, internal tool, open\-source project or company. You stayed with it through the early phase until it found users or you learned it wouldn't. * Evidence that you can move from an uncertain problem to a useful result. You know how to test a premise with a prototype and how to recognize when a prototype needs stronger engineering before it can be trusted in production. * Product judgment and curiosity about users and markets. You can explain why a problem mattered, how you chose it with others, and what changed for users or the business because of what you built. * Practical fluency with AI\-assisted development. You have used models or agents to build real software or workflows, and you can explain where they helped, where they failed, and how you checked the result. * Strong judgment about architecture, quality, security, and user experience. You know which decisions need close attention and which can be accelerated. * Depth in at least one engineering area, with the curiosity and fundamentals to work effectively across the stack. * Low ego, high integrity, and a habit of making your reasoning visible so others can learn from and improve it. **What will stand out** Show us a piece of work you helped take from an uncertain opportunity to a useful result. If it started from zero, tell us what you did to get the first users and what you did when nobody was available to help. What user or market signal made the problem worth pursuing? How did you choose the direction with your partners? What did you build yourself, what reached production, and how do you know it made a difference? If AI or agents played a part, tell us what you delegated, how you evaluated the output, and what you changed when the first approach fell short. A strong account of a failed experiment and the judgment it sharpened is welcome. You may have built that work in a product company, a small team, open source, or a path that does not fit a conventional résumé. The evidence matters more than a particular employer name or tool list. **Why Join?** *We’re redefining family technology.* In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods. *Scale meets startup energy.* With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day. *Purpose\-driven. Performance\-focused. People\-first.* Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem\-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters. **How We Support You:*** Medical: In Tandem pays 100% of the premium for employees AND 99% for all additional family members * 401k: Up to a 4% match with immediate vesting * Paid leave for all new parents * Learning \& Development stipend for employees * Paid Time Off: 11 Holidays \+ Winter Break (3 Days) \+ Volunteer Time Off (1 Day) \+ Floating Holiday (1 Day) * Personal Time Off: 15 days for 0\-1 years of employment \+ 20 days for 1\-3 years of employment * Supportive and flexible working environment – work from anywhere! **Come As You Are**! In Tandem provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.### **About In Tandem** We believe technology can champion deeper connections within families, strengthen bonds, and improve communication. We're building solutions that foster connection, organization, and peace\-of\-mind throughout key stages and milestones of family life.

jobs.title: Sr. Frontend Engineer / Team Lead
jobs.description: As a Sr. frontend Engineer or Team Lead at Infotech, you'll play a key role in modernizing the products behind how our nation's roads and infrastructure are built. Specifically working to help evolve a desktop application to a web\-based experience. You'll inherit an established UX/UI foundation and help evolve it into a faster, more accessible, more consistent experience for our customers. ### **Who we are looking for** You'll use frontend engineering best practices to turn design artifacts into polished, accessible interfaces across our commercial product applications. You understand the business your code supports, and you execute at a high level. Beyond writing clean, testable code, you'll work with peers to evolve our architecture across full stack and split stack applications, so solutions stay practical, maintainable, and aligned with product goals. You're also collaborative and communicative, and you're comfortable working with AI tooling. We're looking for people with an AI\-first mindset who see these tools as a natural part of how great software gets built. At the Team Lead level, you'll also guide the direction of the modernization effort, help set standards for the team, and support the growth of the engineers around you. ### **What it's like to be an engineer on our frontend team** **Our vision** We build software that makes our customers' jobs easier, faster, and less complicated. We do this by learning their challenges, solving problems in thoughtful ways, and always looking for ways to improve. **Our culture** We're a close\-knit group of curious, talented people who care about the work we do and the people we work with. On our team, you'll find that we are: * Curious and open. We ask questions, explore options, and stay open to new ideas. * Creative and lighthearted. We believe work is better with a little fun. * Relaxed and approachable while also being ambitious and technically sharp. * Focused on our customers and driven to solve real problems. * Empowering and supportive. We succeed by helping each other succeed. * Energized and communicative. We value clear, open collaboration and trust. * Always evolving. jobs.description: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non\-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions\-driven, passionate change\-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world\-wide for a better future. **Job Background / Overview** The IRC is actively investing in enterprise AI to improve the speed, quality, and scale of its programs and operations. As the organization expands its use of AI platforms, including tools from Anthropic, OpenAI, and integrated data environments, the IT department is building dedicated technical capacity to keep these systems running reliably, securely, and effectively. The IRC is investing in enterprise AI to improve the speed, quality, and scale of its programs and operations. As that investment grows, so does the need for someone to own the technical layer underneath it: the systems, integrations, and infrastructure that make AI tools work at scale. The AI Platform Engineer is that person. This is a technical operations role, not a user\-facing one. This role is responsible for keeping the IRC's enterprise AI environment running managing platform configurations and API access, building and maintaining integrations between AI tools and IRC systems, writing scripts and automations, and serving as the technical point of contact for data engineering and InfoSec. Day\-to\-day, this person is more likely to be reading logs, troubleshooting a broken pipeline, or pushing a configuration change than answering questions from end users. The role works in close coordination with the AI Platform Support Director, who owns vendor relationships, licensing, and adoption strategy. This role owns the technical execution underneath that, ensuring the systems are reliable, observable, and properly connected to the rest of the IRC's data and operational environment. **Major Responsibilities** **AI Systems Administration \& Operations (40%)** * Serve as primary technical administrator across IRC enterprise AI environments, currently including Anthropic (Claude) and OpenAI platform deployments * Manage user access, API key governance, workspace configurations, and environment\-level settings across AI platforms * Monitor system health, usage patterns, and API performance across AI tools; triage and resolve operational issues as they arise * Maintain and improve observability across AI systems * Tracking uptime, error rates, token consumption, and integration reliability * Oversee and document configuration changes, environment updates, and deployment procedures across managed platforms * Support responsible use by flagging anomalous usage patterns and coordinating with InfoSec on policy adherence and access controls **Integrations \& Technical Implementation (35%)** * Coordinate with the DevOps, SW Engineering and Data Engineering team(s) on deployment processes, environment access, and infrastructure dependencies required to build and maintain AI integrations * Follow established change management procedures for all configuration changes, environment updates, and integration deployments, including documentation, testing, and appropriate approvals before pushing to production * Develop lightweight scripts, connectors, and automations to support AI\-assisted workflows across teams, primarily in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript * Troubleshoot integration failures, data flow issues, and API connectivity problems across the AI ecosystem * Collaborate with the data engineering team on AI/KM pipeline work, including vector store ingestion, retrieval configuration, and source data connections * Contribute to technical design discussions with engineering partners, translating operational requirements into implementable solutions * Maintain technical documentation for all integrations, including architecture notes, runbooks, and dependency maps **Monitoring, Resource Optimization \& InfoSec Liaison (15%)** * Track and report on AI resource utilization across platforms, identifying opportunities to reduce waste and improve cost efficiency in coordination with the AI * Serve as the technical point of contact with the InfoSec team on matters related to AI system security, data handling, access controls, and compliance requirements * Support risk assessments and security reviews for new AI tools or integrations by providing accurate technical context on system behavior and data flows * Contribute to the development of technical SOPs and be , and embedding workflows * Experience working with Databricks or comparable data/ML platforms is a strong plus **Integration \& Development** * Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript for scripting, automation, and lightweight integration work * Experience building and maintaining REST API integrations, including authentication patterns, webhook handling, and error management * Comfort reading and working within existing codebases without requiring significant architectural guidance * Familiarity with version control (Git) and standard deployment practices for scripts and integrations **Systems Administration \& Monitoring** * Experience monitoring distributed systems or SaaS platforms, including setting up alerting, reviewing logs, and diagnosing performance or availability issues * Familiarity with usage/cost monitoring for cloud or API\-based services * Comfort operating in live production environments where reliability and data integrity are critical **Security \& Compliance** * Working knowledge of information security principles as they apply to SaaS and API\-based systems: access controls, credential management, data handling, and audit logging * Ability to engage constructively with InfoSec teams, providing clear technical context to support reviews and risk assessments **Collaboration \& Communication** * Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical colleagues and program staff * Experience contributing to cross\-functional teams alongside product, engineering, and operations stakeholders * Strong documentation habits: runbooks, SOPs, architecture notes, and internal guides **Working Environment** This role is remote, with the possibility of in\-person work depending on location. Stakeholders are located across multiple time zones (GMT\-8 to GMT\+3\), which may require occasional early or late meetings. **Compensation:** ($88,277 \- $102,451/annual). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements **Professional Standards:** All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way \- Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients. Cookies: https://careers.rescue.org/us/en/cookiesettings **Benefits:** IRC offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package. Highlights include 10 paid sick leave, 10 U.S. holidays, 20\-25 generous paid time off based on role and tenure, medical insurance starting at $163/month, dental starting at $6\.50/month, and vision starting at $5/month, flexible spending accounts (healthcare, dependent care, and commuter), a 403(b) retirement savings plan with employer match (immediate vesting) along with a non\-elective employer contribution based on age and years of service (3\-year vesting), disability and life insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering confidential counseling and support services for employees and their families. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. IRC considers all applicants on the basis of merit without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. \#LI\-1

jobs.title: Ashly Audio Engineering - DSP Engineer

Since 1972, JAM has grown to be one of the largest distributors of consumer electronic goods, pro\-audio equipment, and musical instruments. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing digital signal processing (DSP) solutions across a variety of hardware and software platforms. You will play a key role in evaluating platform options, optimizing system performance, and ensuring consistent audio quality across our product portfolio. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about professional audio technology and enjoys working in a collaborative, innovative, and team\-oriented environment. Key Responsibilities **Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:** * Port existing DSP algorithms and control architectures to new products and hardware platforms. * Maintain and support DSP firmware for legacy DSP core architectures. * Design and develop new DSP algorithms to enhance audio quality, system performance, and functionality. * Assist with electronic hardware design, particularly circuits related to DSP system boot\-up and TDM audio clocking. * Contribute to embedded system development projects as required. * Collaborate with engineering teams to define and implement system integration requirements. * Work closely with Technical Support and Quality Assurance teams to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve DSP\-related issues. * Create and maintain technical documentation, including code documentation, flow diagrams, and design specifications. * Follow coding standards and best practices to ensure maintainable, scalable, and reliable software solutions. Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Strong understanding of digital signal processing (DSP) principles, including adaptive filtering techniques. * Experience with Analog Devices SHARC processors, Assembly language programming, and VisualDSP\+\+ or CrossCore development environments. * Proficiency in C, C\+\+, Python, and MATLAB/Octave. * In\-depth knowledge of audio DSP applications and audio signal processing. * Experience with version control systems such as Git and Bitbucket. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative engineering team. Preferred Qualifications * Experience designing firmware and hardware for complex embedded systems. * Familiarity with audio networking, professional audio systems, and related technologies. * Hands\-on experience with hardware\-level troubleshooting and embedded product development. About Ashly Audio Ashly Audio, a division of JAM Industries, has been designing and manufacturing professional audio equipment since 1974\. jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **Description:** AI Cloud Engineer \- RTH **Location:** Hybrid \| Experience: 3\-5 years \| Function: AI Engineering \& Cloud Platforms ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a GenAI Cloud Engineer to build and deploy enterprise\-scale agentic AI solutions that support complex business workflows, decision support, operational intelligence, customer engagement, and other signal\-to\-action use cases across the enterprise. This is a hands\-on engineering role responsible for designing, developing, and delivering production\-grade AI agents using AWS Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, enterprise data products, semantic layers, and governed cloud\-native architectures. You will implement agent runtimes, orchestration patterns, memory, tool integration, observability, evaluation, and guardrail capabilities while partnering with architects, data teams, product owners, and Responsible AI stakeholders. The ideal candidate has recent experience building enterprise agents, agentic RAG, multi\-agent workflows, and secure integrations with business systems in regulated environments. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Develop cloud\-native microservices, APIs, and event\-driven components using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, FastAPI, AWS Lambda, EventBridge, and related AWS services. Build and deploy enterprise AI agents using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Bedrock models, AgentCore runtime services, AgentCore Gateway, agent registry patterns, and agent\-to\-agent communication where appropriate. Implement data ingestion, semantic retrieval, embeddings, vector search, knowledge graph, and memory pipelines that allow agents to consume certified data products, Denodo/USBIE sources, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and governed enterprise content. Develop intent classification, tool routing, workflow orchestration, guardrails, policy checks, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and fail\-safe escalation patterns for agentic applications. Integrate agents with enterprise systems and workflows such as Salesforce/Elevate, Service Platform, CaseView, Genesys, MAC/MPI, USBIE, Denodo, APIs, MCP tools, and event streams. Build evaluation, monitoring, tracing, and operational controls for agents, including quality metrics, hallucination and safety checks, latency, cost, feedback loops, and incident response readiness. Uphold enterprise standards for application security, IAM/agent identity, data protection, auditability, Responsible AI, ADS/data\-product governance, observability, and production reliability. Stay current with AWS AgentCore, Bedrock, agent frameworks, model evaluation approaches, memory architectures, semantic data products, and enterprise agentic AI patterns. LEADERSHIP, MENTORING \& INFLUENCE (ONLY FOR SENIOR 5\-8 YEARS OF EXPERIENCE) **Lead a workstream:** Take technical ownership of a defined feature area or service \- from design through production support \- coordinating a small group of engineers where needed. **Mentor engineers:** Guide associate and mid\-level engineers through code review, pairing, and design feedback; help them build GenAI and cloud skills. **Contribute to architecture:** Participate actively in design reviews, propose solution options with clear trade\-offs, and help shape the patterns and standards the team adopts. **Influence through delivery:** Partner directly with product owners, architects, and business stakeholders to refine requirements and build credibility through working software. **Improve the team:** Identify and drive improvements in engineering practices, tooling, reusable components, and documentation; share knowledge through demos and internal write\-ups. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 3\-5 years of software engineering experience, with hands\-on delivery of cloud\-native applications or AI/ML\-enabled platforms. Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, including API development, asynchronous processing, test automation, and production debugging. Experience developing microservices, APIs, event\-driven workflows, distributed applications, and secure integrations with enterprise systems. Hands\-on experience with AWS cloud services, including serverless, container, messaging/eventing, IAM, observability, and cloud\-native deployment patterns. Recent experience building enterprise GenAI or agentic AI solutions, including agents, agentic RAG, multi\-step orchestration, chat experiences, or signal\-to\-action workflows. Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, or comparable enterprise LLM and agent runtime platforms. Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, Strands, MCP, A2A protocols, tool\-use frameworks, or comparable multi\-agent orchestration patterns. Experience with model evaluation, prompt engineering, agent quality testing, feedback loops, LLM\-as\-judge patterns, and reliability measurement. Experience with data ingestion, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, knowledge bases, memory stores, and retrieval patterns for structured and unstructured data. Experience implementing AI guardrails, safety controls, intent classification, routing logic, access controls, audit logging, evaluation, and human escalation paths. Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, application security, Responsible AI expectations, data governance, scalability, resilience, and production operations. Experience mentoring engineers, leading technical delivery of a defined workstream, and collaborating with architects, product owners, data teams, and platform teams. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with event\-driven and serverless architectures using AWS EventBridge, MSK, SNS/SQS, Step Functions, Lambda, API Gateway, and container services. Experience delivering AI or data products in financial services, insurance, or other regulated environments with privacy, compliance, audit, and control requirements. Familiarity with enterprise data products, semantic layers, Denodo, USBIE, ADS certification, knowledge graphs, Neptune/OpenSearch, and governed data consumption patterns. Experience integrating agents with CRM, service, telephony, document, workflow, or engagement platforms such as Salesforce, Genesys, Service Platform, MAC/MPI, or similar systems. IDEAL CANDIDATE You are a strong software engineer with recent enterprise GenAI and agentic AI experience who enjoys turning ambiguous business use cases into reliable, governed, production\-ready agents. You understand that CNS agents must combine data products, signals, deterministic rules, LLM reasoning, memory, tool use, observability, and human controls. You can work across cloud architecture, data integration, AI orchestration, and production operations while raising the technical bar for the team. **LEVELING:** SENIOR VS. DEV Senior GenAI Cloud Engineer \- 5–8 years. Owns architecture and technical direction for enterprise agentic AI capabilities, sets standards for AgentCore, data, governance, observability, and multi\-agent patterns, leads complex multi\-team initiatives, mentors senior engineers, and influences cross\-team design decisions. GenAI Cloud Engineer \- 3\+ years. Hands\-on technical contributor. Leads implementation of specific agent workstreams, contributes to AgentCore architecture and delivery patterns, mentors associate and mid\-level engineers, and influences within the team through working software. **Rate:** $60\-65/hr \#LI\-PP1

Through our award\-winning portfolio of commercial and residential brands, we serve customers in more than 60 countries worldwide. **MISSION STATEMENT** To delight and excite our customers through truly innovative products, unsurpassed quality, and best\-in\-class customer experience provided by a world\-class organization. **POSITION OVERVIEW** Under the direction of the Engineering Manager – KT Innovation, the Software Engineer II will conduct engineering research and development projects to support Key Technology (KT) and New Product Development (NPD) of Fitness Equipment. The role is considered a generalist and spans the full range of software found in connected fitness products, from embedded firmware and device software to mobile, desktop, web, and cloud applications. The Software Engineer II owns features independently within a project. This position requires a creative and flexible individual who can stretch to support the specific needs of the development situation and manufacturing environment. The successful candidate will be willing to move fast, fail early, iterate, and consistently deliver. This is a non\-supervisory position. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Understand and integrate potential new technologies, features, modalities/ergonomics into Johnson products * Design, implement, test, and debug software across the product stack, from embedded firmware to mobile, web, and cloud applications * Create proof\-of\-concepts (PoC) and partner with the Product Management team for review and refinement * Evaluate and test for viability and risk mitigation * Feed new product development by successfully and smoothly transitioning PoC’s to engineering teams based on Asia sourcing and manufacturing * Develop and document design and specifications * Participate in code reviews * Contribute to new intellectual property and intellectual property workarounds * Other projects as assigned *Marginal Job Functions:* * Other projects as needed. Requirements: **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** *Education:* * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering or equivalent experience *Required Experience:* * Typically, 2\-5 years of professional software development experience, or equivalent * Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C\+\+, C\#, Java, Kotlin, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript * Understanding of object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns * Version control (i.e. Git) * Write clear technical documentation * Application development in mobile (Android/iOS), desktop, or web * Continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) * Strong and creative problem\-solving skills * Ability to work well with numerous diverse groups and individuals **BONUS QUALIFICATIONS:** * Exposure to embedded systems and development in C/C\+\+ * Linux application development, driver development, and OS building * Automated testing and unit testing * Development in React native or React web * Exposure to cloud services * Exposure to machine learning * Exposure to single\-board computers (i.e. Raspberry Pi) * Ability to interact with, program, and debug physical hardware * Basic networking knowledge (ports, sockets, REST) **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS \& WORK ENVIRONMENT** *Standard Office Environment* This position operates in a typical office environment with usually moderate noise levels and requires regular use of a computer, telephone, and standard office equipment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and use hands to handle or touch objects, tools, or controls; frequently required to talk or hear; and occasionally required to stand, walk, reach, stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. Specific vision abilities include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. Occasional domestic and international travel may be required, along with some evenings or early mornings for international conference calls or events. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. *Physical Requirements:* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods, use hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, phone, and other standard office equipment. Will be required to communicate both verbally and in writing, view a computer monitor, and perform tasks requiring close vision with the ability to adjust focus. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, reach, bend, stoop, kneel, or crouch to access files, supplies, or other office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull materials weighing up to 20 pounds. Repetitive hand, wrist, and finger motion is required for keyboarding and other clerical tasks. **BENEFITS \& PERKS** * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Company\-paid life insurance and AD\&D coverage * 401(k) retirement savings plan * Paid time off (PTO) * FSA and HSA options * Employee product discounts, wellness resources, and employee assistance programs *Equal Opportunity Employer, including Protected Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities.*

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer - El Paso, TX
jobs.description: KECH is a growing small business looking for the best and the brightest. We love what we do and that passion shows through every day at KECH. Please review our open job positions below for career opportunities. KECH is always looking for highly qualified, talented candidates for customer service positions. If you are interested in applying to KECH, please complete our Job Application process. As new positions open, we will set up interviews with candidates who have completed their application and meet the qualifications for the open positions. Let us know if you have any career\-related questions. **KECH Job Application Process** -------------------------------- To be considered for a position with KECH, ***applicants must meet the following minimum requirements***: * **LOCATION**: Reside in one of the approved hiring locations (this can differ based on the job position you are applying for) * **JOB QUALIFICATION**: Meet the job’s basic qualifications, as outlined in the job description * **APPLICATION**: Submit an online Job Application * **ASSESSMENT TESTS**: Complete all pre\-hire Assessment Tests (if required by the position) * **INTERNET SPEED**: Run an Internet Speed Test to verify you have a stable internet connection * **TYPING PROFICIENCY**: Take an online typing test to verify your typing speed/accuracy * **RESUME**: Upload an up\-to\-date resume ### **Steps for Applying for a Position with KECH** **Step 1: Review Job Postings** Carefully review our open job postings (see list below), as some positions have ***state residency restrictions***. Ensure you are applying for a position for which you **meet all qualifications**. **Step 2: Complete the KECH Job Application** Submit a KECH Job Application for the desired position. See Job Postings section below to start your application. **Please use a DESKTOP PC to submit your application.** The Internet Speed Test and Typing test must be done on a DESKTOP PC and ***not a mobile device***. **Step 3: Take three Assessments Tests (if required)** Depending on the position, you may be required to complete three short assessment tests. **Step 4: Run an Internet Speed Test** You are required to test your internet connection (remote work may require a fast internet connection). **Do not use a mobile device for this test.** **Step 5: Take a Typing Proficiency Test** You are required to take an online Typng Test to check your typing speed and accuracy. **Do not use a mobile device for this test.** **Step 6: Upload Your Resume** You are required to upload an up\-to\-date resume (in PDF format). **If your application is incomplete (e.g., missing a resume, typing test, etc.) 48 hours after submission, it will be automatically archived and will no longer be eligible for consideration. You can check the** **completion status of your application** **at any time.** - **Senior Full Stack Software Engineer \- El Paso, TX** **Job Description/Requirements** KECH is hiring a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to take technical ownership of business\-critical applications and help lead ongoing modernization and new software development. This is a hands\-on role for an experienced engineer who can maintain production systems, make sound architecture decisions, strengthen security and reliability, and use AI\-assisted development within a disciplined DevSecOps delivery process. The initial assignment will focus on supporting established applications and advancing newer solutions. The engineer will also design, build, integrate, and support future software products and applications as business priorities evolve. This work requires close collaboration with the broader development team on planning, technical decisions, dependencies, code reviews, knowledge sharing, and integrated delivery. The right candidate can work across existing and emerging technologies while improving architecture, testing, documentation, maintainability, and operations. We do not expect candidates to have expert\-level experience with every technology listed. Strong candidates will bring deep experience in production web application development, demonstrated ability to work across legacy and modern platforms, and the capacity to learn unfamiliar tools quickly. **What You Will Do** * Own the maintenance and improvement of current PHP and MySQL applications, including defect resolution, performance tuning, controlled feature changes, and analysis of existing code, databases, integrations, scheduled processes, and user workflows. * Lead the incremental modernization of application capabilities using a modern React and TypeScript stack. Current technologies include Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, and Tailwind CSS. * Design maintainable application components, responsive and accessible user interfaces, APIs, data models, migration routines, and integration patterns. * Plan and execute database changes and data migrations with appropriate validation, reconciliation, backup, recovery, and rollback procedures. * Cre t tools for code analysis, implementation, testing, documentation, or code review, with effective human oversight. * Experience diagnosing production issues across application, database, and integration layers, with demonstrated technical ownership and the ability to deliver with limited supervision. * Strong collaboration, communication, and mentoring ability, including the ability to explain technical decisions to nontechnical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience leading a PHP\-to\-Node.js migration, legacy application modernization, or comparable platform transition. * Experience establishing unit, integration, end\-to\-end, and characterization tests for an existing application. * Experience with one or more of the following: Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, or reusable component\-based design systems. * Experience with one or more delivery and operations capabilities, such as GitHub Actions, containers, infrastructure as code, advanced observability, or detailed security\-scanning platforms. * Experience with authentication, authorization, multifactor authentication, multi\-tenant application design, or regulated business data. * Experience with Antigravity or another AI coding assistant, agentic development tool, or automated code review platform. * Experience administering or developing WordPress websites. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Technology Environment** PHP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Prisma, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, GitHub, GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD tooling, automated testing, security scanning, AI\-assisted development tools, and potentially WordPress. **What Success Looks Like** * The current application remains stable and supportable while undocumented dependencies and high\-risk technical issues are reduced. * Critical system knowledge is converted into clear architecture, deployment, operating, and support documentation. * Modernization work is delivered in controlled increments that preserve business behavior and data integrity. * Code review, automated testing, release discipline, and security practices become consistent parts of the engineering process. * The DevSecOps pipeline provides repeatable builds, automated quality and security checks, controlled deployments, traceability, and reliable rollback procedures. * AI\-assisted development improves delivery speed and documentation without weakening code ownership, review standards, data protection, or production controls. **How To Apply** Apply through this posting with a resume that describes your role in supporting a production application and leading or contributing to a significant modernization or platform migration. Please identify the technologies involved and the decisions for which you were personally responsible. **Pay Range: $125,000 \- $160,000 depending on experience** ### **Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled** KECH is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel welcome and respected. **State Restrictions** You must live in one of the following states to apply for this position: **NM, TX** ### **Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled** KECH is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel welcome and respected.

jobs.title: Staff Solutions Engineer - AI Specialist
jobs.description: **Are you ready to unlock intelligence?** If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box \- we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. **About the Role:** Are you ready to sit at the epicenter of the API and AI connectivity revolution? As a Staff Solutions Engineer at Kong, you won’t just be selling a platform — you’ll be a trusted technical advisor helping the world’s most innovative enterprises architect secure, scalable API ecosystems while navigating the transition into the agentic AI era. Kong sits at the intersection of API management and AI connectivity, and you’ll be the person who makes that story real for customers. **What you’ll be doing:** ------------------------- * Support field sales in helping customers understand the value of the Kong API and AI connectivity platform. * Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer requirements and map them to Kong solutions, from initial product reviews through to production. * Support POCs throughout the entire evaluation process, owning technical validation and stakeholder alignment. * Ensure customer satisfaction across your assigned set of accounts. * Collaborate with support, product, and engineering teams to advocate for customer needs. * Create technical documentation for DevOps, implementations, and services engagements. * Lead and support API Management and AI Goverance evaluations, including scoping API/AI use cases, LLM traffic management, and governance requirements. * Deliver demonstrations of Kong’s API \& AI governance and agentic connectivity capabilities, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) governance, semantic caching, prompt guardrails, and shadow AI detection. * Run API \& AI\-focused Technical Feasibility Workshops (TFWs) to validate Kong’s fit for modern and/or AI/agentic architectures. * Own the technical strategy for complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise deals from qualification through close. * Mentor and coach junior SEs on technical skills, discovery methods, and deal strategy. * Drive thought leadership by authoring technical blogs, hosting webinars, speaking at industry events and conferences such as AWS re:Invent, Google Next, API \& AI summit, and regional events * Influence product direction by synthesizing customer feedback and market signals into actionable input for the product team. * And any additional tasks required by manager. **What you’ll bring:** ---------------------- * 7\+ years of software engineering and/or solutions engineering experience at a SaaS, open source, or enterprise software company. * Proven track record owning complex, enterprise\-level deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders. * Experience mentoring or coaching other SEs or technical team members. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native platforms. * Experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and API security patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS). * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tooling — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent is required. * Working knowledge of AI/LLM architectures, including model routing, rate limiting, semantic caching, and prompt governance. * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic AI patterns. * Solid understanding of cloud computing trends and open source business models. * Strong listener and communicator — you can confidently lead discussions with engineers, architects, and executives. * Enthusiasm for working in a high\-profile, fast\-paced environment at the intersection of API and AI connectivity. **About Kong:** Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500 and AI\-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com. Compensation Range: $222K \- $250K

jobs.title: Principal Software Deployment Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About KPI Solutions** KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e\-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. From initial design through go\-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients. **Position Summary** The Principal **Software Deployment Engineer** leads the teams responsible for getting customers live and keeping them successful. This role owns the full post\-sale lifecycle: software installation, system commissioning and acceptance, ongoing technical support, and end\-user training. The Senior Manager builds scalable processes, develops high\-performing teams, and ensures every deployment is delivered on time, on budget, and to a standard that drives adoption, satisfaction, and renewal. time\-to\-value * Manage project schedules, resources, and risks across multiple concurrent customer implementations * Coordinate with Sales, Engineering, Product, and IT/Security teams to ensure smooth handoffs and technical readiness * Define and enforce commissioning standards, including configuration validation, integration testing, and go\-live readiness criteria * Own customer acceptance testing and sign\-off processes * Ensure documentation (as\-built configurations, test results, handover packages) is complete and accurate * Lead go\-live support and post\-deployment stabilization * Track and report KPIs: implementation cycle time, on\-time go\-live rate, resolution times, backlog, utilization, and training completion * Serve as executive escalation point for critical customer role + Proven track record managing complex, multi\-site enterprise software deployments + Strong understanding of project management methodologies and tools + Experience with ticketing tools (e.g., 10 Holidays) * Training \& Development **Why KPI Solutions?** At KPI Solutions, you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. jobs.title: Senior Android Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Description:** We are seeking an experienced Android Full\-Stack Engineer to join our platform stability team. In this role, you will be responsible for diagnosing, debugging, and resolving complex Android stability issues spanning the entire Android stack both above (System Partition) and below (Vendor Partition) the Treble boundary. You will work deep within Android framework internals, reverse\-engineering issues from source code, providing technical direction for ambiguous problems, and ensuring overall platform robustness across Android version upgrades. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who thrives on solving the hardest, least\-understanding problems in the Android ecosystem. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design and develop middleware and Android background services for platform\-level functionality * Debug and reverse\-engineer complex issues directly from Android Open\-Source Project (AOSP) source code Own overall Android platform stability and reliability * Resolve Android upgrade and integration issues across releases * Diagnose and fix bugs in system server components (Activity Manager, Window Manager, Package Manager, etc.), Car Service, and Surface Flinger * Investigate and resolve black screen, boot failure, and ANR (Application Not Responding) issues 6\. Resolve and provide technical direction and root\-cause analysis for unknown or hard\-to\-reproduce issues * Address and resolve compliance test failures across CTS, VTS, ATS, and STS **Primary Skills Required:** Kotlin, C\+\+ and Java **Experience Required:** * 3\+ years of hands\-on Android platform/framework development experience. * Proven experience in designing and developing middleware and Android background services (long\-running/foreground service) that expose feature\-rich interfaces (AIDL/Binder, APIs) to applications. * Demonstrated track record of resolving complex, low\-level Android stability issues. * Experience contributing to or modifying AOSP source code * Proven experience working across the full Android stack (framework, native services, vendor layers) **Additional Experience Preferred:** * Experience with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) and Car Service. * Familiarity with HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) and vendor integration. * Experience with CTS, VTS, ATS, and STS compliance frameworks. * Knowledge of Android graphics stack and display subsystems * Experience with native debugging tools (gdb, lldb, perfetto, systrace, logcat analysis). * Familiarity with Android build systems (Soong/Make) and partition architecture. * Experience working with SoC/silicon vendors on platform bring\-up **Additional Context for Suppliers:** * This role requires a deep\-dive, problem\-solving mindset and the ability to operate independently on ambiguous, high\-impact issues. * The ideal candidate is comfortable being the technical authority for the most challenging stability problems and can provide direction for other engineers. * Experience in the automotive or embedded Android domain is a strong plus given to our focus on system server, car service and platform stability.

jobs.title: Frontend / WebGL Graphics Engineer
jobs.description: About LVIS LVIS Corporation is on a mission to revolutionize the entire continuum of neurological care by enabling AI driven digital analytics to help physicians accelerate patient throughput by transforming signal analysis and visualization. The LVIS software, NeuroMatch®, utilizes brainwave signals from traditional EEG systems to enable AI driven algorithms to perform EEG source localization, spike and seizure event detection. We have an international team with our headquarters located in Palo Alto, California, USA and we have an office in Gangnam, Seoul, South Korea. We are looking for talented individuals to join us in transforming the neurology health care industry. About the Role NeuroMatch renders large volumes of EEG and neurological data through interactive 2D and 3D visualizations in the browser. This includes a custom, low level WebGL2 rendering engine for real time signal and waveform visualization, with GPU accelerated signal processing (GPGPU), plus a Three.js based 3D brain visualization layer, both built on top of our Vue frontend. We're looking for a senior WebGL / graphics engineer to take ownership of this visualization technology: extending the custom rendering engine, maintaining the 3D brain visualization layer, and solving the GPU performance and large dataset problems that come with continuously streamed clinical data. You'll work closely with frontend engineers, neuroscientists, and clinical specialists to translate scientific algorithms and reference implementations into fast, precise, production visualization Software. **Requirements** Own and extend our custom WebGL2 rendering engine used for real time EEG waveform and signal visualization. * Maintain and build out our Three.js based 3D brain visualization components (source localization, spike and seizure networks, and related views). * Design and implement GPU accelerated (GPGPU) signal processing techniques for in browser filtering and data preparation. * Optimize GPU and CPU performance, memory use, and rendering throughput for large, continuously streamed datasets. * Write and optimize GLSL shaders for custom rendering and data processing pipelines. * Integrate visualization components into our Vue based frontend application. * Collaborate with neuroscientists and clinical specialists to implement algorithms and reference implementations as production software. * Profile and resolve rendering performance issues, memory issues, visual artifacts, and browser/GPU compatibility problems. * Contribute to frontend architecture, code quality, and technical design reviews. Basic Qualifications * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with substantial hands on WebGL 2\.0 / GLSL development (not just framework usage). * Strong JavaScript (ES6\) / TypeScript skills. * Direct experience writing and debugging GLSL shaders, and working with GPU buffers, textures, and render pipelines. * Experience building and maintaining complex, interactive, browser based applications handling large or streaming datasets. * BS or higher degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Three.js and Vue.js. * Hands on experience with digital signal processing, such as digital filter design or noise reduction. * Familiarity with GPGPU techniques using WebGL, and with floating point standards such as IEEE 754\. * Familiarity with OpenGL, Vulkan, Direct3D, Metal, SPIR\-V, HLSL, OpenCL, or CUDA. * Experience with WebAssembly, Web Workers, SharedArrayBuffer, or SIMD based browser performance techniques. * Experience with large scale data visualization (medical, scientific, geospatial, or financial). * Experience with Emscripten or C/C\+\+ to WebAssembly workflows. * Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, and git based code review practices. * Experience with EEG, neuroscience, or medical software is helpful but not required; our science and clinical teams provide the domain knowledge needed. **Preferred Qualifications** * Rendering large EEG waveform datasets smoothly and in real time in the browser. * Visualizing neurological activity on interactive 3D brain models. * Building GPU accelerated signal processing and visualization pipelines. * Improving rendering performance and reducing memory use for long duration EEG recordings. * Building visualization tools that let physicians and researchers explore complex neurological data interactively. **Other Information** * Job type: Full\-time, On\-Site * Location : Palo Alto, CA **Benefits** * Benefits: Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision coverage. **Compensation** * Base Salary: $135,000 to $175,000 annually * Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

jobs.title: AI Residency Program, Physical Sciences
jobs.description: **Your Impact at LILA** The Lila Sciences AI Residency is a full\-time research program at the intersection of artificial intelligence and materials science. Residents join a cohort of researchers tackling open\-ended scientific challenges alongside Lila's scientists and engineers, with the option to focus on fundamental or applied research. Residencies run 6 to 12 months, with extension possible. First residencies begin in spring 2027, with rolling applications and additional intakes in fall 2027\. Residents are paired with technical mentors, receive feedback from cross\-functional teams, and work with proprietary datasets, high\-performance compute, and Lila's research infrastructure. Publishing is encouraged but not required. What matters most is pushing the frontier of scientific discovery. Priority research areas for the 2027 cohort span four domains: * **Soft matter and formulation intelligence:** composition\-process\-property modeling, representation learning for mixtures and formulations, physics\-informed and simulation\-augmented predictive models, and generative models for 3D soft\-material structures at the mesoscale and microscale (colloidal assemblies, phase\-separated domains, particle networks, film and bulk morphologies) * **Physics\-based simulation and in silico discovery:** agentic frameworks for physics\-based and multiphysics or multiscale simulations, and methods that orchestrate and bridge across simulation scales * **Chemistry\-aware AI and molecular design:** molecular representations (graphs, protein\-ligand structures, MD trajectories), chemistry\-reasoning agents, predictive models for synthesis, analysis, and purification, and experimental decision\-making under uncertainty and operational constraints * **Foundational AI for materials science:** sequential decision\-making under real\-world constraints, multimodal learning, reasoning and benchmarking, generative models and representation learning, and scientific machine learning Applications require a resume and a research proposal of up to three pages (unlimited references) outlining the project you would pursue during your residency. Submit the research proposal as your cover letter. Applications without both documents will not be considered. Optional supporting materials such as recommendation letters, publications, or research artifacts are welcome. **What You'll Be Building** * Design and execute independent research projects in AI for materials science * Pursue work in one or more of the 2027 priority research areas * Collaborate with Lila scientists and engineers on open\-science initiatives * Co\-develop novel approaches to scientific discovery with the wider team * Use Lila's datasets, compute, and infrastructure to test ambitious hypotheses * Share findings internally and externally; publication is welcome, not mandatory **What You'll Need to Succeed** * Degree in materials science, chemistry, computer science, AI/ML, physics, mathematics, or a related field (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD) * Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch * Experience working with large\-scale datasets or simulations * Familiarity with modern AI/ML architectures and training techniques * Strong research background shown through publications, thesis work, or open\-source projects **Bonus Points For** * Prior ML work in scientific domains such as materials discovery, chemistry, or simulation * Experience in one or more of the 2027 priority research areas * Open\-source contributions or collaborative research experience * Clear writing and communication on complex scientific ideas **About LILA** Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard\-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves. LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai. Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply. **We're All In** Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. With more than 45,000 AI and data professionals across the company, our AI \& Data practice brings together cutting\-edge AI technologies, deep industry experience, strategic investment, exceptional interdisciplinary talent, and a powerful ecosystem of partners to help clients scale AI with speed and confidence. **You Are** A front\-end engineer passionate about creating **human\-centered, intuitive, visually compelling, and production\-ready user experiences** for advanced Agentic AI products and solutions. You will build and evolve our **Agentic AI Studio**, a cloud\-based platform that enables users to create, customize, deploy, and manage AI agents through intuitive, no\-code experiences. You will also develop **Agentic AI\-as\-a\-Service solutions**, translating advanced AI capabilities into practical, engaging experiences that address real\-world business needs.
