practices. **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design and develop intuitive **graphical user interfaces (GUIs)** for conversational, visual, and multimodal interactions with AI agents. jobs.title: Assistant Manager Cybersecurity-Hybrid
jobs.description: Overview: If you love connecting with people and are ready to grow your career in a company that invests in your success, we’d love to meet you. Come be part of something amazing where your contributions truly matter. Where a hybrid schedule offers the perfect balance of in\-person collaboration and remote flexibility, supporting a great work\-life harmony. The **Assistant Manager, Cybersecurity Engineering** supports the Manager, Assistant CISO in designing, implementing, operating, and continuously improving Logix’s cybersecurity controls. This role is a hands\-on technical leader responsible for helping translate security strategy, architecture, risk requirements, and regulatory expectations into practical security capabilities that protect member data, employees, digital services, cloud environments, and enterprise infrastructure. The Assistant Manager provides day\-to\-day technical support across endpoint, network, identity, data, cloud, vulnerability management, detection and response, security automation, and artificial intelligence security, while acting as a backup and escalation point for cybersecurity engineers and subject matter experts reporting through the Manager, Assistant CISO. Responsibilities: * Support the design, implementation, configuration, integration, and lifecycle management of enterprise cybersecurity platforms and technical controls. * Provide hands\-on technical support for endpoint detection and response, network security, identity and privileged access management, data loss prevention, cloud security, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response, email security, and application security. * Assist with engineering standards, secure configuration baselines, reference architectures, technical procedures, runbooks, and exception requirements using secure\-by\-design and Zero Trust principles. * Provide day\-to\-day managerial direction for assigned team, including work intake, prioritization, capacity planning, technical coaching, cross\-training, performance input, documentation quality, and backup coverage for engineering subject matter experts. * Partner with Information Technology, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Networking, Cloud, Application, Data, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, and business teams to embed security into projects and technology decisions. * Support vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, threat exposure management, remediation governance, attack\-surface reduction, and risk\-based prioritization. Track findings through closure or the approved exception process. * Improve security monitoring by helping develop and tune detections, use cases, dashboards, alert thresholds, response workflows, integrations, and automated playbooks. Support measurement of control effectiveness using clear service levels, key performance indicators, and key risk indicators. * Serve as a hands\-on technical escalation point during cybersecurity incidents. Support investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, evidence preservation, lessons learned, and improvements to incident response plans and playbooks. * Evaluate security architecture and controls for cloud platforms, SaaS solutions, third parties, new products, and major technology changes. Help confirm required logging, identity, encryption, data protection, resiliency, and monitoring controls are implemented before production use. * Support relationships, service performance, technical roadmaps, and escalation paths with managed security providers and cybersecurity vendors. * Assist with regulatory examinations, internal and external audits, risk assessments, control testing, and remediation activities applicable to a federally insured credit union. * Prepare concise technical and executive\-ready updates on security posture, operational risk, incidents, vulnerabilities, project delivery, tool performance, and remediation progress. * Maintain awareness of emerging threats, attacker techniques, vulnerabilities, regulatory expectations, and technology developments. Recommend practical improvements aligned with Logix’s risk profile and business priorities. * Support the secure adoption of AI\-enabled cybersecurity capabilities for threat detection, investigation, alert triage, threat hunting, vulnerability prioritization, incident response, and analyst productivity. * Help assess and reduce risks involving generative AI, agentic AI, shadow AI, data leakage, prompt injection, insecure integrations, model and supply\-chain exposure, excessive permissions, and AI\-enabled attacks. * Assist with technical guardrails for enterprise AI use, including identity, access, data classification, logging, monitoring, human review, testing, third\-party risk, and secure configuration requirements. * Partner with governance and business stakeholders to align AI security practices with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, its Generative AI Profile, applicable financial\-services guidance, and Logix policies. * Build and maintain automation using APIs, scripting, orchestration, and workflow platforms to reduce repetitive work, improve consistency, and accelerate response while preserving human oversight for material decisions. * Review AI\-generated recommendations and automated actions for accuracy, explainability, privacy, security, bias, operational impact, and auditability before production use. * Perform other duties as assigned by the Manager, Assistant CISO or Chief Information Security Officer. Qualifications: **Education*** 4 Year / Bachelor’s Degree preferred. * Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered. **Experience*** A minimum of 5 years of progressive cybersecurity experience, including hands\-on experience supporting security engineering, security operations, major security programs, or cross\-functional technical initiatives. * 1 to 3 years of experience in financial services, credit unions, banking, or another regulated industry strongly preferred. **Knowledge, Skills \& Ability*** Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity architecture, engineering, operations, threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, identity security, data protection, and cloud security. * Working knowledge of NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2\.0, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, CIS Controls and Benchmarks, Zero Trust, MITRE ATT\&CK, PCI DSS, GLBA, NCUA requirements, and FFIEC guidance. * Ability to translate risks and regulatory requirements into clear technical controls, engineering tasks, measurable outcomes, and concise reporting. * Strong troubleshooting, systems thinking, analytical judgment, and root\-cause analysis skills across complex hybrid environments. * Ability to balance risk reduction, member protection, user experience, operational resilience, cost, and business delivery. * Experience supporting vendors, managed security providers, service levels, technical escalations, and product roadmaps. * Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with engineers, leaders, auditors, regulators, vendors, and business partners. * Ability to support incidents, competing priorities, incomplete information, and rapid changes in threats and technology. * Commitment to continuous learning, ethical use of AI, secure innovation, documentation, and knowledge sharing. **Disclaimer** *Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled* Pay Range: USD $138,953\.08 \- USD $222,324\.92 /Yr.

jobs.title: Front-End UI Developer
jobs.description: **Location:** Remote (home\-based) — occasional in\-person meetings in the Los Angeles area **Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Benefitted **About LANES** LANES is a community\-based Health Information Organization (HIO) whose mission is to transform healthcare delivery across Los Angeles County by enabling secure, cost\-effective electronic exchange of patient medical records among public and private providers and health plans. We make personal health information available when and where it's needed for patient care — safely and securely. **About the Role** We're a team of healthcare IT experts solving real\-world interoperability problems, and we're looking for a driven, detail\-oriented Front\-End UI Developer to help build the interfaces our provider and health plan partners rely on every day. You'll design and build responsive, accessible, and secure user interfaces using Angular and TypeScript, working closely with our Business Analysts to translate requirements into intuitive experiences and with our architects, DevOps, and Security Engineers to ensure everything you ship meets our standards for performance, privacy, and HIPAA compliance. This is a front\-end focused role — we have dedicated DevOps and Security teams — so your energy stays where it matters most: crafting clean, reliable, well\-tested UI that makes sensitive health data easy and safe to work with. **What You'll Do** **UI/UX Development** * Design, build, and maintain responsive, accessible front\-end applications using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS * Build and style interfaces using Bootstrap with the Falcon theme, maintaining a consistent, polished look and feel across the application * Implement reactive, data\-driven UI patterns using RxJS * Build rich data views and inputs using component libraries such as ngx\-datatable, ng\-select, and Chart.js * Translate wireframes, mockups, and business requirements into polished, production\-ready interfaces * Build reusable Angular components and maintain consistent design patterns across the application **Data Integration** * Integrate front\-end applications with backend services and REST APIs (built on Node.js/Express.js) that source data from PostgreSQL and Google BigQuery * Work with JSON and JSONata\-based data transformations when consuming and shaping API responses for the UI * Collaborate with backend and integration engineers to define clean, efficient data contracts between front\-end and API layers * Apply working knowledge of HL7 FHIR R4 resources and structures where they surface in the UI **Security \& Compliance** * Build UI features with privacy and security by design, ensuring proper handling of Protected Health Information (PHI) at every layer of the interface * Work within our SAML 2\.0 SSO authentication flow (built on node\-saml/passport\-saml) and session\-based authentication model * Support and extend our custom role\-based access control (RBAC) in the UI, ensuring users see only what their role permits * Partner with our Security Engineers on authentication, authorization, and session management best practices * Follow HIPAA requirements and internal security standards in all front\-end data handling, display, and storage decisions **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Work closely with Business Analysts to clarify requirements, refine user stories, and validate delivered features against business needs * Coordinate with DevOps Engineers on build pipelines, environment configuration, and deployment of front\-end applications * Partner with Solution Architects and backend/integration engineers to ensure front\-end designs align with overall system architecture **Testing \& Quality** * Write unit and integration tests to ensure UI reliability and catch regressions early * Conduct cross\-browser and cross\-device testing to ensure consistent experiences for all users * Participate in code reviews and contribute to front\-end coding standards and best practices **Documentation \& Agile Practice** * Document component libraries, UI patterns, and front\-end architecture decisions using tools like JIRA, Confluence, and SharePoint * Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives **What You Bring** * **3\+ years** of professional front\-end development experience, ideally within healthcare, insurance, or another regulated industry * Strong proficiency with **Angular** (v13\+), **TypeScript**, **JavaScript**, **HTML5**, and **CSS** * Experience with **Bootstrap** and theming/styling frameworks (experience with the **Falcon** theme is a plus) * Working knowledge of **RxJS** and reactive/observable\-based UI patterns * Familiarity with UI component libraries such as **ngx\-datatable**, **ng\-select**, and **Chart.js** * Comfort consuming **REST APIs** and working with **JSON**, ideally with exposure to data transformation tools like **JSONata** * Familiarity with **PostgreSQL** and/or **Google BigQuery**\-backed data, and general SQL literacy * Working knowledge of web application security best practices, with an understanding of **HIPAA** and handling sensitive/PHI data in a UI context * Exposure to **SAML 2\.0 SSO**, session\-based authentication, or role\-based access control (RBAC) patterns is a strong plus * Experience with responsive design and building accessible (WCAG\-compliant) interfaces * Proven ability to collaborate effectively with Business Analysts, architects, and engineers across security, DevOps, and backend disciplines * Strong communication skills — comfortable explaining technical trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Comfort with **npm** and the **Angular CLI** in a day\-to\-day development workflow **Nice to Have** * Experience with **HL7 FHIR** (R4\) and its representation in front\-end applications * Familiarity with **Node.js/Express.js** APIs, even if primarily consuming rather than building them * Familiarity with state management libraries (e.g., NgRx) and modern Angular build tooling * Experience with design/prototyping tools (e.g., Figma) and design systems * Familiarity with Agile frameworks and tools like JIRA, Confluence, and SharePoint * Comfort working independently in a fast\-paced, performance\-driven environment **Requirements** * Successful completion of background check and reference verification *LANES is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.* Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90064

jobs.description: Job Description Los Angeles Software Developers is seeking a motivated and technically skilled Software Developer to design, build, test, and maintain software applications that meet business and user needs. The ideal candidate will have a solid programming foundation, strong analytical skills, and an interest in developing reliable, scalable, and maintainable technology solutions. In this role, you will work with technical team members and project stakeholders to develop application features, integrate software systems, troubleshoot technical issues, and improve existing products. jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT LUNON** The companies that lead the next decade won't adopt AI, they'll be rebuilt around it. Lunon treats strategy and software as one discipline, shaping the systems that let ambitious companies outthink their markets and outpace their competitors. Most advice about AI ends as a recommendation that someone else has to carry out. At Lunon, the people who decide what should change are the people who build it, so an insight becomes capability rather than a slide. We are backed by General Catalyst, and our open\-source research system ranks first on DeepResearch Bench. We're a small team and intend to stay that way. Everyone here owns their work from the first conversation to production, adopts the newest models as they land, and holds an exacting standard for craft. If you want your work to change how a company operates, not just inform it, we'd like to meet you. **ABOUT THE ROLE** As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you will decide how intelligence enters a company's product: which model, adapted how, proven by what evidence, and at what cost. You will work alongside a Forward Deployed Data Engineer, who owns the data foundation. Your first project: helping an ERP company make its product AI\-native. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Choose the right model for each problem, from frontier APIs to open\-weight models, and know when fine\-tuning outperforms a better prompt * Fine\-tune where it pays off: supervised fine\-tuning, preference optimization, and parameter\-efficient methods such as LoRA * Design the evaluations and benchmarks that show whether a change made things better * Take models from training to serving, balancing cost, latency, and quality * Work with the company's team to find where AI will change their results most, and decline work that won't repay the effort **YOU MAY BE A FIT IF** We weigh what you have shipped and sustained over years of experience. * You have fine\-tuned or post\-trained a model and can explain what worked and what didn't * You have built evaluations that changed a decision * You have shipped LLM features that people depend on * You have served a model in production and owned its cost and latency * You work with AI coding tools every day and judge the result by the system it produces **STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO** * Have built on or integrated with an ERP, CRM, or accounting system * Have shipped extraction or search over complex business documents * Have done consulting or forward\-deployed work, and know how to earn trust inside a company that isn't yours **LOCATION** Remote within the US. Lunon is headquartered in New York City. **HOW WE HIRE** * A 30\-minute conversation with the team about what you've built and what we're building. * A technical deep\-dive into one system you owned, from the business problem to production. * A working session with the team on a real client problem. * References, then an offer. The process takes about two weeks. **Beware of recruitment fraud.** All official correspondence comes from a lunon.ai email address. We will never ask you to share bank account information, cash a check, or purchase equipment as part of the hiring process. Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

jobs.title: Senior Staff Controls Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Overview** Mainspring Energy is seeking a highly skilled **Sr. Staff Controls Software Engineer** to architect, develop, and deploy industrial\-grade Human\-Machine Interfaces (HMI) and SCADA systems for our Linear Generator sites. As a senior individual contributor and technical lead, you will define the architecture for modernizing our operator interfaces using Ignition, building scalable, site\-agnostic UI frameworks, and implementing robust industrial communication pipelines using OPC UA, Modbus, and related protocols. You will bridge hardware controls, site telemetry, and operator visualization to deliver intuitive, reliable, and secure control interfaces across commercial, microgrid, and utility\-scale deployments.### **Responsibilities** * **Ignition HMI Development:** Lead the design, architecture, and deployment of commercial\-grade operator interfaces standardized on the Ignition SCADA platform. * **Site\-Agnostic UI Architecture:** Build dynamic, site\-agnostic HMI screens and tag structures that seamlessly scale across diverse power plant configurations, skids, and high generator counts. * **Protocol \& Telemetry Integration:** Implement robust communication interfaces and telemetry pipelines utilizing OPC\-UA, Modbus, and SunSpec for real\-time SCADA data exposure and third\-party integration. * **Alarming \& Diagnostics:** Develop comprehensive alarm management, system of events logging, and diagnostic dashboards for deep visibility into site hardware and network status. * **Testing \& Validation:** Own the testing lifecycle for new features, including unit testing, integration testing, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) validation to ensure site safety logic and grid compliance. * **DER Integration:** Implement strategies for integrating Mainspring technology into Distributed Energy Resource Management Systems (DERMS) and complex microgrid environments. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work with Product, Controls and Hardware teams to translate utility requirements and interconnection standards into functional software specifications. ### **Qualifications** * **Industry Experience:** 12\+ years of hands\-on experience in **commercial power generation**, industrial automation, manufacturing or utility\-scale energy projects. * **HMI \& SCADA Expertise:** Deep hands\-on experience building complex industrial HMI/SCADA systems, with demonstrated mastery of the **Ignition** platform (Perspective/Vision modules, UDTs, Tag Historian) and industrial communication protocols, specifically **OPC\-UA**, Modbus TCP/RTU, and SunSpec, alongside relational database integration (e.g., PostgreSQL). * **Software Architecture \& Scalability:** Proven experience defining industrial software architecture, leading technical decisions, and delivering reusable, site\-agnostic HMI/SCADA platforms from design through deployment. * **Grid Interconnection Standards:** Experience with grid interconnection standards (e.g., IEEE 1547, UL 1741\). * **Cybersecurity Frameworks:** Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks for industrial control systems (e.g., NERC CIP). * **Technical Communication:** Ability to create clear technical documentation and system diagrams that bridge the gap between industrial hardware and modern software. This position is **onsite** at our **Menlo Park HQ**. The salary will be adjusted to reflect local market conditions based on employee location as well as the experience of the employee. Along with base salary, Mainspring offers pre\-IPO company equity through Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) \+ benefits. jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Project Engineer
jobs.description: Mantis Innovation provides managed facility services and turnkey program management with technology\-enabled solutions that target the entire building footprint. We look at the entire facility—inside and out—and can impact 70% of what a building operator allocates critical budget dollars toward, including: Strategic electricity and natural gas procurement, renewable energy, and demand response; climate impact reduction and reporting, net zero strategies, and sustainability planning; roofing, solar, HVAC assessment management, pavement, building envelope, data center optimization, and EV charging; lighting/LED retrofits, HVAC/mechanical systems, and BMS/BAS improvements and implementation. The Senior Mechanical Project Engineer helps clients identify, design, and implement utility and infrastructure improvements. This role solves the challenge of turning complex facility needs into practical projects that improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. The position leads technical assessments, feasibility analysis, project scoping, and engineering design to support informed investment decisions. This role is critical to delivering accurate project recommendations, strong technical solutions, and well\-executed engineering support from concept through implementation. ### **OUTCOMES \& SCORECARD FOR SUCCESS** * Complete 95% of assigned site surveys, feasibility studies, and investment\-grade cost estimates by the committed deadline, with less than 5% requiring material rework due to engineering errors or omissions. * Develop and deliver technical scopes, project economics, and engineering recommendations that contribute to **at least $5M** annually in qualified project opportunities approved for proposal or implementation. * Demonstrate a consistently positive attitude, strong collaboration, and reliable responsiveness with clients, internal teams, and project partners, as evidenced by constructive stakeholder feedback and dependable follow\-through on commitments. ### **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Conduct site surveys and collect technical, operational, utility, and cost data to establish project baselines and identify client needs. * Analyze facility infrastructure, utility systems, and operating conditions to identify energy, water, and operational improvement opportunities. * Perform feasibility studies and technical evaluations for utility modernization and energy efficiency solutions. * Develop project scopes, engineering assumptions, savings calculations, and investment\-grade cost estimates. * Prepare technical recommendations, project economics, and supporting documentation for client proposals and decision\-making. * Lead design engineering activities for approved projects, ensuring technical quality and alignment with project objectives. * Coordinate internal and external engineering resources to deliver design work on schedule and within scope. * Manage engineering support for project implementation, including design\-build coordination, technical reviews, and integration of applicable incentives or funding opportunities. ### **QUALIFICATIONS** ***Minimum Qualifications*** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field. * **5\-10 years of experience in development, design, or delivery of utility system modernization, energy efficiency, or related infrastructure projects.** * Experience supporting industrial and/or commercial projects. * **Technical experience with utility, HVAC, mechanical, or related infrastructure systems.** * Ability to independently manage engineering work and coordinate with clients, internal teams, and external partners. ***Preferred Qualifications*** * PE license, Certified Energy Manager credential, LEED AP credential, or similar professional certification * Strong financial and economic analysis, including lifecycle cost analysis, ROI evaluation, and development of business cases for capital infrastructure improvements. ### **WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** * **Work environment:** This position is performed in a combination of office, remote, and client\-site settings. Client sites may include industrial facilities, commercial buildings, utility plants, mechanical rooms, construction sites, production areas, rooftops, and other operational environments. Conditions at client sites may include exposure to noise, temperature variations, moving equipment, and active construction or manufacturing activities. * **Physical requirements:** This role requires prolonged periods of sitting and computer use, including viewing screens and using standard office equipment. The employee must be able to travel to and move throughout client facilities to conduct site assessments, inspections, and project meetings. Activities may include standing, walking, climbing stairs or ladders, navigating uneven surfaces, bending, reaching, and accessing confined or restricted equipment areas. The employee may be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE), high\-visibility clothing, and safety footwear, as required by site policies. * **Travel requirements:** Regular local and regional travel to client sites is expected. Occasional overnight travel may be required depending on project location and business needs. * **Schedule expectations:** Generally performed during standard business hours; however, flexibility may be required to accommodate client schedules, site access restrictions, project deadlines, commissioning activities, or field work occurring outside normal business hours. Salary depends on years of experience, skills, degree(s), and certifications.*Note: Employees are held accountable for all duties of this job. This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position.* **What else can we offer you?** We offer a fantastic lineup of benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, HSA, 401k Matching, Paid Vacation, Paid Sick, Paid Holidays, Paid Parental Leave, Paid Short Term \& Long Term Disability, Tuition Reimbursement, and a flexible hybrid work schedule (for office\-based employees). Working at Mantis also brings tremendous professional development opportunities that allow you to make a real impact on both the company and your career! **Not sure you meet every single requirement?** Studies show that women and individuals from underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they check every box. At Mantis, we’re committed to building an inclusive and equitable team—so if this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn’t match every single qualification. *Mantis Innovation is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Chemical Process Engineer
jobs.description: **About Mariana Minerals** ========================== Mariana Minerals is a software\-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data\-driven decision\-making. **Role Overview** Mariana Minerals is looking for a highly motivated Sr./Staff Process Engineer to work on building the critical minerals supply chain to support the world’s energy transition and to supply metals necessary for technology and AI, energy, mobility, and defense. As a Sr./Staff Process Engineer at Mariana Minerals, you will lead the development and deployment of state\-of\-the\-art chemical refining processes, while also supporting development of software for capital project execution and automated plant optimization. Responsibilities will include leading process area and equipment scopes from concept through to design, installation, commissioning, ramp, and handover to the operations team. **What You’ll Bring** * Lead process area and equipment scopes from concept and modeling validation, through procurement, engineering, fabrication, installation, commissioning, and ramp * Manage external equipment providers, technology licensors, and engineering companies to deliver fully integrated and functional mineral refining scopes. * Build heat and material balances for integrated mineral refineries * Develop Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs) and Piping \& Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs) for mineral refineries * Build first\-principles\-based models of chemical reactors and unit operations to validate and scale\-up designs * Identify, evaluate, and implement engineering solutions to optimize process designs, confirming functionality and performance under various operating conditions * Work closely with cross\-functional teams including lab technicians, pilot plant engineers, process engineers, project execution teams, and more to scale designs from lab through to commercial scale * Work closely with the software and machine learning teams to automate capital project execution workflows and develop equipment and plant optimization algorithms **What You’ll Bring** * Strong understanding of engineering fundamentals and demonstrated ability to leverage this understanding to solve challenging problems * Strong foundation in chemical engineering, metallurgical engineering, or process engineering, with demonstrated ability to apply engineering fundamentals to complex systems * Experience with plant \& equipment engineering and design. Including but not limited to: * Brownfield modifications and upgrades * Greenfield design * Evaluation and optimization of operating facilities * Experience with the following industries and/or production environments: * Industrial manufacturing * Large\-scale mining or mineral processing, particularly across hydrometallurgy, electrometallurgy, and pyrometallurgy * Large\-scale chemical production processes * Engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC/EPCM) firms **Our culture is built on four principles:** -------------------------------------------- **Everyone Gets Home Safe.** We never put speed or cost ahead of people. **Extreme Ownership.** We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions. **Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate.** We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale. **Share Your Legos.** We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions. **Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!** Compensation Range: $140K \- $175K

jobs.title: Senior Application & AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** We’re KSM, one of the top 50 largest independent advisory, tax, and audit firms in the United States. But more than our size, it’s our people and culture that set us apart. We believe great things happen when people are supported, challenged, and given the freedom to do their very best work. That’s why we’ve built a workplace where your career and personal life can thrive together – where you have the flexibility to manage your time, the resources to grow, and a team that genuinely cares about your success. We’ve been employee\-owned since 2001, giving every team member a stake in our collective success. This ownership mentality fosters a culture of collaboration, curiosity, and excellence – where new ideas are welcomed, different perspectives are valued, and you’re encouraged to explore what excites you most. Whether you’re expanding your skills, tackling new challenges, or making an impact beyond the office, we provide the resources and support to help you grow in the direction that’s right for you. At KSM, your contributions matter – not just to the firm, but to your colleagues, clients, and the communities we serve across the U.S. If you’re looking for a place where you can do meaningful work, build lasting relationships, and grow in ways that align with what’s most important to you, we’d love to meet you. **Position Summary** ==================== The Senior Application \& AI Security Engineer is a hands\-on individual contributor responsible for improving the security of KSM’s internally developed applications, APIs, AI\-enabled solutions, and supporting integrations. This role partners directly with software developers, architects, and engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities, strengthen application designs, and implement and validate practical fixes. The engineer integrates security into application and AI development workflows, with particular attention to authentication, authorization, sensitive client data, and risks associated with large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and connected tools. Application and API security remain the primary focus of this position. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Assess internally developed applications and APIs for vulnerabilities involving authentication, authorization, access control, and sensitive data exposure. * Perform hands\-on application security testing, source code reviews, and architecture assessments; prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact. * Partner with developers to design and implement fixes, then independently validate that identified vulnerabilities are resolved. * Evaluate legacy applications, integrations, and application\-to\-application communications for security weaknesses. * Improve API protections, including service authentication, object\-level authorization, secrets management, rate limiting, and abuse prevention. * Integrate practical security requirements and testing into the software development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines. * Implement and maintain appropriate SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, and secrets\-scanning capabilities. * Establish secure coding guidance and reusable patterns for traditional and AI\-assisted development; review significant changes before production release. * Review application and AI architectures across AWS, Azure, and development environments, including client\-data isolation and access to sensitive information. * Work with Security and Development to strengthen application, API, and AI integration logging, monitoring, and detection of unauthorized activity. * Assess AI\-enabled applications, LLM integrations, and agent workflows for prompt injection, sensitive data disclosure, insecure tool execution, and excessive permissions. * Review how AI systems access, process, and transmit client information; evaluate controls for AWS Bedrock and other approved AI services. * Develop practical security testing for AI features, including adversarial tests of LLM integrations and agent tool calls. * Support investigations involving application or AI integration compromise and drive corrective actions to prevent recurrence. Track application security findings through remediation and communicate material risks, priorities, and progress to leadership. * **Qualifications \& Experience** ================================ **Required** ------------ * 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in software development, application security engineering, or closely related technical roles. * Strong knowledge of web application and API security, including authentication, authorization, session management, and access control. * Demonstrated experience identifying, remediating, and validating vulnerabilities in production applications. * Ability to read, understand, and review application source code and collaborate directly with software developers. * Practical experience with application security assessments, manual testing, and code reviews. * Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. * Understanding of LLM application architectures, AI agent permissions, prompt injection, and the security implications of AI tool integrations. * Experience securing REST APIs, service\-to\-service authentication, and application credentials. * Experience incorporating security testing into CI/CD pipelines and software development workflows. * Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and explain technical risks and remediation to developers and business stakeholders. **Preferred** ============= * Professional software development experience in languages and frameworks used by KSM’s development teams. * Experience securing applications and APIs hosted in AWS or Azure. * Experience with SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, and secrets\-scanning tools. * Experience with application penetration testing, threat modeling, or secure architecture reviews. * Experience protecting sensitive financial, personal, or confidential client information in multi\-tenant applications. * Familiarity with OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, and modern identity integration patterns. * Experience improving application/API logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities, including AI integrations. * Hands\-on experience securing production AI applications or integrations, including AWS Bedrock or comparable platforms. * Experience with AI security testing, adversarial evaluation, or assessing prompt injection and agent tool access. Relevant credentials such as OSWE, CSSLP, or GWAPT, or equivalent demonstrated expertise. * *We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, national origin, race, religion, veteran status, or any other protected category.* *KSM only accepts resumes directly submitted by a candidate and referrals submitted by current KSM employees. Unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles sent by staffing agencies and fee\-based referral services will not be considered outside of a signed KSM vendor contract. KSM will not pay a fee to recruiters or agencies that do not have a signed KSM vendor contract.*

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: **Who is Michaels Energy?** Michaels Energy is a veteran\-owned energy consulting firm that exists to help businesses **minimize waste** and **maximize value**. Our energy and engineering gurus are obsessed with optimizing buildings and processes to maximize energy savings and profits, minimize utility grid stress and carbon footprints, and keep this big, beautiful planet in tip\-top shape. Our passion is developing long\-term client relationships with energy users, utilities, consultants, and partners. This passion combined with our core values of **proactive and responsive service**, **intuitive analysis**, **collaborative partnerships**, and **fanatical execution**, forms the foundation of our corporate culture. **What is the role?** Michaels Energy is seeking a Software Developer to design, develop, implement, and maintain software solutions supporting Michaels Energy's internal operations and client programs. This position uses traditional software development, low\-code platforms, system integrations, and artificial intelligence (AI) to build practical, reliable solutions that improve efficiency and deliver business value. The Software Developer collaborates with internal teams and external stakeholders to understand business needs, develop effective solutions, and continuously improve applications, analytical tools, and workflows. **How You Will Make an Impact** Application Development \& Maintenance * Design, develop, deploy, and maintain applications using Python, Quickbase, and web technologies. * Develop software that supports engineering calculations, analytical models, data processing, and technical workflows, including the modernization of spreadsheet\-based engineering tools, in collaboration with Michaels’ engineering staff. * Develop and enhance Quickbase applications, including data models, interfaces, reports, dashboards, and automated workflows, designed for maintainability and future portability. * Support the modernization and migration of legacy applications and platforms. * Write, maintain, and improve code that supports business applications and client\-facing solutions. * Troubleshoot technical issues, resolve defects, and improve application performance and reliability. * Respond to support requests and bug tickets within established SLAs. * Follow software development best practices for testing, documentation, version control, and security. * Prepare and maintain technical documentation and provide user training as needed. Systems Integration \& Automation * Develop and maintain integrations between internal applications, client systems, and third\-party services using APIs and other integration technologies. * Build and maintain automated workflows, data pipelines, and scheduled processes. * Develop solutions that improve data accessibility, accuracy, consistency, and reliability. * Implement data access controls and security practices that protect business and client data. * Support the deployment and maintenance of applications and automated processes in cloud environments. * Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency through automation. AI Solutions Development * Collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for AI\-enabled applications and workflow automation. * Develop, test, and implement AI\-powered solutions using APIs, large language models, and related technologies. * Integrate AI capabilities into existing applications, business processes, and data workflows. * Evaluate AI solutions for accuracy, reliability, security, and practical business value. * Research and apply emerging AI development tools and techniques to improve software delivery. **How do you contribute?** After 3 months, you will have…. * Developed a working understanding of Michaels Energy’s software ecosystem, including Quickbase applications, Python\-based solutions, integrations, and development practices. * Assumed ownership of assigned applications and workflows, independently troubleshooting issues, resolving bugs, and responding to support requests within established SLAs. * Successfully delivered initial software enhancements or automation solutions, demonstrating proficiency with our development tools, testing practices, and version control. * Collaborated effectively with the Software Product Manager and internal stakeholders to understand requirements, establish priorities, and contribute to technical solution design. After 6 months, you will have…. * Independently designed, developed, tested, and deployed software solutions that address business needs, including Quickbase applications, Python development, and system integrations. * Delivered meaningful improvements to operational efficiency, data reliability, and application maintainability through automation, modernization, and integration initiatives. * Contributed to the development and deployment of AI\-enabled solutions, demonstrating practical application of emerging technologies  ollaborating effectively with stakeholders. **What are the metrics for this role?** * Completed Quarterly Goals – 80% Target * SLAs – Response Time Met \>\= 95% * Average Feedback from Colleagues \>\= 4 out of 5 Rating * Professional Development – Quarterly goals met \= true **What are we looking for?** Competencies * Analytical and creative problem\-solving * Self\-motivated and accountable * Adaptable and eager to learn * Detail\-oriented * Effective verbal and written communication Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of professional software development or application development experience. * Proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language. * Experience developing and maintaining business applications, web applications, or automated workflows. * Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, and system integrations. * Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and relational databases. * Experience using Git or similar version control systems. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Quickbase application development, including Pipelines, custom pages, and third\-party integrations. * Experience developing software solutions for engineering, energy efficiency, building systems, or other technical applications. * Experience developing and deploying Python applications in cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure or AWS. * Experience designing relational database schemas and writing complex SQL, ideally in PostgreSQL. * Familiarity with Docker, automated testing, and continuous integration/deployment practices. * Experience with AI development, including LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and agent\-based workflows. * Experience developing data pipelines, reports, and business intelligence solutions. * Familiarity with Agile software development practices. * Experience supporting client\-facing applications or business process automation. * Familiarity with engineering concepts or a background in Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering. **Where can you work?** * Denver, CO location preferred * Remote or any of the Michaels Energy office locations: La Crosse WI, Minneapolis, MN, Cedar Rapids, IA, Denver, CO, Chicago, IL, and Richmond, VA **Pay Scale** $110,000\-$125,000 \+ regional adjustment if applicable **Perks \& Benefits** * Competitive compensation package * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and holidays * Professional development opportunities * Flexible, collaborative culture where your contributions directly influence company success **Why work for Michaels Energy?** Join a collaborative, purpose\-driven team where you'll have the autonomy to build relationships, uncover opportunities, and drive measurable results. You'll own your success while partnering with customers, utilities, and internal experts to make a real impact through meaningful energy efficiency projects. The top reasons Michaels Energy is an awesome place to work, besides helping the world save energy. * We Never Stop Learning * Flexible Work Hours * Collaborative * Career Development * Beer Fridays * Fresh Fruit Daily * Wellness Rewards * Fun Company Outings **Michaels Energy EEO Statement** We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. We strive to build and nurture a culture that is inclusive and welcoming for all employees. We know diversity and inclusion are essential to innovation, a strong work environment, and exceptional results. This fits well with our culture that celebrates the unique, the different, and the individual. For us, this is who we are and what we do, not just words in a policy.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Frontier Continuous Improvement
jobs.description: **Overview** Microsoft's Continuous Improvement (CI) team is seeking a Senior Director, Frontier Continuous Improvement to shape and deliver customer AI transformation engagements with Microsoft Frontier Company by applying CI methods. Microsoft Frontier Company is a new operating business focused on helping customers achieve business transformation through AI by combining deep industry expertise, AI engineering capabilities, services delivery, continuous improvement, and outcome\-driven execution. Our team brings CI to Microsoft’s customer engagements, helping customers translate AI ambition into measurable business outcomes. We use structured problem solving and systems thinking to understand how work happens today and redesign end\-to\-end workflows across people, processes, and technology. We design better business systems and put them into practice. As part of a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team, you will bring CI and process design expertise to help customers turn AI opportunities into better business outcomes. Within the Frontier Co. engagement model, you will lead workflow discovery and redesign, working alongside engineers, Industry Advisors, and customer teams to define how work should operate and the technical capabilities needed to support it. You will connect business objectives, process design, and technical delivery, ensuring AI solutions are embedded in workflows that customers can sustain and improve over time. You will observe work firsthand, quantify current\-state performance, and facilitate teams through designing better end\-to\-end workflows. This includes determining where AI can change how work gets done and establishing clear roles and performance measures. You will translate the future\-state design into an actionable implementation plan and stay engaged through delivery and adoption, helping teams measure results and refine the system. We look for people with demonstrated experience applying CI practices to complex business processes and delivering measurable improvements. Traditional Lean or CI credentials are not required; the ability to put these practices into action is essential. Successful team members think rigorously, navigate ambiguity with resourcefulness, and work across business and technical teams. They influence across organizational boundaries—from frontline teams to senior executives—and communicate clearly to build alignment and drive execution at pace. If you thrive at the intersection of process design, AI, and hands\-on transformation, this is an opportunity to shape how customers build and run AI\-powered enterprises. Regular travel to customer locations is required, up to 50%. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities*** Bring process design expertise to an FDE pod: Work as an integrated member of a Forward Deployed Engineering pod, partnering with engineers, Industry Advisors, and customer teams to translate business opportunities into redesigned workflows and measurable outcomes. * Understand how work happens today: Lead discovery, voice of customer, gemba, and current\-state analysis. Quantify performance and identify waste, constraints, and unmet needs to focus on the highest\-impact changes. * Lead collaborative workflow design: Guide customers and the FDE pod through Kaizen and collaborative design sessions to reimagine how work should operate across people, AI, and technology. Challenge assumptions and align teams on a practical future state, including roles, decisions, and handoffs. * Design how humans and AI work together: Identify where AI and agents can automate work, support judgment, or enable new capabilities. Define human oversight, decision rights, exception handling, and fallback paths so workflows perform in real operating conditions. * Connect process design to engineering delivery: Translate future\-state workflows into clear requirements and acceptance criteria. Partner with engineers through prototyping and deployment, using customer feedback to refine the workflow and solution. * Drive implementation and adoption: Break the future\-state design into actionable changes. Establish owners, milestones, and execution routines; surface barriers and help customer teams adopt the redesigned workflows. * Measure and sustain business impact: Establish performance baselines and targets that connect workflow improvements to customer outcomes. Validate results and build the customer ownership and CI capabilities needed to sustain performance. * Build alignment and influence action: Communicate clearly with frontline teams, technical partners, and executive leaders. Make complex issues understandable, facilitate tradeoffs, and build commitment across organizational boundaries to keep delivery moving. * Strengthen the practice through field learning: Turn customer experience into reusable playbooks and design patterns. Coach colleagues and customer teams in CI practices and provide feedback to engineering and product teams. * Embody our culture and values: Create clarity in ambiguity, challenge the status quo with evidence, and foster collaboration and ownership. Deliver results with respect, integrity, and accountability. **Qualifications** **Required/minimum qualifications** * Master's Degree in Engineering, Business, or related field AND 6\+ years process management, process execution, process optimization, or related experience + OR Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, or related field AND 8\+ years process management, process execution, process optimization, or related experience + OR equivalent experience. * 4\+ years demonstrated experience leading enterprise transformation, process redesign, and operating\-model change from discovery through adoption and sustained results * 4\+ years experience advising executive leaders, facilitating high\-stakes decisions, shaping complex engagements, and influencing across organizations without direct authority * 1\+ year experience redesigning workflows with generative AI, agents, or automation and partnering with technology or engineering teams on large\-scale implementations **Additional or preferred qualifications** * Master's Degree in Engineering, Business, or related field AND 12\+ years process management, process execution, process optimization, or related experience (e.g., data analytics) + OR Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, or related field AND 15\+ years process management, process execution, process optimization, or related experience (e.g., data analytics) + OR equivalent experience. * Consulting and growth experience: management consulting, professional services, or enterprise sales experience in customer transformation or technology\-enabled operating\-model change * Applied AI fluency: hands\-on experience with agentic workflow design, responsible AI, evaluation, human oversight, and failure\-mode planning * Continuous Improvement methodology: advanced experience with Lean, Six Sigma, operational excellence, or equivalent methods. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **WHO WE ARE** Monetary is the financial platform powering treasury and capital markets across the public sector. State and local governments, public universities, health systems, and the bankers and advisors who serve them run trillions of dollars in debt, cash, and investments on Monetary. We've built the most sophisticated treasury platform in public finance — sitting at the intersection of treasury management and a $4 trillion fixed income market that's been waiting for modern infrastructure. **ABOUT THIS ROLE** We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can exist in a fullstack environment. You will need to balance working on projects with your team and working across teams to implement improvements platform wide. Engineers at Monetary work on products in multiple stages of maturity: we are enhancing some products that have been in use for years, we are launching new products, and we have some products that are in a more greenfield state. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to thrive within our Majestic Monolith of Ruby on Rails and React. You'll strike a balance between driving impactful team initiatives and collaborating across the organization to enhance our entire platform. At Monetary, our engineers touch the full lifecycle of product maturity—from refining established systems to architecting brand\-new, greenfield solutions. As a senior member of the team, you will act as a bridge between various practice areas, providing mentorship to colleagues while leading efforts in system design, solution shaping, and decomposing complex epics into actionable tasks. **HOW WE WORK** * Our application is a Majestic Monolith built with Ruby on Rails, React, and PostgreSQL. Our app is hosted in AWS, and we use GitLab for our CI/CD pipelines and deployments. We use feature flags to allow us to continually integrate our code. * Our front\-end is built with React, TypeScript, and MUI React. We have an in\-house library of accessible components documented in StoryBook. These components are being used in new development, and we are in the process of updating existing pages to use them. * Our back\-end is a Ruby on Rails JSON API that communicates with a React SPA (single page application). * All of our engineers work on the front\-end, back\-end and database. We have some engineers who are much more experienced in one, but we can all do some work in any part of the stack. * We have a small dedicated infrastructure team, but our teams deploy and monitor their own code. * Engineers collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and industry specialists to understand problems and design solutions. Engineers manage breaking down work into tickets and planning and managing projects. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Participate in all stages of the SDLC: solution shaping, system design, ticket writing/breakdown, write full\-stack code, review code, perform deployments, participate in monitoring, and gather data for reporting. * Own the quality of your work. Write tests and work with your team to ensure everything works before merging and releasing. * Work cross\-functionally on your team to ensure work is scoped to deliver quickly and deliver the right functionality. * Work collaboratively with other cross functional product\-focused teams. **WHAT YOU'LL BRING** * 5\+ years of related professional experience * Experience with Rails or similar (Django, Laravel, Phoenix, Gin etc.) * Experience with React or similar (Angular, Vue, Svelte, etc.) * Some familiarity with front\-end and back\-end web development * Experience Leading Projects that have multiple engineers * Ability to communicate complicated technical concepts well with teammates in all functions, including non\-technical roles **WHY MONETARY** Monetary is a fast\-growing company where we dream big, move fast, make an impact, and bring joy to everything we do. Our core values drive our success as an organization, and we are looking for talented teammates who share our passion for challenging the status quo, innovating in all we do, and wanting to make a difference. When it comes to benefits and perks, we are committed to supporting our employees' well\-being to make their lives better, both in and out of the office. We offer: * Location: Charlotte NC (Hybrid \- Flexible) * Annual salary range is $135,000\-150,000 based on experience * Up to 10% annual bonus * Equity (stock options) for all employees * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with 4% employer match * Flexible work schedules and generous leave policies * Professional development opportunities * Stipend for remote workers to set up their ideal work space * Annual Company Onsite **Interview Process** * 30 min \- Introduction Call * 60 min \- Interview with Engineering Manager. Behavioral \+ Technical (Video call) + Our technical assessment covers development using Rails, React, and SQL. * 2 hr \- Onsite Interview with members from the Product, Design, and Engineering teams + This will be multiple panel interviews each containing 1\-2 team members. + The engineering portion will include programming. **OUR "GOAT" VALUES** **GROW Continuously** * We believe in continuous improvement, never accepting the status quo as good enough, and iterating to move quickly without compromising on quality. * We are energized by the fast\-paced rate of change that growth demands and see new challenges as opportunities for resilience and personal development. * We are driven by curiosity to think creatively, innovate, and experiment, and we humbly incorporate lessons learned from success and failure along the journey. **OWN Your Outcomes** * We hold ourselves accountable for exceptional effort, execution, reliability, professionalism, and results that add tremendous value for customers. * We are all individual contributors, responsible for delivering value to our customers, team, and company with every action we take. * As managers, we lead by example in both what we do and how we do it, and stay personally familiar with the work as we coach our teams. * We follow through on our decisions and commitments with action. **ABOVE \& Beyond** * We create moments of magic, surprising and delighting our customers at every touchpoint. * We run towards problems and enthusiastically jump in to help colleagues however we can be valuable. * We take pride in proactively doing the extra little things that set us apart, even when no one is watching. **TEAM Over Ego** * There is no task needed at Monetary that is beneath any of us. * We work hard to be the teammate others want on their team. * We have the courage to have hard conversations and the grace to receive honest feedback in pursuit of excellence. Monetary is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and prohibit discrimination and unlawful harassment in the workplace. All applicants will receive consideration for employment based upon their qualifications without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, marital status, genetic information, political affiliation, National Guard or veteran status, disability, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law. We welcome and encourage applicants with disabilities to contact our team for assistance during the application and hiring process. We are committed to expanding accessibility and making reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.description: In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. This is a Software Engineering position at the Director level, which is part of the job family responsible for developing and maintaining software solutions that support business needs. Morgan Stanley is an industry leader in financial services, known for mobilizing capital to help governments, corporations, institutions, and individuals around the world achieve their financial goals. Interested in joining a team that’s eager to create, innovate and make an impact on the world? Read on. PRIME BROKERAGE AND SECURITIES FINANCING TECHNOLOGY We provide the technology that supports core Prime Brokerage functions—including custody, client service, reporting, capital introduction, sales and finance—as well as the trading and post\-trade processing of Securities Finance Transactions (SFTs), collateral posting and collateral optimization. The team develops applications supporting trade capture and enrichment, lifecycle and position management, exposure management, analytics and operational processing. What you’ll do in the role: * We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to join the Prime Brokerage and Securities Financing Technology department. The role is part of a global team with members in New York, London, Tokyo and Bengaluru, supporting clients in North America. * The development team builds and maintains applications using Scala, Java, and Angular in an agile environment. jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Data Retrieval
jobs.description: NVIDIA is seeking an engineering lead to architect and scale the data acquisition infrastructure that powers our foundation models. Starting with code and STEM data for Nemotron, you will build the systems that discover valuable sources, crawl the open web at scale, and deliver reliable, high\-quality data to training pipelines. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role spanning distributed systems, crawl infrastructure, and third\-party data ingestion. You will own the architecture of a unified platform covering source discovery, URL indexing, crawl frontiers, predictive ranking, scheduling, distributed fetching, and ingestion. We have existing infrastructure to build on, and the goal is to bring it to pretraining scale and extend it to additional model families, modalities, and acquisition workflows over time. Along the way, you will lead architecture reviews and critical implementation work, mentor engineers, and help build the team. **What you’ll be doing:** * Work with storage and scaling teams to design scalable frontier storage and queueing systems with high\-throughput writes, efficient lookups, deduplication, and scheduling based on data quality, diversity, and freshness. Build a continuous discovery loop that extracts links and feeds new candidates back into the crawl frontier. * Develop a shared crawl execution layer that fetches reliably and politely at scale, handling dynamic websites while keeping resource use under control. * Build extensible pipelines for open\-web, licensed, and partner content, including text, PDFs, code repositories, and multimodal assets. Define stable interfaces for source connectors so teams can add sources without rebuilding the platform. * Partner with parsing and curation teams to preserve valuable code, math, and structured content, and improve accepted data yield. * Implement provenance and policy enforcement with legal, privacy, security, and data governance partners. Translate approved publisher preferences, opt\-outs, licensing terms, and use restrictions into auditable controls that follow the data downstream. * Own production readiness, including capacity planning, observability, fault tolerance, recovery, and cost efficiency. Instrument the pipeline end to end and set service objectives for throughput, freshness, reliability, and meeting training cutoffs. * Work with research and product teams to evaluate internal crawls and external datasets through comparable pilots. Deliver reproducible data releases that tie source coverage and processing quality to controlled training experiments. Coordinate dependencies across teams and make clear tradeoffs between immediate data delivery and long\-term platform development. * **What we need to see:** * A BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. * 15\+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, including designing and operating large\-scale distributed systems, setting technical direction, and delivering complex infrastructure across multiple teams. * Deep experience with web crawling or closely related discovery, indexing, or ingestion infrastructure, including distributed scheduling, stateful services, storage, and high\-throughput data processing. * Strong hands\-on engineering and system design skills. Ability to move between architecture, implementation, performance analysis, and production debugging. * Experience building batch or streaming pipelines and reasoning about consistency, retries, duplicate processing, backpressure, and recovery. A track record of improving throughput, latency, resource efficiency, or operational reliability. * Experience delivering data platforms for research, ML, search, or other demanding technical users. Ability to translate evolving requirements into clear interfaces and measurable engineering outcomes. Strong technical communication and leadership through influence across engineering, product, research, and governance teams. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Experience architecting a web\-wide crawl platform, scaling crawl frontier storage, or consolidating multiple acquisition systems into shared infrastructure. * Direct experience supplying foundation\-model pretraining data, including targeted discovery, quality\-aware crawl ranking, and acquisition of code or technical content. * Experience implementing publisher consent, training\-use opt\-outs, dataset licensing controls, or provenance infrastructure at scale. * Background with browser\-based or agentic data collection, programmable extraction, and sandboxed environments for tool\-use data or post\-training evaluation. Experience onboarding licensed or multimodal datasets, building reusable partner integrations, or delivering streaming feeds with low latency for retrieval and grounding. * The platform is a core capability for NVIDIA’s AI models and directly shapes the reach and quality of our training data. If you enjoy solving difficult distributed systems problems and building platforms that other teams depend on, we want to hear from you. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD \- 431,250 USD. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 30, 2026\. This posting is for an existing vacancy.
