jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Data Platform Engineer** **Become a Part of the NPT Team** National Philanthropic Trust was founded in 1996\. Since that time, have raised more than $95\.8 billion in charitable contributions and currently manage $68\.7 billion in charitable assets. We have made more than 1\.1 million grants totaling more than $55\.5 billion to charities all over the world. We rank among the largest grantmaking institutions in the United States. Our mission is to increase philanthropy in society. To that end, our experienced staff of philanthropic professionals are fully prepared to help you establish and administer your donor\-advised fund. NPT is led by a Board of Trustees composed of nationally known experts in philanthropy and business. At National Philanthropic Trust, we foster a welcoming environment for all. People are valued and respected for who they are—with opportunities to bring their entrepreneurial spirit and talents to increase giving around the world. We have an inclusive, supportive, collaborative culture that makes National Philanthropic Trust one of the most rewarding places to work. **What You'll Do** The Senior Data Platform Engineer is a hands\-on engineer on NPT's Data Platform team who helps turn governed data into reusable products that support self\-service analytics, partner and enterprise reporting, external data delivery, and governed AI\-enabled experiences. Working across Snowflake, dbt, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, and APIs, this person helps NPT define data once and deliver it consistently. The role drives data products from discovery through production, partnering with Product and business teams and ensuring each product is secure, observable, documented, and supportable. The ideal candidate combines an analytics engineer's modeling discipline, a platform engineer's focus on reliability, and a product mindset. **Data Modeling \& Transformation** * Design reusable, domain\-focused data products in Snowflake and dbt, including dimensional models with defined grain, conformed dimensions, and shared entities that support reporting, self\-service, external delivery, and AI. * Define governed business rules and trusted financial metrics once, including time logic and point\-in\-time history, and drive ownership and certification with business domain owners. * Build, test, document, and optimize dbt models across staging, core, and consumption layers, with business\-focused tests and contracts, and maintain modeling standards and lineage. **Data Engineering, Platform Operations \& Observability** * Build and operate secure pipelines into and out of Snowflake across APIs, files, Fivetran, data shares, and partner feeds, designed for idempotency, retry, replay, and predictable recovery. * Develop, deploy, and support partner\-facing APIs, secure data shares, and file\-based data feeds with defined delivery expectations, monitoring, and reconciliation. * Manage Snowflake infrastructure, roles, secure views, and masking policies through Infrastructure\-as Code, CI/CD, and automated promotion controls. * Drive platform reliability through service objectives, monitoring and alerting, runbooks, and incident response, while improving lineage, metadata, and cost visibility. **Business Intelligence Development** * Support governed Power BI semantic models and reports on Snowflake consumption products, keeping business logic close to the data. * Partner with business users on certified data products, self\-service, and adoption. * Support migration of high\-value reports and legacy SQL Server, SSIS, and DAX logic to Snowflake with parallel\-run reconciliation and controlled cutover. **Technical Collaboration \& Governance** * Work with Product and business stakeholders from discovery through adoption to turn business questions into agreed definitions, reusable data products, and measurable outcomes. * Define and manage data and consumer contracts, service expectations, and entitlement rules for internal and partner\-facing products. * Serve as NPT's technical counterpart to external implementation partners and absorb knowledge transfer to sustain the platform. * Shape NPT standards for data products, metrics, and platform practices through design and code review, decision records, and runbooks, and mentor engineers and co\-op students. **Agentic AI Enablement** * Enable AI by making the platform AI\-ready: governed data products, rich metadata, semantic definitions, lineage, and least\-privilege access so AI consumes trusted interfaces rather than raw data. * Support governed AI connectors, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and natural\-language experiences with explicit read/write boundaries, accuracy and access evaluation, and human approval for consequential actions. * Apply NPT AI governance to all AI use: use only approved agentic tools, register tools and use cases, protect sensitive data, and verify and be able to explain every output before it is used or committed. **What You Bring** **Education/Certification:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Relevant certifications are a plus, such as SnowPro, dbt Certified Developer, or an infrastructure\-as\-code certification. **Experience:** * 7\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data warehousing, including hands\-on experience driving production dbt models and dimensional designs. * Experience building, consuming, and supporting production APIs and delivering governed data products to multiple consumers (reports, self\-service, partner feeds), including access controls. * Experience modernizing legacy reporting or data pipelines, including reconciliation to systems of record, and working across business, security, and vendor teams. * Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, using tools such as Jira and Confluence for backlog management, sprint delivery, and documentation. **Required Technical Skillsets** * Expert SQL, dimensional modeling, and data warehouse design, including grain, conformed dimensions, slowly changing dimensions, and query optimization. * Production dbt capability across models, tests, macros, incremental strategies, snapshots, documentation, and medallion\-layer design. * Hands\-on Snowflake engineering, including role hierarchy and least privilege, secure views, row access policies, masking, data sharing, and tasks. * Infrastructure as code using tools such as Terraform, schemachange, or comparable, plus Python, Git, and CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps. * Hands\-on API experience building and consuming REST or comparable APIs, including designing, securing, and supporting APIs that expose data to partners and applications, with OpenAPI, OAuth 2\.0, and versioning. * Data pipeline engineering: batch and incremental pipelines from APIs, files, and SaaS sources, with automated testing, monitoring, and recovery. * Data security and governance practices, including role\-based access, masking, classification, lineage, and metadata management, and responsible use of AI tooling. **Preferred Technical Skillsets** * Power BI semantic modeling and DAX; ability to read legacy T\-SQL, SSIS, and Power Query logic. * Ingestion and operations: Fivetran, Fabric or Azure Data Factory, Airflow or comparable, change data capture, MuleSoft, SFTP, Datadog, and FinOps. * Partner and semantic tooling: GraphQL, contract testing, dbt Semantic Layer, Streamlit, and catalog and lineage tools such as Purview or Atlan. * Snowflake Cortex, Microsoft Copilot agents, MCP or comparable agent protocols, AI evaluation, and governed machine learning operationalization with Python; experience in financial services, philanthropy, or Salesforce. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** * Product and platform mindset: starts with consumers and agreed definitions, favors reusable data products and standards over one\-off requests, and designs for security, observability, and recovery. * Strong analytical judgment and accountability, including data accuracy, challenging vague requirements, sound judgment on AI\-generated work, and driving the fix to resolution. * Clear communication across technical, business, and partner audiences, and pragmatic, independent execution in a lean team. **Hybrid Work Schedule:** * This position follows a hybrid work schedule and requires onsite presence in our Conshohocken, PA office every Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays. **Physical Requirements:** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: The Lead Data Engineer owns the Navanta data backbone — public Call Report data in the early build, and secure ingestion from bank cores into lakehouses as each client’s on\-premises environment is stood up. Working under the SVP of Technology and Commercial AI and in close partnership with the AI/ML, security, and platform teams, this role builds the architecturally clean, well\-modeled, reconcilable data foundation that makes it possible for the Navanta AI platforms to give numbers a banker will act on. Key Responsibilities * Design the lakehouse: Apache Iceberg (or similar technology) on object storage, a catalog for table management and per\-bank isolation, dbt models, and a query engine * Build secure, least\-privilege ingestion from bank systems — log\-based CDC where permitted, with query\-based and batch/SFTP fallbacks, plus an in\-bank collector pattern * Own data modeling for the semantic and metric layer (deposits, concentration, uninsured exposure, asset quality, and peer groups) * Handle schema drift, data quality, and reconciliation; make ingestion observable and recoverable * Partner with the AI/ML team on the structured\-query path and with Security on PII classification at landing, in alignment with regulatory data\-handling requirements * Document data lineage, transformation logic, and access controls to support audit and exam readiness * Define and enforce data contracts, quality thresholds, and alerting for pipeline failures Core Competencies * End\-to\-end ownership of ingestion\-through\-serving pipelines, with a bias toward reliability and observability * Rigorous data modeling for analytics — semantic layers, metric definitions, and reconcilable outputs * Security and compliance mindset: PII handling, least\-privilege access, and data governance aligned to regulatory guidance * Cross\-functional partnership with AI/ML and platform engineering to deliver governed, queryable data products Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) * Data freshness and pipeline reliability — SLAs met for data ingestion and bank\-core feeds * Data quality score across key metrics versus source reconciliation * Time to onboard a new bank’s data environment, from kickoff to queryable lakehouse * PII classification coverage at landing and zero unauthorized data\-access incidents * Semantic layer adoption — percentage of assistant queries resolved via governed metrics versus ad hoc SQL Qualifications To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. * 8–12\+ years in data engineering with end\-to\-end ownership of ingestion through serving, and 2\+ years in a lead or senior role * Strong Python and expert SQL; rigorous data modeling for analytics * Hands\-on lakehouse experience (Iceberg/Delta/Hudi or equivalent) and modern transformation tooling * Built reliable pipelines from messy operational and transactional source systems * Comfort with CDC mechanics and the realities of pulling from databases you do not control Core Technologies * Languages: Python, SQL (deep) * Lakehouse \& catalog: Apache Iceberg; Polaris / Nessie / Lakekeeper * Transform \& query: dbt; Trino / Presto / DuckDB * CDC \& streaming: Debezium (SQL Server CDC, Postgres logical replication), Kafka / Redpanda * Orchestration: Dagster (or Airflow) * Storage: S3 / MinIO * SQL Server and PostgreSQL data modeling, pgvector (or equivalent) Nice to Have * Experience with financial or core\-banking data, or FFIEC / Call Report data specifically * Strong SQL Server familiarity * Data contracts, lineage, and governance practices Education and/or Experience * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematics, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience * Experience in the financial services industry or a regulated data environment strongly preferred Work Structure \& Expectations * Full\-time role combining ongoing pipeline operations with initiative\-based lakehouse build\-out and new bank onboarding * Close collaboration with AI/ML, platform engineering, and security teams; on\-call rotation covering data pipeline reliability Physical Demands The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and use hands to finger, handle, or touch objects, tools, or controls. The employee frequently is required to talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, usually waist high, up to 50 feet away. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. Work Environment The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Typical office environment * Up to 20% travel time may be required Who is Navanta? Navanta is the trusted technology and services partner for community financial institutions, unifying critical systems, security, cloud infrastructure, and support into one seamless, purpose built experience. With more than 35 years of banking expertise — from Managed IT to Core Banking, CRM, and Advisory Services — Navanta helps institutions simplify complexity, reduce risk, and strengthen daily operations. Navanta empowers community bankers and their people to thrive together. Go Bankers, Go.™

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Geospatial
jobs.description: Imagine having the power to stress\-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara. We use advanced machine learning to create engineering\-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure. By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network\-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future. Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe. **Data Scientist, Geospatial** We're looking for a Data Scientist, Geospatial to join our Houston team, supporting a key regional electric utility. You’ll work directly with their team to build physics\-backed models on Neara, leveraging complex datasets like LiDAR, GIS, asset records, and weather data. Your work will directly prevent wildfires by simulating vegetation encroachment, predict grid failures under extreme weather loads, and inform capital investment decisions to harden critical infrastructure. **What You Will Do:** * Embed and collaborate directly with customer geospatial and GIS teams in a hybrid setting, spending time on\-site at their offices to deeply understand their data workflows, integrate systems, and solve complex spatial challenges. * Build predictive risk models on Neara that combine LiDAR, terrain models, and weather data to simulate conductor sag, sway, and vegetation fall\-in risks to directly prevent wildfire ignitions. * Translate complex spatial and structural risk metrics into defensible, data\-driven insights that inform utility capital investment decisions for grid hardening. * Build and maintain robust spatial data pipelines to ingest, clean, vectorize, and integrate diverse geospatial data formats from our utility partner. * Establish QA/QC benchmarks for spatial accuracy, coordinate reference system (CRS) transformations, and structural alignment across disparate data sources. * Mentor others in best practices for model training, data analytics, and building data\-driven products. **Who You Are:** * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in data science or machine learning. Geospatial data or power grid domain experience is a plus. * Strong quantitative intuition for data, with excellent communication skills and proven experience presenting complex findings to customers and senior leaders. * Experience working in fast\-paced, high\-growth scale\-up technology environments is a plus. * Self\-driven with a bias for action; comfortable taking full ownership of complex projects and adapting quickly to shifting priorities. * Natural collaborator who thrives at the intersection of technical teams (ML, Software) and external customer stakeholders. * Grounded, resourceful approach to problem\-solving, with a track record of navigating messy, real\-world datasets to deliver clear, business\-driven outcomes. **What We Offer:** * Work with an industry\-leading, multi\-modal spatial data stack \- including airborne LiDAR, high\-resolution satellite imagery, and physics\-enabled digital twins \- to solve real\-world engineering challenges at immense scale. * Your spatial modeling will directly mitigate wildfire risks, optimize utility vegetation management, and harden critical infrastructure across millions of kilometers of energy grids. * Shape the spatial architecture of our core product line while collaborating with top\-tier ML and software engineers. * Enjoy a highly competitive compensation package with a significant equity component, ensuring you are a true stakeholder in our rapid global scaling. \#LI\-NT1 \#LI\-DNP Compensation Range: $140K \- $160K

jobs.description: Nelnet is a diversified and innovative company committed to enriching lives through the power of service as a student loan servicer, professional services company, consumer loan originator and servicer, payments processor, renewable energy solutions, and K\-12 and higher education expert. For over 40 years, Nelnet has been serving its customers, associates, and communities. The perks of working at Nelnet go beyond our benefits package. When you join the Nelnet team, you're part of a community invested in the success of each individual. That support comes through in our work, as we are united by our mission of creating opportunities for people where they live, learn, and work. Responsible for software development contributions supporting a project\-based diversification initiative \- the design and delivery of a new AI\-enabled workforce onboarding and case support platform for public\-sector agencies \- WREN. The initial project proposes the development of an AI\-powered workforce onboarding, training, and case support platform for State Health and Human Services agencies, initially focused on Child Support Services, with the goal of improving how new frontline staff learn, gain confidence, and perform complex, high\-stakes casework. This role will contribute to the delivery of an MVP focused on onboarding and training workflows, decision support, and guided user experiences, starting on WREN and supporting its initial build until the product hands off to a long\-term product team. At that point, the engineer will follow one of two tracks: continuing on with the ongoing support of WREN, or transitioning onto the MVP development team for a new product within New Business and Innovation.**Nelnet believes in a hybrid work environment. The standard hybrid work schedule includes 24 hours of in\-office work each week, for associates that reside within 30 miles of an office. To be considered, candidates must already be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.** *At this time, we are unable to consider external candidates that reside in these states: Alabama, California, Connecticut, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, Oregon, Rhode Island, Vermont, Washington.* **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:** ------------------------- * Contribute to the design and development of application features as part of a cross\-functional scrum team, collaborating closely with other engineers, product owners, and designers. * Implement backend services and APIs and front\-end user interface components to support defined product requirements. * Translate well\-defined business and technical requirements into working software. * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code following established team standards and best practices. * Participate in code reviews, testing activities, and iterative refinement of features. * Assist in diagnosing and resolving defects, performance issues, and integration problems. * Collaborate with cross\-functional team members, including product, design, and domain experts, to deliver project goals. * Adapt to evolving requirements and priorities within the scope of the project timeline. **EDUCATION:** -------------- Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **EXPERIENCE:** --------------- We are looking for engineers experienced in the full stack of software development. Annual compensation range for this role is $100,000 \- $110,000 depending on experience. Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, HSA and FSA, generous earned time off, 401K/student loan repayment, life insurance \& AD\&D insurance, employee assistance program, employee stock purchase program, tuition reimbursement, performance\-based incentive pay, short\- and long\-term disability, and a robust wellness program. jobs.title: Support Team Lead - America
jobs.description: **About Nerdio** At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments. We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost\-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune. Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market\-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology. Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible. We are a fast\-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you. **About the role** You will be responsible for leading a team of motivated and skilled Support Engineers for our AMER\-based Support Team. This role balances hands\-on technical support with team leadership, operational oversight, and quality control. You will be leading a team of highly functioning individuals comprised of Level 1 and 2 engineers. This is a working team lead role. You will oversee tickets, coach engineers, and drive operational discipline across the team to achieve a world class support experience for Nerdio customers. **What you'll do*** Provide daily guidance and direction to Nerdio Support Engineers * Review cases for troubleshooting depth, documentation quality, and communication clarity * Set expectations for case ownership, follow\-through, and customer updates * Act as the first point of escalation for engineers on complex, high\-priority, or sensitive cases * Support onboarding and ramping of new engineers * Deliver direct coaching and performance feedback aligned with Technical Support expectations * Reinforce consistent ways of working across regions **Operational Ownership*** Own day\-to\-day performance and operation of the Nerdio Support queue * Identify trends and recurring issues and partner with leadership on process improvements * Ensure escalated cases meet set standards and include proper documentation and diagnostics * Monitor metrics such as; ticket flow, backlog, and team performance * Ensure SLA adherence and proactive communication in priority cases * Partner with the Escalation team to ensure clean, well\-documented handoffs * Step in on high\-impact cases when needed to stabilize customer situations * Assist navigating customers to the correct Nerdio resource, should Support not be the correct department for their queries. **Nerdio Customer Support*** Provide advanced troubleshooting support for complex Nerdio product issues across Nerdio Manager for Enterprise (NME) and Nerdio Manager for MSP (NMM). * Engage directly with customers via webform emails or live troubleshooting sessions * Serve as a senior technical resource for high\-impact customer cases **Technical Expertise** Demonstrate strong working knowledge of: * Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) * Windows 365 Cloud PC * Microsoft Intune * Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) * Active Directory (AD DS / Entra DS) * FSLogix * Azure networking fundamentals * Promote structured troubleshooting methods and consistent ways of working **Cross\-Functional Collaboration*** Partner with Escalation teams to ensure clean handoffs and efficient resolution * Collaborate with the Engineering and Product teams on reproducible issues and feedback * Support Sales Engineering and Customer Success during customer engagements * Drive alignment across regions to maintain global standards **Qualifications*** 5\+ years of technical support, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise systems experience * Strong experience with Azure Virtual Desktop and Intune environments * Comfortable leading peers; setting technical and operational standards * Clear communication with both customers and internal stakeholders * Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting mindset **Preferred Qualifications*** Prior experience leading or mentoring others is advantageous * Microsoft AZ\-104 (Azure Administrator) and/or AZ\-140 (Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty) certifications are advantageous * Prior hands\-on experience with Nerdio Manager for either Enterprise or MSP, is advantageous * Previous experience in providing support for cloud\-based services or SaaS products * Experience with ITSM systems, such as Zendesk * ITIL v4 framework **Benefits and Incentives*** Competitive Base and Incentive Plan * Stock Options * Health and Welfare Plans\* * Life and Disability Plans\* * Retirement Plan\* * Unlimited Flexible Paid Time Off, including your birthday off! * Collaborative Team Culture * Benefits for international employees, outside the US, vary by country. Nerdio is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Nerdio is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. **The pay range for this role is:** 90,000 \- 115,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Lead Electrical and Automation Engineer
jobs.description: At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic\-related diseases. At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers. **POSITION SUMMARY** As a Lead Digital and Automation Engineer at Nestlé Nutrition \& Health, your mission is to identify, develop and scale automation and digital manufacturing solutions that strengthen performance across the Nutrition \& Health manufacturing network. At our R\&D center in Bridgewater, US, we develop science\-proven nutrition products, processes and packaging, while providing technical support to Nestlé Nutrition \& Health factories worldwide. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with factory, engineering, quality, operations, research and development, digital and automation teams, technology partners and strategic suppliers. This is an opportunity to grow your expertise and deliver meaningful results that help improve lives through nutrition innovation worldwide. You can expect travel both domestically and internationally up to 30% of the time. **JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES** * Leading the identification, development, technical support and global deployment of digital manufacturing and automation solutions that improve reliability, efficiency and operational performance across factories. * Driving the standardization and continuous improvement of automation, process control, manufacturing execution systems and operational technology solutions across Nutrition and Health sites. * Building strong partnerships with factories, project teams and technology suppliers to turn emerging automation and digital technologies into scalable business value. * Delivering expert guidance in the field of electrical, automation and digital for investment projects, from design and commissioning to qualification, validation and handover to operations. * Enabling secure, reliable and actionable manufacturing data through data integration and engineering initiatives that support digital transformation. * Coaching teams and sharing best practices that strengthen digital and automation capabilities across a global manufacturing community. **EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS** * Bringing strong expertise in automation, process control and digital technologies applied to manufacturing, supported by a Master’s, Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Engineering with a background in automation and digital technologies. **EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS REQUIREMENTS** * 8\+ years of experience in automation, process control, digital manufacturing solutions, AI and robotics, manufacturing execution systems (DMO/MES), and digital engineering, preferably within manufacturing or food industry environments. * Use solid knowledge of process mastery applications, control system platforms such as Rockwell, Wonderware or AVEVA, and process simulation tools Siemens SIMIT / Tecnomatix to strengthen operational performance. * Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to deliver engineering projects, commissioning, start\-up and continuous improvement in manufacturing facilities, ideally within aseptic Ready to Drink and Oral Solid Dose (VMS) supplement manufacturing processes. * Demonstrate courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value. \#LI\-hybrid \#LI\-BB1 Salary: $140,000\.00 to $190,000\.00 per year Bonus Eligibility: Yes The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range. Nestlé offers performance\-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. jobs.description: Job Description Net Solutions is seeking a skilled Application Developer to design, develop, enhance, and maintain business applications and digital platforms. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in software engineering, application integration, database management, and modern development practices. In this role, you will collaborate with engineering, product, and design teams to transform business requirements into reliable software solutions. You will contribute to application development, system integration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement while helping deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable digital products. Responsibilities * Design, develop, test, and maintain business and web applications. * Translate technical specifications and business requirements into functional software. * Develop application features using appropriate programming languages and frameworks. * Build and integrate APIs, databases, and third\-party services. * Troubleshoot application defects and resolve performance or functionality issues. * Implement software testing and debugging procedures. * Maintain code quality, documentation, and development standards. * Collaborate with designers, developers, and project stakeholders. * Support application deployment, updates, and ongoing maintenance. * Identify opportunities to improve application performance, security, and reliability. Requirements * Experience in application development or software engineering. * Proficiency in a programming language such as Java, C\#, JavaScript, PHP, or Python. * Understanding of web application architecture and software development principles. * Familiarity with REST APIs, database systems, and application integration. * Experience with Git, debugging, and software testing. * Knowledge of secure coding practices and application performance optimization. * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills. * Effective written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work independently and collaborate with a development team. Preferred Skills * Experience with .NET, Node.js, React, or similar development technologies. * Familiarity with SQL databases and data modeling. * Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS or Microsoft Azure. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing. * Understanding of application modernization and scalable software architecture. About the Company Net Solutions is a digital product engineering company that designs, develops, and modernizes digital products, enterprise applications, and commerce platforms. jobs.title: Software Engineer 5 - Device Certification Infrastructure
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. The Partner Test Tech team ensures a high\-quality Netflix experience on smart TVs and set\-top devices. Every major release adds features and raises the complexity of what device manufacturers must certify against. The volume of certification content keeps growing as features such as Variable Speed Playback and Multiple Players interact in more complex ways. We build and run the infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and services that keep certification consistent and manageable for partners and give Netflix teams a clear signal of release readiness. Our work centers on TV Media, and we collaborate with peer teams across Client and Partner Technologies, including Audio Video Tests and Tools and TV Test Reliability. Who you are * You are a quality\-focused engineer driving cross\-team projects while mentoring peers * You are proficient in JavaScript / TypeScript, and Java * You have created and effectively operate applications in production at scale. * You are experienced with CI/CD systems, test automation, and device scheduling infrastructure. * You have a working knowledge of audio and video streaming technologies * You have an AI\-native mindset, leveraging AI tools to optimize workflows and efficiency. What you will do * Architect and scale CI/CD pipelines for real\-time change feedback * Optimize device lab usage to provide high quality signal from on\-device testing * Enhance reliability and signal quality of distributed testing infrastructure * Modernize backend services for device metric collection and test execution * Track operational metrics to quantify engineering impact * Streamline developer experience to boost velocity * Collaborate with cross\-functional partner teams to standardize test workflows What sets you apart? * Hands\-on experience with video streaming, graphics, encoding, or playback engines * Deep domain knowledge of consumer electronics and device partner ecosystems * Proven track record leading complex system migrations * Full\-stack expertise spanning networking protocols, web technologies, and AWS cloud services * A history of creating novel solutions for intricate problems across organizational boundaries * Active contributor to open\-source or industry standards for device automation Why Netflix? * Our culture is something we strive to constantly improve and practice daily * You’ll work with other stunning engineers and continue your career growth while pushing the boundaries of what is possible with home entertainment today You can use and influence standards for automating streaming devices using world\-class infrastructure and labs * Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $388,000\.00 \- $558,000\.00\. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. jobs.title: Senior Associate - Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- #### **Requisition ID** 95195 #### **Department** Tech Data AI Ventures #### **Job Function** Tech Data AI Ventures #### **Location** New York,New York,United States #### **Role Location Designation** Hybrid \- 3 days per week **Location Designation:** Hybrid \- 3 days per week **Technology, Data, AI and Ventures:** Within the Tech, Data, AI, Ventures (TDAV) organization, our work is guided by a shared vision: deploying the power of technology, data, AI and ventures to accelerate sustainable competitive advantage for New York Life's businesses. We build solutions that power how we serve policy owners, agents, advisors and employees while delivering measurable business outcomes. Across technology, data, AI, cyber, product, digital experience, architecture and infrastructure, TDAV combines the scale and investment of an industry leader, access to leading\-edge technologies and the opportunity to help shape how a world\-class financial services company competes in the AI era \- all backed by the stability and purpose of a mutual company built to last. **Role Overview** The Senior Associate, Analytics Engineer is a practitioner who designs and implements scalable analytics engineering solutions with a high degree of independence. You lead your own workstreams end\-to\-end — from source alignment and data modeling through testing, deployment, and quality monitoring — engaging with the Analytics Engineering Lead and senior engineers for input on the most complex architectural decisions. You are technically strong, self\-directed, and effective at translating business requirements into well\-structured engineering work. You exercise independent judgment in selecting approaches and techniques, engage directly with business stakeholders to understand requirements, and provide input into team\-level goals and delivery planning. You advise peers on data modeling and analytics engineering best practices, and actively contribute to improving the team’s SDLC practices. **What You’ll Do** **Deep\-Dive Exploratory Analysis** * Conduct end\-to\-end deep dives into large datasets to isolate variables driving user behavior, financial anomalies, or operational trends. **Formulate \& Test Hypotheses** * Proactively generate hypotheses based on business problems and run statistical tests to prove or disprove them. **Deconstruct Business Metrics** * Move past surface\-level KPIs (e.g., "Revenue is down 5%") to identify the exact levers causing the shift (e.g., "A localized drop in conversion rate among cohort X during checkout step 2"). **Present Strategic Recommendations** * Translate complex technical findings into narrative\-driven, actionable business strategies for executive stakeholders. **Collaborate on Experiments** * Partner with product or marketing teams to design, track, and interpret rigorous A/B tests and experimentation models. **Pipeline Design \& Data Product Delivery** * Lead, with support from the Analytics Engineering Lead, the design and implementation of scalable dbt transformation pipelines across Databricks, Postgres and Bigquery — covering layered modeling (staging / intermediate / mart), incremental strategies, and source contract definitions. * Design and build well\-tested, documented data products — dimensional models, aggregates, and feature tables. * Develop solutions to complex data transformation problems using advanced SQL and Python, selecting the right approach based on evaluation, judgment, and the performance and maintainability requirements of the platform. * Optimize and tune transformation pipelines for performance, cost efficiency, and incremental processing at scale — independently identifying bottlenecks and driving improvements. * Own your data products end\-to\-end: source alignment, modeling, testing, documentation, deployment, and post\-release monitoring, with awareness of downstream BI and AI/ML dependencies. **Data Quality, Governance \& SDLC** * Lead, with support from senior engineers, the availability, usability, integrity, and security of data within your domain — ensuring data is consistent, trustworthy, and governed in accordance with enterprise standards. * Implement robust dbt test frameworks, source freshness checks, and data quality monitoring patterns that make pipeline health observable and failures diagnosable. * Apply governance standards at the analytics layer: column\-level PII tagging, access control integration, and lineage documentation that supports the enterprise data catalog. * Lead efforts to improve SDLC practices within the team — contributing to and helping establish CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, branching conventions, and PR review standards. * Maintain data catalog entries for all owned assets: lineage, ownership, grain documentation, and business glossary alignment. **Innovation \& Pattern Development** * Develop and maintain reusable macro libraries and dbt modeling patterns that enforce consistency and a with structured sprint planning, backlog grooming, and milestone tracking. * Clear written and verbal communication skills — able to explain technical decisions, document data products, and engage effectively with both engineering and business stakeholders. Preferred * Exposure to semantic layer tooling — dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow, Looker LookML, or equivalent — and experience building metric definitions consumed by BI or AI systems. * Familiarity with agentic AI concepts and interest in applying LLM\-assisted tooling to pipeline construction, data quality remediation, or transformation pattern generation. * Experience with data observability tooling (Monte Carlo, Anomalo, or dbt built\-in monitoring patterns) and building self\-monitoring pipeline patterns. * Exposure to graph data models, knowledge graphs, or context graph construction for AI or analytics use cases. * Experience with data catalog and lineage platforms (Dataplex, DataHub, Alation) and column\-level governance tagging practices. * Insurance or financial services industry experience, with familiarity with data privacy standards and enterprise compliance requirements. **Job Level: LEVELPF4** **Pay Transparency** Salary Range: $124,000\-$177,000 Overtime eligible: Exempt Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes Sales bonus eligible: No Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program. **Company Overview** At New York Life, our 180\-year legacy of purpose and integrity fuels our future. As we evolve into a more technology\-, data\-, and AI\-enabled organization, we remain grounded in the values that drive lasting impact. Our diverse business portfolio creates opportunities to make a difference across industries and communities—inviting bold thinking, collaborative problem\-solving, and purpose\-driven innovation. Here, you’ll find the rare balance of long\-standing stability and forward momentum, supported by an inclusive team that honors tradition while embracing progress. As a Fortune 100 mutual company, we offer a place to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and deliver solutions that matter. Your ideas drive what’s next, and your growth powers it. **Our Benefits** We provide a full package of benefits for employees – and have unique offerings for a modern workforce, including leave programs, adoption assistance, and student loan repayment programs. Based on feedback from our employees, we continue to refine and add benefits to our offering, so that you can flourish both inside and outside of work.Click hereto discover more about our comprehensive benefit options or visit our NYL Benefits Site. **Our Commitment to Inclusion** At New York Life, fostering an inclusive workplace is fundamental to who we are and how we serve our communities. We have a longstanding commitment to creating an environment where individuals can contribute their best and succeed together. This foundation is rooted in our core values of humanity and integrity, ensuring that every employee feels valued and supported. By embracing a broad range of perspectives and experiences, we achieve greater success and fulfill our promise of providing financial security and peace of mind to families across all communities. Click here to learn more about New York Life’s leadership in this space. Recognized as one of *Fortune’s* World’s Most Admired Companies, New York Life is committed to improving local communities through a culture of employee giving and volunteerism, supported by the Foundation. We're proud that due to our mutuality, we operate in the best interests of our policy owners. To learn more about career opportunities at New York Life, please visit the Careers page of www.NewYorkLife.com. Job Requisition ID: 95195

jobs.title: Outbound AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nimble:** ----------------- Nimble is the real\-time web search platform built for enterprise accuracy, completeness, and trust. We run Web Search Agents that actively navigate live websites using real browsers and reasoning, turning the public web into governed, decision\-grade data for AI systems and high\-stakes business use. Unlike index\-based “AI search” tools or brittle legacy scraping, Nimble makes the live web queryable on demand, delivering structured outputs that teams can verify and rely on. Our platform powers use cases where correctness matters: financial due diligence, real\-time pricing and promotions, market intelligence, and AI systems that depend on fresh, complete data. Trusted by leading enterprises like Home Depot, Uber, and Coca\-Cola and backed by top\-tier investors, Nimble sits at the intersection of AI, automation, and real\-time web intelligence. As demand accelerates across AI, LLMs, and data\-driven decisioning, we’re scaling quickly and looking for high\-energy, driven teammates who thrive in fast\-moving environments and want to help define a new category. **Why join Nimble?** * Work on a deeply technical platform powering real\-time AI and enterprise decisions * Help define the future of Web Search Agents and live web intelligence * Build alongside a sharp, mission\-driven team that moves fast, ships often, and takes ownership **About the Role:** ------------------- As an Outbound AI Engineer at Nimble, you’ll support a focused Enterprise pod and help that pod create pipeline and ARR. You’ll own the work traditionally associated with top\-of\-funnel, but your role will not stop at booking meetings. You’ll use AI agents, automation, account research, GTM assets, and follow\-up support to help the pod open doors, progress opportunities, and generate revenue. The goal is simple: help the pod create more pipeline and ARR from the accounts we care about. **You do not need to be a software engineer.** **You do need to be resourceful, AI\-native, and comfortable using modern AI tools to replace manual BDR work with better research, stronger personalization, faster execution, and more useful sales support.** Being good at prompting is helpful, but it is not enough. We’re looking for someone who understands how to connect AI into actual GTM workflows and can think in terms of agents, workflows, tools, and repeatable systems. **What Makes This Role Different** Most BDR roles are built around activity volume. This role is built around pod outcomes. You’ll be expected to open doors and book meetings, but also to help the pod create better account strategies, better messaging, better assets, better follow\-up, and better ways to engage the accounts we care about. You are not just passing meetings to AEs and moving on. You are part of the Enterprise pod and share the goal of creating pipeline and ARR from the accounts assigned to that pod. The role combines the accountability of outbound with the leverage of AI, agents, automation, and GTM tooling. **What You’ll be Doing:** ------------------------- * Support a pod of 2–3 Enterprise AEs * Research accounts, stakeholders, buying committees, market signals, and relevant business initiatives * Build AI\-executed outbound campaigns across email, LinkedIn, phone, and other channels * Book qualified meetings with target accounts * Use AI agents, workflows, and automation to improve account research, personalization, messaging, sequencing, and follow\-up * Build repeatable account research workflows for assigned accounts and segments * Build lightweight tools, workflows, dashboards, and automations that help the pod prioritize accounts and execute faster * Create account\-specific or segment\-specific GTM assets that help AEs open and progress conversations * Support post\-meeting follow\-up, stakeholder mapping, and multi\-threading * Partner closely with AEs to help move opportunities from first meeting to pipeline and ARR * Stay focused on assigned accounts and strategic GTM priorities rather than chasing easy meetings outside the target list **How We Expect AI to Be Used** This role is not about occasionally using ChatGPT or Claude to write outbound emails. We’re looking for someone who can use AI agents, workflows, automation, and agentic loops to make outbound faster, sharper, and more scalable across a focused set of target accounts. You should be comfortable using AI as a research, workflow, automation, and GTM execution layer. That means using LLMs where useful, but also connecting them to tools, data sources, workflows, and repeatable processes that help the pod operate more effectively. **Examples of how you might use AI in this role:** * Build repeatable account research agents for assigned accounts and segments * Create agentic workflows that gather, summarize, and structure public web signals across accounts * Build account briefs that summarize company priorities, business model, public web presence, competitive landscape, and relevant business initiatives * Identify relevant stakeholders and buying committees across target accounts * Turn account research into relevant outbound angles by persona, account, and use case * Build repeatable messaging frameworks for different segments, buyer types, and use cases * Create personalized outreach based on account\-specific signals, not generic AI\-written copy * Use AI agents to analyze websites, documentation, product pages, job postings, news, company updates, customer stories, technical content, and other public web signals * Build lightweight workflows, automations, dashboards, and internal tools that help the pod prioritize accounts and execute faster * Connect AI tools like Claude to external tools, data sources, workflows, and internal systems through Skills, APIs, automations, or similar approaches * Use agentic loops to monitor accounts, surface changes, identify triggers, and suggest next actions * Use AI to create GTM assets that help AEs open conversations and move opportunities forward * Improve follow\-up after meetings by summarizing context, identifying next stakeholders, creating tailored follow\-up assets, and helping the AE multi\-thread the account * Continuously test and improve outbound messaging, targeting, and account strategy based on what is converting **Success in this role means contributing to:** * Pipeline created by the pod * ARR generated by the pod * High\-quality account engagement * Opening doors in strategic target accounts * Supporting AEs with research, assets, tools, and follow\-up * Stronger pipeline creation and deal progression You will not be measured by activity volume, emails sent, or meetings booked for the sake of meetings. **What You Should Have for the Role:** -------------------------------------- **We’re looking for someone who can combine outbound execution with AI\-native thinking.** **You should be comfortable doing the hard parts of outbound, but also curious enough to build better ways of doing the work.** You are: * Commercially minded and revenue\-oriented * Comfortable with outbound prospecting, including email, LinkedIn, and phone * Strong at account research and business writing * Able to understand business problems and turn them into relevant outreach * Able to use AI as a workflow and research engine, not just as a copywriting tool * Comfortable connecting AI tools like Claude to external tools, data sources, workflows, and internal systems * Familiar with Skills, APIs, automations, no\-code / low\-code tools, or similar ways to extend AI beyond a chat interface * Able to build repeatable processes with AI, automation, spreadsheets, enrichment tools, and lightweight dashboards * Able to turn public web data and account signals into specific outbound angles * Aware that good AI\-assisted outbound still requires judgment, business context, and strong sales instincts * Disciplined about working assigned target accounts and GTM priorities * Strong at follow\-up, organization, and CRM hygiene * Able to work closely with AEs and support opportunities after the first meeting * Excited by a role that blends outbound, AI, GTM strategy, and sales execution **Helpful Background** You may be a fit if you have experience in one or more of the following: * BDR / SDR / outbound sales * Enterprise sales development * AI\-assisted prospecting or GTM automation * Sales tools, workflow automation, or no\-code / low\-code systems * Account\-based outbound or strategic account prospecting * Working with assigned target accounts or named account lists * Selling or prospecting into technical, product, data, operations, strategy, or revenue buyers * Building workflows, internal tools, automations, or agent\-based research processes On\-Target Earnings (OTE): 75,000$ \- 90,000$

You'll work at the intersection of engineering, product, and go\-to\-market, identifying emerging opportunities in generative AI, rapidly prototyping new ideas, and shipping innovative experiences while the window of opportunity is still open. You'll contribute to OpenArt Agent and other core products, and help build and evolve OpenArt Arena. The role also involves evaluating the latest video and image generation models, understanding where they excel, and translating those insights into better product capabilities and user experiences. This is a highly product\-oriented engineering role. You'll work closely with product, design, and the broader GTM team, moving quickly from market signal to prototype to production. You'll need strong product instincts, solid engineering judgment, and the ability to balance speed, quality, and scalability. ### **What You’ll Do** * Contribute to the development and iteration of OpenArt Agent and other OpenArt products * Build and evolve OpenArt Arena, creating intuitive experiences for exploring and evaluating generative AI models * Partner closely with product, design, and GTM to turn emerging market trends into compelling product capabilities * Evaluate video and image generation models across quality, capabilities, reliability, and real\-world use cases * Rapidly prototype and ship innovative projects inspired by new models, technologies, and shifts in user behavior * Ship polished, production\-ready frontend experiences in React and Next.js, end to end * Make pragmatic trade\-offs between speed, correctness, and scalability and communicate them clearly ### **What We’re Looking For** **Core Requirements** * 2\+ years of full\-stack engineering experience shipping production software * Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered agents or applications that have reached real users — not just prototypes or demos * Working familiarity with agent harness concepts: tool use, context/memory management, multi\-step planning, or sub\-agent orchestration * Solid data modeling and schema design skills for real product use cases * A strong AI\-assisted jobs.title: Senior Staff Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: **About OpenLoop** ------------------ OpenLoop was co\-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go\-to\-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states. **About the Role** ------------------ OpenLoop is the clinical and operational infrastructure that digital\-health brands, clinics and employers use to run virtual care across all 50 states. Our clients put their brand on the front end; everything behind it runs on us: clinicians, intake, scheduling, charting, pharmacy and fulfillment, payments and licensing. Clients reach that infrastructure through one client platform, from a no\-code storefront to a full Partner API, and our job is to make it effortless for them to adopt. As a Staff Frontend Engineer you are the technical architect of our unified web platform: one front end, composed from many services and built by many teams. You decide how the front end is structured, packaged and distributed, you own how fast it loads and how we know, and you lead the consolidation of existing apps onto it without breaking the clients who depend on them. You write production code every week, you set the patterns the rest of engineering builds on, and you keep the end user’s experience at the center of decisions that are too often made from the backend out. This is an architecture role, not a pixel\-pushing one. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Architect one front end over many services. Design the structure of a unified web platform that sits on top of many backend services and is built by multiple teams: module boundaries, routing, shared state, and how teams ship independently without stepping on each other. * Decide how front\-end code is packaged and distributed. Own the strategy for shared libraries, component systems and package distribution, so a change made in one place is safe everywhere it lands. * Own performance end to end. Set load\-time and bundle budgets, find and fix what slows the platform down, and put real\-user monitoring behind every page so performance is measured, not assumed. * Consolidate without disruption. Lead the migration of existing web apps into the unified platform in a deliberate sequence, with clear compatibility windows, so clients and users never feel the seams. * Build for the person on the other side of the screen. Work closely with UX designers and product to turn designs into accessible, responsive experiences that hold up on desktop and mobile browsers, for patients, clinicians and clients alike. * Raise the bar. Set front\-end coding standards, review code, and mentor the full\-stack engineers who work in the front end today. Help design our front\-end interview loop and serve as a technical interviewer. **Who You Are** --------------- **Required Qualifications:** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, primarily in front\-end/UI. Your career has been built in the front end, not as a backend engineer who also does UI. * Deep expertise in React and Next.js, along with modern TypeScript and build tooling. * Experience building or scaling a large enterprise front end: one UI composed of many services and built by many teams. * A track record of making UIs highly performant: you can name the performance problems you diagnosed, how you measured them, and what changed after you fixed them. * Strong problem\-solving and system\-level thinking: you reason about the whole platform, not just the component in front of you. * Real care for the end\-user experience, and a habit of thinking from the customer's or patient's point of view. * Clear communication with engineers, designers and product partners, including explaining architectural tradeoffs to people who are not front\-end specialists. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with micro\-frontend architectures or module federation. * Familiarity with user personas, UX research and accessibility standards. * Comfort with design tools such as Figma; we have dedicated UX design support, so this is a plus, not a requirement. * Experience in healthcare or another regulated domain where a mistake has consequences beyond a rollback. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. **How You Work** ---------------- OpenLoop's values are prescriptive, and this role tests all of them: * Disciplined Intensity: effective under real deadline pressure, and you build systems and standards instead of becoming the only person who can fix the frontend. * Do No Harm: patient safety, accessibility and data privacy come first, and you know when to slow down to do it right. * Step In, Stay In: your ownership travels through the migration to the outcome, not to the handoff. * Purposeful Speed: you ship fast without leaving behind something only you can maintain. * Clarity Over Comfort: you say the thing, explain the why, and invite disagreement. **Our Benefits** ---------------- In addition, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for: * Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts * Flexible PTO * 401(k) \+ Company Match * Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more **Our Company** --------------- We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work. Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Takes proactive steps to design and architect infrastructure and service to ensure reliability and functionality. Forecasts demands and responds to capacity needs. Collaborates with software development teams to develop reliable and scalable infrastructures. Performs data collection to maintain and optimize operations and reliability. Leverages knowledge to perform incident response and/or maintenance tasks. Provides health and performance reporting. Identifies opportunities for automation. Communicates about services and identifies and explains the potential impact of changes. Provides support for technology and documents incidents. Experiments with new tools and assesses potential impact and develops knowledge of site reliability trends. **Key Responsibilities** **Capacity Ingestion and Management:** \-Takes proactive steps to design and architect infrastructure and/or service according to terms for reliability and functionality. \-Forecasts demands for infrastructure and responds to capacity needs, ensuring systems have sufficient resources to handle current and future workloads. \-Collaborates with the software development team to develop infrastructures and features that are reliable and scalable according to deployment requirements. \-Independently identifies opportunities for and drives prototyping (e.g., testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding). **Incident and Service Lifecycle Management:** \-Performs data collection, triage, technical analysis, and redirection to maintain and optimize operations and infrastructure reliability. \-Independently monitors services, maintains up\-to\-date knowledge of their performance, and documents their condition. \-Leverages comprehensive knowledge to perform incident response, root cause analyses, and/or maintenance on assigned services (e.g., software installs, version upgrades, security updates, backup and recovery). \-Provides health and performance reporting and takes appropriate actions based on trends in data. \-May independently perform provisioning to support infrastructure, applications, and services. \-May perform standard and non\-standard decommissioning (e.g., shutting down servers, removing data from databases) to remove objects that are no longer needed. **Automation:** \-Identifies opportunities for automation and assesses potential benefits. \-Develops automation tools or scripts to provide solutions, gather metrics, monitor, analyze, mitigate, or remediate issues/defects within infrastructures. \-Independently conducts testing to ensure automation performs the task correctly and produces expected results. Technical Communication and Guidance: \-Communicates the scale, capacity, security, performance attributes, and requirements of services and technology within and sometimes beyond immediate team. \-Identifies and explains the potential impact of infrastructure, feature, and tool changes, considering their impact on team operations. **Troubleshooting and Resolution:** \-Provides operational support for technology, escalating incidents and other standard and non\-standard issues arising within Oracle services. \-Participates in on\-call shifts to address issues. \-Resolves technical issues spanning various services, investigating and debugging products in order to reach SLOs (service level objectives). \-Documents incidents and performs root cause analyses according to standard reporting methods. \-Independently performs post\-mortem procedures to prevent incident reoccurrence. **Innovation and Improvement:** \-Experiments with new tools and technologies to assess their potential impact on and improve infrastructure performance and reliability, ensuring adherence to security standards. \-Independently identifies and executes improvements for performance bottlenecks and deployments to ensure efficient resource usage, speed, and scalability. \-Develops knowledge of site reliability trends and shares new information with team members, management, and beyond to help others build, test, deploy and run services. \-Performs standard and non\-standard analyses and provides clear data on production to contribute to business development decisions (e.g., design changes). **Core Responsibilities** **Planning \& Execution:** Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. **Collaboration \& Partnership:** Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. **Problem Solving:** Independently identifies and addresses standard and non\-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non\-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. **Continuous Learning:** Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. **Continuous Improvement:** Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.
