jobs.title: Data Engineering Lead
jobs.description: Join our team and experience how we lead with passion, positivity, and accountability to deliver the Right Talent. Right Now. We create an environment where you can think big, have fun and truly make a difference. For more than 40 years, Oxford Global Resources has helped organizations solve complex business and technical challenges by connecting them with specialized expertise. We work across industries including technology, life sciences, engineering, and healthcare, providing services that range from individual staffing support to co\-managed projects and fully managed programs. Our work is built on understanding what each organization needs and bringing the right people and approach to the challenge. Behind that work are teams across Oxford who strengthen how we operate, support our people, and help us deliver for clients. If you’re looking for a place where your work connects to a larger purpose and has a visible impact, there’s an opportunity to do that here. **What We’re Looking For** We’re looking for a hands\-on Data Engineering Lead to guide our data engineering team and shape the next stage of Oxford’s enterprise data platform. Reporting to the Director of Data Operations, you’ll lead a team of two to four engineers while remaining closely involved in architecture, development, troubleshooting, and delivery. Oxford’s data environment spans Azure and Microsoft Fabric. Your mandate is to connect those ecosystems thoughtfully, reduce redundancy, and build a clear path toward a strong, consolidated Fabric platform without disrupting the business. You’ll set engineering standards, strengthen platform reliability, and partner across analytics, technology, and the business to turn changing requirements into dependable data products. **Remote, Eastern U.S. \| Exempt \| Reports to the Director of Data Operations** **What You’ll Do:** * Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data engineers through clear priorities, project planning, code reviews, coaching, and career development. * Own the platform strategy across Azure and Microsoft Fabric, identifying overlapping pipelines, storage, and tooling and creating a practical roadmap to consolidate or retire redundant components. * Build and mature Oxford’s Microsoft Fabric platform, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, and OneLake, while defining what should remain in Azure and what should move into Fabric. * Develop complex T\-SQL queries, stored procedures, and database solutions while managing, monitoring, and optimizing SQL Server database environments for performance, reliability, and scalability. * Design, optimize, test, and maintain the stored procedures that support Oxford’s core ETL processes, with disciplined version control and performance management. * Manage transformation pipelines end to end, including orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, failure handling, troubleshooting, and recovery. * Lead impact analysis and change management for major upstream source\-system changes, coordinating with platform owners and downstream stakeholders so the warehouse adapts before the business is disrupted. * Establish and reinforce standards for data quality, testing, observability, documentation, security, and CI/CD. * Partner with analysts, BI developers, technical teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable, scalable data products. * Manage platform reliability, performance, and cloud cost while applying sound governance practices around access, lineage, compliance, and PII handling. * Evaluate emerging tools and approaches, make clear build\-versus\-buy recommendations, and communicate priorities, risks, tradeoffs, and progress to technical and nontechnical leaders. **What You Bring to the Table:** **Required** * Five or more years of data engineering experience, including at least two years leading engineers formally or as a technical lead. * Strong, hands\-on experience using Microsoft Fabric in a production environment, beyond evaluation or proof\-of\-concept work. * Working knowledge of Azure data services, including Azure Data Factory, Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Azure SQL, and how those services integrate with or overlap Microsoft Fabric. * **Advanced T\-SQL skills, including experience writing, tuning, testing, and maintaining stored procedure\-based ETL at scale.** * Experience orchestrating and monitoring transformation pipelines, with a demonstrated ability * to diagnose and resolve production failures. * Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of Spark or PySpark. * A strong foundation in dimensional and lakehouse or medallion data modeling, along with modern ETL and ELT design patterns. * Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure as code, using tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions and Terraform or Bicep. * Clear communication, sound judgment, and the ability to influence stakeholders while balancing hands\-on delivery with team leadership. **Preferred** * Microsoft Certified Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate DP\-600 or Fabric Data Engineer Associate DP\-700 certification. * Experience managing data from enterprise source platforms such as Salesforce, ATS or VMS platforms, and ERP or finance systems, ideally in staffing or business services. * Experience leading a data\-platform migration or consolidation. * Familiarity with applying AI to the data estate, including grounding large language models and natural\-language query tools in governed semantic models and evaluating the accuracy of AI\-generated answers. **What We Bring to the Table:** **Salary Range** The reasonably expected annual base compensation range for this position is $120,000–$150,000\. This range reflects the minimum and maximum targets for new hires across the United States. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by job\-related skills, experience, geographic location, and applicable state or local laws. **Bonus Eligibility** This position may also be eligible for an annual performance\-based bonus opportunity of 10% of base salary, resulting in potential total annual cash compensation of approximately $132,000–$165,000\. Bonus eligibility and payments are subject to the terms of the applicable incentive compensation plan. **Benefits** Health, dental, and vision coverage; Flexible Spending Account (FSA); 401(k); Health Reimbursement Account (HRA); Health Savings Account (HSA); life insurance; disability insurance; paid parental leave; holiday pay; and vacation and sick time. **Perks** Observed company holidays, up to 3 floating holidays, community and social events, learning and development, $100 per month student loan payment contribution, tuition reimbursement opportunity, access to Employee Assistance Program, and other health \& wellness perks. ***Disclaimer:*** *Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check conducted in accordance with applicable law. Depending on the requirements of the position, the background check may include, but is not limited to verification of employment history, education, criminal history, motor vehicle records, credit history, and other job\-related information. Motor vehicle record and credit checks will be conducted only when relevant to the duties and responsibilities of the role.* *As Oxford is a global company hiring candidates, our perks and benefits packages may adjust based on your location.* *Direct applicants only; no recruitment agencies or third\-party recruiters, please.* For US job seekers: **Salary Information:** $120,000\.00\-$150,000\.00 Annual Please contact careers@oxfordcorp.com if you are interested in this position. Oxford is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oxford will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable law. Oxford provides holiday pay, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life and disability benefit plans, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, employee tuition reimbursement, student debt assistance and a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan. Oxford is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer - Mobile
jobs.description: **Jr Software Engineer \- Mobile** *(Remote, US\-Based Only)* **Build software that matters.** At Pulsara, we build technology that helps healthcare teams communicate, coordinate care, and make critical decisions when every second counts. Our mobile applications put that technology directly into the hands of the people who need it. We're looking for a **Software Engineer – Mobile** who enjoys building things, solving problems, and learning along the way. You don't need to know everything coming in. By replacing fragmented communications with one unified patient channel, Pulsara simplifies workflows, helps reduce treatment times and costs, and improves the experience for patients and caregivers. **Who we are:** Pulsara is a 100% remote team made up of people with backgrounds in technology, healthcare, emergency services, business, and beyond, united by a common purpose: to improve the lives of people in need and those who serve them. Working remotely gives us flexibility, but great remote work takes more than being able to work from home. jobs.title: Expert Grid Innovation Engineer
jobs.description: Requisition ID \# 175242 **Job Category:** Engineering / Science **Job Level:** Individual Contributor **Business Unit:** Strategy \& Growth **Work Type:** Hybrid **Job Location:** Oakland Department Overview At PG\&E we’re reimagining the future of energy—and we need passionate, purpose\-driven professionals to help us get there. As part of Grid Research Innovation \& Development (GRID) team, you’ll be at the forefront of transforming California’s electric system to meet the demands of a rapidly evolving energy landscape. In 2022, PG\&E launched its True North Strategy (TNS) , a bold 10\-year vision to advance our breakthrough commitments to people, climate, and prosperity. Innovation on our high voltage electric transmission system is a critical component of reaching our TNS vision, with the sharp rise of interconnection requests from large\-load customers, especially data centers , creating significant opportunities to reduce rates through beneficial load growth. The GRID department is focused on bringing technologies and solutions that support the implementation of TNS from conception to reality. The Innovation Framework \& Execution (IF\&E) team plays a critical role within GRID by enhancing PG\&E’s capacity to assess, test, and deploy novel solutions and technologies. The team is comprised of experienced innovation practitioners that are directly embedded into some of our highest priority R\&D initiatives, including transmission innovation, to drive successful outcomes and accelerate new technologies’ paths to scaling. Position Summary We’re seeking a curious, tenacious professional to support cross\-departmental innovation efforts on PG\&E’s electric transmission grid. This role is ideal for someone who has built a strong foundation in electric power systems and has developed a product\-oriented mind\- and skill set. In this position you’ll have a unique opportunity to influence how California's transmission grid evolves to support electrification, data center growth, and emerging energy technologies. Successful solutions developed in this role may influence future transmission planning and operational practices within PG\&E and across the utility industry. The successful candidate will begin their assignment with a six\-month rotation in Transmission Planning to deepen their understanding of PG\&E's planning processes, tools, and interconnection challenges before transitioning into the Grid Innovation role to apply those insights to transmission innovation initiatives. This is a highly collaborative role that requires empathy, technical fluency, and a systems\-thinking approach. You’ll be a connector breaking complex challenges into actionable solutions, bridging transmission planning with real\-time operations, and technical ingenuity with customer needs. This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need. The assigned work location is in Oakland, CA. The team has an expectation of working from Oakland office up to several days per month. Also, the role will require up to 20% travel throughout PG\&E’s service territory. PG\&E is providing the full salary/pay range for this position. The actual amount paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, and geographic location. The range to reasonably expect will be between the minimum and the midpoint of the range. The final decision will be made on a case\-by\-case basis related to the factors above. This job is also eligible to participate in PG\&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs. **Bay Area Minimum:** $140,000\.00 **Bay Area Midpoint:** $189,000\.00 **Bay Area Maximum:** $238,000\.00 Reporting Relationship This position will have a matrixed reporting structure. You will primarily report to the Manager of Innovation Framework \& Execution, with additional reporting responsibilities to leaders within Transmission Planning and Large Load Development teams. You will collaborate closely with Transmission Operations and Local Customer Engagement teams. Job Responsibilities Lead innovation for transmission grid transformation Drive the assessment and development of new technologies and processes to expand grid capacity and flexibility Collaborate with internal teams, utilities, and vendors to evaluate and iterate on innovative new solutions Benchmark industry best\-practices for large\-load interconnections, especially data centers Keep the customer experience at the center of every solution Develop business plans that articulate the expected benefits and costs of innovative solutions, with a close eye on rate and systems impacts Translate technical findings into compelling executive summaries that inform enterprise decision\-making Pilot, learn, and scale novel transmission solutions Stand up cross\-functional teams and project governance to pilot novel technology pilots with real impacts on large\-load customers Translate complex discussions with inherent uncertainty into tactical checklists of clear next steps, following PG\&E’s Lean Operating System Facilitate cross\-functional evaluations of pilot outcomes and develop recommendations for scaling successful solutions Evaluate solution feasibility, operational readiness, and scalability, and develop implementation roadmaps from concept through deployment Support broader transmission innovation initiatives Flexibly jump in to support emerging relevant priorities across GRID Act as transmission innovation subject matter expert during PG\&E\-hosted events such as Pitch Fest Qualifications **Minimum:** Bachelor’s Degree in engineering or equivalent experience Experience with grid modeling software (e.g. CYMDIST, PSLF, TARA, Aspen, or similar tools) 7 years of electric utility related experience **Desired:** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering 8\+ years of electric utility, transmission planning, transmission operations, or related power systems experience Previous experience in power flow, short circuit, and transient studies Previous experience with writing code using Python and EPCL Familiarity with NERC TPL\-001\-05, MOD\-26, and MOD\-32 standards Experience with grid digital twins, AI/ML applications, and advanced analytics Experience evaluating DERMS, EMS, ADMS, or grid flexibility management platforms Experience supporting large\-load, hyperscale, or data center interconnections Experience evaluating emerging technologies, startups, or conducting technical due diligence Technology innovation, R\&D, or pilot deployment experience Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in Electrical Engineering or related field preferred Knowledge, Skills, Abilities Ability to lead and influence cross\-functional technical teams and project stakeholders Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical information into clear, actionable insights for audiences at all levels. Ability to adapt to change and quickly pivot, with a strong bias for action and results Ability to be creative, versatile, efficient, and productive in the face of ambiguity and change Ability to lead complex, cross\-functional initiatives that impact multiple business functions Ability to rigorously define and enforce prioritization of feature development, defeating scope creep and delivering the most impactful iterative results

jobs.title: Hardware Engineer
jobs.description: **About Perry Weather** Perry Weather is the weather safety standard for organizations that operate outdoors. We combine on\-site weather hardware with a software platform that automates alerts, siren activations, and safety decisions for more than 3,000 organizations — from the PGA of America, the NFL, and MLB to Turner Construction, thousands of school districts, cities, and golf courses. We've grown 80%\+ annually for five consecutive years, and are continuing to grow. We're headquartered in Dallas at The Centrum, in the Oak Lawn neighborhood, where our teams work together every day to help organizations make faster and safer decisions when weather puts people, assets, and operations at risk. **About the role** Perry Weather builds field\-deployed weather monitoring and outdoor warning hardware —lightning detection, weather sensors, sirens, and strobe warning units. These units run unattended on solar and battery power through extreme weather, and when something fails, it fails at a customer site, not on a bench. We're hiring an Electrical Engineer to join and contribute to the hardware platform: PCB verification and manufacturing readiness, component sourcing and obsolescence management, power system design, and root\-cause investigation when field hardware misbehaves. **Responsibilities** * **Schematic capture \& PCB layout execution.** Work in Altium Designer on new revisions and design changes under the Staff Engineer's architectural review — not from a blank sheet, but with real ownership of the layout and component placement. * **Impedance \& DFM verification.** Confirm controlled\-impedance nets (e.g. USB differential pairs at 90Ω, Ethernet at 100Ω) against fab documentation, and manage the CM / Fab House submission and review process — including catching placement/conversion errors in PnP/CPL files before they become a bad board run. * **Component sourcing \& BOM management.** When parts go obsolete or out of stock, find and validate drop\-in or near\-equivalent replacements (electrical spec \+ footprint), and keep the BOM current as revisions ship. * **Power system design.** Prototype and characterize 12V/24V power architectures, select load\-switch/eFuse ICs for new switched rails, and run battery/solar runtime characterization (current draw across operating modes, worst\-case load estimation). * **Protocol\-level hardware integration.** Bring new sensors and peripherals onto the Custom PCB Carrier through its approved expansion interfaces — GPIO, Modbus RS\-485, I²C, and Ethernet/IP — working within the platform's defined GPIO/bus budget rather than requesting ad hoc hardware revisions. * **Field hardware RCA.** Reproduce field\-reported hardware issues (siren/strobe not clearing, speaker output degradation, sensor readings out of range) on the bench using scopes, DMMs, and electronic loads/shunts, isolate root cause, and drive the fix into the next design or manufacturing revision. * **Manufacturing process improvement.** Own discrete process problems end\-to\-end — e.g. grounding/ESD compliance fixes on the line, reducing manual bottlenecks in assembly/configuration steps, and building out the automated manufacturing test fixture (hardware harness \+ pass/fail criteria) the team doesn't have yet. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 5\-7 years of hands\-on electrical/hardware engineering, ideally on field\-deployed products. * Real experience in Altium Designer (or similar) for schematic capture and PCB layout — this should be work you've shipped, not coursework. * Comfort verifying board designs against fab constraints: controlled impedance, differential pairs, power trace sizing. * Experience selecting components from datasheets, including sourcing alternates under supply constraints. * Working knowledge of power electronics fundamentals: regulation, load switching, battery/solar\-powered system design. * Practical familiarity with I²C, RS\-485/Modbus, and Ethernet/IP at the level of integrating a real device, not just protocol theory. * Bench instrumentation skills: oscilloscope, DMM, electronic load, and comfort measuring current/voltage under dynamic or switched load. * Experience with root\-cause analysis on returned or field\-failed hardware. * Direct experience working with contract manufacturers As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you'll personally build the most complex models and systems on this stack, hold the bar for code quality and healthy ML infrastructure and lead the technical direction for notification content ranking. What you'll do * Lead multiple technical sub\-areas within Growth content science effectively. * Drive Growth ML model improvements through AB test driven innovation loop \- from ideation to production launches. * Own the health of our ML ecosystem: training pipelines, feature and serving infrastructure, evaluation frameworks and monitoring, AB test set up, etc. * Help raise the technical excellence bar through mentorship, reviews, evaluations, documentation, standard setting, etc. * Collaborate and build strong working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders to tackle big, cross\-functional, initiatives. * Work closely with other engineering leaders to form technical directions and roadmaps. * Operate autonomously, take ownership in complex and evolving environments and drive work effectively. * Identify and apply relevant state\-of\-the\-art techniques from recent research and/or collaborate on novel research directions. * Continuously optimize various parts of work by building and using cutting\-edge AI tools. What we're looking for * Graduate degree in Computer Science or in a related field * Minimum of 8 years of experience in machine learning engineering, including hands\-on experience building and shipping models for a large\-scale, real\-time, end\-user production recommender system * Expertise in recommender modeling, including sequence modeling of user behavior with transformer architectures, DNN rankers and generative and LLM\-native recommenders * Experience in building and operating high\-QPS, latency\-constrained ML systems, including training and serving infrastructure, and in owning the cost, latency and reliability tradeoffs * Experience in industry\-grade software engineering that others use as the example, and in conducting thorough code and design reviews that raise the quality of a team's work * Understanding of content personalization and content quality as one problem, and of why cold\-start and low\-signal users break standard rankers * Experience in leading technical work across teams, making timely decisions on hard tradeoffs and saying no when the user experience or the system health is at stake * Experience in mentoring junior engineers * Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, especially in a cross\-functional set up * Demonstrated experience using AI to improve speed and quality in applied research * Strong track record of publications and patents **In\-Office Requirement Statement:** * We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. jobs.title: Network Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Company and Vision** PlanetArt’s vision is to be the leading seller of personalized and make\-on\-demand products worldwide. We provide consumers with unmatched tools and content and an unparalleled end\-to\-end customer experience that results in high\-quality, meaningful finished products and memorable celebrations of life events. The company’s brands include the popular FreePrints and FreePrints Photobooks apps and the industry leading SimplytoImpress card and stationery site, as well as Personal Creations, CafePress and ISeeMe! Visit www.planetart.com to learn more about our brands. We have more than 500 team members across multiple offices, primarily in Calabasas CA, San Diego CA, Woodridge IL, Minneapolis, MN and Pleasanton, CA. We also have team members in two company\-owned offices in China, as well as in Europe. **Job Overview** PlanetArt is looking for a Network Security Engineer to support the company’s Security Department. The successful candidate will assess network and server security, monitor security events, and investigate alerts across Cisco technologies, Palo Alto firewalls, Windows and Linux servers, and endpoint security tools. This role requires an understanding of SIEM log collection and monitoring, EDR configuration, and SOC alert triage. The engineer will work with infrastructure teams to address security risks; direct configuration of network devices and firewalls is outside the scope of this position. PLEASE NOTE: Candidates must be local to or willing to relocate to the (office) area as we operate on a hybrid work model (3 days onsite, 2 remote) **What You’ll Do** **Key Responsibilities** * Review Cisco and Palo Alto firewall policies, access controls, segmentation, VPNs, and security logs. * Assess Windows and Linux server hardening, patching, authentication, permissions, and audit logging. * Verify SIEM collection of firewall, network, server, and endpoint logs; investigate logging gaps. * Monitor SIEM and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) alerts for suspicious activity. * Triage alerts: validate detections, distinguish false positives, assess severity, and escalate incidents. * Correlate network, server, identity, and endpoint events to identify affected systems and timelines. * Configure EDR policies, detection settings, exclusions, and alerts through approved change procedures. * Coordinate incident containment and remediation with infrastructure teams; track issues to resolution. * Document investigations and response procedures; evaluate AI use in analysis and detection. * Develop, test, and maintain security tools for log analysis, alert triage, and automation. * Recommend security improvements to the teams responsible for network and server configuration. **Requirements** **What You Should Have** **Skills, Qualifications, and Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience. * 3–5 years of experience in network security, security operations, incident response, or a related role. * Working knowledge of Cisco technologies and Palo Alto firewalls, including interpreting configurations, policies, and logs; understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, NAT, VPNs, and segmentation. * Understanding of Windows and Linux server security, including hardening, patching, authentication, permissions, and audit logging. * Knowledge of Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), including log collection, forwarding, ingestion, parsing, correlation, and alert monitoring. * Experience with EDR configuration and investigation, including policies, detection settings, exclusions, endpoint telemetry, and response capabilities. * Ability to triage alerts as a SOC analyst would, gather evidence, prioritize threats, and escalate incidents with clear documentation. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across security, network, and infrastructure teams. * Understanding of how artificial intelligence (AI) can be integrated into security workflows, including validating AI\-generated findings, protecting sensitive data, and maintaining analyst oversight. * Ability to develop, test, and document security scripts and tools using Python, PowerShell, or similar languages, including integrations with security tool APIs. * Preferred: Splunk experience, including SPL searches, dashboards, and configuring and tuning alerts, thresholds, schedules, and notifications. **What You Can Expect** **Working Conditions** * Work is performed in an office environment with low to moderate noise levels. * Occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds. * Position requires regular, continuous use of computer. * Position requires regular sitting and standing. * Position requires regular interaction with team members through the following methods: in\-person, phone, WebEx, Slack, or email. * May require occasional travel. * This is a hybrid position; employees are expected to be in the office three days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday) with the option of working remotely two days (Wednesday and Friday). **Benefits** **PlanetArt offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:** * Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Life Insurance * 401(k) with matching * Excellent Work/Life Balance – Paid Time Off, Sick Days, Paid Holidays, and Floating Holidays * Employee Product Discounts

jobs.title: FPGA Design Engineer, Senior
jobs.description: **About Positron AI** Positron AI is building next\-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low\-latency, high\-throughput large language model inference. Our first\-generation ASIC, Asimov, is a cutting\-edge accelerator targeting frontier AI workloads, with additional generations already underway. **Role Overview** ----------------- We are seeking a Senior FPGA Design Engineer to own FPGA designs from microarchitecture through lab\-based silicon validation. In this role, you will work closely with inference system architects, software, verification, and hardware teams to design, implement, and release networking and digital logic functions targeting FPGA and ASIC technologies. You will also build FPGA prototypes that let the team validate architectural choices early, and you will play a hands\-on role in bringing up complete systems that combine FPGA, firmware, and software. Your trade\-off decisions across cost, size, power, performance, and features will directly shape the customer experience of Positron's inference platforms. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **End\-to\-End FPGA Development*** Create and release FPGAs through every development phase: microarchitecture, RTL design, physical implementation, timing closure, simulation validation, and lab\-based silicon validation. * Define, design, implement, test, release, and support networking functions for FPGA and ASIC targets in partnership with inference system architects. **Cross\-Functional Design \& Prototyping*** Partner with software, verification, and inference system architects and design engineers to implement digital logic functions in FPGA and ASIC technologies. * Build FPGA prototypes that validate architecture and design alternatives and inform trade\-off decisions before committing to silicon. **System Bring\-Up \& Optimization*** Bring up and test systems that combine FPGA, firmware, and software functions alongside systems architects, hardware engineering, and software teams. * Drive trade\-off analysis that improves customer experience and optimizes target technology resources for cost, size, power, performance, and features. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * A Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in FPGA and/or ASIC design and implementation. * Hands\-on proficiency in SystemVerilog RTL coding. * A proven record of designing, testing, delivering, and supporting multiple FPGAs or ASICs that have shipped to customers. * Direct experience working with high\-end Intel and Xilinx (AMD) FPGAs. * Strong working knowledge of modern ASIC and FPGA design and verification tools. * Deep practical experience across microarchitecture, RTL coding, FPGA optimization for timing and power, simulation, and validation. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with artificial intelligence workloads, particularly large language model inference. * Familiarity with cocotb or other Python\-based logic verification frameworks. * A track record of successfully fielding and supporting FPGA and ASIC products in production environments. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability, paired with clear communication skills. * A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively within a cross\-functional technical team. ### **Leveling \& Scope** While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth\-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * Own FPGA designs end to end, from microarchitecture to lab validation, on hardware purpose\-built for frontier LLM inference. * Shape the networking and system architecture of next\-generation AI accelerators while working shoulder to shoulder with architects, software, and silicon teams. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The base salary range for this role is $200,000 – $250,000\. Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits. At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.**Health and wellness*** Fully company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents * Company\-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more * Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available **Time off and flexibility*** Unlimited paid time off; we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge * 13 paid company holidays * Remote\-first culture with a company\-provided computer and home office setup **Compensation and future*** Competitive salary and equity * 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one **Visa Support** ---------------- This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H\-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates. **Equal Opportunity Employer.** If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Company Overview** At Procure Analytics, we are passionate about driving continuous value for our 800\+ members, and we are passionate about doing so with cutting\-edge technology. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, USA, Procure Analytics is the leading tech\-enabled global purchasing organization for MRO and Packaging, leveraging $1B\+ in buying power to achieve up\-front and ongoing savings for member companies. The Company was founded to address the complex challenges of a frequently ignored indirect spend category – Maintenance, Repair and Operations Supplies (MRO) and packaging. The nature of MRO supplies (millions of SKUs, thousands of individual transactions, hundreds of potential suppliers, and the relatively small cost for individual products) make MRO an under\-managed category within most organizations. MRO comprises 1\-3% of most companies’ total purchases. In the last decade, Procure Analytics has grown from 2 employees and $5 million in total managed spend to over 100 employees and more than a billion dollars in spend, while maintaining its high\-touch service model and member\-focus. Procure Analytics has continued to evolve, adding new categories and geographies in response to members’ needs. Procure Analytics is the fastest growing company in its sector. Procure Analytics’ team serves as an extension of their member organizations, leading change management, driving adoption, and increasing compliance at member locations, while providing analytical tools, savings reporting, and buyer training to drive continuous value growth for mid\-size to Fortune 500 companies. These services, resources and data analytics are provided at no cost to members. Procure Analytics has a very collaborative, humble, and values\-driven culture that upholds these guiding principles: * Act with integrity and in compliance * Drive value creation * Be disciplined entrepreneurs * Be innovative * Treat others with dignity and respect **Strong Private Equity Ownership** In December 2021, Genstar Capital invested in Procure Analytics, along with a large rollover from Bregal Sagemount and the management team. Genstar Capital is a leading private equity firm that has been actively investing in high quality companies for over 30 years. Based in San Francisco, Genstar has developed a strong market reputation of working in partnership with management teams and its network of strategic advisors to build industry\-leading businesses while generating outsized returns. Genstar’s vision is to help build lasting, impactful companies that will continue to succeed well beyond their ownership. Genstar currently has approximately $33 billion of assets under management and targets investments focused on targeted segments of the software, industrials, healthcare, and financial services industries. In 2020, Genstar was ranked 2nd worldwide in aggregate private equity fund performance (out of 529 PE firms) and ranked 3rd in 2019 (out of 497 PE firms) by HEC\-Dow Jones. For more information, please visit www.gencap.com. The Company had previously been backed successfully by Bregal Sagemount, who rolled a significant equity stake into the new investment to continue with the company as a minority investor. **The Opportunity** As a Software Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain the internal and member\-facing software that powers our analytics, reporting, and procurement tools. You will write production code daily, work closely with senior engineers on system design, and use AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to accelerate your work. jobs.title: Mobile QA Engineer (iOS)
jobs.description: **About the Team** We are Quadcode, a fintech company excelling in financial brokerage activities and delivering advanced financial products to our global clientele. Our flagship product, an internal trading platform, is offered as a Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) solution to other brokers. We are looking for a **Mobile QA Engineer** for our **iOS team**. We are currently undertaking a major redesign of our flagship trading platform, used by millions of users worldwide, with three key goals: delivering an adaptive UI across different screen sizes and device families, expanding automated regression coverage, and transitioning to native Swift\-based test automation. We follow an AI\-first approach, actively integrating AI tools into our daily engineering workflows, including test design, automation development, code reviews, and debugging. We work in 2\-week Scrum sprints, with daily meetings at 11:00 EET/EEST. Our ideal candidate has a strong product mindset, takes ownership of features, proactively identifies issues and opportunities for improvement, collaborates with different teams, and drives features through testing to a successful release. ### **Tasks** * **Manual Testing:** Perform functional, regression, smoke, end\-to\-end and integration testing of new and existing iOS functionality. Review specifications, identify risks and edge cases, prepare test cases and checklists, and validate the redesigned UI across different screen sizes, device families, and iOS versions. * **Test Automation:** Develop and maintain automated tests to expand regression coverage across product domains. Contribute automated tests for new functionality, including end\-to\-end tests, and add coverage for features that are not yet covered by developer\-written tests. * **Automation Migration:** Help migrate the existing test automation framework to Swift\-based automation, improving maintainability, reliability, and regression coverage. * **API Testing and Debugging:** Test REST APIs and JSON responses, validate integrations and real\-time data flows, analyze network traffic using Charles Proxy or Proxyman, and investigate issues using device logs and debugging tools. * **Cross\-Platform Testing:** Collaborate with the Android team to verify cross\-platform functionality and identify inconsistencies between iOS and Android implementations. * **CI/CD:** Integrate and maintain automated tests in CI/CD pipelines, helping ensure reliable execution and timely feedback on product changes. * **AI\-Assisted Workflows:** Use AI tools in day\-to\-day QA activities, including test design, test automation, code reviews, and debugging. ### **Requirements** * **Mobile Testing Experience:** 3\+ years of experience testing native mobile applications, with a focus on iOS. Understanding of platform\-specific features, guidelines, and limitations (Apple Human Interface Guidelines, Material Design). * **Test Automation:** Hands\-on experience building and maintaining mobile automated tests using Appium, XCUITest, and/or Espresso. Ability to design a scalable test automation framework from scratch using patterns such as Page Object or Screenplay. * **Programming Skills:** Proficiency in at least one programming language used for test automation: Kotlin, Java, Swift, Python, or TypeScript. Ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable test code. * **Testing Theory and Test Design:** Solid understanding of functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end\-to\-end testing. Experience with test design techniques, including equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, decision tables, and pairwise testing. Ability to write clear test cases, checklists, and bug reports. * **API Testing:** Experience testing REST APIs and working with JSON. Familiarity with Postman, Swagger, API automation tools such as REST Assured, Retrofit, or requests, etc.). Basic understanding of WebSockets and real\-time data testing. * **Debugging and Traffic Analysis:** Experience using Charles Proxy, Proxyman, or Fiddler for traffic interception and mocking. Ability to inspect logs using Xcode Console, Android Studio Logcat, and adb. * **CI/CD and Test Infrastructure:** Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Bitrise. * **AI Tools:** Willingness to use AI\-assisted tools in everyday engineering workflows, including test design, test automation development, and debugging. * **Languages:** English at B1 level or above and Russian at C2 level. ### **Nice to have** * Experience writing mobile automated tests in Swift using XCUITest. * Experience migrating legacy automation frameworks or transitioning between programming languages and testing technologies. * Experience testing financial applications, trading platforms, or other products where data accuracy and reliability are critical. ### **We offer** * Full\-time remote work (service provider contract). * Competitive compensation (EUR). * Flexible working hours. * Corporate AI subscriptions (Claude, Gemini, GPT, etc.). * Access to a rewards marketplace offering products and language courses, redeemable using the company’s internal currency. * A strong team of engineers. * Positive and friendly atmosphere. With a team of 500\+ creative and tech\-driven people across the globe, Quadcode is the place where ideas turn into impact, where every project is a chance to grow, innovate, and make your mark. **Join us today, and let's shape the future of fintech together!** *Note: All applications will be treated with strict confidence. This role plans site readiness, stages and installs equipment, configures and integrates multivendor solutions, executes testing, resolves implementation issues, maintains accurate documentation, and prepares customer teams to operate and support the deployed environment. The ideal candidate has strong routing and switching experience, disciplined field\-engineering practices, customer\-facing communication skills, and broad exposure to optical networking, fiber infrastructure, cybersecurity, microsegmentation, encryption, QKD, PQC, and key\-management integration Key Responsibilities **Review the contracted architecture, BOM, scope, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, POC results, schedule, partner responsibilities, and acceptance criteria before deployment begins.** Lead site\-readiness reviews covering rack space, power, grounding, cooling, physical security, fiber paths, optics, cabling, management access, IP addressing, VLANs, routing, firewall rules, certificates, monitoring, and change controls. **Develop detailed designs, implementation plans, Methods of Procedure, rollback plans, test procedures, maintenance\-window plans, change\-control packages, configuration records, and as\-built documentation.** Stage, install, configure, integrate, and validate routers, switches, firewalls, optical systems, servers, encryption platforms, QKD equipment, PQC\-enabled products, key\-management systems, and supporting infrastructure. **Configure and troubleshoot TCP/IP routing, switching, VLANs, segmentation, microsegmentation, VPNs, high availability, network services, monitoring, logging, and management connectivity.** Validate optical and fiber readiness, including connector condition, patching, optics, wavelength plans, end\-to\-end loss measurements, attenuation, receive levels, continuity, and transport dependencies. **Integrate QKD systems and key\-management components with customer PKI, HSMs, certificates, encryptors, routing and switching infrastructure, firewalls, identity platforms, monitoring systems, and change\-management processes.** Implement and validate cybersecurity controls, including secure management, access controls, microsegmentation, firewall policy, logging, certificate handling, and secure configuration practices. **Execute functional, interoperability, resiliency, security, performance, failure\-recovery, and acceptance testing; collect evidence and manage defects and remediation through closure.** Troubleshoot complex network, optical, fiber, cryptographic, software, API, configuration, and performance issues and coordinate escalation with OEMs, carriers, partners, and internal resources. **Own the field implementation workstream, including technical schedule, daily status, risks, issues, dependencies, customer communications, scope control, and readiness for go\-live.** Deliver administrator training, knowledge transfer, operational runbooks, as\-built records, customer acceptance materials, and a structured handoff to operations and support. **Support post\-go\-live stabilization and capture lessons learned, product defects, and reusable improvements for future deployments.** Required Qualifications **Five or more years of experience implementing, integrating, testing, or supporting enterprise network, security, data\-center, or infrastructure solutions in customer environments.** Hands\-on expertise in TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, LAN/WAN, VPNs, segmentation, high availability, network services, monitoring, and troubleshooting. **Experience with site\-readiness assessment, equipment staging, installation, configuration, change control, cutover support, rollback, and customer acceptance.** Ability to develop MOPs, low\-level designs, test procedures, rollback plans, as\-built documentation, operational runbooks, and customer training materials. **Strong customer communication and project discipline, including the ability to explain risks, manage technical expectations, and coordinate multiple contributors.** Ability to travel regularly to customer locations and support scheduled maintenance windows, including evenings or weekends when required. **Bachelor’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, electrical engineering, telecommunications, information technology, physics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.** U.S. work authorization and the ability to travel within the United States for implementation activity. Desired Experience **Optical networking and fiber infrastructure, including DWDM, coherent transport, optical power and loss measurements, attenuation, fiber inspection, cleaning, troubleshooting, and test equipment.** Cybersecurity implementation involving firewalls, zero trust, network access control, microsegmentation, PKI, certificates, TLS, IPsec, identity, secure management, logging, or vulnerability remediation. **QKD architectures and operations, PQC\-enabled technologies, crypto\-agility, key\-management systems, HSMs, network encryptors, or hybrid cryptography.** Integration of QKD or external key\-management systems using certificates, APIs, ETSI interfaces, or vendor\-specific protocols. **Juniper, Cisco, Arista, Nokia, Ciena, HPE Aruba, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, F5, Kentik, or comparable platforms.** Python, shell scripting, APIs, configuration management, automation, test harnesses, or infrastructure\-as\-code. **NIST PQC standards such as ML\-KEM, ML\-DSA, and SLH\-DSA and guidance related to quantum\-safe migration.** Relevant networking, cybersecurity, cloud, Linux, optical, or project\-delivery certifications. Measures of Success **Deployments are completed safely, on schedule, within approved scope, and against documented acceptance criteria.** Site\-readiness gaps and delivery dependencies are identified early and managed effectively. **Functional and performance testing succeeds with limited rework and disciplined defect closure.** Customer documentation, as\-built records, training, and support handoff are complete and usable. **Post\-go\-live stabilization is efficient and customer operations teams are prepared to manage the solution.** Reusable automation, configurations, MOPs, and delivery playbooks reduce future deployment effort. About Quantum Foundry Quantum Foundry helps commercial, public\-sector, research, and education organizations modernize enterprise infrastructure while preparing for quantum\-era security and computing. The company integrates networking, optical transport, cybersecurity, data\-center, QKD, PQC, professional services, and managed services into practical customer solutions. Application Information Submit a resume and a brief summary of relevant customer\-facing engineering experience to https://quantumfoundry.ai/careers\-1 Equal Employment Opportunity Quantum Foundry is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. Quantum Foundry does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified applicants and employees with disabilities. Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Implementation Success Partner
jobs.description: On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare. We enable hospitals to focus on what matters most: patient care. Our innovative solutions harness the power of machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to deliver exceptional outcomes and empower care teams to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise. Our success in rapid scale across the globe is backed by some of the world's leading investors. At Qventus, you will have the opportunity to work with an exceptional, mission\-driven team across the globe, and the ability to directly impact the lives of patients. We're inspired to work with healthcare leaders on our founding vision and unlock world\-class medicine through world\-class operations. \#LI\-MB1 As a **Senior Surgical Growth Implementation Success Partner**, you will lead the most complex perioperative deployments in our portfolio, multi\-service\-line, multi\-site, and executive\-facing engagements where the bar for delivery, influence, and autonomy is highest. You will own the full implementation lifecycle from pre\-sale collaboration through hypercare, partnering with Sales early to shape scope and set delivery expectations, and serving as the strategic advisor to perioperative executives, surgeons, schedulers, and IT teams once delivery is underway. This role blends engagement leadership, executive stakeholder management, technical fluency, and analytics. You will operate with broad autonomy, escalating only the highest\-risk or strategic matters, and you will be expected to anticipate risks before they materialize, design mitigation strategies proactively, and guide client decision\-making at the executive level. Your fluency with Qventus dashboards and reporting will allow you to identify gaps, surface opportunities, and build reinforcement strategies that drive sustained adoption and ROI. Your deep understanding of the product, perioperative operations, and EHR architecture will allow you to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement, maximizing value for clients and positively impacting healthcare operations. Join us and help revolutionize the healthcare landscape with cutting\-edge technology and strategic implementation. **Key Responsibilities:** ------------------------- * Partner with Sales prior to delivery handoff to shape scope, validate feasibility, and set clear delivery expectations for enterprise perioperative engagements. * Define and manage the timeline for enterprise\-wide deployment of the Qventus Periop Solution across multiple service lines and facilities. * Lead large, complex perioperative implementations involving multiple service lines, surgeon groups, and executive stakeholders. * Serve as a strategic advisor to perioperative leadership and the C\-suite, facilitating executive\-level discussions and guiding client decision\-making on scope, risk, and operational strategy. * Build and manage relationships at every level of client organizations, with a particular focus on influencing executive and senior operational stakeholders. * Collaborate with Data Engineers, Product Specialists, and Client Success Partners throughout each deployment to identify and implement solutions that maximize client value. * Partner with operational and technical client teams to ensure periop implementation requirements and needs are met. * Leverage deep functional periop expertise to create and sustain buy\-in from core users, executives, and surgeons around workflows and tool adoption. * Anticipate risks before they materialize, design proactive mitigation strategies, and advise internal and external leaders on resolution paths. * Demonstrate fluency across Qventus dashboards and reporting tools to identify gaps, surface opportunities, and build reinforcement strategies that drive sustained adoption and value realization. * Identify process improvement opportunities, implement structured approaches to close gaps, and lead change management efforts to ensure successful workflow adoption and long\-term sustainability. * Act as the primary owner of the implementation for assigned client accounts, operating with broad autonomy and accountability and escalating only the highest\-risk or strategic matters. * Articulate Qventus' value proposition and create value for customers by establishing clearly defined business outcomes. * Create a customer base who is excited about Qventus and serves as a reference for prospective customers. * A passion for fixing our healthcare system. **What We're Looking For:** --------------------------- * 8\+ years of project/program management experience with a comprehensive understanding of the business requirements and technical capabilities needed for an enterprise\-wide SaaS implementation. * 8\+ years of professional experience working at a top healthcare consulting firm, digital health company, or health system. * 8\+ years of experience working cross\-functionally with multiple teams, both internally and externally, to manage end\-to\-end project lifecycles and to drive project milestones to completion. * Demonstrated experience leading large, complex implementations with executive engagement. * Proven track record collaborating with Sales or pre\-sales teams to scope, validate, and hand off enterprise deployments. * Knowledge of perioperative metrics, processes, challenges, and solutions; ability to engage in strategic and operational discussions with hospital leaders and surgeons. * Fluency with Epic, Cerner, or comparable EHR environments, able to speak credibly to EHR architecture, integrations, and workflow implications without relying on technical SMEs. * Project management experience with complex implementations in the provider\-side healthcare setting. * A track record of applying strong quantitative and analytical skills in prior roles, including fluent use of dashboards and reporting tools to drive adoption and reinforcement strategies. * Prior experience managing projects for hospital systems (e.g., EHR implementations) is required. * Skilled at understanding, documenting, and analyzing data using a variety of tools (data validation dashboards, interpreting JAVA/SQL code, complex Excel functions, etc.). * Ability to travel on average 25% \-35%. **It's a Plus if You Have…** ---------------------------- * Experience writing SQL queries (highly desired). * PMP certification. * Experience working with clinical and/or process consultants. Qventus values diversity in its workforce and proudly upholds the principles of Equal Opportunity Employment . We welcome all qualified applicants and ensure fair consideration for employment without discrimination based on any legally protected characteristics, including, but not limited to: veteran status, uniformed service member status, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin or ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics) or any other category protected by federal, state or local law (collectively, "protected characteristics"). Our commitment to equal opportunity employment applies to all persons involved in our operations and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee, including supervisors and co\-workers. Qventus participates in the E\-Verify program as required by law and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in compliance with Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). In compliance with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Qventus provides transparency into how applicant data is processed during the application process. Candidate information will be treated in accordance with our candidate privacy notice. * Benefits and perks are subject to plan documents and may change at the company's discretion. * Employment is contingent upon the satisfactory completion of our pre\-employment background investigation and drug test.

jobs.title: Edge AI/Computer Vision Engineer
jobs.description: Concept Reply, part of the Reply Network, is a leader in IoT solutions. We support and advise our customers in Automotive, Manufacturing, Smart Infrastructure and beyond in all aspects of Internet of Things (IoT) and Cloud Computing. From designing and developing customized IoT solutions to implementing and managing them seamlessly, Concept Reply helps customers unlock the potential of IoT. We are seeking a Computer Science or Computer Engineering graduate for an engagement deploying AI\-driven computer vision for industrial safety, working alongside our data and AI engineering team and the client's controls engineers on real, on\-site deliverables. ### **Responsibilities** * Install, configure and calibrate smart cameras at manufacturing sites for human detection in restricted areas * Train, optimize and deploy object detection models on edge hardware (AXIS ACAP) * Build and maintain the containerized software stack on Linux, managed through GitOps workflows (Git as source of truth, automated build/test/deploy) * Collaborate with controls engineers to translate detection events into machine signals (e.g., stop a machine when a person is too close) and validate end\-to\-end behavior * Monitor model performance in the field, collect edge cases and iterate on datasets and models, with growing autonomy over the engagement ### **Minimum Requirements** * Bachelor's degree (completed or final year) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field * Strong foundation in programming fundamentals; proficiency in Python, working knowledge of C/C\+\+ * Solid Linux background (command line, services, logs, networking basics) * Hands\-on experience with Docker (images, Compose, volumes, container troubleshooting) * Familiarity and experience with Git\-based CI/CD and GitOps practices * Coursework or project experience in computer vision / deep learning * Willingness to travel regularly to client manufacturing sites ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with CV/DL frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV) and object detection models (YOLO, SSD, or similar) * Experience optimizing models for edge devices (TFLite, ONNX, quantization) on hardware such as AXIS ACAP, NVIDIA Jetson, Coral or Raspberry Pi * Basic understanding of industrial controls (PLCs, digital I/O, Modbus, OPC\-UA) and machine safety concepts * Experience with IP cameras, video streaming (RTSP) or network configuration * Prior internship, research, or hands\-on hardware/IoT project experience * Strong communication skills; comfort working directly with client engineering teams **About Reply** Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Reply services include Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services. The base compensation range for this full\-time position is between $100,000\-$120,000 plus benefits. Compensation decisions are supported through market data, where regional variances may exist based on cost of labor. We also consider prior experience, relevant skills, education, training, certifications, and other job\-related qualifications. If you have questions regarding compensation, the talent acquisition team can provide details during the interview process. Reply is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to provide equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you need assistance and reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, email us at jobusa@reply.com. Visit our website at www.reply.com to learn more about our open roles. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

scratch (requiring immaculate cable management), followed by configuring a home server network and network\-attached storage (NAS) / home lab environments. * **App \& Software Development:** Build new software applications from scratch and actively modify, optimize, or debug existing app codebases to add new features. * **Web Engineering:** Create, deploy, and maintain functional websites, handling up home labs, managing network routing, and establishing secure local storage. * **Work Style:** Exceptionally reliable, organized, highly careful with expensive hardware components, and able to transition seamlessly between physical tech tasks and deep software engineering. **How to Apply** If you are an all\-in\-one technician, developer, and engineer looking for immediate task\-based pay, please reach out with: * **A link to your GitHub profile** (or portfolio) showcasing your past repositories, app codebases, or website projects. * A brief summary highlighting your hands\-on experience with custom PC builds, server setups, or physical hardware troubleshooting. * Your current academic or professional availability over the coming weeks near the University of Houston campus. Pay: From $20\.00 per hour Application Question(s): * Provide a link to your Github showcasing your experience portfolio. Experience: * Application development: 2 years (Required) * Back\-end development: 1 year (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Houston, TX 77204

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: Overview: Location: 2201 Lakeside Blvd., Richardson, TX 75082 Position Title: Lead AI Engineer Hours: Monday – Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, 40 Hours/Week Responsibilities: **Technical Strategy \& Architecture:** Own the end\-to\-end architecture for AI products and platforms, including: Model selection strategy (e.g. Google vs. OpenAI, small vs. large models), multi\-agent and workflow orchestration patterns (responder/thinker pattern, tool calling, agentic frameworks), and data and retrieval architecture (RAG, hybrid search, knowledge graphs, semantic caching). Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies such as: next\-generation LLMs and multimodal models, real\-time streaming infrastructures, and advanced agent frameworks, workflow engines (e.g., Agents SDK, Google ADK, LangGraph, etc.). **Platformization \& Reusable Capabilities:** Design and lead the implementation of shared AI services and SDKs, including reusable RAG pipelines and ingestion frameworks, common UI components and design patterns for AI copilots and agents, and modular reusable coding practices for agentic back\-end processes. Establish standards and best practices for: prompt design and versioning, model and retrieval evaluation, and observability, logging, and incident response for AI systems. **Leadership \& Mentoring:** Provide hands\-on technical leadership to AI Engineers, ML Engineers, and Data Scientists. Guide architectural decisions and code quality, conduct thorough design and code reviews and mentor team members in LLMs, RAG, agentic design, and production AI practices. Help define and grow the AI engineering culture, focusing on innovation, quality, and responsible AI. **Delivery \& Stakeholder Management:** Partner closely with Product, Design, and Business stakeholders to: identify high\-value AI use cases aligned with company strategy and PropTech domain needs, shape product roadmaps and define measurable success criteria for AI initiatives. Lead complex, cross\-functional AI projects from concept to production, ensuring: clear requirement definitions and project plans, on\-time delivery with high quality and reliability, and ongoing iteration based on user feedback and metrics. **Evaluation, Governance \& Responsible AI:** Define robust evaluation frameworks, including offline and online metrics for relevance, safety, user satisfaction, and business impact, human evaluation workflows for complex or sensitive tasks. Drive AI governance and responsible AI practices, including: content safety, bias and fairness considerations, PII handling, compliance with internal policies and external regulations (e.g., GDPR\-like requirements, data residency). Collaborate with security, privacy, and legal teams to ensure compliant AI solutions. **Performance, Reliability \& Cost Management:** Lead performance and cost optimization for AI systems, including: model routing, distillation, and caching strategies, right\-sizing infrastructure and making build\-vs\-buy decisions, SLAs/SLOs for key AI services, including latency, uptime, and error budgets. Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks related to scalability, data quality, or vendor lock\-in. Remote work permitted. Qualifications: * The position requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field and seven (7\) years of experience in the job offered or as a Data Scientist, Software Engineer, ML Engineer, or an acceptable alternate occupation. * The position requires two (2\) years of experience in a senior or leadership role. * The position requires knowledge and experience with the following skills and technologies: + Python and TypeScript or JavaScript in production environments; + Designing and operating distributed, cloud\-native systems, such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Azure, or Amazon Web Services(AWS); Containerization and orchestration, such as Dockers or Kubernetes, and modern Continuous Integration /Continuous Delivery (CI/CD); + Working with coding assistants, such as Windsurf, Cursor, Codex, etc.; + Architecting and shipping complex AI systems to production at scale; + Leading multi\-engineer initiatives and mentoring others; + Making data\-driven tradeoffs between speed, quality, and cost; + Advanced experience with LLM\-based application design, such as prompting, tool use, function calling, multi\-agent workflows; + Advanced experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, and retrieval optimization techniques; + Advanced experience with AI observability, monitoring, and evaluation frameworks; + Ability to communicate complex AI concepts to executives and non\-technical partners; + Experience presenting AI strategy and progress to leadership and cross\-functional teams; + Advanced experience in context engineering, including prompt design, RAG pipelines, grounding strategies, and multi turn orchestration to optimize LLM reasoning; + Ability to build and maintain evaluation harnesses for LLMs, including dataset creation, automated benchmarking, regression testing, and quality of output analysis; + Hands on experience with LLM fine tuning , such as SFT, PEFT/LoRA, distillation; + Ability to prototype and deliver AI POCs, translating ambiguous business problems into validated technical solutions through rapid experimentation; + Ability to read, interpret, andapply scientific research, extracting actionable insights from AI/ML papers and implementing state of the art techniques. Remote work permitted. Travel required to Richardson, TX office 1 wk / mo. Pay Range: USD $190,578\.00 \- USD $249,400\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Front-End Software Engineer II
jobs.description: At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. **About the team:** The Terrestrial Software team is building the foundation for an automated rocket factory and integrated launch platform. Their mission is to automate and streamline workflows across the entire lifecycle of Terran R, from raw material intake to launch operations and eventually manufacturing on Mars. This is a hands\-on senior individual contributor role in which you will contribute directly through pull requests, help engineers who rotate into the SRE function, and shape the tools and practices of the new organization. **NOTE: \*Must be eligible to work on W2 without sponsorship. Not eligible for C2C.** * Pay Rate: $75–$80/hr * Duration: 6mo Contract\-to\-Hire * Location: Hybrid or Remote, however must reside in the following states: WA, OH, CA, AZ, CO, CT, FL, GA, MD, MN, NV, OR, AL, IL, VA, WI, TX, NY **RESPONSIBILITIES****SRE Framework \& Standards** * Establish the SRE framework, production standards, service\-level objectives, and error budgets, and replace ITIL\-style operational habits with engineering\-driven reliability practices. * Design the rotational model in which product engineers rotate into the SRE function, and grow it as new products launch. **Observability \& Hands\-On Engineering** * Lead full instrumentation of the first product, covering availability of every critical component, throughput, performance, and quality metrics, using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. * Go into product codebases to identify root causes and redesign for resilience, delivering fixes directly through pull requests. * Recommend observability and self\-healing tooling, with a strong preference for open\-source solutions. **Incident Leadership \& Roadmap** * Establish incident response and post\-incident learning practices, and give development teams early, actionable reliability signals. * Shape a roadmap toward automated investigation, automated remediation, and AI\-assisted pull requests for resiliency fixes. * Mentor engineers and partner with security and privacy stakeholders on engineering practices. **QUALIFICATIONS*** Demonstrated technical leadership for reliable production systems across multiple engineering teams, grounded in Google\-style SRE principles. * Strong software engineering skills in Python, TypeScript, or Node.js, with a record of fixing root causes in application code. * Hands\-on experience with several observability tools, including OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana, and the judgment to recommend best practices from experience. * Experience with Terraform\-based CI/CD and cloud infrastructure; jobs.description: REV Renewables, an LS Power company, is a leading developer, owner, and operator of renewable energy and energy storage projects across North America.
