Our mission is to deliver affordable, reliable, and clean electric power to all. Through a commitment to innovation, REV continuously adapts to the evolving regulatory, environmental, and market landscape to deliver optimized energy solutions. Learn more at https://www.revrenewables.com. **Job Summary:** REV’s Energy Management team optimizes storage and renewable assets in wholesale power markets, primarily PJM, CAISO, and ISO\-NE. Our in\-house Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) platform supports trading, dispatch, analytics, and portfolio reporting. We are seeking a Lead Data Systems Engineer to own the platform’s architecture, data pipelines, core applications, and daily operations. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with technical leadership responsibilities. You will maintain and improve a production system supporting trade capture, valuation, settlements, position management, and risk analytics. Working closely with traders, analysts, developers, and IT, you will keep the platform reliable, secure, and adaptable while enabling users with varying technical skills to build applications and access trusted data. **Duties/Responsibilities:** * **Build and maintain core systems**: Develop ETRM components, shared Python libraries, APIs, and data pipelines supporting trading, dispatch, valuation, settlements, and reporting. * **Guide platform architecture**: Establish practical patterns and standards that help users and AI agents build reliable applications while limiting maintenance complexity. * **Build infrastructure for intelligent automation**: Develop and maintain shared services that connect language models to internal data and tools, with secure access, deployment, monitoring, and evaluation. Establish reusable patterns that help traders, analysts, and developers automate workflows with appropriate controls and human oversight. * **Maintain engineering quality**: Review production code and maintain testing, documentation, source control, and deployment practices. * **Own production reliability**: Resolve incidents, maintain monitoring and runbooks, strengthen recovery procedures, and communicate system issues to stakeholders. * **Protect data and systems**: Maintain access controls, change management, audit trails, and segregation of duties in coordination with IT and applicable security, SOC, and NERC/FERC requirements. * **Ensure reporting integrity**: Deliver accurate, timely, transparent, and auditable position, dispatch, valuation, and hedge reporting for trading, risk, and finance. * **Partner with IT**: Define cloud and infrastructure requirements, including compute, storage, networking, and deployment needs. * **Enable users**: Provide technical guidance, documentation, and hands\-on support to traders, analysts, and developers. **Required Education/Skills/Knowledge:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science. * 7\+ years of relevant experience, including hands\-on ownership of production data platforms or trading systems. * Strong Python skills, including time\-series processing, dataframe libraries, columnar storage, data modeling, and API development. * Experience with production operations, testing, code review, deployment, and incident response. * Working knowledge of security, access controls, segregation of duties, and auditability in an energy trading environment. * Experience integrating language models with enterprise data and tools, including access controls, workflow orchestration, and production monitoring. * Experience using AI coding assistants effectively, including reviewing generated code, validating business logic, and testing changes before production deployment. * Clear communication skills and the ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions. * Strong ownership, sound judgment, and comfort working independently in a lean front\-office team. * **Preferred:** Experience with US power markets, energy trading products, building infrastructure for AI applications and agents, quantitative analytics, machine learning, and cloud infrastructure using Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and AWS EKS. **Technology Platform** **The platform is built primarily in\-house using open\-source tools. You will maintain and evolve the existing stack in collaboration with its users:** * **Data and business logic:** Python, pandas, Polars, and internal libraries. * **Integrations and APIs:** FastAPI, Selenium, SFTP, and HTTPS. * **Pipelines and reporting:**Dagster, Streamlit, and Power BI. * **Development and deployment:** Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS EKS, WSL, and Conda. * **Storage:** Primarily AWS S3, with an emphasis on efficient data access and querying. Please include “rev\-em\-systems” in your application materials. **Physical Requirements/Working Conditions:** * Must be able to sit/stand at a desk, using a computer workstation. * The employee is occasionally required to climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, reach with hands and arms, walk; lift push or pull objects up to 20 pounds. * Must be able to handle long periods of screen time and typing. * Must be able to have effective time management skills, with the ability to concentrate for long periods of time. **Why Join REV Renewables?** At REV Renewables, we’re not just transforming the energy landscape—we’re building a workplace where people thrive. Our mission is to accelerate the decarbonization of the electricity supply while ensuring affordability, reliability, and resilience. We do this by empowering our team with purpose, support, and opportunity. **Our Core Values** * **Integrity First** – We uphold the highest ethical standards in everything we do. * **Teamwork** – We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and fun work culture. * **Ownership Mindset** – We take accountability and act in the long\-term interest of our stakeholders. * **Thought Leadership** – We are creative, purposeful, and diligent in our decision\-making. * **Making a Difference** – We strive to positively impact our communities, employees, and society at large. **What We Offer** REV is proud to provide a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support employees’ well\-being and long\-term success. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend Full Stack - Rippling AI
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the role** ------------------ At Rippling, we're not just building AI features, we're building an autonomous operating system for work. We're investing heavily in the next generation of enterprise AI: intelligent background automation, systems that monitor and improve themselves, and a custom intelligence layer built on Rippling's unique data and workflows. The opportunity is to make Rippling's products fundamentally smarter and more autonomous over time, not through one\-off features, but through platform\-level infrastructure that compounds. You'll be joining the team that recently launched Rippling AI, the fastest\-growing product in Rippling's history. Every customer touchpoint, from onboarding to expense approvals to IT requests, is being rebuilt around agents, and the platform you build will be the foundation every AI surface at Rippling runs on. We're moving at startup speed with the reach of a category leader, and we're staffing this team like it's the most important bet at the company. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer for Rippling AI, you'll own meaningful technical initiatives end\-to\-end — from backend infrastructure to the user\-facing surfaces that make AI capabilities accessible, trustworthy, and intuitive. You'll drive architecture decisions within your scope, collaborate closely with engineers across product, infra, and platform orgs, and work alongside some of the best engineers and product leaders at Rippling. This is a deeply hands\-on role where you'll be in the weeds of the code — across the entire stack. **What you will do** -------------------- * Own end\-to\-end technical design and implementation for high\-impact AI platform initiatives — from backend systems through to the frontend surfaces that expose them to users and admins * Build scalable agent infrastructure that automates repetitive, high\-frequency workflows across Rippling's product surface * Design and implement user\-facing AI experiences that are observable, controllable, and intuitive — translating complex backend capabilities into clean, trustworthy interfaces * Develop harness and platform capabilities that encode business logic and institutional knowledge into reliable, automated workflows * Build frontend components and interaction patterns for AI\-powered surfaces including chat interfaces, agent dashboards, configuration UIs, and real\-time feedback loops * Collaborate closely with engineers across product, infra, and platform organizations to deliver cohesive experiences across the stack * Design systems that are observable, self\-correcting, and capable of improving over time with minimal human intervention * Partner closely with Product and Design to ensure AI\-powered surfaces are trustworthy, controllable, and delightful for end users and admins * Mentor junior engineers, contribute to best practices for full stack AI platform development, and raise the technical bar on your team * Track the frontier — translate model capability improvements into architectural and UX decisions, and move quickly when new approaches unlock better outcomes **What you will need** ---------------------- * 5\+ years of software engineering experience with a proven track record of owning and delivering complex technical projects across the full stack * Strong expertise in platform and distributed systems engineering — you've built reliable, observable, large\-scale backend systems * Proficiency in modern frontend frameworks (React/TypeScript) with a strong sense for building polished, performant user experiences * Strong hands\-on coding skills; you are an active, high\-output contributor in the codebase — backend and frontend * Experience driving technical initiatives end\-to\-end, including collaborating across teams to deliver outcomes that span infrastructure through UI * Strong product instincts — you translate ambiguous problems into durable platform capabilities and intuitive user experiences, and partner effectively with product and design teams * Clear, precise communication to diverse audiences, both written and verbal * Comfort with ambiguity and high velocity; the roadmap evolves as the technology evolves * Recent hands\-on experience building AI agents or AI\-powered user interfaces is a plus **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US San Francisco Bay Area) 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Irvine, California **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Technology and InnovationArchitecture, Systems, and Controls **Compensation** ---------------- * $107,000 – $147,050 • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • This role has an annual target bonus of 5% The posted salary represents the lowest and highest ranges RV Tech reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position. Any posted salary range pertains only to the estimated starting pay for the role. Actual starting pay is based on a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, skillset, qualifications, specific competencies, relevant education, and location. **About Us** ============ Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software\-defined vehicles around the world. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone. **Summary** The Embedded Software Engineer at Rivian Volkswagen Technologies Group is responsible for implementing and validating embedded software for battery and energy management systems, developing features for both low and high voltage systems such as power distribution, fault detection, and advanced state estimations. The role involves designing scalable, reliable software architectures, writing automated tests, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure safety and compliance with critical standards. **Responsibilities** * Implement and validate embedded software for battery and energy management systems. * Develop one or more of the following features for the low and high voltage systems: power and current distribution, DC/DC and operational state controls, fault detection and recovery, range estimation, battery thermal controls and management, and advanced battery state estimations (e.g. cell balancing, state\-of\-charge, state\-of\-health, state\-of\-power etc.) * Design scalable software with a focus on the embedded system reliability and performance. * Write automated tests for the software components, using unit, Software/Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (SIL/HIL) * Participate in code reviews and provide feedback for high\-quality solutions. * Support cross\-functional teams to ensure safety and reliability compliance for respective features. * Support technical meetings with peers to review feature design and performance. * Support teams with their test plans to achieve design \& validation goals. **Qualifications** * Bachelors in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent engineering or sciences. * 2\+ years’ experience in embedded programming in C or C\+\+ * Proficient in test driven development with developer driven coverage from different test targets (HIL/SIL/Unit). * 1\+ years' experience developing code for low or high voltage components in an integrated system. * Experience working with CAN, LIN, UDS, DoIP communication interfaces. * Strong interpersonal skills. **Total Rewards** ----------------- We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full\-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program. Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements. In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full\-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. **Learn more about our global benefit programs****.** External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site (**https://rivianvw.tech/\#careers**). **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are also committed to ensuring compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws regarding citizenship and immigration status. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com. **Candidate Data Privacy** -------------------------- Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies” may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) record keeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies affiliates; and (iii) Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies’ service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions. If you provide a mobile telephone number as part of your application or during the recruitment process, Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use that number to contact you via SMS text message for recruitment\-related purposes, including scheduling, logistics, and status updates. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out of SMS communications at any time by replying STOP to any text message you receive from us. Consent to receive SMS messages is not a condition of applying for or being considered for employment. \- *Please note this job posting represents an open, active vacancy. Additionally, we are not currently accepting applications from third party application services.* Compensation Range: $107,000 \- $147,050

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Pricing
jobs.description: Root was founded on the belief that car insurance is broken, and we set out to change it. We’re harnessing the power of technology to revolutionize this archaic, complicated industry. Using machine learning and mobile telematic platforms, we’ve built one of the most innovative insurtech companies in the world. **The Opportunity** Root is looking for a Staff Product Manager to define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the platforms that power our pricing advantage. This is a highly cross\-functional PM role focused on enabling faster, higher\-quality pricing decisions and model deployment across the company. You’ll own critical pricing capabilities, including our internal tool Pricing Platform System (PPS), and lead the evolution of the infrastructure, tooling, and decisioning systems at the center of Root’s pricing ecosystem. Pricing is one of Root’s core strategic advantages, and this role will shape the systems that determine how quickly we turn data and models into market\-leading pricing decisions. In this role, you will help build the next generation of Root’s machine learning platform for pricing, creating the infrastructure that allows researchers to move rapidly from experimentation to production. You will work closely with researchers on problems including feature pipelines and feature stores, reproducible model training and orchestration, model registries and versioning, automated validation, model serving, production observability, and tooling that ensures consistency between research and production. You will also explore how emerging LLM technology can revolutionize the data science workflow, improving the way models are developed, tested, deployed, and maintained, with the goal of dramatically reducing the time and effort required to turn new research into production pricing models. **Salary Range**: **$168,300 \- $210,980** (Eligible for competitive bonus and equity offering) Root is a “work where it works best” company. Meaning we will support you working in whatever location that works best for you across the US. We will continue to have our headquarters in Columbus, Ohio. **How You Will Make an Impact** * Own the Pricing platform roadmap and iterate on the vision for 2027 and beyond * Lead a team of engineers through the full product lifecycle, from ideation to implementation and iteration * Partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, and Actuarial to identify platform needs, prioritize investments, and define a roadmap that reduces friction from data readiness through model development, deployment, diagnostics, and monitoring * Guide the development of end\-to\-end ML platform capabilities, including opportunities to leverage emerging LLM technology to automate research, modeling, validation, and deployment workflows * Write clear product requirement documentation (PRDs) that align business strategy with engineering plans * Cultivate a prioritized product backlog using robust product frameworks and data\-driven decision makingAccelerate the path from new data and model features to production deployment * Improve pricing workflow speed, reliability, observability, and usability * Build self\-service tooling that enables faster experimentation and feature creation * Reduce operational and regulatory bottlenecks across pricing and filing workflows * Support Root’s nationwide expansion by adapting pricing capabilities to meet the specific regulatory and operational needs of new states **What You Will Need to Succeed** * 8\+ years of product management experience, ideally in fintech, insurtech, or another data\-intensive regulated environment * Strong systems thinking and comfort with technical concepts like predictive modeling, APIs, and workflow orchestration * Drive the integration of LLMs and advanced AI capabilities directly into daily data science workflows, transforming raw feedback into proactive models. * Data\-driven mindset; experience working with data scientists and analytics partners * Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex concepts into simple user experiences * Experience in agile development methodologies * Customer\-centric mindset with demonstrated success in improving user experiences * Detail\-oriented with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively * Adaptable approach to scope and responsibilities in a growing organization * Collaborative work style with the ability to influence without direct authority * Roll\-up\-the\-sleeves work ethic and "do\-what\-it\-takes" attitude to drive results in a fast\-paced environment * Ability to travel 10% of the time (quarterly in\-person team events) Preferred: * Experience as a data scientist, analyst, or Product Manager partnering closely with data science and ML engineering teams. * Experience working in insurtech, preferably in the risk and pricing ecosystem As part of Root's interview process, we kindly ask that all candidates be on camera for virtual interviews. This helps us create a more personal and engaging experience for both you and our interviewers. Being on camera is a standard requirement for our process and part of how we assess fit and communication style, so we do require it to move forward with any applicant's candidacy. If you have any concerns, feel free to let us know once you are contacted. We’re happy to talk it through. Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and the Civil Rights Act of 1964, it is the policy of Root to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or candidate with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for Root. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodation applies to all aspects of the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact recruiting@joinroot.com.

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer
jobs.description: We believe being healthy should not require tradeoffs. SCN BestCo is a leading innovator, developer and manufacturer of Vitamin, Mineral \& Supplement (VMS), Over\-the\-Counter (OTC) and prebiotics/probiotics in enjoyable forms such as gummies, lozenges and chews. With over 50 years of excellence, our team leads the way in changing how consumers make healthier choices. With unique food science expertise and proprietary processes, we’ve pioneered many firsts. The fire in our belly to create new to the world products has guided and continues to be core to our mission of making health and wellness more enjoyable. Come join us and become a part of our winning formula! The Senior Automation Engineer leads automation initiatives that improve overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), reduce downtime, support compliance, and modernize factory systems. The Senior Automation Engineer must possess extensive experience with programmable logic controllers (PLCs), human\-machine interface/supervisory control and data acquisition (HMI/SCADA) systems, industrial networks, process controls, batch systems, and automation project execution in a food manufacturing facility. Estimated starting annual base salary is $148,227\.14 \- $222,340\.71 per year less applicable withholdings and deductions, paid on a bi\-weekly basis. Please note that the actual compensation offered may vary based on relevant factors as determined by the Company, which may include, but is not limited to, location, experience, qualifications, education, skillset, and market conditions. The target base compensation for this role is in the low to middle of the range, with the top of the range reserved for only exceptional circumstances. In addition, this role is eligible for a discretionary, variable annual incentive, paid based on Company performance factors. SCN BestCo offers a competitive benefits package to eligible full\-time employees, which currently includes medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with employer matching contributions, life insurance, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more, as well as paid sick leave in accordance with applicable law. Each benefit is subject to eligibility requirements as specified in plan documents, and the Company reserves the right to modify the benefits it offers from time to time. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Design, program, troubleshoot, and maintain PLC systems, HMI/SCADA platforms, variable frequency drive (VFD) and servo systems, industrial instrumentation, batch control systems, robotic systems, and packaging automation systems. * Support continuous manufacturing operations and rapid troubleshooting of production issues. * Develop functional specifications, user requirement specifications, control narratives, and automation standards. * Provide PLC and controls programming on typical platforms such as Rockwell, Allen\-Bradley ControlLogix, CompactLogix, and legacy systems such as the SLC 500 series. * Provide programming and support of SCADA systems such as FactoryTalk, Wonderware, Ignition, DeltaV, or other distributed control systems (DCSs). * Provide manufacturing support of automated systems, including mixing and blending, clean\-in\-place/sterilization\-in\-place (CIP/SIP) systems, filling and packaging lines, conveying systems, vision inspection systems, and environmental monitoring systems. * Manage compliance and validation of computerized systems, ensuring compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, cGMP requirements, HACCP and food safety standards. * Support computerized system validation activities including installation, operational, and performance qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) protocols, risk assessments, change control, and standard operating procedure (SOP) development. * Provide internal plant production network support of ethernet/IP, OPC communications, managed industrial switches, and backup recovery systems. * jobs.title: Director, Quality Engineering
jobs.description: SI\-BONE is a fast\-growing, publicly traded medical device company that is an industry pioneer in minimally invasive sacropelvic solutions. Our mission is to help patients rise up and reach for the stars, and our vision is to work together as the global leader to make sacropelvic conditions universally recognized and effectively treated through innovation, evidence, education, and advocacy. SI\-BONE® is focused on helping patients in one of the most under\-served, under\-diagnosed, and under\-treated areas in orthopedics, the sacroiliac (SI) joint. SI\-BONE developed an innovative, patented implant to fuse the SI joint. The iFuse Implant System® provides a less invasive alternative to traditional sacroiliac (SI) joint fusion surgery and has been used in over 90,000 procedures to date. We are a medical device company that is focused on improving the lives of patients with sacroiliac pelvic conditions. We are looking for people who are passionate about our mission and who are willing to work hard to achieve it. We are also looking for people who are: * Agile: We work in a fast\-paced environment and need to be able to learn and adapt to change quickly. * Creative: We embrace creativity, and we need people who are not afraid to challenge the status quo. * Team Players: We roll\-up our sleeves and work together as one team to achieve our goals. **Position Summary:** The Director of Quality Engineering leads the technical quality function supporting product development, manufacturing, suppliers, and sustaining engineering. The Director manages the Quality Engineering team and partners with Research and Development, Operations, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, and other Quality functions to translate product requirements and risks into effective design, manufacturing, supplier, and inspection controls. This is a technically engaged leadership position requiring substantial engineering depth, strong statistical capabilities, and sound judgment. The Director is expected to challenge assumptions, assess the strength of technical evidence, and guide practical solutions, not just oversee completion of quality documentation. **Key Responsibilities:** **Technical Leadership and Team Development** * Manage and develop the Quality Engineering team, and inspection personnel if assigned; establish clear responsibilities, technical expectations, priorities, and development plans. * Define the Quality Engineering strategy across new product development, design transfer, and sustaining activities, and allocate resources according to product risk, business priorities, and project needs. * Provide independent quality judgment in cross\-functional decisions, clearly communicating technical risks, evidence gaps, and recommended actions. * Partner with the Senior Director of Quality and the Quality Systems function so that engineering activities align with quality\-system processes and are appropriately controlled, traceable, and documented. **Product Development and Design Assurance** * Partner with R\&D to establish clear, measurable product requirements and appropriate methods for demonstrating that those requirements are met. * Lead Quality Engineering contributions to product risk management, including identification of failure modes, evaluation of risk controls, and assessment of residual risk. * Guide verification and validation strategies, including test methods and test\-method validation, acceptance criteria, and worst\-case configurations; provide technical oversight of mechanical and functional testing and, as applicable, biocompatibility, cleaning, sterilization, packaging, and distribution testing. * Review technical protocols, results, deviations, and reports for scientific rigor, appropriate statistical treatment, and defensible conclusions. * Support design transfer by ensuring that manufacturing processes and supplier capabilities can consistently achieve product requirements. * Evaluate design, material, manufacturing, supplier, and quality\-process software changes to determine their effects on product performance and risk, and the qualification, validation, or testing required. **Manufacturing, Inspection, and Process Quality Engineering** * Lead Quality Engineering support for manufacturing and sustaining activities, including contract manufacturing and risk\-based process qualification and validation. * Provide technical oversight of inspection methods, sampling plans, acceptance criteria, and critical controls, supported by appropriate validation and measurement\-system analysis. * Evaluate process capability, stability, and sources of variation; lead engineering improvements to reduce recurring failures and improve product conformity and manufacturing performance. * Lead technical evaluation and significant nonconforming\-product disposition decisions using objective evidence and risk assessment. **Supplier Quality Engineering** * Lead the technical quality interface with suppliers and contract manufactur ce and investigate complex failures. * Substantial applied statistical experience, including sampling and sample\-size justification, inference, process capability and control, measurement\-system analysis, experimental design, and reliability methods. * Proficiency with statistical software; ability to independently analyze data, critically review others' analyses, and interpret assumptions, uncertainty, and engineering significance. * Working knowledge of applicable medical\-device requirements and standards, including 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and the EU Medical Device Regulation. * Experience with risk\-based validation or assurance of quality\-process software. **Leadership and Communication** * Ability to balance technical rigor, risk, timelines, and business needs without compromising product quality, moving readily between detailed analysis and broader organizational priorities. * Demonstrated effectiveness influencing cross\-functional teams, resolving technical disagreements using evidence, and explaining complex technical issues and recommendations to senior leadership. * Strong prioritization, accountability, and follow\-through. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with orthopedic implants, surgical instruments, and associated manufacturing processes, including applicable ASTM and ISO test standards. * Experience with sterile products, packaging validation, cleaning validation, and sterilization. * Experience with dimensional metrology, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, and inspection of precision\-manufactured components. * Quality engineering experience with human tissue products, particularly process characterization, variability assessment, test\-method development, validation, and product acceptance criteria. * ASQ Certified Quality Engineer or comparable certification; advanced degree in engineering, statistics, or a related technical discipline. **Quality Authority and Professional Conduct** The Director has the authority to place affected product or processing activities on hold when there is a reasonable concern regarding product conformity, safety, or compliance, and is responsible for promptly escalating those concerns through the appropriate Quality, Regulatory, and management channels. The Director conducts business honestly, ethically, and lawfully, consistent with SI\-BONE's Code of Conduct and applicable company policies. SI\-BONE does not tolerate retaliation for good\-faith reporting of suspected violations. Salary range: $210,000 \- $235,000\. The compensation range for this position is specific to the location and is in good faith what SI\-BONE expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job\-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; and other relevant business and organizational factors. Supplemental pay: bonus and stock There are potential risks associated with the iFuse Implant System. It may not be appropriate for all patients and all patients may not benefit. For additional information on the company or the products including risks and benefits, please visit www.si\-bone.com/risks. We are aware of active recruitment scams using the SI\-BONE name, in which individuals pose as our recruiters and post fake remote job openings and make fake job offers on the Internet. Please note, we will never make an offer of employment without conducting multiple rounds of interviews face\-to\-face using secure video\-conferencing technology. We will never ask candidates to cash checks or make a payment in order to be considered for a position. SI\-BONE only uses company email addresses, which contain "@si\-bone.com" to communicate with candidates. If you believe you've been a victim of a phishing scam, please visit the Cybersecurity \& Infrastructure Security Agency at https://www.cisa.gov/be\-cyber\-smart/report\-incident learn how to report it.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Developer
jobs.description: SMSI Group is a multi\-trade mechanical contractor headquartered in Springfield, Missouri, with operations across Missouri, Arkansas, and Oklahoma. We are continually improving how our business operates, and custom software is an important part of that work. We are looking for a hands\-on software developer who can help turn business needs into reliable applications. You will work directly with our IT leadership and employees to understand problems, discuss solutions, and carry projects through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. and qualifications.** **Compensation:** $85,000 \- $100,000 yearly **Responsibilities:*** Participate in meetings with business users to understand workflows, clarify requirements, identify code they produce. * Test backend logic, APIs, database operations, permissions, integrations, and failure scenarios, along with the user\-facing experience. * Deploy applications to SMSI\-managed environments and troubleshoot issues in production. * Support and improve our existing Zoho applications, workflows, forms, approval rules, and integrations while replacement systems are developed. * Help plan and execute migrations, including moving data, validating results, transitioning users, and retiring replaced functionality. * Maintain clear source control, technical documentation, and deployment instructions so others can understand and support your work. * Communicate progress, raise issues early, and help balance new development with application support and changing priorities. **Qualifications:*** At least three years of professional software development experience, with examples of applications or substantial features you personally helped deliver to production. * manufacturing, or field\-service operations. * Prior Zoho or Deluge experience is helpful but is not required. Explain your responsibilities, the technologies you used, how you used AI if applicable, and how you handled testing, deployment, and support. Public repositories or demonstrations are welcome but are not required; we understand that much professional software is confidential. **About Company** SMSI is dedicated to providing the highest quality mechanical services performed in an honest, dependable, and efficient manner. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Application Platform
jobs.description: **Senior Backend Engineer, Application Platform** ================================================= **Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) · $185k–$215K base \+ meaningful early\-stage equity \+ full benefits** **About Sodalis** ----------------- Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in\-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1\.5B\+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). **The Opportunity** ------------------- Every pharmacy works from the same building blocks: prescriptions, directions, insurance claims, rejects. But each one handles them a little differently, so today every implementation means custom code. We want implementation to be configuration, done by a technical solutions team using internal tools, with no engineer in the loop. That's the engine you'd build. It's a classic backend problem with real stakes. You'll model the shared primitives so one system can absorb each pharmacy's nuances, build the configuration layer and the backend behind the tools, and define the contract between the engine and the people tuning it. That includes how new versions roll out only to the customers who want them, on a system that's already live and can't break. You'd own the application platform: the domain model, configuration layer, and tooling. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture and where the platform goes. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Model the shared primitives (prescriptions, directions, insurance outcomes) and build the backend that turns each pharmacy's differences into configuration, so one system serves many pharmacies. * Decide where the line between configuration and code sits: what a solutions team can safely configure, and what stays in the engine. * Build the backend services and APIs behind the internal tools a solutions team uses to implement a new customer without an engineer. * Define and version the contract between our engines and whoever configures them, so upgrades ship safely and selectively. * Ship changes to a system that's live, where every prescription is a patient and a bad migration isn't an outage, it's a delayed therapy. Zero\-downtime rollouts and safe versioning are table stakes here. * Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture and roadmap. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 5\+ years building backend systems in production. * Strong system design: you can take an open prompt, design a coherent system, and explain the trade\-offs clearly. * Solid data modeling and API design: you build systems that generalize, not one\-offs. * You've built something config\-driven that other people operated: a rules engine, a multi\-tenant platform, a feature\-flag or rollout system, a workflow DSL. You know where those designs go wrong. * You've shipped 0 1 in startups and are comfortable with ambiguity. * You'll spend time with the solutions team and with pharmacies to understand how their workflows actually differ. No healthcare background required. **How we work** --------------- We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk. Compensation Range: $185K \- $215K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Software Engineer, Infrastructure** ===================================== **Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) · $185K–$215K base \+ meaningful early\-stage equity \+ full benefits** **About Sodalis** ----------------- Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in\-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1\.5B\+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). **The Opportunity** ------------------- Everything we run today is cloud\-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on\-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range. You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on\-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between. * Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy. * Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site. * Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range. * Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 5\+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering. * You've taken an AWS\-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services. * You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on\-prem, customer\-hosted, edge, or embedded. * You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them. * You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity. * You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required. **How we work** --------------- We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk. Compensation Range: $185K \- $215K

jobs.title: Finance Engineer
jobs.description: SPRCHRGR (pronounced "supercharger") is a professional services consultancy providing highly skilled team members across a variety of complementary disciplines. We like to say, "cut out the vowels, get there faster!" because we prioritize creativity, efficiency, and performance in our work, and we have fun doing it. Our exceptional staff \+ innovative approach set us apart from stuffy traditional accountancies and commoditized outsourced bookkeeping agencies. We think differently about our work supporting high\-growth startups, forward\-thinking SMBs, and nonprofits located all across the US. We specialize in **cutting\-edge technology** and partner with dynamic businesses across diverse industries. Our team culture emphasizes **collaboration**, **learning**, and **process\-driven efficiency**. We're looking for someone who reads a trial balance and writes software. You'll build the client\-facing financial tools for our fractional CFO firm: interactive dashboards and forecasting models, AI assistants that answer finance questions from live accounting data, and automations that take real recurring work off our clients' plates. We're small, we move fast, and we build our own tools instead of buying and configuring someone else's platform. **Who we are** -------------- SPRCHRGR combines executive financial leadership, fractional CFO work and controllership with data, systems integration and workflow automation. Our clients run $1 million to $50 million in revenue and get a white\-glove build, not a template. We're small, we move fast, and we build our own tools (when it makes sense) instead of buying and configuring someone else's platform. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build and own our client dashboards.** Interactive financial models delivered as web apps, with scenario sliders, drill\-down tables, and Excel exports a client's own finance lead can audit. * **Build AI automations.** Small, versioned automations that do one job properly, like turning a client's billing spreadsheet into reconciled QuickBooks invoices with built\-in approval gates. * **Get the data in yourself.** Write the database queries behind our reporting and connect them to live client accounting data. Our VP of Technology owns the platform and will hand you the tools and procedures to work independently, not a ticket queue. * **Be the person we trust when two numbers disagree.** Work discrepancies to a documented answer, and know a genuine variance from two figures that were never comparable. * **Teach the rest of us.** Help our accountants and operators build their own tools instead of depending on you for every one. * **Work directly with clients.** Meet (virtually) with key client stakeholders to work out what they need, then build it. No layer in between, although you'll have full access to collaborate with other accounting \+ finance experts within our firm. **Who you are** --------------- **You have both halves. Finance \+ Engineering.** * **Finance:** real depth in accounting, financial statements, month\-end close, receivables and payables, reconciliation, how a general ledger actually works. CPA or CMA is a strong signal; demonstrated judgment matters more. * **Building:** you write and maintain real code and real database queries. Our VP of Engineering partners with you to architect, maintain, and enhance the secure data warehouses, APIs, and hosted web app platform underneath. You can take a system with wrong or missing documentation, work out what it actually does, and build against reality. You've built AI tools, not just used them. **Minimum requirements** * Bachelor's degree with a focus in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field. * 10\+ years of combined experience across accounting or finance and software or systems development. * CPA or CMA preferred, not required. * Proficiency in SQL preferred, not required. * Experience with at least one accounting system in depth, such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or Dynamics. * Clear and concise communication, both written and verbal. * Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment. * A dedicated workspace and access to reliable, secure, high\-speed internet. * An unwavering commitment to confidentiality. * Based in the United States * Embrace SPRCHRGR's Core Values. **What this job isn't** ----------------------- * Not a reporting role. If you just want to produce monthly financial packages, this is the wrong job. * Not a coordinator between finance and engineering. You build. * Not a management role in year one. * Not a place to learn accounting on the job. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- * *Fully Remote:* Work from home with a structured schedule. * *Career Growth:* Gain hands\-on mentoring and opportunities to work directly with our Founder \& CEO. * *Team\-Oriented Environment:* Collaborate with Software Engineers, Sr. Controllers, CFOs, and Accounting Managers to synthesize bespoke solutions for our clients. * *Competitive pay:* $150,000 \- $180,000 Base Salary, DOE. * *Phantom Equity:* Eligible for consideration after your first year. * *Bonus*: Annual performance\-based bonus compensation plan. * *401k:* Up to a 4% match and no vesting period. * *Benefits:* Customizable options. **What will make you stand out** -------------------------------- Send us something you built: a repository, a working file, or a written account of an automation you shipped end to end, with the before\-and\-after time it took. That matters more to us than a cover letter. jobs.title: AI Application Engineer
jobs.description: **THE COMPANY:** STACK INFRASTRUCTURE (STACK) provides digital infrastructure to scale the world’s most innovative companies. Each of our national facilities meets or exceeds the highest industry standards in all operational categories of availability, security, connectivity, and physical resilience. STACK offers the scale and geographic reach that rapidly growing hyperscale and enterprise companies need. The world runs on data. Data runs on STACK. **THE POSITION:** We're building enterprise AI platforms that automate document\-intensive review workflows across the business. The AI does the heavy lifting on document understanding, rule validation, and exception detection. The Product Engineer builds what users actually see and use — the reviewer workbench, the executive reporting layer, the data products, and the audit\-ready outputs that turn AI insights into business decisions. This is a hybrid product engineering \+ analytics engineering role. You'll partner with the AI Solution Architect (who owns the agents) and the MLOps Engineer (who owns the data platform) to ship the user\-facing layer. You report to the Head of AI \& Data Strategy. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: **Reviewer Workbench \& application engineering** * Reviewer\-facing application — triage incoming documents, accept or override AI recommendations, annotate decisions * UI/UX patterns that match how reviewers actually work today (comment logs, page\-level evidence links, override flows) * Feedback capture — every reviewer interaction trains the model and refines the rule packs * Application performance at scale — handling high document volumes with thousands of pages of supporting context * Surfacing of agent outputs, confidence scores, and citations to reviewers in a way they trust **Reporting, dashboards \& executive visibility** * Power BI dashboards on Databricks SQL Warehouse — review throughput, accuracy, time saved, operational metrics * Executive reporting layers for SLT and business leadership * Portfolio analytics — cross\-domain benchmarks, trend analysis, anomaly surfacing * Quarterly reporting infrastructure for SteerCo and AI Program Council reviews **Data products \& analytics engineering** * Clean, documented Gold\-layer data products on Unity Catalog — reusable across business stakeholders, IT Delivery, AI team * Output generators — auto\-produce Excel \+ Word \+ linked evidence outputs per reviewed item, audit\-ready by default * APIs and integration patterns surfacing platform outputs to enterprise systems and business workflows * Analytics engineering standards — dbt or equivalent modeling, version control, lineage, documentation **User research \& adoption** * Direct work with business users — what's slowing them down, what's working, what they need next * Fast\-cadence iteration based on real user feedback, not quarterly release cycles * User documentation, training materials, onboarding flows for end users and report consumers * Cross\-functional partnership with the AI Solution Architect, MLOps Engineer, business stakeholders, IT Delivery, SLT **THE DETAILS:** * Location: Denver, CO * Travel: Under 10% * Benefits: Healthcare, Dental Care, Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Paid Leave Programs * Must be eligible to work in the United States * Must pass comprehensive background and drug screening **MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS:** * 5\+ years building data\-intensive applications, internal tools, or data products in production * Full\-stack capability — modern web frameworks (React, Vue, or equivalent), Python or TypeScript, SQL * Production experience with at least one BI/reporting tool (Power BI preferred) * Strong SQL on Databricks SQL Warehouse, dbt, or equivalent lakehouse modeling * Proven UX intuition — you have shipped internal tools real users adopt and improved them based on observed behavior * Experience designing reporting consumed by executive stakeholders — balancing detail, accuracy, clarity * Microsoft 365 and Azure ecosystem familiarity (Power BI, SharePoint Online, Azure App Services, Entra ID) * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field **Nice to have** * Power BI Data Analyst Associate or Databricks Data Analyst Associate certifications * Document\-heavy UX experience — PDF viewers, annotation tools, evidence linking, comment logs * Experience surfacing LLM outputs to end users — confidence scoring, override flows, citation interfaces * React \+ TypeScript \+ modern frontend tooling and component libraries * Embedded analytics (Power BI embedded, Looker embedded, or equivalent) * Construction, real estate, data center, or AEC industry context * Experience operating in a small AI team where you wear multiple hats **How you work** * You build for the user in front of you. You would rather watch a user use what you built than read about adoption metrics. * You're comfortable with ambiguity. You figure out what the user needs by talking to them, not by waiting for a spec. * You ship small and often. Big quarterly releases are not your model. * You think about data products as products. A Gold\-layer table should be documented, versioned, and reliable. **Compensation Range:** $128,260\.00 \- $146,017\.59**THIS MIGHT BE RIGHT FOR YOU IF:** * You are a strong communicator, you are persuasive and clear, blending analytics with experience in decision\-making. * You do not get flustered easily. You can juggle multiple priorities while balancing urgent requests with shifting timelines and deliverables. * You are a team builder. You take the time to understand and develop the strengths of your resources while formulating long\-term plans for the growth and success of the team. * You are naturally curious and driven toward continual improvement. While you celebrate your successes, you take time to review and analyze campaigns for future learning. **WHY STACK?** * We offer a competitive compensation package with strong benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401K program, flexible spending accounts – even a cell phone subsidy. * We foster a culture of appreciation, including peer\-to\-peer recognition and rewards programs. * Fun is part of our DNA, with events, game nights, happy hours, and barbecues. * We’re growing – this is a great time to join and make an impact! *STACK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of STACK Infrastructure, Inc.*

jobs.description: Sawhorse Productions is a Los Angeles based, Award winning full\-service creative studio turning ideas into unforgettable experiences through captivating branded content, viral social moments, and groundbreaking interactive experiences. We partner with industry\-leading brands, artists, and studios such as Walmart, Google, NBCUniversal, Fanatics, Toyota, Pepsi and Alo to deliver industry\-leading, innovative multi\-platform content. At Sawhorse, we believe in fostering a culture of collaboration, creativity, and relentless excellence while shaping the future of digital storytelling. Our releases include: \[Roblox, Fortnite, Rec Room, ZEPETO] * Roblox: How To Train Your Dragon * Roblox: Wicked RP * Roblox: Walmart Discovered \- 2024 ADDY Winner * Roblox: Fenty \- 2024 Webby winner * Roblox: Alo Sanctuary * Roblox: Lamborghini Lanzador Lab \- 2024 Telly Winner * Gen AI applet: Coca \- Cola Cappy * And numerous digital fashion releases on UGC Gaming platforms \- Sawhorse Productions We're looking for a hands\-on, player\-obsessed, and highly organized Roblox Game Producer to lead the end\-to\-end production of branded and original experiences on Roblox. Sawhorse Productions sits at the intersection of commercial production, interactive experiences, and UGC gaming, and this role is the engine that turns big brand ideas into games players genuinely want to come back to. You'll own schedules, scope, and team coordination from concept through launch and live operations, keeping our developers, artists, and brand partners aligned and moving fast. Our office is located in Los Angeles. While we are a remote\-first company, we expect this role to be in the office for key client meetings, kickoffs, and team collaboration as needed. **This is an hourly freelance position, with expected availability during PST core hours M\-F 9:00 AM \- 6:00 PM.** **Requirements** * **End\-to\-End Game Production:** Lead the production of branded and original Roblox experiences from concept and pre\-production through launch, ensuring every release ships on time, on budget, and to Sawhorse's quality bar. * **Roadmaps and Scheduling:** Build and manage project roadmaps, sprint plans, and milestone schedules in Jira, Asana, or Airtable, giving every discipline clear visibility into deliverables, priorities, and deadlines. * **Scope and Budget Management:** Manage project scope, budgets, and resourcing, flagging risks early and making smart tradeoffs that protect timelines and creative quality. * **Cross\-Discipline Collaboration:** Partner with game designers, Luau scripters, 3D artists, UI/UX designers, and QA to keep development aligned with the creative vision and game design document. * **Brand Partner Management:** Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact for brand and agency partners, leading status meetings, presenting builds, and translating client goals into actionable development priorities. * **Roblox Platform Compliance:** Manage Roblox approval processes, brand guidelines, and platform policies, including Roblox Advertising Standards and content maturity requirements, so every experience launches cleanly. * **Live Operations:** Plan and execute post\-launch content updates, limited\-time events, and live ops calendars that drive player retention and engagement. * **Analytics and Performance:** Monitor game performance through the Roblox Creator Dashboard, tracking concurrent users, session length, retention, and conversion, and use those insights to shape updates. * **Playtesting and QA:** Develop and run playtesting and QA processes, gathering player and stakeholder feedback to refine gameplay before and after launch. * **Production Process Ownership:** Establish and improve production workflows, documentation, and Agile ceremonies that help Sawhorse's interactive team scale across multiple concurrent projects. * **External Studio Coordination:** Collaborate with external development studios and freelance Roblox creators when projects need additional capacity, keeping outsourced work aligned with internal standards. * **Platform Trends and Innovation:** Stay ahead of Roblox platform updates, emerging genres, and branded gaming trends, bringing new formats and ideas to Sawhorse's creative and business teams. ### **Qualifications** A strong candidate for this position should have the following qualities: * **Experience:** 3\+ years of experience as a Producer, Associate Producer, or similar role within games, interactive media, or branded entertainment, including at least one shipped experience on Roblox. * **Roblox Platform Knowledge:** Deep understanding of the Roblox platform, its audience, and its ecosystem, including Roblox Studio workflows, publishing, and platform approval processes. * **Game Development Lifecycle:** Proven track record taking games from pre\-production through launch and into live operations. * **Production Tools:** Strong proficiency with Jira, Asana, Airtable, or comparable project management tools, along with Agile and Scrum methodologies. * **Client\-Facing Delivery:** Experience managing projects for external brand or agency clients, including expectation setting, status reporting, and feedback management. * **Data\-Informed Decisions:** Strong understanding of game metrics such as DAU, CCU, retention, and session length, and how to use them to prioritize updates. * **Budget and Schedule Management:** Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, schedules, and resourcing across multiple concurrent projects. * **Communication and Leadership:** Excellent communication skills, with the ability to align creative, technical, and client stakeholders and keep teams motivated in a fast\-moving environment. ### **Nice To Have's** * Experience producing on Fortnite Creative / UEFN, Minecraft, or other UGC gaming platforms * Background in commercial production, advertising, or agency environments * Familiarity with Luau scripting or hands\-on time in Roblox Studio * Experience with Roblox monetization, including Game Passes, Developer Products, and UGC avatar items * Experience producing live in\-game events, brand activations, or music and entertainment collaborations * Agile or Scrum certification (CSM, PSM) **Benefits** **$30 \- $45 per hour** EEO Statement Sawhorse Productions is an equal employment opportunity employer. jobs.title: Sr. Integration Engineer
jobs.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960\. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all\-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built\-in gas\-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go\-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now! #### **Overview** Our integration technology landscape is currently centered on MuleSoft and SAP BTP and will continue to evolve as our business and technology ecosystem grows. We are looking for a hands\-on Senior Integration Developer who brings strong integration fundamentals, depth in MuleSoft, exposure to SAP BTP, and the curiosity and flexibility to learn and adopt new integration technologies over time. #### **What you'll do** Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick\-up truck \& rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: * Contribute to the design, development, implementation, and support of the enterprise Integration Platform, currently leveraging MuleSoft Anypoint Platform and SAP BTP Integration Suite. * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support APIs and integrations connecting enterprise applications, SAP systems, SaaS platforms, cloud services. * Develop scalable and reusable integrations using MuleSoft, SAP BTP, and other integration technologies as the platform evolves. * Design and implement APIs using REST, SOAP, OData, and event/message\-based integration patterns based on business and technical requirements. * Develop MuleSoft applications using Mule 4, DataWeave, Anypoint Studio, API Manager, and Anypoint Platform capabilities. * Develop and support integrations using SAP BTP Integration Suite, particularly for SAP and enterprise application integration use cases. * Create reusable APIs, integration components, templates, and common patterns to improve development speed and consistency. * Implement appropriate error handling, logging, retry, exception management, and security within integration solutions. * Work with messaging and event technologies such as Kafka, queues/topics, and related technologies where required. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support automated build, testing, and deployment of integration applications. * Perform unit and integration testing and troubleshoot technical issues throughout development, testing, and production support. * Monitor integrations and proactively identify and resolve performance, connectivity, data, and application issues. * Optimize integrations for performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability. * Maintain technical documentation for APIs, interfaces, mappings, integration flows, deployment procedures, and operational support. * Follow established development, security, API, and integration standards and contribute to improving those standards as the platform matures. * Participate in technical design and code reviews and provide recommendations based on integration development best practices. * Collaborate with application teams, SAP teams, security, DevOps, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver integration solutions. * Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other developers and contribute to a culture of engineering quality and continuous learning. * Learn and adopt new integration technologies and patterns as the enterprise integration landscape continues to grow. **Location \& Travel Expectations**: * This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in Charlotte, North Carolina. * This role requires 4 days per week in the office, with regular in\-person meetings and events. * Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the comp ML, XSD, CSV, and SQL. * Experience with messaging or event\-streaming technologies such as Kinesis, Kafka or similar technologies is a plus. * Experience integrating with SAP S/4HANA or other SAP applications is a plus. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git\-based source control, and DevOps practices for integration applications. * Working knowledge of integration and API security concepts such as OAuth 2\.0, certificates, JWT, TLS/mTLS, and secrets management. * Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. * Experience with application and integration logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support. * Strong understanding of error handling, performance optimization, reliability, and maintainability in enterprise integrations. * Ability and willingness to learn additional integration platforms and technologies as the enterprise integration ecosystem evolves. * Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills. When a problem occurs, you run toward it, identify the root cause, and help drive it through resolution. * Effective communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across technical and business teams. * Ability to provide technical guidance to less\-experienced developers while remaining hands\-on with development and delivery. #### **What you'll gain** The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: * Competitive insurance including: + Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans * 401(k) program with: + An employer match and immediate vesting * Generous Paid Time Off including: + 20 days planned PTO, as accrued + 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually + Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders + Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave #### **Pay Transparency** This is a full\-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent. Initial base salary range \= $140,000\.00 \- $170,000\.00 Internal leveling code: IC8 **Notice to applicants:** * To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older. * Residing in **San Francisco**: *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* * Residing in **Los Angeles**: *Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.* * Residing in **New York City**: *This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.* **Equal Opportunity** Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre\-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.
