jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: SEE Headquarters \- Charlotte Sealed Air designs and delivers packaging solutions that protect essential goods transported worldwide, preserve food, enable e\-commerce and digital connectivity, and help create a global supply chain that is touchless, safer, less wasteful, and more resilient. We strive to foster a caring, high\-performance growth culture that will deliver consistent, sustainable profitable growth and accelerate our performance – a culture where accountability is clear and aligned, and where we reward business outcomes and impact. That culture guides everything we do, including how we partner with our customers and suppliers, how we attract and retain top talent, and how we create and deliver value to our stakeholders. In 2025, Sealed Air generated $5\.4 billion in sales and has approximately 16,100 employees who serve customers in 119 countries/territories. To learn more, visit www.sealedair.com. ***What will you do as a Senior AI Engineer at Sealed Air?*** ------------------------------------------------------------- Sealed Air is seeking a hands\-on **Senior AI Engineer** to design, develop, deploy, and support AI\-enabled applications for supply chain and manufacturing operations. The role combines software engineering and solution architecture with predictive machine learning, industrial IoT, MES integration, and generative AI to improve equipment reliability, work center performance, product quality, and operational productivity. The engineer will partner with supply chain leaders, plant operations, maintenance, OT, data engineering, and IT teams to turn business problems into secure, reliable production solutions and measurable outcomes. ***Why do we need you?*** ------------------------- * **Manufacturing AI and predictive analytics.** Develop and operationalize ML solutions for predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, equipment failure risk, cycle time and throughput forecasting, quality prediction, and work center bottleneck analysis. Define baselines and measure operational impact with plant stakeholders. * **Industrial data and MES integration.** Integrate machine and sensor telemetry, historian data, MES events, maintenance records, and ERP data. Connect equipment signals with production orders, assets, work centers, downtime reasons, and quality results to create meaningful analytical features. * **Model engineering and lifecycle.** Build reproducible data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and retraining pipelines. Address time\-series alignment, missing data, data leakage, class imbalance, and changing operating conditions; monitor model drift, false alarms, and prediction quality. * **LLM and RAG applications.** Build applications using LLMs, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) for manufacturing knowledge, troubleshooting, and operational assistance. Evaluate retrieval quality, grounded responses, access controls, latency, and cost. * **AI automation.** Develop AI\-assisted workflows that turn predictions and retrieved knowledge into alerts, recommendations, maintenance requests, and approved business actions. Apply human review, auditability, and appropriate OT controls to actions affecting plant operations. * **Full stack engineering and Azure operations.** Design and build APIs, backend services, databases, and web interfaces. Deploy, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, and support applications in Azure App Service, including identity, secrets, networking dependencies, availability, and application performance. * **DevOps and production ownership**. Use Azure DevOps for source control, work tracking, pull requests, automated testing, and CI/CD across development, test, and production. Maintain deployment approvals, rollback procedures, monitoring, incident diagnostics, and support documentation. * **Technical leadership and collaboration.** Translate business needs into technical designs and delivery plans; conduct code reviews, mentor engineers, and establish reusable patterns. Use approved AI coding tools and validate generated code for security, correctness, and maintainability. ***What do you need to succeed?*** ---------------------------------- Candidates must demonstrate hands\-on capability across all areas below. Experience limited to AI tool usage, proofs of concept, or managerial oversight does not meet the requirements. * **Engineering background.** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; 10\+ years of overall IT experience, including 7\+ years of hands\-on software development. Demonstrated solution design and architecture experience. * **Supply chain and manufacturing domain.** Strong understanding of production planning and execution, work centers, asset maintenance, quality, inventory, and material flow. Ability to translate downtime, throughput, yield, scrap, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE) into practical AI use cases and success measures. * **Industrial Io t Fabric, and production MLOps or LLMOps practices. (Preferred) * Experience integrating SAP or other ERP platforms with MES, historians, maintenance systems, and event\-driven services; familiarity with industrial edge deployments. (Preferred) * **Predictive AI and ML engineering**. Hands\-on experience building and deploying predictive models using machinery, work center, or manufacturing process data. Strong Python, SQL, feature engineering, time\-series analysis, model validation, and ML framework skills; ability to integrate model outputs into operational workflows. * **LLMs and RAG.** Demonstrated experience developing AI applications using LLMs and RAG, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, API integration, and evaluation. Understand hallucination risks, prompt injection, data privacy, and permission\-aware retrieval. * **Azure application management.** Hands\-on experience deploying and operating web applications in Azure App Service. Understand Microsoft Entra app registrations, service principals, managed identities, authentication and authorization, Key Vault, and Azure role\-based access control. Understand VNets, subnets, private endpoints, DNS, and App Service network integration sufficiently to troubleshoot application connectivity with infrastructure teams. * **Azure DevOps.** Working proficiency with Azure Repos or Git repositories integrated with Azure DevOps, Boards, pull requests, branching, CI/CD pipelines, service connections, environment configuration, release approvals, and rollback practices. * **Software engineering and collaboration.** Strong hands\-on Python for AI/ML and deep expertise in at least one primary backend stack: Python, .NET/C\#, or Java. Experience with APIs, databases, automated testing, production troubleshooting, and modern web interfaces. Communicate clearly with plant, business, and technical teams and mentor engineers. * Experience with Azure AI services, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, and production MLOps or LLMOps practices is preferred. Experience integrating SAP or other ERP platforms with MES, historians, maintenance systems, and event\-driven services; familiarity with industrial edge deployments is preferred. ***Pay Transparency*** ---------------------- **Base Compensation:** $93,100 \- $160,655 \+ bonus eligibility The range disclosed complies with applicable state and local pay transparency laws. Offers within this range will be determined by considering relevant factors including education, experience, and internal alignment. This position may also be eligible for annual performance bonuses and other incentive programs. jobs.description: **The Job:** We are seeking an exceptional and innovative Controls Engineer to design, develop, and implement control systems for our unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The ideal candidate will have a strong background in control theory and hands\-on experience with UAV systems. Experience applying machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) to enhance autonomous navigation, path planning, and flight performance is a distinct advantage. **What You'll Do:** * **Flight Control System Design:** Design, implement, and test advanced control algorithms for UAVs to ensure stability, maneuverability, and reliable performance. * **Modeling and Simulation:** Create and maintain dynamic flight models for various UAV platforms to simulate and validate control strategies. * **Path Planning and Autonomy:** Integrate path planning algorithms for autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and optimal flight route generation. * **ML/DL Integration:** Apply machine learning and deep learning techniques to enhance flight control and dynamic flight models. * **Embedded Systems:** Develop and optimize robust, compute\-constrained code for embedded systems, ensuring reliability and real\-time performance. * **Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) Testing:** Conduct comprehensive system testing, including Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop simulations and flight testing, to validate control system performance. * **Troubleshooting and Optimization:** Analyze flight data to troubleshoot system issues, optimize control parameters, and continuously improve overall performance. * **Collaboration:** Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including mechanical, software, and systems engineers, to deliver high\-quality and reliable drone solutions. **What You Bring:** * **EITHER** PhD \& 2\+ years of work experience: PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related field AND 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in control system design, modeling, and simulation. * **OR** Masters \& 5\-8\+ years work experience: Masters in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related field AND 5\-8\+ years of hands\-on experience in control system design, modeling, and simulation. * Strong proficiency in programming languages like C\+\+ and Python. * Familiarity with embedded systems and real\-time operating systems **Bonus Points For:** * Hands\-on experience with UAVs, autopilots (e.g., PX4, ArduPilot, Betaflight), and sensor integration. * Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) for robotics or autonomous systems. * Knowledge of computer vision principles and techniques. * Familiarity with aviation regulations and safety protocols. **What We Offer:** * **Competitive Salary** – Reflective of your skills and jobs.title: Senior Identity Governance Engineer
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** ------------------------ At ServiceTitan, we are building a next\-generation identity fabric, and this role engineers the governance layer on top of it. Identity spans cloud environments, SaaS applications, data systems, machine identities, and now AI agents, which makes it one of the most sprawling attack surfaces in the enterprise. You will make sure every identity, whether a Titan, a third\-party contractor, a service account, or an AI agent, has the right access, for the right reason, at the right time, and that we can prove it. Corporate Engineering (IT) administer our identity platforms, including Okta and Lumos, and run lifecycle operations. InfoSec defines identity governance requirements and validates that controls work. You sit in InfoSec and engineer the governance layer: authentication and authorization design standards, entitlement models, access review automation, and audit\-ready evidence. You administer Veza with Corporate Security, Security Architecture, Product Security, and Security Operations, work with Corporate Engineering and System Owners to put governance requirements into practice, and you will be a key owner of our ISPM and IGA program. **What you'll do:** ------------------- You engineer identity governance: the tooling, automation, and design standards that make access reviewable and provable. Corporate Engineering and IT administer the identity platforms, and InfoSec GRC owns the policies and the review program. * **Access Request Governance:** Define governance requirements and design patterns for access request workflows across privileged systems (code repositories, databases, infrastructure), including role\-based, time\-bound, delegated, and just\-in\-time access, and measure adoption so access is not granted outside the governed workflow. Corporate Engineering and IT administer Lumos and implement the workflows; you specify the requirements, build the monitoring that detects bypass, and validate that they work. * **Authentication \& Authorization Design:** Partner with Security Architecture to define authentication and authorization design standards (SSO, MFA and phishing\-resistant requirements, OIDC/SAML/SCIM patterns, least\-privilege role models) for enterprise tools, and review integrations against them. * **Authorization Governance \& Entitlement Design:** Provide the technical design for authorization decisions on job functions and privileged data access, including critical systems such as ST Admin roles, Snowflake, Salesforce, and other high\-risk entitlements. Build role models scoped to job function and normalize entitlement data across applications in Veza so access can be reviewed like for like. * **Access Review \& Lifecycle Automation:** Build and operate the tooling and automation behind the user access review program (SOX ITGC, PCI DSS, SOC 1/2, ISO 27001\), which InfoSec GRC owns, and behind joiner/mover/leaver control assurance, including leaver access\-reversion evidence, reconciliation against the authoritative HR source, and orphaned account detection. * **Privileged Access Governance:** Build visibility into standing privileged access across core cloud infrastructure and the data platform and drive it down, moving toward time\-bound elevation (PIM and JIT) with governed exceptions for the access that must remain. * **Identity Fabric Architecture:** Define the target\-state governance architecture across Okta, Veza, and Lumos and the risk\-based identity lifecycle it supports. You administer Veza in combination with Corporate Security, Security Architecture, Product Security, and Security Operations, building its data source integrations, policies, and alerts. Corporate Engineering and IT administer Okta and Lumos, and you partner with them on lifecycle and workflow integration. * **ISPM \& Continuous Governance:** Add continuous monitoring to periodic certifications. Build identity analytics that detect over\-privileged accounts, shadow identities, dormant access, and identity drift, and automate remediation workflows with named owners. * **Non\-Human Identity \& AI Security:** Build the inventory and governance workflows for service accounts, API keys, personal access tokens, and AI agents, including ownership, rotation, and attestation requirements, and drive remediation with owning teams. Ensure AI integrations are covered by rigorous entitlement management, in partnership with our AI governance review process. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work with Corporate Engineering, the administrative owner of identity platforms and lifecycle operations, alongside Security Architecture and System Owners to ensure every enterprise tool is integrated with identity by design, while InfoSec GRC defines identity governance requirements and validates control effectiveness. * **Compliance as Code \& Audit Support:** Provide the technical identity evidence for audit requests (SOX, PCI, ISO 27001, SOC 1/2\), partnering with our SOX I  be a tailwind, not a headwind. You build identity governance that lets Titans move faster and collaborate safely. * **Data\-Driven:** You use identity analytics to find high\-risk areas and prioritize work based on actual risk data. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- As ServiceTitan scales and integrates AI across our platform, identity governance is what keeps access defensible. Your work protects customer data, supports the trust our customers place in us, and lets our teams move faster with confidence. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. **Use of AI Technology:** We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role is Zone 1: $134,500 USD \- $201,700 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WA Zone 2: $125,700 USD \- $188,500 USD Applicable for: All other US locations. International Compensation for candidates residing outside the United States will vary by location and will be discussed during the hiring process. Actual compensation within a range is determined by factors including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and performance. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes an annual bonus, equity, and a holistic suite of benefits.

jobs.title: AI Engineer- Remote
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Sharecare is a digital healthcare company that delivers software and tech\-enabled services to stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to help improve care quality, drive better outcomes, and lower costs. Through its data\-driven AI insights, evidence\-based resources, and comprehensive platform, including benefits navigation, care management, home care resources, and health information management, Sharecare helps people easily and efficiently manage their healthcare and improve their well\-being. Across its three business channels, Sharecare enables health plan sponsors, health systems and physician practices, and leading pharmaceutical brands to drive personalized and value\-based care at scale. AskMD by Sharecare, the company’s **free AI health app**, helps people describe a symptom, ask a health question, and get evidence\-based guidance and a clear next step. AskMD is available in the U.S. on the **App Store**, **Google Play**, and the **web**. To learn more, visit sharecare.com. **Job Summary:** As the AI Engineer, you will play a critical role across vision, strategy, operations, and execution for defining and driving the transformation of Sharecare into the era of agentic engineering. We are looking for engineers who can take a big problem domain we hand to them, disappear into it, and they come back with it working, documented, and theirs. We don’t need to check their work or meddle, because checking isn’t unnecessary. The people who have struggled here waited for scoped tickets to tell them what to do, but that’s what we have agents for. What "a fit" looks like, concretely: * Demonstrate you can ship daily at high volume with a fleet of AI agents. In the interview we'll ask to see your actual setup and what you let it do unsupervised. "I use Copilot sometimes" is not this. * You've owned architecture across multiple companies or many codebases: staff\-plus IC, chief\-architect, or platform\-consulting background. You've seen a dozen ways teams ship and you have opinions with scars behind them. * When handed an ambiguous, ugly, load\-bearing problem, your instinct is to take it whole: read everything, decide, build, write the doc, tell us what you decided. Not to schedule a meeting about scope. * Prior experience working in healthcare and/or clinical research, on health data products including electronic health records, claims, wearables, etc. and/or remote patient monitoring technologies is a plus * You communicate proactively in writing. For example: a Sunday text that says "took care of it, here's the PR and what I changed." * 6\+ years and multiple systems owned end to end What you will own: * The Factory spine. Develop and improve our existing factory to maximize and align in the era of agentic engineering. Increase our throughput by 50% while maintaining a lean team. Your job is to evolve our factory platform: Merge gates, migration safety, canary and rollback on a system where a bad deploy can touch patient care. * The application work spine. The layer that lets AI agents and humans act on patient care with auditability and fail\-closed checks. You’ll own the guardrails that ensure agents can safely provide broader components of care. * The data and metrics. Warehouse, analytics platform, and the pipelines that tell us what happened. * Architecture syncs with me. You'll have the standing I give someone who has seen more systems than I have: disagree with me, make the call in your domain, unpack it for the team when asked. **Essential Job Functions:** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain AI and machine learning solutions to support business needs. * Build and optimize machine learning models, predictive analytics solutions, recommendation systems, and intelligent automation tools. * Develop and implement generative AI applications utilizing large language models (LLMs), retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and conversational AI technologies. * Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business challenges into AI\-driven solutions. * Integrate AI and machine learning models into enterprise applications, workflows, and business processes. * Develop and maintain data pipelines that support model training, evaluation, deployment, and ongoing monitoring. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and platforms to identify opportunities for innovation and business improvement. * Monitor model performance and implement processes for model retraining, optimization, and lifecycle management. * Ensure AI solutions meet security, privacy, compliance, and governance standards. * Conduct testing, validation, and performance assessments of machine learning models and AI applications. * Collaborate with cloud engineering and infrastructure teams to deploy and scale AI solutions in cloud environments. * Develop technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and operational procedures for AI systems. * Support AI governance initiatives, including model transparency, explainability, fairness, and responsible AI practices. * Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to AI models, integrations, and production environments. * Participate in code reviews, solution design sessions, and architectural planning activities. * Provide technical leadership and guidance on AI best practices and implementation strategies. * Stay current with advancements in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, and related technologies. Support strategic innovation initiatives and contribute to the organization's AI roadmap. * **Qualifications** **Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Technology, or a related field required. **Experience:** * Minimum of at least 4 years of experience software engineering or systems architecture. * Experience developing, deploying, and supporting machine learning models and AI\-driven applications. * Experience developing solutions using large language models (LLMs), generative AI platforms, and natural language processing tools preferred. * Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Experience working with model deployment, MLOps, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization technologies preferred. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** * Familiarity with model governance, monitoring, and lifecycle management. * Knowledge of cloud\-native AI services, distributed computing, and scalable architecture principles. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills. * Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business\-focused solutions and recommendations. * Strong collaboration and teamwork skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business functions. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast\-paced environment. * Knowledge of data privacy, cybersecurity, compliance, and responsible AI practices. * High level of professionalism, integrity, and accountability. Sharecare and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and E\-Verify users. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, equal pay, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or other status protected under applicable law.

jobs.title: Tooling Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** With more than 100 years of experience, Sika is a worldwide innovation and sustainability leader in the development and production of systems and products for commercial and residential construction, as well as the transportation, marine, automotive, and renewable energy manufacturing industries. Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation industries toward greater environmental compatibility. Approximately 33,000 employees generated CHF 11\.20 billion in sales in 2025\. **Job Description** **Position Summary** The Tooling Engineer specifies, sources, and approves all new production injection mold tooling for parts designed by the automotive application engineering group, and supports those tools from kickoff through launch and into production. The role centers on complex multi\-shot tooling, including 2\-shot and 3\-shot rotary and index molds, run on 500 to 1,300 ton presses. The Tooling Engineer works with design engineering, process engineering, quality, and a network of domestic and international tool shops to deliver tools that make parts to print, on time and on budget. In the plant, the Tooling Engineer partners with the tooling supervisor, tooling technicians, tool setters, and molding operators to provide technical oversight of production molds and resolve tooling issues. **Tooling Environment** The plant runs 2\-shot and 3\-shot rotary and index molds, family tools, and valve gate, thermal gate, and cold runner manifold systems on presses ranging from 500 to 1,300 tons. Most parts are molded in nylon and Sika proprietary materials. The Tooling Engineer typically manages 20 or more new tool builds and 10 or more engineering changes or repairs at the same time, working with tool shops in Missouri, Michigan, Wisconsin, South Carolina, Canada, China, and Portugal. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** **New tool development and launch** * Review all injection molded part design concepts with design engineering for tooling feasibility, cavitation, and manufacturability, and recommend part and tool design changes. * Develop tooling estimates covering cost, timing, cavitation, and press size based on program needs, and solicit, compare, and recommend tool shop quotes. * Participate in part and tool design reviews to reach final designs capable of meeting customer requirements. * Kick off and track all new injection mold tooling, lead tool design reviews with tool shops, approve tool design details, and ensure Sika molding standards are applied. * Set up and attend molding trials at domestic and international tool shops and in the plant; review tool and part dimensional layouts and drive corrections to tooling and process discrepancies until the tool produces parts to print. * Partner with process engineering on the setup, verification, and launch of all new injection mold tools, including support of customer part approval (PPAP) requirements. * Serve on program launch teams and report tooling status, issues, timing, and cost to team members. * Manage 20 or more tool builds at the same time from kickoff through production, and track tooling spend against quotes and program budgets. **Engineering changes and production tooling support** * Manage engineering changes (ECs) to existing tools, including scope, quoting, tool shop coordination, trial, and approval. * Provide technical oversight of production molds, working with the tooling supervisor, tooling technicians, tool setters, and molding operators. * Assist process engineering and production in troubleshooting current production tools; determine, schedule, track, and confirm the results of corrective actions. * Input and maintain the history of all mold maintenance and repairs on assigned tools, and use that history to guide repair, refurbishment, and replacement decisions. * Apply lessons learned from production tooling performance (downtime, scrap, repair trends) to the design of new tools. **Standards and continuous improvement** * Develop and update Sika tooling standards as part of the tooling group. * Identify and implement current tooling technologies and techniques that improve tool performance, cost, or lead time. * Follow plant safety requirements for mold handling, trials, and work around molding equipment. * Complete other tasks as assigned by the Launch Director. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * 5 or more years of experience in the design, development, or sourcing of plastic injection mold tooling. * Experience managing multiple new tool builds at the same time with outside tool shops, from design review through tool trials and approval. * Ability to read and interpret part prints, mold drawings, GD\&T, and dimensional layout reports. * Proficiency in SolidWorks for part and tool design reviews. * Strong internal and external relationship and communication skills, including with tool shops, design engineers, and plant floor teams. * Ability to travel 20\-30% of the time, domestically and internationally (including Canada, China, and Portugal), for design reviews and tool trials. * Valid passport, or ability to obtain one before the first international trip. **Education** * Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline (plastics, mechanical, or manufacturing) strongly preferred. * Candidates without a bachelor's degree will be considered with an associate's degree or journeyman mold maker credential plus 8 or more years of injection mold tooling experience. **Strongly Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with multi\-shot tooling, including 2\-shot or 3\-shot rotary and index molds. * Experience with large tools for presses of 500 tons or more. * Experience with precision, multi\-cavity, and family tooling, including valve gate, thermal gate, and cold runner manifold systems. * Experience with Autodesk Moldflow or similar mold flow analysis. * Plastics technology or plastics engineering focus in education or training. * Experience in the automotive industry, preferably with a Tier 1 or Tier 2 supplier. * Working knowledge of APQP and PPAP. **Additional Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on mold making or tool shop background. * Experience managing offshore tool builds, including in China or Europe. * Experience with scientific or decoupled molding principles. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Sika Corporation is committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals that apply. As an equal opportunity employer Sika will consider all qualified applicants without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, or other protected characteristics. We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

This is a great opportunity to start a career with a company that builds things that matter and values its team. We are proud to share our culture of diversity and inclusion. jobs.title: Founding Design Engineer
jobs.description: **About Skiffra** ================= Skiffra is building the intelligence layer for operational decision\-making in physical industries. We're developing AI\-native orchestration systems that turn complex, high\-stakes operations into intelligent, adaptive workflows. We're starting with mining and natural resources, where decisions move people, equipment and capital, and where the consequences of getting them wrong are real. Our ambition extends well beyond mining. We're building a platform designed to change how physical industries make decisions. **The Role** ------------ We're hiring our founding Design Engineer: a deeply skilled senior frontend engineer with exceptional product design instincts. You'll own the experience end to end, from understanding the problem in the field to designing the solution, writing production code and shipping it. As our first dedicated design hire, you'll set the foundations: the design system, the interaction patterns and the quality bar every Skiffra product after this one is built on. The hardest problem you'll work on is trust. Our users are experienced operators, planners and site leaders who have seen plenty of software come and go. Your job is to make AI\-driven recommendations clear enough to act on, honest about what they don't know, and easy to question or override. You'll spend real time on site with the people who use what you build. You'll learn how mines actually run, then turn that understanding into software that feels simple, fast and dependable. If you're equally at home shaping an experience in Figma and building it in React and TypeScript, we'd love to talk. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own frontend development and product design for Skiffra's products, taking features from first concept through production * Design how people work with AI: surfacing recommendations, showing confidence and uncertainty, explaining the reasoning behind a suggestion, and keeping humans in control of the final call * Turn complex operational workflows and real\-time data into interfaces that help planners, site leaders and operators make better decisions quickly * Build Skiffra's design system, reusable component library and frontend standards from the ground up * Design for the full range of environments our users work in, from administrative offices and control rooms to site conditions with unreliable connectivity and time\-sensitive decisions * Spend regular time on site with operators and our field teams, observing real workflows, testing prototypes and bringing what you learn back into the product * Work closely with product, engineering and field teams to prototype, ship and keep improving what we've built **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 5\+ years building and shipping complex production frontends * Strong production\-level React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS, with the ability to independently build and ship complex frontend applications * Exceptional product design and UX judgment, strong visual design skills and fluency in Figma * Hands\-on daily use of AI tools like Claude Code or Codex to prototype and ship faster, with the depth to review, debug and own everything that goes to production * A track record of owning products or significant features end to end, from design through engineering and deployment * Experience designing complex workflows or data\-rich applications, such as dashboards, planning tools or decision\-support software, and making them intuitive * Experience designing AI\-driven or data\-driven products where users need to understand, trust and act on what the system tells them * Experience building 0 1 products, including establishing a design system and frontend standards where none existed * A solid grasp of frontend architecture, component libraries, responsive design, accessibility and performance * Curiosity about how physical operations really work, and a willingness to go to site to find out * A builder's mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, quick to move, clear on when something is good enough to ship, and proud of the quality of what you ship **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience in mining, resources, energy, logistics or other industrial settings * Experience with offline\-first, mobile or field\-based applications * Experience with real\-time data or agentic workflows * Experience as an early hire at a startup ### **How We Work** We value speed, clarity, and technical rigor. We favor simple systems over clever ones, prototypes over over\-planning, and ownership over handoffs. You’ll work directly with founders and ship things that matter quickly. ### **Location \& Work Model** This is a hybrid role with regular in\-person collaboration in Los Angeles or the San Francisco Bay Area. We are not a remote\-only company. ### **Work Authorization** Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where this role is based. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. ### **Benefits \& Eligibility** This position is eligible for Skiffra’s standard benefits, including health insurance and retirement plans, and may also qualify for participation in the Company’s bonus and incentive programs. ### **Equal Opportunity** Skiffra is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Compensation Range: $200K \- $235K

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer (Python/AWS)
jobs.description: **About the Role** Sky Bridge Financial is a fast\-paced financial startup looking for a Full Stack Engineer to help drive our software development and cloud architecture. You will play a critical role in building scalable applications, optimizing our data pipelines, and fortifying our security posture as we scale. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain scalable full\-stack applications using Python for the backend and modern JavaScript frameworks (React/Vue/Angular) for the frontend. * Develop and manage serverless architectures and microservices using AWS (Lambda, ECS, S3, and Systems Manager). * Optimize database performance, including migrating complex SQL views to standard flat tables to accelerate daily data refreshes. * Build secure, robust APIs and integrate with enterprise data platforms like Snowflake. * Develop custom scripts, manage concurrent record updates, and build integrations for third\-party platforms, including Zoho jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Software Developer \| Remote \| Hiring Immediately **Job Type:** Contract, full\-time, remote (US time zones) **Pay:** $500 per month to start, plus **POTENTIAL** founding equity options. Compensation to be reviewed after launch **Full Job Description** We launch in Florida in 2 to 3 weeks, sooner if we can. We need a developer who can start now and help us get there. Help After Accident is building the app that takes an injured person from the accident scene to the right personal injury attorney and the right treating doctor, fast. One intake, one journey, everyone connected. The patient never pays. Today, after a crash, patients, doctors and lawyers are still chasing calls, texts, paperwork and each other. You know where your Uber is. You know where your Amazon package is. You should know where your recovery is. We are fixing that, and we are doing it now. We have already coordinated thousands of recoveries by hand. Now we are turning what works into software and putting it in front of Florida patients, law firms and medical providers. The clock is running, the market is waiting, and every day without the product is a day people go without help. **Why This Role Is Urgent** Launch is 2 to 3 weeks out. Your first features go live with real users almost right away. We are interviewing now and want our hire working within days of an offer. This is not a role that will sit open. When we find the right person, we close it. **If you can start this week, say so in your application.** **What You Will Do** * Build and ship the core app end to end: patient intake, matching, scheduling and case status. * Take features from idea to production in days, not sprints. * Make architecture calls you can defend, and document them so new engineers can onboard fast. * Build APIs and integrations with law firm and medical practice systems. * Use AI and automation where it saves real time for patients and staff. * Keep patient data secure and private from day one. * Fix what is broken, own what you ship and say plainly when something is behind. * Join a short daily standup and report progress, blockers and next steps. **What You Bring** · Proven full\-stack experience with a modern front end and back end. · Real experience building and consuming APIs and real\-time workflows. · Comfort with cloud infrastructure, databases and secure, scalable design. · Experience with AI tools or automation is a strong plus. · A track record of shipping without a large team or perfect requirements. · Clear written and spoken English and reliable availability during US business hours. · Work samples, a portfolio or a GitHub you can walk us through. We care less about your exact tech stack and more about whether you can build and ship. **Compensation, Spelled Out** · Starting pay: $500 per month, paid monthly as a contractor. · Prove\-it period: the first 45 to 60 days are a prove\-it period for both sides. Either side can end the arrangement at any time. · Compensation review: once the product launches, we review your pay based on what you delivered. · Founding equity: you **may** receive founding equity options. Terms to be discussed **after** a successful launch. We are honest about this: the starting pay is low because we are an early\-stage startup putting every dollar into launch. The upside is real ownership in a company at the very start, a pay review tied to launch and a seat at the table while the product is built. **What This Job Is Like** · This is startup life. Full\-time, all in and fast. Weekends are required until the product launches. · You work directly with leadership. No layers, no committees and no hiding behind tickets. · You will not wait three days to solve a three\-hour problem. · You will have a real hand in what we build, how we build it and what this company becomes. **If you are looking for a 9 to 5 with weekends off, this is not the role.** **How We Hire** * Apply on Indeed with your resume and a link to your work. * A short intro call, usually within 48 hours of applying. * A short technical exercise and a walkthrough of something you built. * Final call with leadership and references. * Offer in writing, with a start date within days. Be ready to provide verifiable professional references. We verify who we hire, including identity, work authorization, work history and technical skills, using independent and, where appropriate, official verification services. People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply. If your experience is real, your skills are real and you want to build something that matters from the ground up, apply today. We are moving now. **Nobody owns recovery. We will.** Pay: From $500\.00 per month People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Application Question(s): * Which seat fits you best? A: Founding Engineer (architecture, full stack, DevOps, production ownership). B: Senior Full\-Stack Product Engineer (React, TypeScript, APIs, UI and product decisions). C: Senior Backend and Platform Engineer (APIs, PostgreSQL, auth, matching, integrations, queues, reliability) * It is Monday morning. You inherit our existing codebase, AWS setup and database. We want to relaunch in 7 days and you trust nothing yet. What do you do in the first 4 hours, the first 24 hours and the first 72 hours? Be specific. * Give us the high\-level architecture for this flow: Accident, Opt\-In, Intake, Match, Notify, Accept, Appointment, Messaging and Documents, Outcome. Cover the database, APIs, auth, events and queues, failures, retries, idempotency and monitoring. We care about how you think, not polish. * It is 11:30 PM on launch night. Production is breaking and the engineer who built that part is not answering. Walk us through what you do. Then tell us about a real production fire you personally owned and how it ended. * When can you start? Starting pay is $500 per month plus founding equity options, with a compensation review after launch. Does that work for you? * How many hours can you commit in your first 7 days, and each week after? Weekends are required until launch. * Are you ready to code every day, work outside your lane, push back on founders and engineers when they are wrong and stay in it when production breaks? * If we make you an offer, will you complete our verification process, including identity, work authorization, professional reference checks and a live technical review? * Tell us the hardest production system you personally built and owned. What did you build, what broke and what did you do about it? Have you taken a product from zero to production? Experience: * Software development: 3 years (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: AI Engineering Manager
jobs.description: As an AI Engineering Manager at Solstice, you will play a pivotal role in driving AI initiatives across various business functions using multiple technology platforms. in multiple AI/ML \& Automation tools such as Azure AI / Microsoft Foundry, Databricks, Cognitive services \& Bot frameworks, Microsoft Power Platform, Workato, OutSystems, Automation Anywhere or similar, with a strong understanding of AI concepts and their application in automation. * Experience integrating with enterprise platforms such as SAP, SFDC, HCM and other similar enterprise applications to create seamless AI \& automation solutions. * Proven track record in developing, architecting end\-to\-end AI \& Automation solutions that integrate multiple systems and deliver measurable business value. **WE VALUE** * Python experience for AI/ML workflows strongly preferred. * Experience building agent\-based systems with tool use, reasoning workflows, and API orchestration. * Experience developing AI applications with LLM integrations, prompt engineering, and orchestration frameworks. * Solid understanding of AI security practices including RBAC/ABAC, audit logging, and prompt\-level safeguards. * Experience optimizing vector databases and semantic search technologies for large datasets. * Experience with compound AI architectures, retrieval pipelines, and Azure/Databricks DevOps or MLOps practices. * Experience integrating AI solutions into enterprise channels such as Teams, Web Chat, or Direct Line. * Ability to quickly understand new problem\-solving skills in complex technical and business contexts. * Ability to translate AI technical concepts for audiences at various levels. * Ownership and Pride in your work and willingness to work in a diverse, cross\-functional environment. Attention to detail. * Proven ability to partner with diverse stakeholders, identify automation improvements, and understand data needs across discrete and continuous manufacturing processes. * Experience of working closely with managed services providers to ensure effective support and management of automation processes. * Prior publication record in top tier journals or conferences such as NeurIPS, AAAI, EMNLP, MICA or similar. **COMPENSATION** The annual base salary range for this position is $201\-063\-251,622\. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. hands\-on experience in systems engineering, endpoint management, and identity infrastructure, with at least 2 years in a management or lead capacity. * *Identity \& Directory Services:* Deep expertise in Active Directory, GPO, Azure AD Sync, Okta (SAML, Workflows, MFA), and Google Workspace Administration (OU management, Vault,GCP, GAM, security configurations, and user provisioning for enterprise tools like Gemini). * *Endpoint \& VDI:* Proven experience managing Windows and macOS environments at scale using JAMF, NinjaOne, PDQ SmartDeploy, and AWS WorkSpaces. * *Scripting \& AI Tooling:* Strong proficiency in PowerShell, Bash, Python or similar scripting languages, with demonstrated experience using AI\-assisted coding platforms (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate scripting and automation. * *Network \& Storage:* Solid understanding of DNS, PKI/Certificate Authorities, AWS FSx, AWS File Gateway, and core networking principles. **Leadership \& Soft Skills** * Proven ability to operate effectively as a player\-coach on a small team, balancing high\-level planning with direct technical execution. * Strong commitment to emotional intelligence, transparent communication, and collaborative problem\-solving across teams. * Experience managing IT projects via Jira/Confluence using Agile or Kanban frameworks. **Preferred Qualifications** * Certifications in relevant technologies (e.g., Okta Certified Administrator, Jamf Certified Admin, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator). * Experience in healthcare jobs.title: Sr AI Engineer
jobs.description: Syniverse is the world’s most connected company. And how we’re able to provide our incredible talent with an innovative culture and great benefits. **Who We're Looking For** Syniverse is scaling AI capability across the company, and this role is responsible for turning that strategy into working, production\-grade systems. The Sr AI Engineer takes the patterns and standards set by the AI Architect and implements them as integrations, agentic automations, internal tooling, and the evaluation harnesses that measure whether each capability is actually performing as intended. This is a hands\-on\-keyboard role. The engineer will spend most of their time writing code, debugging integrations, and shipping capability that colleagues across the company use daily.* **Some of What You'll Do** **Job Description:** * Design, build, and maintain AI\-powered integrations, agentic automations, and internal tooling on Syniverse's AI stack (Azure OpenAI, Claude Enterprise, and self\-hosted models on AWS/EKS behind the Bifrost AI Gateway). * Develop production\-grade Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/tools that connect internal data and systems to LLMs. * Build and maintain evaluation harnesses and test suites that measure model and system quality, catch regressions and drift, and report objectively on whether a given AI capability is working. * Take architectural patterns and standards defined by the AI Architect and turn them into working, supported, production systems — not just proof of concept. * Write, test, and ship code (primarily Python, Java, and SQL) implementing new AI capability and integrations end to end. * Debug and troubleshoot issues across the AI stack — API layers, the AI gateway, model endpoints, and downstream integrations — including root\-cause analysis of production issues. * Evaluate tradeoffs between frontier LLMs and locally hosted models (e.g., Qwen, Gemma) and select the model best suited to a given requirement based on cost, latency, accuracy, and data sensitivity. * Use agentic software development tools (Claude Code preferred; Codex or Cursor as viable alternatives) to build and ship production applications. * Automate deployment, infrastructure, and operational tasks using DevOps tooling such as Ansible and Terraform, primarily on AWS. * Create design documentation for new integrations and automations, and maintain operational runbooks for systems in production. * Review code, designs, and evaluation results from peers to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to requirements and standards. * Partner cross\-functionally across business units to gather requirements, integrate AI capability into existing workflows, and support adoption. * Report on the status, metrics, and outcomes of AI initiatives to stakeholders and leadership. **Required Experience and Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience. * 5\+ years of software engineering experience — direct, hands\-on experience programming and shipping software, not just prompting or “vibe coding.” * Proficiency with Agentic AI \& RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generalization). * Proficiency with Relational DBMS (Postgres, MySQL). * Proficiency with AWS, Python, Java, and SQL. * Experience building and maintaining automated test suites. * Experience with multi\-layer architectures and API design/integration. **AI \& Agentic Development:** * Experience building production applications (not just proofs of concept) using agentic software development tools — Claude Code preferred; Codex or Cursor are viable alternatives. * Direct experience with Syniverse's AI tech stack, or equivalent: Azure OpenAI; Claude Enterprise; AWS with the Bifrost AI Gateway and self\-hosted models on EKS (e.g., Qwen, Gemma). * Hands\-on experience with RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) development. * Hands\-on experience with vector databases and embedding\-based retrieval (pgvector, FAISS, Pinecone, or equivalent) * Hands\-on experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) development. * Direct experience with both frontier AI (LLMs) and locally hosted models, including a working understanding of the tradeoffs and the ability to identify the right model for a given requirement. * Demonstrated experience improving the quality of a generative AI system through structured iteration. **Infrastructure \& Cloud:** * Experience using AWS as a platform for software development and automation. * DevOps background, including experience with Ansible and Terraform is preferred. **Professionalism:** * Ownership and accountability for tasks and projects. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills across the organization. * Comfortable reporting on status and metrics to stakeholders. * Works well within a team environment; excellent oral and written communication skills. * Independent work habits with a proven ability to deliver quality software on time. * Acts with a sense of urgency and maintains composure in a stressful environment. * Strong analytical, business logic, and problem\-resolution skills. **\#LI\-Hybrid** * **Why You Should Join Us** Join us as we write a new chapter, guided by world\-class leadership. Come be a part of an exciting and growing organization where we offer a competitive total compensation, flexible/remote work and with a leadership team committed to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and transparent organizational culture. At Syniverse connectedness is at the core of our business. We believe diversity, equity, and inclusion among our employees is crucial to our success as a global company as we seek to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people who want to help us connect the world. **Know someone at Syniverse?** Be sure to have them submit you as a referral prior to applying for this position. jobs.description: **Build a Safer World.** ------------------------ TRM Labs provides AI\-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. **The Data Platform team** collaborates with an experienced group of data scientists, engineers, and product managers to build highly available and scalable data infrastructure for TRM's products and services. As an Engineering Manager, you will guide your team toward executing mission\-critical systems and data services that analyze blockchain transaction activity at petabyte scale. Your contributions will play a pivotal role in building a safer financial system for billions of people. **The impact you'll have here:** * Lead and nurture a team of high\-impact engineers, offering guidance in both technical and cultural aspects. * Provide regular coaching and technical mentorship to your immediate team, while contributing to the broader engineering organization's growth. * Assume direct responsibility for ensuring the quality and timely delivery of the team's work, while overseeing the availability and performance of critical services. * Drive projects aligned with well\-defined goals and measurable outcomes, accountable to key performance indicators (KPIs). * Foster best practices in design and usability, creating scalable solutions while emphasizing documentation and knowledge sharing. * Resolve operational escalations and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to address production incidents through resolution. * Collaborate closely with management and product teams to plan, estimate, and prioritize roadmap objectives, while identifying opportunities and mitigating risks. * Contribute to the creation of highly reliable data services that seamlessly integrate with numerous blockchains. * Engineer and optimize ETL pipelines that handle real\-time transformation and processing of petabytes of structured and unstructured data. * Architect data models to ensure efficient storage and retrieval, maintaining sub\-second latency for querying blockchain data. * Oversee the deployment and monitoring of large\-scale database clusters, focusing on performance and high availability. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with data scientists, backend engineers, and product managers to design, implement, and refine new data more complex systems than when you started). * Technical depth you still use. You can frame where a team is heading in a way that makes strong engineers want to build it with you. * A Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related field. * A proven track record with 5\+ years of experience conceiving and implementing distributed systems from ideation through production. * Proficiency in Python, along with strong SQL or SparkSQL experience. * Versatility across the full data engineering stack, including: * Data stores such as ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, Postgres, Redis, and Neo4j. * Data pipeline and workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, DBT, Luigi, Azkaban, and Storm. * Data processing technologies and streaming workflows, including Spark, Kafka, and Flink. * Infrastructure deployment and monitoring in public cloud environments using Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Datadog. * Demonstrated ability to load, query, and transform large\-scale, complex datasets. **The following represents the estimated range of compensation for this role:** * Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only * The estimated base salary range  focus and positivity in a fast\-moving and intense environment. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission\-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. **Leadership Principles** ------------------------- We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. * Impact\-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. * Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday. * Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger. **Join our Mission** -------------------- At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast. We value curiosity and knowledge sharing, including helping non\-technical teammates build the skills and confidence to do more in Shopify admin and our backend tools. We move quickly, stay close to our customers, and adapt as new opportunities emerge. You’ll build and maintain custom Shopify themes, templates, sections, and interactive components using Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. jobs.title: Oracle Fusion PPM – Project Accounting SME
jobs.description: **Oracle Fusion PPM – Project Accounting SME** **Center of Excellence \| Working alongside Tessera AI Agents** **Location:** US\-based. **Remote:** Hybrid: remote, with regular on\-site work at customer offices and store construction sites. Travel up to 30%. **Experience:** 12\+ years in Oracle project accounting, including 5\+ years on Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM **Employment type:** Full\-time, permanent. **Positions:** 1 **Reports to:** VP, Center of Excellence. **Start date:** Immediate. **Engagement model:** Full\-time, permanent Tessera role. The initial assignment is a program\-length, multi\-wave legacy\-to\-Oracle Fusion PPM migration and implementation for a retail store development program, expected to run 12 to 18 months, after which you move to the next Oracle engagement. Works US business hours alongside the customer's Corporate Accounting, Construction, Real Estate and Procurement teams, the Oracle Fusion Financials consultant and Tessera's distributed delivery team. **About Tessera Labs** Tessera is an AI\-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi\-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera addresses the scope a system integrator would have traditionally taken up with the speed of execution and efficiency of an AI\-native platform. For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for Oracle and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI\-powered, multi\-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English. **Role Summary** We are looking for an Oracle Fusion Project Accounting (PPM) SME to migrate a customer's capital project and cost accounting processes from their legacy system to Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management (PPM), with a primary focus on the store build\-out, remodel and relocation program. You will lead the assessment of current\-state legacy processes, run a structured fit\-gap analysis against Oracle Fusion standard functionality, and translate the resulting requirements into a greenfield Oracle configuration. This is a build\-new implementation rather than a lift\-and\-shift: you will use the legacy system as the authoritative source of how the business actually operates and what it must continue to produce, then design the Oracle\-native solution that delivers those outcomes without replicating legacy workarounds or customizations. Because this is a capital program, the design decisions go well beyond project costing: whether Budgetary Control is switched on and commitments encumber against project budgets, how change orders and contingency flow, how tenant improvement allowances interact with CIP and lease accounting, whether internal labor is capitalized, how remodels and closures drive retirements and impairments, how sales and use tax is handled across states, and who can see which project costs. You will own these decisions with the business and with the Oracle Fusion Financials consultant, as the interface between Project Accounting and the core financial modules is central to both the design and the migration. You will do this work with Tessera's AI agents. The platform documents legacy processes and reports, traces how costs flow today, and generates a large share of the configuration workbooks, test scripts and conversion reconciliations. What it cannot do is decide whether a legacy report is a real requirement or a workaround, or how a capital appropriation should gate spend. That judgment is the role, and every time you exercise it we expect it to go back into the platform. Two outcomes define the job. The first is a clean, standard\-aligned Project Accounting solution that supports the store development program, asset reporting and the financial close, and passes audit. The second is that the customer's finance and construction teams adopt it as their normal way of working, without falling back to spreadsheets. **Why Join Tessera** * Work with AI agents every day. Agents document legacy processes, draft configuration and test assets and reconcile conversions, so you spend your time on the design decisions that matter. * Own a real capital program end to end, from current\-state discovery through design, conversion, cutover and hypercare. * Shape the platform, not just the project. Your Oracle PPM know\-how becomes part of the Tessera platform and is reused across customers. * Work alongside senior Oracle architects, Forward Deployed Engineers a tion rules, and of month\-end close and subledger\-to\-General Ledger reconciliation. * A track record of delivering capital reporting suites with OTBI and BI Publisher, and proficiency with Functional Setup Manager. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail, with the judgment to distinguish a genuine business requirement from a legacy habit. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams, including non\-finance operational users and legacy system owners who may be resistant to change. * Proven ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and become the person others ask. You will be expected to reach real fluency in the Tessera platform within your first months. * Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology or a related field. **Who This Role Is Not For** If your PPM experience is mainly project billing or services projects, with little capital accounting, this is not the role. If you prefer to reproduce the legacy system in Oracle rather than challenge it, the same applies. And if you have configured Oracle PPM but never owned a conversion reconciliation, a cutover or a first period close, you will find this uncomfortable. We are asking for someone who is at ease owning the capital accounting design end to end, and who is willing to have their judgment turned into platform capability rather than kept as personal expertise. **Preferred Qualifications** * Oracle Cloud certification in Project Management or Project Portfolio Management. * Prior migration experience from a specific legacy platform such as SAP FI/CO and Project Systems, Oracle E\-Business Suite Projects, PeopleSoft, JD Edwards, or a homegrown or spreadsheet\-based capital tracking process. * Experience in retail, restaurant, hospitality or another multi\-unit environment with a recurring store build program and a high volume of concurrent capital projects. * Experience with phased or multi\-wave rollouts across regions, brands or legal entities. * Familiarity with integration points between Oracle Fusion PPM and General Ledger, Payables, Procurement, Fixed Assets, Inventory and Cost Management. * Experience integrating Oracle Fusion PPM with a construction project management platform such as Procore, IBM Tririga or Yardi. * Exposure to Project Billing and Project Contracts for franchise build\-outs, landlord allowance billing or intercompany construction services. * Experience with Oracle Fusion Lease Accounting, and with Oracle EPM for store profitability, allocation and return\-on\-investment reporting. **First\-Year Measures of Success** * Month 1: Fluent in the Tessera platform. Current\-state capital processes and the legacy reporting inventory documented. The major design decisions (Budgetary Control, internal labor capitalization, tenant improvement allowances, security model) framed with options for leadership. * Month 3: Fit\-gap complete with dispositions and traceability. Conference room pilots delivered and the design signed off, including the chart of accounts and Subledger Accounting with the Financials consultant. Conversion strategy and in\-flight project treatment agreed. * Month 6: System integration testing passed and conversion cycles reconciled to the General Ledger. The capital reporting suite built and validated. Training ready for construction and field users. This role requires a blend of capital accounting acumen, legacy systems analysis and Oracle Fusion configuration expertise, to deliver a clean, standard\-aligned Project Accounting solution that supports the store development program, asset reporting and the financial close. *No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs’ name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.* Compensation Range: $190K \- $220K
