The first is that the customer sees value, stated in their terms, agreed in writing, and tracked. The second is that the customer's own teams and users adopt the Tessera platform as their normal way of working, rather than working around it. The second is what makes the first durable, and it is the measure you will be held to. The role also sits partly ahead of delivery in pre\-sales. You will join early customer and partner conversations together with the Tessera client partner, because an architect who only sees signed work designs for the problem we solved last year. What you learn there is expected to change how you run the engagements you already hold, and what we ask Product to build next. Oracle is one of the fastest\-growing parts of our engagement portfolio, and deep Oracle judgment, particularly in Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications, is what the role needs on day one. It is not where they stop. Our platform spans ERP, CRM, HCM and SCM, and integrations of orbital systems with Oracle and your design view is expected to widen with it. This role owns the proposal definition, solution build and solution delivery with AI across several Oracle engagements/ accounts — how it is shaped in the sales cycle, how it is designed, and how it lands. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Solution Direction Across Engagements (35%)** * Own the functional and architectural direction on several concurrent engagements, including the trade\-offs between what the customer asked for and what will actually create value. * Orchestrate the engagement team across functional, technical, data and other AI enabled workstreams — you are the person who holds the whole picture when nobody else does. * Translate customer business outcomes into a solution shape the Tessera AI platform can deliver — and say clearly, early, when it cannot. Provide feedback to the Tessera product platform team for new R\&D initiatives. * Agree what "better" means with each customer before execution starts: measurable, written, and owned by a named person on their side. * Hold the line between business intent and technical design, working directly with Forward Deployed Engineers, Tessera AI agents and customer architects. * Act as the counterpart our Technical Program Managers come to first, and get a straight answer from. **2\. Pre\-Sales, Go\-to\-Market and Product Input (30%)** * Lead the solution definition and approach in early customer and partner conversations. Shape opportunities before they are scoped — approach, effort and risk — and tell our go\-to\-market teams what is real and what is not. * Own the Oracle solution story in proposals and statements of work, alongside the sales team/client partner and the Forward Deployed Engineers who run platform demonstrations. * Bring the forward view back into live engagements and adjust how we run them. * Close the loop to bring in a specialist. Experience in several end\-to\-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementations across new implementation, E\-Business Suite or JD Edwards migration and phased coexistence approaches, and very familiar with the key challenges and major activities for each transition path. * Solid technical architecture knowledge: integration patterns, data architecture, and how an Oracle Cloud landscape actually fits together, including Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Visual Builder and PaaS extensions, data conversion into Fusion Cloud (FBDI, HDL) and integration with non\-Oracle systems. Have a good understanding of the Oracle AI roadmap for Fusion Cloud Applications, including embedded AI agents. You can hold your own in a room full of engineers. * The confidence to tell a program it is over\-staffed, and the evidence to back it. * Proven ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and become the person others ask. You will be expected to reach real fluency in the Tessera platform within your first months. * Excellent verbal and written business English, with strong presentation ability to both business and technical audiences. * Demonstrated experience leading distributed (onshore, nearshore and offshore) delivery teams, with strong asynchronous communication discipline. * Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Who This Role Is Not For** If your experience is deep configuration inside one or two process areas, this is not the role — we hire specialists for that work and you would be underused here. If your pre\-sales experience is running the demo rather than owning the solution, the same applies. And if you prefer one engagement at a time with a clear scope agreed by someone else, you will find this uncomfortable. We are asking for a senior Oracle architect who is at ease holding several unfinished things at once in various stages of the sales cycle and delivery. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience across more than one Oracle enterprise suite — ERP, CRM, HCM or SCM. Oracle is the entry point, not the whole picture. * Experience across more than one path to Oracle Fusion Cloud (from E\-Business Suite, JD Edwards, or non\-Oracle ERPs such as SAP). * Exposure to adjacent Oracle Fusion Cloud pillars such as Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), HCM and Fusion Data Intelligence / Analytics. * Prior experience partnering with AI, automation or RPA tooling inside an enterprise delivery context. * Experience working within the Oracle partner and co\-sell ecosystem, including Oracle PartnerNetwork (OPN). * Oracle Unified Method (OUM) or equivalent implementation methodology experience across multiple full\-lifecycle Oracle Fusion Cloud programs. * Oracle Cloud certifications, for example Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials, Procurement or SCM Implementation Professional. * Spanish, Portuguese or German is a plus but not a must\-have. **First\-Year Measures of Success** * **Month 3:** Fluent in the Tessera platform. Holding at least two engagements. Trusted by the Technical Program Management and sales client partners on those accounts. * **Month 6:** Value targets agreed and tracked on every engagement you hold. Adoption measured and improving. A steady flow of field input reaching Tessera product platform R\&D. Owning the solution on at least two new Oracle opportunities. * **Month 12:** Tessera AI Platform client user adoption on your accounts is the norm rather than the exception. Your engagement teams are sized on evidence. Your read of where customers are heading has changed at least one thing in how we deliver or what we build. *No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs' name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.* Compensation Range: $190K \- $220K

jobs.title: Oracle Technical Project Manager — E-Business Suite and Fusion
jobs.description: **Oracle Technical Project Manager — E\-Business Suite and Fusion** **Center of Excellence \| Working alongside Tessera AI Agents** **Remote, USA** **Location:** Near\-shore (Latin America) or offshore (e.g., India). Both are open, and we will evaluate strong candidates from either. **Remote:** Yes, with a daily overlap of US business hours (full overlap for near\-shore, at least 3–4 hours for offshore) and occasional travel to customer sites for kick\-offs and go\-lives as needed. **Experience:** 12\+ years **Employment type:** Long\-term contract, engaged directly or through a staffing partner. **Positions:** 1 **Start date:** Immediate. **Engagement model:** Multi\-engagement delivery management role. Approximately 80% running several concurrent Oracle engagements — proofs of value, discovery and implementation work across E\-Business Suite and Fusion — and 20% delivery standards, platform input and pre\-sales support. Works with a daily overlap of US business hours alongside customers, Oracle architects and SMEs, Forward Deployed Engineers and the Principal Architects. **About Tessera Labs** Tessera is an AI\-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi\-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera address the scope a system integrator would have traditionally taken up with the speed of execution and efficiency of an AI\-native platform. For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for Oracle and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI\-powered, multi\-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English. **Role Summary** We are looking for an Oracle Technical Project Manager to run Oracle E\-Business Suite and Oracle Fusion Cloud engagements — several at the same time — from kick\-off to go\-live. Our architects decide what the solution should be; you make sure it gets built, tested, converted and cut over on the date we committed to, and that the customer can see exactly where it stands at every point in between. This is a technical project management role, and that is deliberate. You need to know Oracle delivery well enough to manage the deliverables themselves, not just the dates: the RICEFW inventory, functional and technical specifications, configuration moving between environments, data conversion mock cycles, integration builds, test cycles and the cutover runbook. A project manager who cannot tell whether a mock conversion actually reconciled, or why a Fusion quarterly update threatens the test plan, will report green until the week it turns red. Most of our customers are not simply upgrading Oracle. They come from SAP ECC, JD Edwards, PeopleSoft, Infor or home\-grown systems, and many run EBS and Fusion side by side. Our engagements are also shorter and sharper than a traditional system integrator’s: proofs of value measured in weeks, with success criteria agreed up front and evidence of value expected at the end. You will run these engagements with Tessera’s AI agents as part of the team, and you need to be genuinely fluent in using AI. The platform produces a large share of the analysis, specifications, configuration, code and test material. Your job is to plan around that: build review and approval gates into the plan, know where AI output needs a domain expert’s eye, track the value it delivers against the manual baseline, and use AI tools yourself to plan, report and spot risk faster. What the platform cannot do is hold a steering committee to a decision or tell a customer that the date is at risk. That is the role. Two outcomes define the job. The first is engagements that land: on the date, inside the scope, with the customer’s sign\-off and a reference we can use. The second is that each one makes the next easier to run, because what you learn goes into our delivery standards and the platform rather than staying in your head. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Engagement Planning and Governance (25%)** * Own the plan on several concurrent Oracle engagements: scope, phases, milestones, dependencies, resourcing and the critical path — from discovery and fit\-gap through build, testing, data conversion, cutover and hypercare. * Set up and run governance: weekly checkpoints, daily syncs during execution, steering committees, RAID logs and clear escalation paths — and report status the customer’s executives can trust. * Manage scope, budget and commercial terms: burn and   PeopleSoft or Infor. * Hands\-on experience managing technical deliverables on Oracle implementations: RICEFW inventories, functional and technical specifications, configuration migration, data conversion mock cycles, integrations, test cycles and cutover runbooks. * Working knowledge of Oracle delivery methods — Oracle Unified Method (OUM) for EBS and Oracle’s cloud implementation approach for Fusion — and of the Fusion quarterly update cycle and Oracle Support service request management. * Practical, everyday fluency with AI: using generative AI and agentic tools in your own work, and experience — or a clear point of view — on planning and governing delivery where AI produces part of the work. * Strong commercial and governance discipline: budgets, burn and forecast, change control, RAID management and steering committees. * Senior client\-facing presence: able to hold a steering committee, deliver bad news early and keep the relationship. * Proven ability to run several engagements at once without losing control of any of them. * Proven ability to learn a new AI platform quickly and become the person others ask. You will be expected to reach real fluency in the Tessera platform within your first months. * Excellent verbal and written business English, with strong presentation ability to both business and technical audiences. * Experience leading distributed (onshore, nearshore and offshore) delivery teams, with strong asynchronous communication discipline. * Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Who This Role Is Not For** If your project management stops at the plan and the status report, this is not the role — you will be expected to understand and manage the technical deliverables themselves. If you have run ERP programs but never an Oracle implementation through cutover, you will find the learning curve steep on our timelines. If you are sceptical of AI or prefer to keep it at arm’s length, you will struggle in a delivery model where AI agents produce a large share of the work. And if you want one long program with a scope someone else agreed, you will find several short, high\-pressure engagements uncomfortable. **Preferred Qualifications** * A technical or functional background in Oracle before moving into project management — for example as a developer, DBA, data conversion lead or module consultant. * Experience running proofs of value or pilot engagements with defined success criteria and measured outcomes. * Experience with AI or automation tooling in ERP delivery — code generation, test automation, data quality or documentation tools — and with measuring its impact. * Agile or hybrid delivery experience, and tooling such as Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project or Confluence. * PMP, PRINCE2, PgMP or SAFe certification. * Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation certification or Oracle Cloud Success Navigator experience. * Experience with large multi\-country or multi\-entity Oracle rollouts, and with system integrator and staffing partner management. * Experience running engagements for US or European customers from a near\-shore or offshore location, with strong ownership despite the time\-zone gap. * Spanish, Portuguese or German is a plus but not a must\-have. **First\-Year Measures of Success** * Month 1: Fluent in the Tessera platform. Running at least one Oracle engagement with plan, governance, RAID log and success criteria agreed with the customer. * Month 3: Running at least two engagements on plan, with technical deliverables, AI review gates and value metrics tracked and reported, and a first set of Tessera Oracle delivery templates in use across the team. *No third party may recruit, solicit candidates, publish job opportunities, use Tessera Labs’ name or branding, or represent that they are acting on behalf of Tessera Labs without prior written authorization. Any such activity conducted without explicit written consent is strictly prohibited.* Compensation Range: $190K \- $220K

jobs.title: Data & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **Are you someone who strives for excellence, values accountability, provides the best service, all while reflecting unwavering integrity? Our talented team members across the state follow the behaviors, beliefs and outcomes of these core values to ensure that our vision is met. If you're ready to join the TSTC family and make great memories please complete our application process.** **Job Description** =================== The Data \& Analytics Engineer is a hands\-on practitioner within the Data \& Analytics team responsible for developing data, analytics, business intelligence, and data science solutions that support institutional decision\-making and operations. This role works across the analytics lifecycle, including data transformation, analytics\-ready data structures, semantic modeling, business intelligence, advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and AI. The position works extensively with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI and provides expertise in data science and advanced analytics when institutional needs require statistical, predictive, or machine\-learning solutions. The Data \& Analytics Engineer partners with Data Engineering, Data Governance, Institutional Research, Application Engineering, and business stakeholders to transform institutional data into trusted, scalable, and actionable analytical products. The position contributes to shared standards and reusable approaches while continuing to develop expertise across the institution's data and analytics ecosystem. **Essential Functions** ======================= The employee will demonstrate TSTC’s Core Values of **Excellence, Accountability, Service, and Integrity** with internal and external stakeholders, customers, students, and community members. **Data \& Analytics Engineering** Designs, develops, and maintains scalable data and analytics solutions using Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Python, and related technologies. Transforms raw and complex source data into well\-structured, analytics\-ready datasets to support institutional reporting, business intelligence, advanced analytics, and data science initiatives. Develops and maintains analytical data models, data transformations, automated pipelines, notebooks, and reusable data assets while partnering with Data Engineering to manage Silver and Gold architectural layers. Applies robust software and data engineering practices, including version control, testing, technical documentation, code reviews, and deployment management, while troubleshooting and optimizing solutions for peak performance, reliability, and maintainability. **Business Intelligence \& Power BI** Designs and delivers enterprise Power BI dashboards, reports, semantic models, and analytical tools that drive institutional decision\-making. Builds and maintains reusable semantic models, standardized measures, and institutional performance metrics using Power BI, DAX, Power Query, and Microsoft Fabric. Implements best practices for data visualization, dimensional modeling, performance tuning, row\-level security, and report lifecycle management. Partners closely with Data Governance and Institutional Research to ensure calculations, metrics, and institutional data definitions are consistently executed across all analytical deliverables while supporting and mentoring team members in utilizing shared analytical assets. **Advanced Analytics \& Data Science** Serves as a key technical resource for data science, predictive analytics, statistical modeling, and machine learning across the institution. Evaluates complex business problems to determine where advanced statistical or machine\-learning methodologies deliver actionable value beyond traditional reporting. Designs, develops, validates, and operationalizes predictive and analytical models supporting critical institutional priorities, including enrollment forecasting, student retention and completion, program alignment, financial optimization, and operational capacity planning. Executes feature engineering, exploratory data analysis, regression, classification, clustering, and time\-series forecasting, collaborating with Data Engineering and Application Engineering to integrate model outputs into enterprise platforms and workflows. **Data, AI \& Governance** Evaluates and prototypes emerging capabilities in analytics, machine learning, and generative artificial intelligence to address institutional challenges and enhance operational effectiveness. Ensures all data and analytics solutions adhere strictly to institutional data governance, security, privacy, and data\-handling standards. Collaborates with Data Governance to maintain data quality, lineage, metadata dictionaries, data classification, and responsible data usage. Embeds responsible AI and data science principles across all deliverables, ensuring transparency, explainability, reproducibility, and appropriate oversight while maintaining comprehensive documentation of data sources, transformations, calculations, and analytical  riven insight, and business awareness. Encourages a culture of problem solving and calculated risk taking, while fostering innovation and process improvement. Seeks input from a range of perspectives when appropriate and weighs both short\- and long\-term implications. **Leadership Without Authority** Leads by example, acting as a visible role model of the organization's values, integrity, and high standards. Provides clear direction, support, and inspiration to team members while ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Offers coaching, feedback, and mentorship to foster professional growth and encourage adaptability, ownership, and resilience. Builds trust, influences outcomes through strong relationships, and empowers others to contribute their best. Navigates change confidently while cultivating a high\-performing, engaged team. **Extra Duties Statement** ========================== *This job description outlines the general responsibilities and expectations of the role. It is not intended to include every task or responsibility. Additional duties may be assigned by leadership as needed.* **Employment Classification** This position is classified under Fair Labor Standard Act (FLSA) as exempt and operates in a professional and instructional environment that may include campus offices, classrooms, or lab settings. **Reasonable Accommodations** TSTC will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of the position. **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** TSTC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, religion, genetic information, or veteran status. **Work Environment** The role may require movement across campus, participation in meetings, and engagement with faculty, staff, and students to support institutional goals. Work is primarily performed in an office or academic environment using standard technology and communication tools. These activities can be performed with or without reasonable accommodation to support the essential functions of the role. **Telework Eligibility** This position may be considered for telework options based on eligibility under TSTC's Telework Policy, aligned with State of Texas requirements. Telework eligibility is determined by role responsibilities and business needs. **Availability and Communication Expectations** The employee must be reachable during assigned work hours through established communication channels as required by the role. **Travel Requirements** Periodic in\-state travel to campuses or meetings beyond the employee's designated or nearest base campus may be required based on business needs and will comply with TSTC and State of Texas requirements. **Confidentiality and Sensitive Information** This role requires attention to confidential and sensitive information appropriate to assigned responsibilities. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Texas State Technical College (TSTC), as an equal opportunity employer, complies with all applicable federal and state laws regarding nondiscrimination. TSTC is committed to a policy of equal opportunity for all persons and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, age, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or veteran status in employment, educational programs and activities, and admissions. **Employment Eligibility Verification** If hired, you will be required to complete the federal Employment Eligibility Verification I\-9 form. You will be required to present acceptable and original documents to prove your identity and authorization to work in the United States. Documents need to be presented no later than the third day of employment. Failure to do so will result in loss of employment at TSTC. **Background Checks** A criminal history background check will be required for the finalist(s) under consideration for this position.

jobs.title: Traveling Senior Scheduling Engineer - Data Centers
jobs.description: Job Summary The ATL Homemaker is seeking an experienced and highly organized Traveling Senior Scheduling Engineer to support the planning, development, and monitoring of data center construction schedules. This role is suited to a scheduling professional with strong project controls experience, an understanding of complex construction activities, and the ability to travel to project sites as needed. The Senior Scheduling Engineer will coordinate with project managers, construction teams, engineers, subcontractors, and vendors to develop reliable schedules, track progress, identify risks, and help ensure projects meet established milestones. The ideal candidate combines technical scheduling expertise with effective communication, analytical thinking, and the ability to manage changing project priorities. Key Responsibilities * Develop, maintain, and update detailed schedules for data center construction and related infrastructure projects. * Establish project activities, milestones, dependencies, critical paths, and completion targets. * Coordinate scheduling activities with project managers, design teams, field supervisors, subcontractors, and equipment vendors. * Monitor actual progress against planned schedules and identify potential delays or resource constraints. * Analyze critical path activities and recommend corrective actions to help maintain project timelines. * Prepare baseline schedules, progress reports, look\-ahead schedules, and schedule forecasts. * Track major data center construction activities, including site preparation, structural work, electrical systems, mechanical systems, cooling infrastructure, and equipment installation. * Coordinate schedules for long\-lead equipment, material deliveries, commissioning, testing, and project handover. * Review contractor and subcontractor schedules for consistency with overall project milestones. * Conduct schedule reviews and progress meetings with project stakeholders. * Evaluate the scheduling impact of design changes, scope adjustments, site conditions, and unforeseen issues. * Maintain accurate scheduling documentation, progress records, and project controls data. * Use scheduling software and project management tools to analyze performance and communicate schedule updates. * Travel to project sites to collaborate with local teams, validate progress, and resolve scheduling concerns. * Support risk assessments, recovery planning, and schedule optimization initiatives. * Communicate significant scheduling risks and recommended solutions to project leadership. Requirements and Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, project management, or a related field is preferred. * Significant experience in construction scheduling, project controls, or planning for complex construction projects. * Experience with data centers, mission\-critical facilities, industrial construction, or large\-scale commercial projects is highly desirable. * Strong understanding of construction sequencing, critical path methodology, schedule logic, and progress measurement. * Proficiency with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or comparable scheduling software. * Ability to interpret construction drawings, technical specifications, project plans, and contractor schedules. * Experience coordinating multiple contractors, engineering teams, and construction activities. * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to prepare clear schedule reports and present progress information to project stakeholders. * Willingness and ability to travel to project sites as required. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a deadline\-driven environment. * Professional judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to maintaining accurate project records. Work Environment This position combines scheduling and project controls work with regular coordination across construction sites. The role may involve office\-based planning, construction\-site visits, meetings with project teams, and travel to different locations. Candidates should be comfortable working in active construction environments and following site\-specific safety requirements. What We Offer * Opportunities to contribute to complex data center construction projects. * Professional development in construction scheduling and project controls. * Collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering and construction teams. * Opportunities to expand expertise in mission\-critical infrastructure projects. * Compensation, travel arrangements, and eligible benefits in accordance with company policy and applicable requirements. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit an application highlighting their scheduling and project controls experience, relevant technical qualifications, software proficiency, and experience with complex construction projects. Applicants should include examples of their work with project schedules, critical path analysis, contractor coordination, and schedule recovery planning where applicable. Join The ATL Homemaker as a Traveling Senior Scheduling Engineer – Data Centers and help coordinate complex construction activities while supporting project milestones, schedule reliability, and successful delivery. Pay: $41\.66 \- $45\.66 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * 403(b) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Relocation assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI-Driven Systems
jobs.description: ### **About Us** Thimble was an early pioneer in insurtech. We built a digital\-first way for small businesses to buy coverage by the job, month or year, and have since delivered more than 200,000 policies across the United States. We started direct\-to\-consumer as an MGA, but today, we’re focused on growing through brokers and distribution partners, bringing the same simple, fast experience to the agents who serve small businesses. Thimble is still evolving and is at the front of AI\-native distribution with MCP technology paired with API distribution. In 2023, Thimble was acquired by Arch Insurance, part of Arch Capital Group Ltd. (Nasdaq: ACGL), an S\&P 500 company providing insurance, reinsurance and mortgage insurance worldwide. That gives us something rare: the speed, ownership and culture of a startup, with the balance sheet, stability and long\-term commitment of one of the industry’s strongest insurers. For more information, visit thimble.com. ### **Our Values** Our unique culture is built around our six core values: **Think Wild, Act Tame** Be relentlessly creative. Question everything. Get to know the rules so well, you can use them in new ways. Be the industry’s compliant radicals. **Green Means GO** Act. Move forward. Learn. You can only make a decision based on the best information you have – so make it. **Own Every Detail** Be ruthlessly precise. Disciplined. Sweat the small stuff. **Simplify,** **Simplify, Simplify** Get to the point. Make it crystal clear. Cut everything else. It’s our job to make insurance easy – however hard that is for us. **Every Moment Counts** Show up early and ready. Deliver on time or before. Make the most of your time, so others can make the most of theirs. **Stay Human** Treat every person, and their ideas, with respect. Cherish diversity.### **About the Role** Thimble is investing in the next generation of its platform, and this engineer helps lead that work. Our backend is built on Node.js microservices and event\-driven architecture on AWS, and we are evolving it toward durable, explicitly orchestrated workflows, with AI\-native tooling at the center of how we build. This is a hands\-on role: you’ll write, review, and ship production code every day, with AI agents as your primary build partner. You’ll also shape technical strategy and set the patterns the rest of the team builds on. You’ll work in Node.js and TypeScript every day, so you need to be productive in them from the start. ### **What You’ll Do** * Design and build the durable workflows and services that will replace our current event\-driven flows, defining service boundaries, state ownership, idempotency, and retry semantics * Use of agentic coding tools on hard problems: setting up context, breaking down problems, and verifying output * Write and ship production code in Node.js and TypeScript every day, using agentic coding tools (Claude Code and similar) as your primary way of working * Define the reference patterns (service templates, shared libraries, code generators) that every rebuilt service follows * Plan and execute the migration in increments that keep production running, with tested rollbacks * Build and maintain the tooling around our AI workflow: MCP servers, evaluation scripts, and automated checks that hold AI\-generated code to the same bar as hand\-written code * Instrument services with metrics, alerts, dashboards, and tracing, and own production incidents end to end * Make targeted changes in our React and Angular applications when backend work requires them * Partner with product, growth, and other engineers, and contribute to code reviews and architecture discussions ### **What We’re Looking For** * Strong backend engineering with production experience in Node.js and TypeScript * Hands\-on experience building and operating distributed or event\-driven systems, and a working understanding of how they fail * Experience using AI tools to drive a large code migration at scale (framework upgrade, service rewrite, language port) * Curiosity about agent harnesses, MCP, and A2A protocols; production deployment of agents is not required * Experience contributing to a migration or re\-platform on a live system * Comfort reading unfamiliar code and data models and spotting problems in them * Enough frontend literacy to trace a problem from the UI down to the service layer * Clear written communication and comfort working in a remote, async\-friendly environment ### **Bonus Points** * Hands\-on experience with a durable execution or workflow orchestration engine, in any language * You’ve built or contributed to an MCP server, an agent harness, an evaluation suite, or a multi\-agent system, whether as a side project, open source, or an internal tool * Experience in InsurTech, FinTech, or another regulated industry in a similar environment to our tech stack **Thimbler Benefits \& Perks!** * Fully remote company * Thimble Fridays! (out of office at 12:00pm local time) * Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage * 401(k) auto enrollment and matching (100% of the first 3% and 50% of the next 3%) * PTO: 20 days vacation \+ 12 company\-wide holidays \+ 8 floating days \+ 1 VTO (Volunteer Time Off) \+ unlimited sick time * Parental Leave: 100% paid 12 weeks \+ 2 weeks gradual return * Computer choice of Mac or PC * Work from home setup reimbursement * Monthly co\-working space and/or child care reimbursement * Monthly ClassPass credit * Quarterly wellness reimbursement * Other health \& wellness perks including: One Medical, Teladoc, Talkspace, Kindbody, and Health Advocate * Virtual events, happy hours, trivia, and fun! jobs.title: Lead AI Experience Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** At Thomson Reuters™, we’re transforming Service Management from a reactive, process\-bound group into an AI\-native, intelligence\-driven organization. Operational data flows into intelligence, intelligence into orchestration, and orchestration into execution, in a closed loop with AI embedded in detection, decision, and action. Our AI Operations and Automation (AIOps) function is the intelligence layer of that model. Intelligence only matters if people can see it, question it, and act on it. As more of our operations run through AI agents, the layer where people and agents meet the data decides whether any of it gets trusted. You’ll build that layer. **Key Responsibilities** This role sits where three disciplines meet: dynamic data visualization, applied AI, and UI/UX. You’ll define how our AI agents exchange information with one another and hand it to the engineers who depend on it. You’ll design and build interactive visualizations that make dense operational telemetry immediately readable, showing what’s happening, why, what the system has already done about it, and what still needs a person. And you’ll own the experience end to end, from first prototype to the tools our teams run on every day. This is an internal role and an exciting one that never existed before. Your users are our own people: the Global Command Center, site reliability and platform engineers, service managers, and the leaders who need to read the health of our systems at a glance. Their trust in what they see is the product. We don’t have a template for this role, and that’s the point. You’ll help define what it becomes. You’ll join Service Management and Transformation, part of the CIO segment of our Technology organization, and work alongside AIOps, the team building the models and automation behind the interfaces you design. We keep a clear separation between building and running, so you’ll have room to build. The role is hybrid, based in our Dallas, TX office. * Build dynamic data visualization. Design and engineer interactive, real\-time views of operational data, including topology and dependency graphs, event and alert streams, incident timelines, and predictive signal. Think D3, WebGL, and modern front end, not drag\-and\-drop BI. * Define the agent\-to\-agent interface. Establish the interfaces and data contracts that let AI agents pass structured, verifiable information to one another, and hand it to engineers in a form they can inspect and challenge. * Make automated action visible. Our L0 tier is where AI and automation resolve issues ahead of human responders. Show what it did, why, and how confident it was, so engineers supervise machine decisions rather than simply receive them. * Design the experience. Lead the UI/UX and information architecture: research how responders work under pressure, decide what they need to see and when, shape the interaction model, and make a complex system feel simple to someone working an incident at 3 am. * Prototype and ship. Turn ambiguous problems into working software quickly, then harden the strongest ideas into tools our teams depend on. * Set technical direction. As a lead, you’ll set the standard for the experience layer, make the architectural calls, and mentor engineers and designers. A builder first, a coach alongside. * Partner closely. Work day to day with AIOps, Service Data and Insights, Configuration and Topology, Workflow Engineering, and the Global Command Center. In your first year, you might: * Replace an operational report our teams read line by line with an interactive view that answers the question in seconds. * Publish the first version of our agent\-to\-agent data contract, and prove it with two agents working together in production. * Ship the interface that lets engineers see, and trust, every L0 resolution they’re accountable for. * Establish the shared patterns the rest of the organization builds on: components, guidelines, and working prototypes. **Required Qualifications** * Experience. 8\+ years designing and building software, including data\-rich, user\-facing products, hands\-on applied AI or agentic work, and time setting technical direction for others. A degree in computer science, human\-computer interaction, design, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * A hybrid background. Deep experience in two of these three and fluency in the third: front\-end and data\-visualization engineering, applied AI, and UI/UX design. * Information architecture and user\-centric design. You structure dense information so people find what matters without hunting for it, and you ground design decisions in research with real users, including interviews, task analysis, and usability testing. * Dynamic visualization in production. You’ve shipped interactive data visualization in JavaScript or TypeScript, with React and tools such as D3\.js, WebGL, or Canvas, and you care how it feels as much as whether it renders. * Applied AI fluency. Hands\-on wi two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Governance - TikTok Privacy and Security
jobs.description: Technology Software Engineer \- AI Governance \- TikTok Privacy and Security **Location :** Seattle **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A39691A Responsibilities The TikTok Privacy and Security (PnS) R\&D team creates privacy solutions that are intuitive for users, auditable for regulators, and sustainable for the company, making TikTok a platform where people can safely discover, create, and connect. We build user\-facing privacy features, including privacy settings, consent management, data access and export, and age\-appropriate experiences. We protect personal data across its full lifecycle, from collection and transfer through access, storage, retention, and deletion. We develop the platforms, technical controls, and governance tools behind privacy protection and regulatory compliance in global markets, and we bring privacy\-enhancing technologies and research into production at scale. We tackle challenges unique to operating a platform at global scale: translating rapidly evolving laws and policies into reliable technical controls, providing transparency and auditability across highly complex data systems, supporting different regulatory requirements across regions, and making privacy protection work at the quality and speed production systems demand. You will work across product privacy, data lifecycle management, data protection and residency, privacy engineering platforms, AI governance, and privacy\-preserving technologies, using techniques including automated compliance enforcement, data lineage and taxonomy, differential privacy, trusted execution environments, AI fairness, and privacy protection for generative AI. The systems you build will protect hundreds of millions of people, and the privacy decisions you make will reach every one of them. TikTok's Privacy and Security (PNS) Data Retention team makes sure that data across the platform is kept only as long as it is needed, and is then deleted reliably and verifiably. The data covers online services, offline warehouses, logs, backups, and ML training datasets. Global privacy rules keep getting stricter, and the data estate keeps growing to exabyte scale. The team owns the policies, platforms, and technical controls that turn retention commitments into guarantees we can enforce and audit. As a Backend Engineer \- Data Retention, you will design and build scalable, reliable, high\-performance systems that manage the lifecycle of data at TikTok scale. That includes finding and classifying data, applying retention policies, running deletion, and proving that deletion happened. You will turn fast\-changing privacy and regulatory requirements into concrete platform capabilities. You will work closely with storage infrastructure, data platform, ML platform, product, privacy, legal, and security teams to ship solutions across thousands of services and storage systems. Responsibilities: \- Design and build large\-scale data lifecycle management systems that enforce retention policies across heterogeneous storage: RDBMS, KV stores, caches, message queues, data warehouses (Hive/HDFS), object storage, logs, and backups. \- Build and run high\-throughput deletion pipelines, such as TTL enforcement, user account deletion propagation, and partition and snapshot expiry. They must be correct, idempotent, and observable, and must not hurt the stability or performance of production systems. \- Build data discovery and inventory capabilities, including metadata collection, data lineage, and classification of personal and sensitive data. These keep retention policies accurately mapped to real storage assets. \- Build verification, auditing, and reporting systems that prove deletion is complete and on time. Provide evidence for internal audits and regulator inquiries. \- Support exception workflows such as legal holds, retention extensions, and policy approvals, with fine\-grained access control and full audit trails. \- Work with ML platform teams to extend retention and deletion controls to training datasets, feature stores, and derived artifacts such as embeddings and model checkpoints. \- Work with privacy, legal, and compliance teams so that systems meet applicable regulations (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other global and regional privacy laws) and TikTok's own data commitments. \- Help shape the technical roadmap for the data retention platform, and find and evaluate new techniques and tools that improve coverage, efficiency, and reliability at scale. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications \- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field. \- Strong background in large\-scale distributed systems, databases, messaging and streaming systems (such as Kafka or Flink), and caching. \- Solid understanding of storage internals and data lifecycle concepts, such as TTL, compaction, partitioning, snapshots and backups, and consistency models. \- Experience building high\-throughput batch or streaming data pipelines with strong correctness guarant age systems. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units. ​ Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure). ​ The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice. ​ **For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:** ​ Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: ​ 1\. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues; ​ 2\. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and ​ 3\. Exercising sound judgment. ​ About TikTok TikTok is the leading destination for short\-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. ​ Why Join Us Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy \- a mission we work towards every day. ​ We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​ ​ Diversity \& Inclusion ​ TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too. ​ TikTok Accommodation TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. jobs.title: Hiring: Cloud Security / AI Security Engineer | AWS IAM & Cedar Policies | Remote | 15+ Years
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Role: Cloud Security Engineer / AI Security Engineer** **Location: Los Angeles, CA** (Remote – 10% Travel; must be comfortable traveling to client sites for workshops and meetings) **Duration: 3\+ Months (Extension Possible)** **Experience:** 15\+ Years **Primary Skills:** IAM Policy Templates, Cedar Policies **Role Overview:** Seeking an experienced Security Engineer with 15\+ years of experience in cloud security and identity management to secure enterprise AI applications on AWS. The role focuses on authentication, reusable IAM policy templates, Cedar\-based authorization, and secure access to tools, APIs, and enterprise resources. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. IAM Policy Templates \& Access Management** * Design, develop, and maintain reusable AWS IAM policy templates for AI agents and AgentCore infrastructure. * Implement role\-based access control (RBAC) and least\-privilege security principles. * Define IAM roles, trust policies, permission boundaries, and resource\-based policies. * Configure IAM execution roles for AgentCore Runtime and AgentCore Gateway. * Develop standardized IAM templates for accessing AWS services such as Lambda, S3, Bedrock, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, and CloudWatch. * Automate IAM policy deployment and configuration using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK. * Conduct IAM access reviews, permission audits, and policy validation. * Troubleshoot access\-denied issues, role\-assumption failures, and authorization misconfigurations. **2\. Cedar Policies at AgentCore Gateway** * Design, author, test, and deploy Cedar authorization policies using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Policy. * Implement fine\-grained authorization for AI agents accessing tools through AgentCore Gateway. * Define policies specifying which identities can invoke particular tools, APIs, and operations. * Configure policy engines and associate them with AgentCore Gateways. * Implement attribute\-based access control (ABAC) using identity attributes, roles, scopes, and contextual conditions. * Develop policies that restrict sensitive tool operations based on business roles, permissions, and security requirements. * Validate Cedar policies against gateway schemas and test permitted and denied access scenarios. * Enforce default\-deny authorization and prevent unauthorized tool execution. * Monitor and troubleshoot authorization decisions and policy evaluation failures. **3\. Security Governance \& Compliance** * Implement security controls for enterprise AI agents and Generative AI applications. * Develop security standards for agent identities, API integrations, and access management. * Support audit logging, access traceability, and security monitoring using AWS CloudTrail and CloudWatch. * Identify and mitigate risks including excessive privileges, credential exposure, unauthorized tool access, and privilege escalation. * Conduct security reviews of agent architecture and integrations. * Collaborate with AI engineering and DevOps teams to ensure secure production deployments. **4\. Security Automation \& DevSecOps** * Automate security policy deployment through GitHub Actions and infrastructure\-as\-code pipelines. * Integrate IAM and Cedar policy validation into CI/CD workflows. * Implement automated security checks and policy compliance testing. * Maintain version\-controlled security configurations across development, testing, and production environments. * Support security incident investigation, access troubleshooting, and remediation. **Required Technical Skills** * **AWS Security:** IAM, IAM roles, policies, STS, AWS Secrets Manager, CloudTrail, CloudWatch. * **Authorization:** Cedar policy language, RBAC, ABAC, fine\-grained access control. * **Authentication:** OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, AWS IAM authentication. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation. * **Automation:** Python, GitHub Actions, CI/CD security integration. * **Cloud Security:** Least\-privilege access, identity federation, credential management, and secure API integrations. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Sr. DataOps Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description: **Our Story** ------------- TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We've grown 2\-3x year over year for three years running, and we're now building the operations, systems, and teams to scale without sacrificing quality or culture. We're fully remote, and we value ownership, open communication, and speed. If you want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel at home here. **The Opportunity** We're looking for a Senior DataOps Engineer to own the operations, security, and cost of our data platform. We're migrating from BigQuery to Snowflake, and you'll be the hands\-on Snowflake expert who runs the platform and makes sure it stays secure, observable, and well managed as our data footprint grows with machine learning, AI, and structured and semi\-structured data from AWS S3 and external vendor files. This is a tactical, hands\-on role supporting the data team and application teams across multiple business verticals. You'll bring data operations practices together in one place, and over time that scope will grow to include the Postgres and NoSQL databases our application teams use. We need deep Snowflake expertise combined with the breadth to look beyond it: how all of our data tools, vendors, access, and costs fit together, and opportunities to improve platform practices. You bring demonstrated experience managing complex data platforms and improving their operations. **What You Will Own** **Data Platform \& Operations** * **Run the platform.** Own administration and day\-to\-day operations of Snowflake, including environments, warehouses, performance, and the operational side of our migration from BigQuery. * **Standardize data operations.** Define consistent operating practices for data ingestion from S3 and vendor files, structured and semi\-structured data, and ML and AI workloads, using infrastructure as code and CI/CD for data. * **Extend platform practices to operational databases.** Extend consistent operational practices to the Postgres and NoSQL databases used by application teams, including backups, performance, and access. **Security \& Access** * **Secure the data.** Apply least\-privilege permissions, design appropriate data access roles, and integrate our data tools with SSO, with encryption and auditing for sensitive data. * **Manage data vendors and tools.** Manage the external vendors and tools used by our data team, covering access, SSO integration, configuration, and licensing. **Reliability \& Cost** * **Keep it observable and reliable.** Build monitoring and observability across our data pipelines and platform, and define and run the incident management process, from response through root cause and follow\-up. * **Improve cost transparency.** Track and attribute spend across Snowflake and data tooling, provide teams with clear cost visibility, and drive optimization. **Support Across Teams** * **Support multiple teams.** Serve as the data operations point of contact for teams across business verticals, helping resolve operational challenges and establishing reusable practices and documentation. **What You Bring** **Required:** * 7\+ years of professional experience in data platform engineering, DataOps, or DevOps, with a track record of operating production data platforms. * Deep Snowflake expertise, including administration, role\-based access control, warehouse management, performance, and cost. * Strong security and access management skills, including least\-privilege role design, SSO integration, encryption, and audit logging. * Experience with AWS data storage and access, including S3, IAM, and the networking that governs data access. * Experience building monitoring, observability, and incident management for data pipelines and platforms. * Experience with cloud data cost visibility and management, including reporting spend clearly to technical and non\-technical teams. * Experience administering data vendor tools, such as ingestion, orchestration, BI, and data quality platforms. * Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD for data workloads (e.g., Terraform, dbt deployments). * Working experience operating relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres). * Broad understanding of the data ecosystem, including how platforms, tools, and processes integrate and where improvements are needed. * Strong communication skills and a track record of supporting multiple teams and helping teams adopt shared practices. **Preferred (Nice to Have):** * Experience migrating a data warehouse to Snowflake, or working knowledge of BigQuery. * Snowflake certifications. * Experience supporting data infrastructure for machine learning and AI workloads. * Experience with orchestration and transformation tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt). * Experience with data governance, catalog, or compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, or in a regulated or document\-heavy industry such as legal or financial services. **Who Thrives Here (Core Values)** We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset. * **Embrace Change:** Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?" * **Committed:** You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting. * **No\-Ego Energy:** Positive, professional, and solutions\-oriented. Drama stays at the door. * **Ownership:** You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours. * **Fast \& Hungry:** You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact. **What We Offer** * Base Salary: $130,000 \- $160,000 commensurate with experience * Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor. * Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave. **Equal Opportunity Employer** We are an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **Our Story** ------------- TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We've grown 2\-3x year over year for three years running, and we're now building the operations, systems, and teams to scale without sacrificing quality or culture. We're fully remote, and we value ownership, open communication, and speed. If you want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel at home here. **The Opportunity** We're looking for a Staff\-level Software Engineer who is as comfortable designing production systems as they are applying AI to real business problems. This is a hybrid role, not a pure AI research or ML engineering position. You'll build the internal tools and platforms that power our operations teams, and be the technical expert on where AI creates real value and where it doesn't. You'll set technical direction across multiple teams and systems, not just the ones you build yourself. When the business needs to explore an AI opportunity, weigh technology options, or understand where we stand on AI, you'll investigate, recommend, and deliver. You'll navigate ambiguity and make well\-reasoned build\-versus\-buy decisions, then drive the recommended solution through implementation. You'll also think about the data each product generates, so what we build feeds our analytics and helps leadership decide where to invest. You bring strong engineering judgment, a bias toward pragmatic solutions, and the ability to turn open\-ended questions into decisions and working software. You'll be a trusted technical advisor to leadership, and your impact will be measured by what the whole team ships, not just what you build yourself. **What You Will Own** **Architecture \& Delivery** * **Build and own.** Architect and build internal tools and platforms for operations teams, owning them from design through deployment and ongoing operation, including reliability and incident follow\-through. * **Set direction.** Define service boundaries, integration patterns, and data flow across teams, and write the technical strategy and RFCs that make the direction clear. * **Simplify.** Reduce operational toil by retiring or consolidating systems, managing tech debt and migrations, and weighing long\-term maintenance cost in every build\-versus\-buy decision. * **Integrate and protect.** Build reliable integrations with legacy and third\-party SaaS systems, with security, access control, and audit trails designed in for sensitive data. **Applied AI** * **Apply AI with judgment.** Identify where AI belongs in a solution and where it doesn't, and design it as a well\-engineered part of the system (retrieval, agents, LLM\-powered features, workflow automation). * **Prove it, then ship it.** Run time\-boxed proofs of concept that answer "is this worth doing?" with evidence, then advance successful proofs of concept into production\-ready solutions, with evaluation, observability, reliability, and security. * **Guide AI investment.** Assess our AI maturity, define a practical roadmap, and track AI cost and ROI so investment decisions rest on data. **Data** * **Build products that produce good data.** Design data models and instrumentation so every product generates clean, usable data for analytics and strategic planning. **Technical Leadership** * **Lead across competing priorities.** Align teams with differing priorities on shared platforms, standards, and tradeoffs. Build consensus through influence and evidence, and drive decisions when consensus cannot be reached. * **Improve engineering quality and delivery practices.** Write high\-quality code and lead through code reviews, design reviews, and engineering standards, using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to raise the whole team's delivery speed. * **Mentor and advise.** Mentor engineers and serve as a trusted technical advisor to stakeholders and leadership, explaining tradeoffs clearly and driving decisions to closure. **What You Bring** **Required:** * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of designing and shipping reliable, maintainable production systems. * Demonstrated Staff or Principal\-level scope: you have led architecture or a major technical initiative across multiple teams with competing priorities, and aligned them on shared platforms or standards. * Hands\-on experience building applications with LLMs and generative AI in production, not just experiments. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor. * Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave. **Equal Opportunity Employer** We are an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Applied AI)
jobs.description: Traba is building the AI operating system for the industrial supply chain \- the network of warehouses, manufacturers, logistics providers, and workers behind the physical goods people rely on every day. We started by tackling labor, supplying industrial businesses with consistent, reliable temporary workforces, and quickly became the fastest growing staffing company in America. Since then, we've expanded our suite of AI agents to help logistics providers, manufacturers, 3PLs, and other industrial businesses fully automate their manual workflows, derive insights from their data streams, and transform their decision intelligence. Our mission is to build a world where the global supply chain operates at peak efficiency. We’re proud to be backed by some of the world’s best investors, including Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst. **You'll build Traba's product on top of AI agents**—taking frontier models and existing agents and putting them to work across our staffing marketplace to automate the pipeline that sources, vets, matches, and places workers on millions of shifts. (Our AI Agents team builds the agent platform; you apply it everywhere it creates leverage.) This is a product\-engineering role first, so you'll go where the priorities are—some quarters that's an agent that automates vetting or matching, others it's a payments flow or platform work. You'll partner with our CTO on architecture and roadmap, and build the platform the rest of the company runs on. **About You:** * **An applier, not a researcher.** You take frontier models and existing agents and wire them into real product across the stack—shipping reliable automation rather than owning the orchestration internals. And you don't need every task to be an AI task: you take the highest\-priority problem, model or not. * **Voracious learner.** You move easily between API design, UX, and deployment infrastructure. * **Proven full\-stack builder.** You have a track record of shipping scalable, performant applications from frontend interfaces to backend distributed systems. **You Will:** * Apply existing agents and frontier models across the stack—worker app, business app, ops platform, marketplace—to automate vetting, matching, and fulfillment. * Lead frontend and backend development, mentoring other engineers. * Architect and build core systems—real\-time matching, autonomous vetting pipelines, distributed systems, and APIs. * Own product surfaces end to end, partnering closely with product and design. **You Have:** * 5\+ years across frontend and backend: TypeScript, React/React Native, and Node.js or Python. * Strong with APIs, distributed systems, PostgreSQL, and messaging (Kafka or RabbitMQ). * Hands\-on experience integrating LLMs or agents into real product—prompting, tool wiring, evals. You've shipped AI features, even if you didn't build the platform. * A track record of shipping scalable products in fast, ambiguous, early\-stage environments. **Benefits:** * Start\-up equity * Competitive Salary * 100% Paid health, dental \& vision coverage * Dinner Provided via DoorDash, free DashPass \& stocked kitchen for NY employees * Commuter benefit * Gympass Benefit * ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, HealthAdvocate, Teledoc Health **Salary Range Details** ------------------------ The compensation range for this position is set between $200,000 and $240,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. **Our Values** -------------- **Dream Big \-** We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life\-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long\-term value for short\-term results. **Olympian’s Work Ethic \-** Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field. **Growth Mindset \-** We confront the toughest challenges head\-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience. **Customer Obsession \-** We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. We remain focused on delivering high\-quality products and services that solve this massive and overlooked industries’ problems Job Applicant Privacy Notice Compensation Range: $200K \- $240K

jobs.title: Associate Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Family** IT \- General**About Us** At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests. Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there. **Who We Are** We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life. Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them. We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms. **What We Do** Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1\) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2\) Protection Solutions and Savings \& Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3\) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs. Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23\.9 million customers worldwide.\* For more information, visit transamerica.com. **Job Description Summary** Aegon’s Core AI Team is scaling rapidly to meet growing demand for AI\-driven transformation across our global business. Building on recent successes – including the launch of a vendor\-agnostic enterprise LLM gateway (AWS Launchpad), we are now investing in next\-generation Gen AI and Agentic AI capabilities. We are seeking an experienced Associate Principal AI Engineer to join Aegon’s Core AI team, evolve the organizations AI platform capabilities, develop and mature AI services, drive and support AI adoption, and provide AI expertise in support of AI fueled digital transformation.**Job Description** * Contribute enhancements to Aegon’s AWS Launchpad platform and related operational services. * Provide support to Launchpad Platform onboarding of internal development teams. * Apply strong Python skills to build production ready Gen AI and Agentic AI solutions (AWS AgentCore). * Translate complex problems into well\-defined project requirements. * Under supervision, lead AI development teams in the delivery of business transformation initiatives using software engineering best practices, and adhering to Aegon’s Software Delivery Lifecycle. * Apply strong AWS AI knowledge to select the right components and AI services to solve business problems. * Contribute to the evolution of our AI governance and operational processes. * Proactively share compelling ideas and work to the rest of the team and organisation. We want you to help lead/push the adoption of AI throughout Aegon. * Champion a culture of innovation, continuous learning and operational excellence. * Work closely with broader software engineering teams and stakeholders (internal and external) to innovate, design and delivery highly effective solutions. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. * 10\+ years related experience with at least **3 years of demonstrable experience** in end\-to\-end AI solution design. * Professional certifications in AI and / or cloud technologies. * Strong proficiency in Python for production ready delivery. * Deep understanding of the Gen AI landscape and agentic frameworks (inc. Strands SDK, LangChain, A2A, and MCP) * Experience working in the full model lifecycle – planning, training, deploying and maintaining AI systems. * Good knowledge of AWS AI Infrastructure and AI services. * Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools such as **Kubernetes** and **Docker**. * Experience in working with a diverse set of stakeholders to deliver AI solutions. **Preferred Qualifications:** *  horized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. This is a hybrid position requiring three days in office per week in one of our hub locations (Cedar Rapids, Denver or Philadelphia). Relocation assistance will not be provided for this position. *This job description is not a contract of employment nor for any specific job responsibilities. The Company may change, add to, remove, or revoke the terms of this job description at its discretion. Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. In the event an employee or applicant requests or requires an accommodation to perform job functions, the applicable HR Business Partner should be contacted to evaluate the accommodation request.* **What We Offer** For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well\-being of our employees. Compensation Benefits * Competitive Pay * Bonus for Eligible Employees Benefits Package * Pension Plan * 401k Match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Tuition Reimbursement * Disability Insurance * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Employee Discounts * Career Training \& Development Opportunities Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits * Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service. * Ten (10\) paid holidays per year (typically mirroring the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) holidays). * Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars * Parental Leave – fifteen (15\) days of paid parental leave per calendar year to eligible employees with at least one year of service at the time of birth, placement of an adopted child, or placement of a foster care child. * Adoption Assistance * Employee Assistance Program * Back\-Up Care Program * PTO for Volunteer Hours * Employee Matching Gifts Program * Employee Resource Groups * Inclusion and Diversity Programs * Employee Recognition Program * Referral Bonus Programs **Inclusion \& Diversity** We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women. To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company\-sponsored, employee\-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all. **Giving Back** We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994\. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work. **Transamerica’s Parent Company** Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999\. Since its start in 1844, Aegon has grown into an international company serving more than 23\.9 million people across the globe.\* It offers investment, protection, and retirement solutions, always with a clear purpose: **Helping people live their best lives.** As a leading global investor and employer, the company seeks to have a positive impact by addressing critical environmental and societal issues, with a focus on climate change and inclusion and diversity. * As of December 31, 2023
