platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce, Jobber, or similar), Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and automated email platforms. ● Marketing Fundamentals: Solid understanding of technical SEO, email deliverability standards (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), and digital sales pipelines. ● Requirement: Must be able to commute daily and work 100% on\-site at our corporate office. **What We Offer** ● Retirement: jobs.title: Service Desk Analyst I (M - F 9:30am to 6pm EST)
jobs.description: ### **Grow Your IT Career with Hands\-On Experience** Looking for an opportunity to launch your career in IT? As a **Service Desk Analyst**, you’ll be the first point of contact for customers who need technical help. You’ll troubleshoot everyday technology issues, solve problems, and gain hands\-on experience with widely used technologies including Microsoft 365, Windows, Azure, Active Directory, and more. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their IT career who enjoys technology, problem\-solving, and helping people. ### **What You’ll Do** * Provide friendly, professional technical support by phone, ticket, and remote session * Troubleshoot common hardware, software, network, and account\-access issues * Support technologies such as **Microsoft 365, Windows, Azure, Active Directory, Google Workspace, and macOS** * Document troubleshooting steps and resolutions clearly and accurately * Keep customers informed throughout the support process * Partner with senior technicians and engineers when issues require additional expertise * Learn new technologies while building valuable real\-world IT experience ### **What We’re Looking For** You don’t need to know everything on day one. We’re looking for someone who is **curious, dependable, customer\-focused, and excited to grow in IT.** You should have: * Strong customer service and communication skills * A natural ability to troubleshoot and solve problems * Comfort working in a fast\-paced environment * Strong organization and attention to detail * An interest in technology and a willingness to learn ### **Education \& Experience** Candidates should have **one** of the following: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, MIS, or a related field * Associate degree plus 1 year of relevant experience * 2 years of professional service desk or technical support experience CompTIA A\+ and Microsoft certifications are a plus. CompTIA A\+ must be obtained within six months of employment. ### **Your Schedule** **Monday\-Friday \| 9:30 AM\-6:00 PM Eastern Time** Enjoy a consistent weekday schedule while building the technical skills and customer experience that can help you grow your IT career. ### **Ready to Get Started?** If you have a passion for technology, enjoy helping people, and are looking for an opportunity to build your IT career, **we’d love to hear from you.** **Compensation:** Starting from $21 an hour

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer** Full\-time Twisthink is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design and build custom software solutions across a variety of domains, including backend systems, data platforms, connected applications, and AI\-enabled products. This role provides technical leadership throughout the design, implementation, and launch of scalable, maintainable, and resilient software solutions. The ideal candidate has experience delivering complex software systems, enjoys solving challenging problems, and is comfortable learning new technologies and domains. You’ll collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams and clients to translate business needs into technical solutions and deliver high\-quality software. You’ll also help us continue evolving how we use AI development tools and agents to improve the way software is designed, built, tested, and maintained. **What You’ll Accomplish:** * Design and deliver custom software solutions spanning backend services, APIs, applications, data platforms, and cloud\-connected systems. * Contribute to the design and implementation of data platforms, data pipelines, integrations, and application architectures that support analytics and intelligent software solutions. * Work across programming languages, frameworks, and cloud technologies based on project needs, becoming effective with unfamiliar technologies when needed. * Collaborate with clients, architects, designers, and engineers to define technical approaches that align with business goals and user needs. * Use AI development tools and agents throughout the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, quality, and delivery speed. * Explore emerging AI models, tools, and development practices and help determine how they can be applied effectively across our engineering teams. * Provide technical direction while advocating for sound engineering practices in software architecture, testing, security, observability, DevOps, and maintainability. * Foster a culture of learning, collaboration, experimentation, and continuous improvement. **Keys to Success:** * 7\+ years of experience in full life\-cycle software development, with experience designing, delivering, and supporting production software systems. * Demonstrated experience using AI development tools or agents to plan, build, test, and deliver meaningful engineering work, with an interest in continuing to explore new models, tools, and approaches. * Strong software engineering fundamentals and proficiency in one or more modern programming languages. Experience with C\#/.NET, Python, Java, TypeScript, or similar technologies is valuable, but exact stack alignment is not required. * Experience with modern cloud platforms and development workflows, including source control, code review, and CI/CD pipelines. Our teams primarily work with Azure and AWS, but experience with other cloud platforms is also valuable. * Experience working with data\-intensive systems, including areas such as data modeling, SQL, data pipelines, integrations, event\-driven systems, analytics, or data platforms. * Proven ability to lead technical discussions, learn unfamiliar technologies and domains, and collaborate directly with clients and stakeholders. * Familiarity with modern engineering practices including automated testing, observability, infrastructure\-as\-code, security, and maintainable system design. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a self\-directed approach to learning, problem solving, technical leadership, and helping others succeed. * Experience designing, integrating, or implementing LLM\-based, agentic, or other AI\-enabled software solutions is a plus. **Why Join Our Team?** * **Do meaningful, challenging work.** Solve complex problems and create impactful software solutions across a variety of industries, technologies, and client applications. * **Help shape the future of software engineering.** Explore emerging technologies, including AI development tools and agents, and influence how we apply them to deliver better solutions. * **Build better solutions together.** Work alongside talented, multidisciplinary teammates in a collaborative environment, with at least three days each week together in our Grand Rapids office and the flexibility of hybrid work. * **Share in the value you help create.** Join a 100% employee\-owned company, with the opportunity to participate in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). * **Invest in your professional growth.** Learn from and mentor talented teammates, with support for professional development, training, certifications, and tuition reimbursement. * **Benefit from comprehensive total rewards.** Receive competitive compensation, medical, dental, and vision coverage, company\-sponsored life and disability insurance, and a 401(k) with a company match. * **Make a difference beyond your projects.** Contribute to a culture of giving back through teammate\-led initiatives that support causes and communities locally and globally. Twisthink ensures equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital status, citizenship, national origin, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: This is a grant funded, 18 month, Limited Appointment position. Certain terms and conditions of employment for this position, including the rate of pay, benefits, etc., are currently subject to negotiation with the appropriate union. This position is considered flexible, 2 days on\-site, and must be available for lab on\-site meetings that may happen once per week or bi\-weekly, based on needs of the department. The Machine Learning and Data engineer role will lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of data pipelines and infrastructure to support the deployment and continuous monitoring of Machine Learning (ML) and generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools within UCSF’s APeX Enabled Research (AER) team. Most projects will be in partnership with other UCSF technical teams and involve highly customized research solutions. Communication skills and inventive technical solutioning are crucial. The AER team provides a large array of services to the UCSF Research community, including project consultation, grant support, budget estimations, and project implementation and support. Project examples include: * Development of EHR\-based interventions via clinical trials embedded within healthcare delivery systems to generate scientific evidence while delivering healthcare. + Enabling UCSF researchers with algorithms, digital tools and / or clinical interventions with strong evidence of feasibility and acceptability. + Develop technical approaches and budgets in order to implement these tools within the electronic medical record. + Supporting the development of scalable, low cost infrastructure to enable ongoing research. This role primarily involves managing and optimizing the data and monitoring pipelines of the Health IT Platform for Advanced Computing (HIPAC), a cloud infrastructure that supports the development and deployment of AI/ML tools, including large language models (LLMs) in the EHR. Specifically, the ML/data engineer will work on implementing new data integrations, enhancing HIPAC’s ETL functionalities, productionizing AI/ML tools developed by UCSF data scientists/researchers, and designing and implementing metrics to continuously monitor AI/ML tools deployed at UCSF Health. Competitive applicants for this position are software, machine learning, or data engineers with 6\+ years of experience in implementing and maintaining AI/ML pipelines. Proficiency in MLOps, Python, SQL, and CI/CD is required. This role also requires a deep understanding of Epic data models (Clarity and Caboodle). Successful candidates either have or are able to obtain Epic Clinical/Clarity data model certification shortly after onboarding. **Department Overview** The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) Department of Information Technology Academic Research Systems (ARS) group is chartered to provide data services and infrastructure that support the UCSF Research Community’s computing and analytic requirements through centralized informatics services in the areas of Data, Tools, Secure Compute Environments, and Consulting Services. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related area and / or equivalent experience / training. * 6 years of experience in positions of increasing responsibility designing, implementing, and maintaining complex AI/ML applications. * Experience with data analysis and machine learning tools such as Jupyter, Pandas, scikit\-learn, Numpy/Scipy, PyTorch, etc. * Demonstrated advanced knowledge of full software development lifecycle * Advanced experience with Python; ability to write clean, efficient, and production\-level Python code * Advanced experience with SQL (e.g., SQLServer, PostgreSQL) * Demonstrated experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining AI/ML models and pipelines * Advanced experience in database systems, data warehousing solutions, and understanding of ETL pipelines * Advanced experience in designing, building, or maintaining data infrastructure for efficient ML model training and inference. * Demonstrated experience working with MLOps, DevOps, and CI/CD pipeline toolsets * Experience in developing complex, automated testing * Experience with cloud\-based architecture in platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure * Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills * Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to technical and non\-technical personnel at various levels in the organization * Self\-motivated and works independently and as part of a team. Able to learn effectively and meet deadlines * Demonstrated broad problem\-solving skills * Demonstrated ability to interface with management on a regular basis * Excellent project leadership and management skills. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Master’s Degree or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related area and / or equivalent experience / training. * Experience with large language models and other generative AI technologies, especially supporting the deployment of GenAI\-based tools in a production environment * Familiar with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau) * Experience with Epic data structures * Epic Clarity Certification * Cloud Development certifications **About UCSF** The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate\-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10\-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells. **Pride Values** UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values . In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here . Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide. **Equal Employment Opportunity** The University of California is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected status under state or federal law. **Salary Information** The final salary and offer components are subject to additional approvals based on UC policy. Your placement within the salary range is dependent on a number of factors including your work experience and internal equity within this position classification at UCSF. For positions that are represented by a labor union, placement within the salary range will be guided by the rules in the collective bargaining agreement. To learn more about the benefits of working at UCSF, including total compensation, please visit: https://ucnet.universityofcalifornia.edu/compensation\-and\-benefits/index.html

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, AI for Care
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Verily Health is a data platform and technology company purpose\-built to power AI\-enabled precision health solutions that accelerate research and improve care for individuals and communities. Uniquely positioned at the intersection of technology, data science, and healthcare, Verily transforms multimodal health data into insights, models, and actions that make healthcare more personalized, predictive, and precise. **Description** =============== Verily Health builds healthcare solutions for customers in every vertical in the market from life sciences to health systems to health plans and to patients. Each of those solutions is powered by AI capabilities. where we need to continually verify that the output is meeting the needs of our end users. You’ll own the product strategy for Verily’s AI Platform, the capabilities that first\- and third\-party AI developers use to benchmark, evaluate, monitor, and improve AI experiences in healthcare. Your first major initiative will be focused on our Evaluation Harness. AI evaluations across Verily’s solutions are paramount for establishing trust with our users and customers. The work will span everything from golden\-dataset evals, code assertions, LLM\-as\-a\-judge evals, error analysis, and customer feedback signals, from quick one\-off checks to long\-running validation for regulated use. You’ll set a 12\-month strategy and a longer vision for our AI Platform in healthcare, then lead a team of software engineers and AI developers, working beside them every day, to build it. The standard you set will shape how trustworthy healthcare AI gets made at Verily and beyond. We’re looking for someone who has a track record of building AI developer tooling and infrastructure and wants to define how the healthcare industry does it. **Responsibilities** ==================== * Build a platform, not a point solution. Build evaluation tools for AI developers across many customers, verticals and clinical risk levels. * Obsess about user value. Name your end users, map their journeys, deeply understand their unmet needs, and conduct continuous discovery, delivery, and iteration with your team. You are directly responsible for end to end user value creation. * Build on Platform with technical credibility. Work as a peer with software architects, engineers, and data scientists on architecture and AI tradeoffs. Align solutions with Verily’s existing platform capabilities, and work with other teams to extend those capabilities in ways that scale the platform rather than create one\-offs. * Compliance in healthcare. Align with subject matter experts across clinical, regulatory, quality, security, and data science to right\-size and de\-risk solutions for the business constraints we must operate within. * Own the AI Evaluation Harness portfolio. Drive the roadmap across error analysis, golden datasets, code assertions, LLM\-as\-a\-judge, and customer feedback signals, and align stakeholders when interests conflict. Own product strategy and prioritization. Develop and communicate at different levels of detail and time horizon based on the audience; 12\-month product strategy, half\-year milestones, quarterly delivery roadmap, and biweekly sprint priorities. Set the direction, sequence the steps, and stay hands\-on with the scrum team. **Qualifications** ================== Minimum Qualifications * 5\+ years of product management on platform products. You have been embedded with engineering scrum teams, and have a record of shipping and operating the product, not just specifying it. * Hands\-on AI Evaluation product experience. You have shipped AI evaluation tooling that customers use (LLM\-as\-a\-judge frameworks, golden datasets, code assertions and trace tooling). You can name the products, describe in detail the hard problems you solved, and show the adoption and quality outcomes for end users. * Deep technical foundation. You have a background in software engineering, systems engineering, data science, clinical informatics, or a comparable discipline. You can review architecture with engineers and go deep on LLM behavior with data scientists and be technically credible with them. * Stakeholder negotiation. You have aligned technical and non\-technical leaders around one product vision, and can give examples where you moved a conflicted group to a decision. * Scale and complexity. You have owned a multi\-tenant, version\-controlled platform in a high\-growth environment, with real tenancy, versioning, and backward\-compatibility tradeoffs. Preferred Qualifications * Healthcare domain fluency: FHIR resources, clinical informatics, and interoperability standards. You know what a “correct” clinical output requires and who must sign off on it. * Regulated environments: experience navigating HIPAA, GxP, FDA SaMD, or other healthcare compliance frameworks, ideally including building validation or audit evidence into a product. * Clinical Specific AI \- Experience building evals for clinical or high\-stakes AI outputs (summarization, coding, triage, decision support), including clinician\-in\-the\-loop labeling and adjudication. Qualified applicants must not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States. **Compensation Information** ============================ The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $169,500\-$254500\+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits. years working directly with data science or machine learning teams on products shipped to real users in production environments. * Demonstrated track record of managing a roadmap and delivering data Value Realization:** Embed auditability, data lineage, least\-privilege access, and responsible AI guardrails into the context layer by design, tracking ROI through API cost reduction, task resolution lift, and operational risk mitigation. **Experience you’ll bring:** * **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical consumed by engineering teams. * **Technical Skills:** Deep understanding of applied generative AI and agentic systems, including advanced RAG, embeddings, chunking, metadata management, grounding, and context window assembly. * **Data Modeling \& SQL:** Strong experience working with structured enterprise data, relational models, certified metrics, and the failure modes of natural\-language querying over raw database schemas. * **Hands\-on Technical Depth:** Demonstrated comfort working directly with technical artifacts—inspecting retrieval traces, reading SQL query plans, reviewing JSON/YAML configurations, and executing API calls. * **AI Evaluation \& Benchmarking:** Proven track record of designing and running evaluation harnesses, golden benchmark datasets, error taxonomies, logging, and data privacy. * **Communication \& Influence:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with a demonstrated ability to align and influence global engineering, jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Platform (Remote)
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, AI Platform** (Remote) **Overview:** Weedmaps is hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** to build the AI systems our company runs on: the agents that do real engineering and operational work, and the "AI brain" that gives them trustworthy context about our business. You will work on an autonomous coding agent that picks up Jira tickets, opens pull requests and responds to review feedback; a shared platform (an internal MCP server) that gives every agent common skills, tools and processes; and a knowledge layer that connects our Snowflake semantic layer, internal documentation and a growing knowledge graph so agents and people get consistent answers. Success means agents that are measurably useful, cheap enough to run at scale, and safe to trust with production systems. This role sits on the AI Platform team and partners closely with Developer Experience, Data and product engineering teams across the company. **The impact you'll make:** * Design, build and operate production AI agents, including an autonomous coding agent that works from Jira and Slack, opens PRs, fixes its own CI failures and applies review feedback. * Build the retrieval and context layer behind our "AI brain": embeddings and semantic search, knowledge\-graph modeling, and integration with our Snowflake semantic layer and internal docs, so agents pull the right context in one pass instead of several. * Extend our internal MCP server with shared skills, tools and processes that other teams can reuse, and help product teams bring agents into their own workflows. * Own evaluation: build offline test sets and online metrics that show whether a change to a prompt, model or retrieval step made an agent better or worse, and gate releases on them. * Drive cost and latency down: route work to the cheapest model that can do it, use caching and structured outputs, and track spend per agent and per task on AWS Bedrock. * Harden agents against prompt injection, memory poisoning and over\-broad permissions: least\-privilege tool access, auditable actions, human approval where the risk warrants it. * Instrument agents with tracing and logging so failures can be diagnosed and fixed quickly, and take part in on\-call for the systems you own. * Evaluate new models and tools with a practical eye, adopting what holds up and passing on what doesn't. * Write clear design docs, review code, and mentor other engineers on building with LLMs. **What you've accomplished:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * Minimum of 6 years of professional software development experience, including owning production services end to end. * At least 1 year of hands\-on experience shipping LLM\-powered features or agents to production (not only prototypes): tool/function calling, prompt design, structured outputs, and handling model failures gracefully. * Experience building retrieval systems: embeddings, vector or hybrid search, chunking and ranking, and measuring retrieval quality. * Strong proficiency in at least one of Python, TypeScript or Ruby, and comfort working across a polyglot codebase. * Experience with a major cloud platform (AWS preferred), CI/CD, and observability tooling. * A track record of measuring what you build: evals, A/B tests or clear before/after metrics. **Bonus points:** * AWS Bedrock, and experience managing model cost and latency at scale. * Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or other agent tool frameworks. * Knowledge graphs or semantic layers (for example, Snowflake semantic views, dbt metrics or graph databases). * Agents that act on developer workflows: GitHub Actions, Jira and Slack integrations, automated code review or code generation. * LLM security: prompt\-injection defenses, sandboxing, permission models and red\-teaming. * Entity matching or classification at large scale (millions of records) using ML combined with LLM reasoning. * Experience with Ruby on Rails, Elixir or Node.js services. * Experience at a marketplace, e\-commerce or regulated\-industry company. *The base pay range for this position is $180,000\.00 \- $222,000\.00 per year, and a competitive bonus* **2026 US Benefits for Full Time, Regular Employees:** * Physical Health (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * + 100% employer\-paid premium for employees + Up to 80% coverage for dependents + Company HSA contribution with the High Deductible Health Plan * 401(k) Retirement Plan (employer will match contribution up to 3\.5% of employee contribution) * Basic Life, Voluntary Life and AD\&D Insurance options * Supplemental, voluntary benefits * + Student Loan Repayment/529 Education Savings with a monthly company contribution + FSA (Medical, Dependent, Transit and Parking) + Voluntary Life and AD\&D Insurance + Critical Illness Insurance + Accident Insurance + Short\- and Long\-term Disability Insurance + Pet Insurance + Identity theft protection + Legal access to a network of attorneys * PTO, paid sick leave, and company holidays (including a 2026 holiday shutdown) * Paid parental leave **Why Work at Weedmaps?** Life at Weedmaps means innovation and heart. Come join us if you care about the plant, the people who love it, and are ready to let your talent shine. We foster a bustling and collaborative culture that revolves around an environment that focuses on the benefits of weed, and the community that supports it. You too can have a hand in shaping the industry's future; ready to roll with us? See how we've grown—our journey, leadership team, and what's next atWeedmaps.com/corporate **About Weedmaps:** Founded in 2008, we've grown from a small startup to a global leader in the cannabis industry. Our dedication to transparency, education, and community has set us apart, and today, we proudly serve cannabis to consumers and businesses in the U.S. and worldwide. "Freedom to choose. Freedom to access. Freedom to enjoy." **Notice to prospective Weedmaps job applicants:** Our team has been made aware of incidents involving LinkedIn, Telegram, and Facebook accounts impersonating Weedmaps recruiters. These individuals are attempting to use our company name to solicit payment from prospective candidates interested in applying for jobs at our company. Our team is actively working to combat these attempts, but in the meantime, please be mindful of the following: * Our recruiters will always communicate with candidates through an @weedmaps.com email address. * CORRECT: jlebowski@weedmaps.com * INCORRECT: jlebowski@gmail.com * Our recruiters will NEVER ask for or attempt to solicit payment from applicants in order to apply, interview, or work for Weedmaps. * If you are interested in a role at Weedmaps, please apply through our established channels. * Weedmaps Careers Page or LinkedIn If you are unsure if a communication is legitimate, please contact our recruitment team at talentops@weedmaps.com and they will happily confirm for you. Thank you for your vigilance and we appreciate your interest in working with us! Weedmaps is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. The Company prohibits unlawful discrimination against employees or applicants based on race (including traits historically associated with race, such as hair texture and protective hairstyles), religion and religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, military status, veteran status, uniformed service member status, sexual orientation, transgender identity, citizenship status, pregnancy, or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws. jobs.title: Programmer Analyst 1
jobs.description: **Nature of Work** ------------------ The Tax Division is seeking an entry level application developer to join its I.T. Division. The chosen candidate will work with other developers, vendors, analysts, and end users in supporting, configuring, and developing applications for the integrated tax system (GenTax) and other Tax\-specific applications. Examples of work include but are not limited to: Writes code in visualbasic.net, asp.net, and SQL, and will be required to learn the GenTax tool sets. Works with a team of programmers and end users to determine the specifications and requirements for the solutions being designed and coded. Analyzes the business rules required to process State taxes, then code, configure, implement, and maintain those solutions and current processes as they relate to the application systems. May be required to write code that will support the data interfaces with multiple input sources and output destinations from within and outside of State government, and to support websites and web applications. Perform full system testing and prepare data flows, application flows, and system flows. Create system and user procedure documentation. Performs related work as required. The successful candidate should have some familiarity with asp.net, visualstudio.net, and SQL, and familiarity with working with relational databases such as SQL and Oracle as it pertains to using query statements for extracting ad hoc datasets. Experience with extensible markup language (XML) and XML Schema Preparation is desirable. The position will require the use of structured techniques and object\-oriented techniques in design and implementation. jobs.title: Senior Production Engineer
jobs.description: **Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!** --------------------------------------------- Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops. As a remote co\-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact. We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the \#1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce. **Role** -------- That growth is the reason this role exists. Production Engineers are software engineers who embed with product, platform, and infrastructure teams to find and fix what breaks at scale. We think of them as hunters: engineers who go looking for the anomaly, the bottleneck, the slow degradation nobody has noticed yet, and then own it through to a fix, working with whoever owns the system to make sure it stays fixed. Live video and real\-time commerce run on the same critical path here. Every auction is live and money moves during the show, so system behavior and business outcomes are tightly coupled in a way few platforms experience. Milliseconds are visible to buyers and sellers, and the signals that matter most are often small, concentrated in a specific cohort, and invisible in aggregate. Surfacing them early, and knowing which ones are worth acting on, is the core of this work. Production Engineers embed with a team and go deep on its systems, while staying accountable for what falls between teams. Some of the most consequential problems at our scale live in the seams, in the interaction between two services that each look healthy on their own, so we expect hunting both inside your area and across it. You'll be joining early, which means broader discovery across the platform before the embedding settles, and real influence over how Production Engineering takes shape here. What You'll Do: * Go deep with the team you embed with, raising the reliability, performance, and scalability of their systems alongside them and writing the code that gets it there. * Hunt anomalies across traffic, latency, error, and cost signals, both inside your area and in the seams between teams, and trace them to root cause across services, storage, and clients. * Connect operational signals to business impact: which degradations matter, for which cohorts, and which are safe to leave alone. * Work where the risk concentrates: payments, live video, search, the bidding path, and security. * Eliminate scale bottlenecks in production, then remove the class of problem rather than the instance. * Prepare for peak events through capacity modeling, load testing, and failure drills. * Improve observability where it's thin, so the next anomaly is found in minutes rather than quarters. * Put AI to work on operations: anomaly detection, on\-call assistance, remediation, toil reduction. Mostly greenfield, and yours to prove out. * Share on\-call with the team you embed with, and act as an escalation point for live production incidents. * Lead incident response for complex cross\-team failures and drive the systemic fixes that follow. **We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in\-person time for planning, problem\-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of our San Francisco or New York City hub.** **You** ------- People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they're building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it. As our next Production Engineer, you likely have: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience. * 6\+ years building and debugging production services at scale. You may have come to that through software engineering, production engineering, SRE, or systems engineering; what matters is the depth, not the title. * A software engineer's identity first, paired with a pull toward the messy end of production. You want to write code and build systems, and you're the one who notices the graph that looks slightly wrong and can't let it go. * Strong systems and distributed systems fundamentals: failure modes, saturation, queueing behavior, cascading failure, and how Linux, networking, and storage behave under load. * Depth in observability and production debugging, plus experience in one or more of: capacity and performance engineering, load and resilience testing, incident command, or large\-scale migrations under production constraints. * The ability to work well embedded. You can walk into another team's codebase, earn trust quickly, and leave the system better than you found it. * Fluency across languages and technologies, and comfort in cloud\-native environments such as AWS or GCP with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code. Our backend is primarily Python and Elixir, with Go for performance\-sensitive infrastructure, and we care more about depth and adaptability than a specific stack. * Bonus: high\-traffic, real\-time, event\-driven, or live streaming systems. **Benefits** ------------ * Flexible Time off Policy and Company\-wide Holidays (including a spring and winter break) * Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision * Work From Home Support + Home office setup allowance + Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet * Care benefits + Monthly allowance for wellness + Annual allowance towards Childcare + Lifetime benefit for family planning, such as adoption or fertility expenses * Retirement; 401k offering for Traditional and Roth accounts in the US (employer match up to 4% of base salary) and Pension plans internationally * Monthly allowance to dogfood the app + All Whatnauts are expected to develop a deep understanding of our product. We're passionate about building the best user experience, and all employees are expected to use Whatnot as both a buyer and a seller as part of their job (our dogfooding budget makes this fun and easy!). * Parental Leave + 16 weeks of paid parental leave \+ one month gradual return to work \*company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence. **Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.** **EOE** ------- Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce. Compensation Range: $207K \- $230K

You'll be joining early, which means broader discovery across the platform before the embedding settles, and real influence over how Production Engineering takes shape here. What You'll Do: * Go deep with the team you embed with, raising the reliability, performance, and scalability of their systems alongside them and writing the code that gets it there. * Hunt anomalies across traffic, latency, error, and cost signals, both inside your area and in the seams between teams, and trace them to root cause across services, storage, and clients. * Connect operational signals to business impact: which degradations matter, for which cohorts, and which are safe to leave alone. * Work where the risk concentrates: payments, live video, search, the bidding path, and security. * Eliminate scale bottlenecks in production, then remove the class of problem rather than the instance. * Prepare for peak events through capacity modeling, load testing, and failure drills. * Improve observability where it's thin, so the next anomaly is found in minutes rather than quarters. * Put AI to work on operations: anomaly detection, on\-call assistance, remediation, toil reduction. Mostly greenfield, and yours to prove out. * Share on\-call with the team you embed with, and act as an escalation point for live production incidents. * Lead incident response for complex cross\-team failures and drive the systemic fixes that follow. **We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in\-person time for planning, problem\-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of our San Francisco or New York City hub.** **You** ------- People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they're building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it. As our next Production Engineer, you likely have: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience. * 9\+ years building and debugging production services at scale. You may have come to that through software engineering, production engineering, SRE, or systems engineering; what matters is the depth, not the title. * A software engineer's identity first, paired with a pull toward the messy end of production. You want to write code and build systems, and you're the one who notices the graph that looks slightly wrong and can't let it go. * Strong systems and distributed systems fundamentals: failure modes, saturation, queueing behavior, cascading failure, and how Linux, networking, and storage behave under load. * Depth in observability and production debugging, plus experience in one or more of: capacity and performance engineering, load and resilience testing, incident command, or large\-scale migrations under production constraints. * The ability to work well embedded. You can walk into another team's codebase, earn trust quickly, and leave the system better than you found it. * Fluency across languages and technologies, and comfort in cloud\-native environments such as AWS or GCP with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code. Our backend is primarily Python and Elixir, with Go for performance\-sensitive infrastructure, and we care more about depth and adaptability than a specific stack. * Bonus: high\-traffic, real\-time, event\-driven, or live streaming systems. **Benefits** ------------ * Flexible Time off Policy and Company\-wide Holidays (including a spring and winter break) * Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision * Work From Home Support + Home office setup allowance + Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet * Care benefits + Monthly allowance for wellness + Annual allowance towards Childcare + Lifetime benefit for family planning, such as adoption or fertility expenses * Retirement; 401k offering for Traditional and Roth accounts in the US (employer match up to 4% of base salary) and Pension plans internationally * Monthly allowance to dogfood the app + All Whatnauts are expected to develop a deep understanding of our product. We're passionate about building the best user experience, and all employees are expected to use Whatnot as both a buyer and a seller as part of their job (our dogfooding budget makes this fun and easy!). * Parental Leave + 16 weeks of paid parental leave \+ one month gradual return to work \*company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence. **Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.** **EOE** ------- Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce. Compensation Range: $245K \- $290K

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Agentic Quoting Tools
jobs.description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to own that experience end to end. You sit between Sales and the quoting teams and you serve the customers who matter most to Xometry. Your job is to rethink how a request becomes a priced quote: every channel it can arrive through, every hand\-off between a person and a system, and every step that does not need a human at all. You will design the agents that read the request, build the quote, and propose the price, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations that let those agents work across our quoting systems and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform, and the staff tools where people review what the agents did and decide what they should not. The measure is simple: how fast, how accurately, and with how little effort our best customers get a quote they can act on. This role sits in the Pricing and Manufacturability (P\&M) group alongside the product managers for cost prediction, pricing, and Design for Manufacturability (DFM), and reports to the head of P\&M product. You will be given a metric and a problem space, not a fully scoped backlog. Comfort defining your own roadmap from ambiguous signals is a requirement, not a bonus. This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our Waltham, MA or North Bethesda, MD office location. **How You'll Contribute** * **Own the request\-to\-quote experience for our most important customers.** Map every path a quote request takes today, from the moment a customer emails, texts, uploads, or sends an agent, through Sales, quoting, pricing review, and back to the customer. Know the behind\-the\-scenes steps better than anyone outside the teams that run them. Remove the steps that do not need to exist. Your scorecard: quote turnaround time, cost per quote, quote accuracy, and quote\-to\-order conversion on the human\-assisted path. * **Redesign the funnel, not just the tools.** Treat each intake channel as a pathway with its own drop\-offs and its own fix. Decide where a request should be read by an agent, where it should be routed to a person, and where the customer should be able to self\-serve without either. Build the pathways so a request arrives structured, complete, and already half\-priced by the time a human sees it. * **Make agents do the work people should not have to.** Own the roadmap for agentic quoting: agents that read a request and its files and build the quote, assistants that propose margin and lead time, and automation that promotes human\-priced parts into the instant\-pricing engine over time. Decide what the agent does, what the human confirms, and what stays human. Define "good" and "failure" for every AI feature before engineering starts, and hold that bar through launch and after. * **Connect the agents to the business through MCP and the ERP.** Own the integration layer that lets agents and people exchange work across Salesforce, our quoting systems, file storage, and the ERP: Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, tool definitions, permissions, and the audit trail that shows who (or what) changed a quote and why. The exchange between humans and agents is a product surface; design it like one. * **Build the staff tools the quoting and sales teams actually use.** Own the internal quote review, pricing, and quote summary tools. Treat adoption as the product metric: a tool the team routes around has failed, regardless of what shipped. * **Instrument everything.** Every human pricing decision (override, margin change, lead\-time adjustment) becomes structured data that improves the next prediction and the next agent run. Write your own queries, build your own dashboards, and put the events you need into the requirements document, not into an analyst request. * **Run discovery continuously, not on a research calendar.** Sit with quoters and account managers. Read the inbound email and text queues. Watch session recordings. Synthesize the signal with AI tools and validate it against live customer and staff conversations before acting on it. A working prototype, tested with the people who will use it, is your default artifact for a build decision. * **Set product strategy and secure buy\-in.** Define a 6 to 12 month roadmap for agentic quoting, sequence it by customer impact and speed, and align Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Quoting Operations, and Finance behind it. Present progress against named outcomes to technical and non\-technical audiences. * **Build and ship with AI agents.** Operate spec\-first. Read the relevant systems with agentic tools, ask sharper feasibility questions as a result, and write specs that an engineer can h nd the customers it serves, in a B2B, marketplace, or enterprise context. * Evidence of shipping AI or automation into an expert human workflow with guardrails, and of knowing when not to automate. * Experience integrating products across systems of record (CRM, ERP, file storage, messaging), and a working understanding of how agents connect to those systems through tool protocols such as MCP. * Multi\-channel thinking: you have redesigned how requests enter a business (email, text, forms, APIs, agents) and can show the drop\-off you removed. * AI\-native practice, not just AI tool use: you can show where AI changed a decision your team made, not only where it saved you time. Hands\-on fluency with Cursor, Claude, or equivalent agentic tools, and a point of view on evaluating large language model (LLM) features before and after launch. * Strong analytical fluency: you write your own SQL, you have built your own dashboard, and you have caught a broken metric before it misled a decision. * Operational curiosity: you learn how a process actually runs by sitting with the people who run it, and you earn their trust before you change their tools. * Exceptional written communication: your documents let an operations lead, an engineer, and an executive act on the same page. * Comfort making decisions under ambiguity, translating a loosely defined problem into a testable hypothesis and a plan. * Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. **Signals we look for** * You can walk through a specific request\-to\-fulfillment funnel you redesigned across a sales team, a service team, and their customers: the channels involved, the steps you removed, the before and after numbers, and how adoption went. * You have built or owned an integration between an AI agent and a system of record, and you can explain what the agent was allowed to do, what it had to ask a human for, and how you knew when it was wrong. * You have shipped an AI or machine learning (ML) feature into a human\-in\-the\-loop process and can describe its evaluation criteria, its failure modes, and what you monitored after launch. * You can point to a case where your team decided differently because of an AI\-driven workflow you built (continuous customer signal, prototype\-first decisions, evaluation criteria written before build). * You have worked in manufacturing, supply chain, pricing, or quoting, or you can show how you learn an unfamiliar operational domain fast. **Pace** This is a startup pace inside a public company. You will be given a metric and an open problem, not a scoped project plan, and you will be expected to move quickly from hypothesis to shipped test. If you do your best work with a clear brief and a stable backlog, this is not the right role. **What Xometry Will Bring To You** * The base pay range for this role is \[insert range]. The total compensation package includes base, bonus and equity. * Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and vision insurance, generous paid time off, 401k match and more. The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $180,000\-$207,000 annually \+ bonus depending on factors such as job\-related skills, relevant experience, and location. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including 401(k) match, medical, dental and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays, maternity and bonding leave; EAP, other wellbeing resources; and much more. Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. ASIC Development and Design Implementation** * Participate in the ASIC development lifecycle from specification and microarchitecture through RTL design, verification, synthesis, physical implementation, and tape\-out. * Develop synthesizable, maintainable, and production\-quality RTL that meets design requirements. * Perform lint checks, clock\-domain crossing (CDC) analysis, and reset\-domain crossing (RDC) analysis. * Support logic synthesis, static timing analysis, and timing closure. * Work with physical design engineers to address timing, congestion, power, and area challenges. * Analyze and resolve functional and implementation issues identified during simulation, synthesis, and physical design. * Support silicon bring\-up, post\-silicon debugging, and validation activities as needed. **5\. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer II - Catalog
jobs.description: **For A Better You** At iHerb, we believe that living a healthy and balanced life should be easy and accessible to everyone. As a team member, we’ll empower you to live this promise each day as you make a truly global impact in your career. We constantly strive for innovation, while transforming and improving the online shopping experience for our customers. We believe that individually we are incredible, but when we come together, our growth is infinite. In an industry that is constantly evolving, we are on a mission to make an impact on the global market, and the individual and collaborative efforts of our people are paramount to helping us succeed. Whether you work in one of our logistics centers, technology hubs, corporate offices or even from home, your role at iHerb will take you beyond what’s expected, turning challenge into change. If you're ready for it, we want you to join our team. Get started now. **Job Summary:** The Sr. Software Engineer II \- Catalog will build and modernize iHerb's product catalog, one of the most business\-critical platforms in the company. You will work across the full stack: backend services, React frontend, and relational data layers. Our current backend is .NET/C\#; we also use Go, Python, and Java across the organization. **Job Expectations:** * Build and ship catalog features end\-to\-end: API design, business logic, data models, and React UI. * Use AI\-driven SDLC tooling such as Claude Code as a core part of your daily workflow, including code generation, spec\-to\-code translation, and automated test creation. * Participate in the catalog modernization effort, working on the new stack in parallel with the existing platform. * Write and maintain automated tests; quality is built in, not handed off. * Review pull requests, maintain code standards, and contribute improvements to the shared golden path. * Collaborate with product and design to refine specs before and during implementation. * Instrument services with logging, metrics, and alerts; participate in on\-call rotation and own incident response for catalog services. The duties and responsibilities described above may provide only a partial description of this position. This is not an exhaustive list of all aspects of the job. Other duties and responsibilities not outlined in this document may be added as necessary or desirable, with or without notice. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** **Required:** * AI\-driven SDLC : hands\-on experience shipping production code with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor. The bar is not awareness; it is daily use in delivering real software. * Full\-stack awareness: comfortable contributing across layers of the stack when needed; purely single\-layer specialists are not the target profile. * Production ownership: experience owning features end\-to\-end from spec through deployment, observability, and on\-call. Engineers here own what they ship; there is no separate ops handoff. * Code quality fundamentals: strong grasp of software design principles, automated testing, code review, and CI/CD. * Backend development proficiency in one or more of: C\#/.NET, Go, Python, Java. .NET/C\# is the primary stack today. * Proficiency in React or equivalent modern frontend framework. * Proficiency in Relational database experience with MS SQL Server or Postgres. * Proficiency in REST API design and microservice patterns. * High degree of accuracy and attention to detail * Excellent organization skills and ability to multi\-task **Preferred:** * Contributions to internal developer tooling, golden path standards, or SDLC process improvements. * Experience with e\-commerce platforms, product catalogs, or high\-traffic consumer applications. * Experience working in globally distributed teams. * Track record of documenting architectural decisions, writing RFCs, or contributing to engineering wikis. **Equipment Knowledge:** * Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) * Experience with Google Business Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Forms) preferred **Experience Requirements:** Generally requires a minimum of 10\+ years of software engineering experience. **Education Requirements:** Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field preferred, or a combination of education and equivalent work experience. **Judgment/Reasoning Ability:** Able to identify, troubleshoot and resolve problems quickly using sound judgment, poise and diplomacy. Ability to use judgment and reasoning skills, and determine when to escalate issues, as required, in a timely manner. **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to talk and hear. The Team Member is frequently required to sit, walk, climb stairs, use hands and fingers, bend, stoop and reach with hands and arms. Reaching above shoulder heights, below the waist or lifting as required to file documents or store materials throughout the work day. The Team Member may occasionally lift or move office products and supplies up to 25 pounds. Proper lifting techniques required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Work Environment:** The noise in the work environment is usually moderate. Other factors are: * Hectic, fast\-paced with multi\-level distractions * Professional, yet casual work environment * Office / Warehouse environment * Ability to work extended hours as required \#LI\-JC1 **Compensation**: The expected salary range for this role is $187,000\.00 \- $235,000\.00 USD. The actual base pay offered will be determined by factors such as the candidate's relevant experience, education, geographic location, and internal equity. If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us! **Staffing Agency Submission Notice** iHerb does not accept unsolicited 3rd party ("Agency") candidates. If you are an Agency, please send any requests to be considered as a supplier in our Vendor Management System to staffingvendors@iherb.com. Do not contact iHerb employees directly. If requested to work on a role, any Agency candidates would be presented through the internal recruiting organization. iHerb is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status. iHerb provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment.

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description: We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Junior Software Developer to join our dynamic team. You will help design, develop, and support internal applications and automations that underpin core operations, streamline workflows, and enable data\-driven decision\-making. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in a collaborative environment and is eager to drive innovation in day\-to\-day processes. Ideal for an early\-career developer, this role offers broad exposure across software development, automation, and data analytics while delivering real operational impact. **POSITION SUMMARY** The Junior Software Developer supports the design, development, and maintenance of internal applications, automations, and data solutions that improve business operations. This role works closely with management and operations teams to streamline processes, support end users, and deliver data\-driven insights while gaining experience across software development, automation, and analytics. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot internal applications and software solutions. * Create and support automation scripts to improve operational efficiency. * Develop and maintain integrations between business systems, databases, and manufacturing platforms. * Write and optimize SQL queries, reports, and data extracts. * Analyze operational data to identify trends and support business decisions. * Provide technical support and troubleshoot software\-related issues for end users. * Test, debug, and document applications to ensure reliability and performance. * Maintain technical documentation, system procedures, and user guides. * Support data security, system integrity, and cybersecurity best practices. * Collaborate with operations and management teams to identify and implement process improvements. * Assist with application maintenance, updates, and incident resolution. * Perform other duties as assigned. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** This position operates in a professional office environment while regularly supporting employees and systems throughout the manufacturing facility. The Junior Software Developer works closely with operations, production, and management teams to support business applications, troubleshoot system issues, and implement process improvements. The role involves a combination of computer\-based work, collaboration with end users, and occasional time spent in production and warehouse areas to support software, hardware, and operational systems. Employees may be exposed to manufacturing noise, equipment, and warehouse conditions while supporting facility\-wide technology needs.

jobs.title: ReRAM Memory and AI Development Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a ReRAM Memory and AI Development Engineer to advance resistive random\-access memory (ReRAM) technology and develop AI\-enabled solutions that improve semiconductor engineering productivity and technical capability. The role combines hands\-on ReRAM technology development with the broader application of machine learning, generative AI, physics\-informed AI, and AI agents across semiconductor engineering. The successful candidate will bridge semiconductor device knowledge, data science, AI/ML, EDA, and software development to turn new concepts into practical engineering solutions. * Responsibilities * ReRAM Technology Development * Develop and characterize ReRAM technology, including SET/RESET behavior, resistance distributions, variability, endurance, reliability, and operating margins. * Develop device, statistical, and behavioral models linking ReRAM characteristics to circuit and system requirements. * Analyze device and array data to support technology optimization, design enablement, and reliability assessment. * Collaborate with process integration, device, modeling, design, reliability, and test teams to advance ReRAM technology. Evaluate ReRAM for embedded memory, compute\-in\-memory, and other emerging applications. * AI\-Enabled Engineering * Develop and deploy AI solutions to improve engineering productivity, technical capability, and decision\-making across semiconductor development, not limited to ReRAM * Apply machine learning, generative AI, physics\-informed AI, and AI agents to engineering problems such as: Device and process modeling Engineering data analysis and visualization Simulation and design\-space exploration EDA and design automation Model generation and optimization Technical knowledge retrieval and synthesis Engineering workflow, documentation, and repetitive\-task automation * Identify high\-value opportunities where AI can reduce manual effort, accelerate analysis, or enable new engineering capabilities. * Prototype emerging AI technologies and transition successful concepts into practical tools for engineering teams. * Promote effective AI adoption through technical collaboration, demonstrations, documentation, and knowledge sharing. * Qualifications * Ph.D. or advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Physics, Computer Science, or a related field. Strong foundation in semiconductor devices, memory technologies, EDA, or semiconductor engineering. Experience with machine learning, deep learning, and scientific computing. Strong Python programming skills and experience with frameworks such as PyTorch or equivalent. Experience developing data\-driven or physics\-informed engineering models. Ability to translate semiconductor engineering challenges into modeling, AI, software, or automation solutions. Strong cross\-functional communication and technical problem\-solving skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with ReRAM or other emerging memory technologies, including device characterization, modeling, variability, endurance, or reliability. Experience with physics\-informed machine learning, generative AI, probabilistic modeling, LLMs, or AI agents. Experience with semiconductor EDA and simulation tools such as Cadence Virtuoso, Synopsys Custom Compiler, Sentaurus TCAD, HSPICE, or Verilog\-A. Experience with compute\-in\-memory, memory\-aware AI, or neural\-network quantization. Experience developing reusable engineering automation, analysis, or AI software tools. About Us **onsemi** (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end\-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world’s most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world. More details about our company benefits can be found here: https://www.onsemi.com/careers/career\-benefits About the Team We are committed to sourcing, attracting, and hiring high\-performance innovators, while providing all candidates a positive recruitment experience that builds our brand as a great place to work. **onsemi** is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, or local laws. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Talent.acquisition@onsemi.com for assistance.

jobs.description: **Job Description: Senior Forescout Engineer (OCONUS \- Hawaii)** ================================================================= Location: Honolulu, HI Employment Type: Full\-Time**About SERVISS** ----------------- At SERVISS, we deliver cutting\-edge cybersecurity and IT solutions to government and commercial clients, with a mission to secure systems, data, and critical infrastructure through innovation and expertise. We don’t just deploy tools; we engineer mission platforms that become foundational systems of record for cyber operations, compliance automation, and national cyber readiness. From DHS CISA to DoW mission enclaves, our work shapes how government sees, governs, and defends its digital terrain. matter expert responsible for engineering, deploying, maintaining, and optimizing Forescout solutions across complex Department of Defense (DoD) enterprise environments. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
