compliance across multiple networks and security domains. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ This position is primarily on\-site, with some remote flexibility. Occasional travel may be required to support C2C deployments at Army installations within the continental United States (CONUS) and outside the continental United States (OCONUS). ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ **The Work** ------------ This is a hands\-on senior engineering role. The selected candidate will: ------------------------------------------------------------------------- * Engineer, deploy, configure, integrate, and sustain Forescout NAC and C2C solutions across U.S. Army enterprise networks. * Provide advanced technical support for C2C implementations across multiple DoD networks and classification domains. * Design and optimize network access control policies, endpoint discovery, device classification, and compliance enforcement. * Integrate Forescout capabilities with enterprise networking, cybersecurity, and endpoint management technologies. * Monitor platform health, performance, availability, and operational effectiveness, including tuning, alerting, and reporting. * Troubleshoot complex network connectivity, authentication, policy enforcement, and systems integration issues. * Identify, assess, and support remediation of findings associated with DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs). * Develop and maintain technical documentation, network architecture diagrams, deployment procedures, and operational processes. * Recommend architectural and operational improvements that enhance scalability, reliability, security, and performance. * Collaborate with Army stakeholders, defensive cyber operators, incident responders, and other mission partners to resolve technical challenges. * Prepare technical reports, operational status up r. We want a Forescout subject matter expert who understands how to translate complex cybersecurity requirements into reliable, operationally effective solutions. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The ideal candidate is technically accomplished, proactive, collaborative, and comfortable working directly with military and civilian stakeholders. You should enjoy solving challenging technical problems, improving existing architectures, and helping mission partners achieve measurable cybersecurity outcomes. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Above all, we value engineers who take ownership, deliver exceptional results, and recognize the importance of the missions they support. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Compensation** ---------------- SERVISS offers a highly competitive compensation and benefits package designed to attract exceptional engineering talent. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- * **Base Salary:** Starting at $165,000 annually, with higher compensation available based on experience, technical expertise, and qualifications. * **Signing Bonus:** Up to $10,000 for qualified candidates. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and the requirements of the position ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Freedom to Thrive. ================== Why Join SERVISS? Our goal as an employer is simple yet profound: to create an environment where you can be your best self, pursue your passions, and enjoy the freedom to thrive both personally and professionally. Your success is our success, and we're committed to supporting you every step of the way. * Highly competitive compensation and best in class benefits * 100% of medical, vision, dental, and life insurance premiums paid for by SERVISS * 401(k) retirement plan with 6% dollar for dollar match * Be part of an exciting company with ground floor opportunities in the SERVISS STARS long\-term incentive equity program * Opportunities for annual performance bonuses and growth incentives * Incentive bonuses for earning advanced technology and professional certifications ***Additional considerations for HUBZone resident applicants:*** *Preference may be given to applicants residing in a federal HUBZone in support of SERVISS LLC’s HUBZone workforce objectives; all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ***How to determine HUBZone residency:*** *Candidates can verify HUBZone eligibility by entering their home address into the SBA HUBZone Map at* *https://maps.certify.sba.gov/hubzone/map**. If your residence falls within a designated HUBZone area on the map, you are considered a HUBZone resident for hiring preference purposes.* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- OSJk25Wp3e

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Python/FastAPI)
jobs.description: **About Us:** Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high\-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P\&L. **Ideal Background:** This role is ideal for engineers who have built production systems at companies like Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Meta, or similar high\-scale engineering organizations. We especially welcome graduates from top computer science programs such as Stanford, MIT, Carnegie Mellon, UC Berkeley, Georgia Tech, and comparable institutions — though exceptional experience and skill always take precedence over pedigree. **Project Overview:** As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting\-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections — with a primary focus on Python across backend services, data pipelines, and ML infrastructure, alongside JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C\+\+, Java, Rust, and Go. You will evaluate and refine AI\-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability, and work with cross\-functional teams to enhance enterprise\-level AI\-driven coding solutions. **What Does a Typical Day Look Like?*** Work on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in Python, with additional work in JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C\+\+, Java, Rust, and Go. * Evaluate and refine AI\-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance AI\-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks. * Build agents and automated verification tools in Python that can verify the quality of code and identify error patterns. * Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them. * Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task. **Required Skills:*** Several years of software engineering experience (3 years or more). * Strong expertise in Python with deep knowledge of frameworks, tooling, and best practices for building production\-grade software. * Experience building full\-stack applications and deploying scalable software using modern languages and tools. * Deep understanding of software architecture, design, development, debugging, and code quality/review assessment. * Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales. **Engagement Details:*** Commitment: flexible engagement, minimum 10 hrs/week, up to 40 hrs/week. * Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave). * Duration: 1 month (potential extensions based on performance and fit). * Location: Candidates must be based in the United States. **Evaluation Process:*** The application process takes 15–30 minutes. * Completion of an AI video interview is required.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Evaluation Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Turing** ================ Turing's mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high\-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest\-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end\-to\-end agentic AI systems inside mission\-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real\-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com. **Senior Software Engineer, AI Evaluation Infrastructure** ========================================================== We build the infrastructure that frontier AI labs use to evaluate coding agents and language models: benchmark datasets, agent evaluation runs at scale, and automated task quality checks. You would own features across the stack, from the data model and background jobs to the screens our users work in every day. This is a role for an experienced engineer who works independently, makes sound tradeoffs, and turns a loosely defined request into something shipped, tested, and safe to leave alone. **What you will do** -------------------- * Design and ship features end to end: data model, API, background workers, and the UI when the change needs it. * Build and improve how agents and models are evaluated: running trials in sandboxed environments, scoring results, and turning thousands of runs into results people can trust. * Improve how benchmark tasks are quality\-checked: verifiers, rubric\-based and LLM\-as\-a\-judge grading, and deciding whether a task is clear, solvable, and fair to score. * Integrate new models, agents, and benchmarks in a way that generalizes, without a special case for each one. * Keep the system fast and reliable as usage grows: efficient queries, safe migrations, and concurrency that holds up under load. * Review teammates' pull requests against our engineering guidelines and help keep the codebase consistent. **What you bring** ------------------ * 5\+ years building and operating production backend systems, with ownership of at least one service from design through on\-call. * Bachelor's degree or higher in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * Strong Python and experience with Django (or a similar framework), PostgreSQL, and a task queue such as Celery. What matters most is having run a real system, not knowing a particular framework. * Hands\-on experience in LLM evaluation, beyond calling a model API. You understand how a benchmark task is built, how an agent trial is scored, and how results are aggregated and compared. Experience with Harbor, Terminal\-Bench, SWE\-bench, Inspect, or a similar harness is a strong plus. * Judgment about task quality. You can spot ambiguous instructions, weak or gameable verifiers, leaked answers, and checks that pass for the wrong reason. * Good tradeoffs. You reach for the smallest design that solves the problem, extend what already exists before adding something new, and can explain what you chose not to build. * Ownership. You take a fuzzy request, find the relevant code, ask questions only when the answer changes the design, and finish the job, including migrations, tests, and edge cases users will hit. * Quick adoption of team conventions. You read the written guidelines and your first pull requests already match them in naming, structure, tests, and error handling. * Comfort with a TypeScript and React frontend when a change is visible there. You don't need to be a frontend specialist. * Clear writing. Your pull request descriptions and design notes explain why, not just what. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience running agents in sandboxed or containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud sandboxes such as Modal or Daytona). * Experience with LLM\-as\-a\-judge or rubric\-based grading, and with reducing judge bias and noise. * Familiarity with coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or OpenHands, and with MCP. * Experience with distributed job scheduling, concurrency limits, or database locking at scale. * Contributions to open\-source evaluation or infrastructure projects. **How we work** --------------- * Written engineering guidelines, applied consistently, with the same review bar for everyone. * Business logic lives in services. Hot paths stay cheap. Lint and tests pass before a pull request is ready. * The same vocabulary in the code, the API, and the UI. * We prefer deleting code to adding it, and simple designs to clever ones. A strong first month looks like several changes merged with light review, and one area of the system you can change confidently without a guide. **Compensation:** $170,000 \- $200,000 Base Salary \+ Equity \#LI\-VC1 **Values** ---------- * **We are client first:** We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. * **We work at Start\-Up Speed:** We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection * **We are AI forward:** We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity. **Advantages of joining Turing** -------------------------------- * **Work at the frontier of AI**, helping the world's leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first\-of\-a\-kind benchmarks. * **Contribute to leading\-edge AI research** and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS. * **Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise**, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real\-world business challenges. * **Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues** with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies. * **Move at the pace of AI innovation**, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us:** Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. **Turing supports customers in two ways:** first, by accelerating frontier research with high\-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P\&L. **Project Overview:** As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting\-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections in Python, JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C\+\+, Java, Rust, and Go; evaluating and refining AI\-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability; and working with cross\-functional teams to enhance enterprise\-level AI\-driven coding solutions. **What Does a Typical Day Look Like?*** Working on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code in Python, JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C\+\+, Java, Rust, and Go. * Evaluate and refine AI\-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance AI\-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks. * Build agents that can verify the quality of the code and identify error patterns. * Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them. * Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task. **Required Skills:*** 3\+ years of software engineering experience. * Strong expertise in building full\-stack applications and deploying scalable, production\-grade software using modern languages and tools. * Deep understanding of software architecture, design, development, debugging, and code quality/review assessment. * Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales. **Engagement Details:*** **Commitment**: flexible engagement, minimum 10 hrs/week, up to 40 hrs/week (partial PST overlap required). * **Type**: Contractor (no medical/paid leave). * **Duration**: 1 month (starting next week; potential extensions based on performance and fit). * **Location:** Candidates must be based out of US, Canada or WEU countries (UK, Netherlands, Italy, Germany). **Note:** As part of assessments you will go through an AI video interview. **After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.**

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Python/Typescript
jobs.description: ### **About Turing** Turing is one of the world’s leading AGI infrastructure companies, working with frontier AI labs to accelerate model development through high\-quality training data, evaluations, and engineering talent.### **About the Role** We’re looking for experienced, hands\-on software engineers to help **evaluate and improve AI coding models**. Rather than primarily building production applications, you’ll work with coding agents across real\-world repositories and assess the quality of their work. You’ll review generated code and agent behavior, determine whether solutions are technically correct, identify failure modes, and create the evaluation signals and feedback used to improve model performance. **Think of the coding agent as another engineer whose work you’re reviewing:** Can it understand the task? Did it choose the right approach? Is the resulting code correct, robust, and maintainable? Can you explain precisely where it succeeded or failed?### **What You’ll Do** * Evaluate AI\-generated code and solutions across real\-world software repositories * Review agent behavior, tool usage, and code changes for correctness and quality * Identify technical errors, weak approaches, and recurring model failure modes * Compare model outputs and explain why one solution is better than another * Create and refine rubrics and evaluation criteria for coding tasks * Produce high\-quality evaluation and preference data used to improve coding models * Build and maintain pipelines and infrastructure supporting data generation, collection, and evaluation workflows * Synthesize findings from data work into clear write\-ups, updates, and recommendations for the team * Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers to translate qualitative judgment into scalable processes * Share clear, actionable findings with AI researchers and engineers ### **What We’re Looking For** * **5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience** * Strong proficiency in **Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or another major production language** * Experience working in substantial real\-world codebases * Strong code\-review skills and technical judgment * Ability to clearly explain why an implementation is correct, incorrect, or could be improved * Strong written communication * Experience using modern LLMs or AI coding tools Experience with **LLM evaluation, coding agents, RLHF, preference data, rubric design, or post\-training** is a plus, but not required.### **Engagement Details** * **Compensation:** Market rate; please provide a specific hourly rate expectation * **Availability:** 40 hours/week preferred, with at least 6 hours of Pacific Time overlap * **Type:** Independent contractor * **Duration:** Approximately 3 months * **Start:** As soon as possible * **Location:** North America, LATAM, or India ### **Evaluation Process** * AI interview (\~25 minutes) * Practical code/AI evaluation exercise (\~30 minutes) * Hiring manager interview (\~20 minutes) The practical exercise focuses on your ability to **review and evaluate AI\-generated code**, not competitive programming or algorithm puzzles.

jobs.title: Video Production Applications Systems Administrator
jobs.description: **Job Summary** The Production Applications System Administrator serves as a subject matter expert coordinating between live production, creative teams, and IT infrastructure within the U.S. Department of State’s Bureau of Global Public Affairs (GPA), Office of Video Production (GPA/DC/VID). This role is responsible for supporting pre\- and post\-production application ecosystems, and delivering specialized, high\-touch desk\-side and remote technical support to creatives primarily operating in a macOS environment. The engineer ensures seamless interoperability between on\-premise video editing environments and cloud infrastructures, leads patching and release management, enforces strict Department cybersecurity standards, and directly supports key software suites including Adobe Creative Cloud, Frame.io, and Google Workspace. In the event of network outage, serves as “first responder” on behalf of end users and liaises with the Engineering unit to resume normal operations. **Primary Responsibilities** * **macOS \& Creative Application Desk\-Side Support** + Provide direct desk\-side and remote technical support to editors, producers, and creative staff operating on macOS workstations + Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve application\-level incidents involving Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Audition), Frame.io integration, Maxon plugin tools, Google Workspace, Splashtop Remote access tools, and working with the producer\\editors in creating media based workflows + User management for all accounts by adding and removing users access permission on all GPA platforms to include but not limited to, Active Directory, Adobe Creative Cloud, Maxon, NAS connectivity, and tools provided to limited users for specific use + Manage workstation image deployment, application installation, plugin configurations, and driver updates tailored for high\-performance video rendering and editing environments + Manage testing of all updates and hardware modifications prior to deployment to users + Manage the test environment to replicate current and proposed configurations + Respond rapidly to user trouble tickets during normal and surge operational windows to ensure uninterrupted broadcast and post\-production workflows * **System Maintenance, Patching \& Asset Management** + Oversee regular maintenance, operating system patching, licensing, and updating of NAS servers and production LAN components + Ensure proper maintenance of host names, device certificates, and network connectivity between local editing hardware and cloud storage solutions + Support the Network Engineering Unit with all network activities to include naming conventions, IP addressing (static and DHCP), and connection of devices such as printers, scanners, and camera accessories. OSI (Open Systems Interconnection) model familiarization and competency in layers 1 through 4 + Enforce production asset management best practices for tracking, organizing, versioning, and archiving frequently changing digital media assets + Systems configuration management and tagging of all GPA Video assets. + Entering equipment information into CheqRoom for management of location and user assignment + Maintain uninterrupted power supplies with battery replacement and complete unit replacement and schedule disposition + Ensure all local and cloud systems strictly adhere to Department of State IT security directives, vulnerability remediations, and cloud computing policies (5 FAM 1100\) * **Modernization, Research \& Surge Support** + Conduct research, testing, and implementation of new media tools, scripts, automated workflows, and software subscriptions not currently deployed in production + Provide expert advice to Video Office leadership regarding future technology investments, hardware replacements, and infrastructure planning + Assist during emergency live\-broadcast events or high\-priority initiatives requiring surge support, overnight support, or weekend availability **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * **Minimum Professional Experience** + Experience: Minimum of 3\-5 years of dedicated experience in Windows, Linux and MAC OS computer systems administration, desktop technology support, and specialized video application support + Minimum Education Experience: Bachelors in IT, Computer Science, Engineering or related field. Industry Certifications are a plus * **Technical \& Platform Expertise** + macOS Environment: Expert\-level desktop administration and troubleshooting for Apple macOS hardware and operating systems in a professional media network environment + Application Ecosystem: Working knowledge/familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud applications, Frame.io review/approval tools, Google Workspace, and broadcast asset management tools + Cloud \& Storage Systems: Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based architectures, Amazon Web Services (AWS S3, EC2 instances), and active directory federation + Networking \& Security: Practical knowledge of network firewalls, VLAN configurations, SSL/device certificates, and IT security compliance protocols * **Leadership \& Soft Skills** + Strong leadership, team\-oriented attitude, and willingness to train and mentor video editors, producers, and junior technical staff + Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to articulate complex technical workflows to creative staff and government stakeholders **Physical Requirements** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times
